title: Updating a Discrete Morse Vector Field for a Lower Star Filtration Vineyard
summary: In this paper, we provide a construction of an acyclic discrete vector field that is compatible with a total order associated with a lower star filtration on a simplicial complex, called the colex vector field. We show that the colex vector field induces a filtered acyclic vector field, whose resulting Morse complex computes the persistent homology of the lower star filtration on the underlying simplicial complex. We show that the colex vector field can be recomputed quickly when the vertex function that induces the lower star filtration is modified via order-adjacent vertex swaps. We provide a framework for storing and computing the number of paths between cells in the simplicial complex, as well as a method to update these values quickly when the colex vector field changes. Finally, we provide publicly available proof-of-concept code for the ideas shown. When applying it to the Persistent Homology Transform, we show that its runtime is comparable to a more standard matrix reduction approach.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一种与低星滤流相关的全序相容的无环离散向量场（colex向量场），证明其诱导的过滤无环向量场对应的Morse复形可计算持久同调，并给出在顶点函数经相邻交换修改时的快速重算方法及路径计数存储与更新框架。
AI.motivation: 持久同调的标准矩阵约简方法在顶点函数频繁变化时需大量重算，效率较低。作者希望借助离散Morse理论构造一种可快速更新的向量场结构，从而高效计算低星滤流的持久同调。
AI.method: 构造与低星滤流全序相容的无环离散向量场——colex向量场；证明其诱导过滤无环向量场并使Morse复形计算持久同调；在顶点函数经顺序相邻交换修改时快速重算该向量场；建立存储与计算单纯复形中胞腔间路径数的框架，并在colex向量场变化时快速更新这些值；提供公开的概念验证代码。
AI.result: colex向量场诱导的过滤无环向量场对应的Morse复形可正确计算低星滤流的持久同调；该向量场在顶点函数经顺序相邻交换修改时可快速重算；路径计数的存储与快速更新框架有效。应用于持久同调变换时，运行时间与更标准的矩阵约简方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 所提colex向量场框架为低星滤流持久同调提供了一种可快速更新的离散Morse理论计算方法，其运行时与矩阵约简相当，代码已公开，展示了作为替代方案的可行性。

title: Transfer systems on trees and opposite posets
summary: We study transfer systems on partially ordered sets whose Hasse diagrams are rooted trees. We prove there is a bijection between transfer systems on a tree and order-preserving functions to the natural numbers that are bounded by the rank function. We then develop a recurrence for the set of functions and use this to enumerate transfer systems on some families of trees. In addition to our study of trees, we prove for any finite poset $\mathcal{P}$, the lattice of transfer systems on the opposite poset $\mathcal{P}^{op}$ is isomorphic to the opposite lattice of transfer systems on $\mathcal{P}$. We show this by establishing a bijection between weak factorization systems and transfer systems, which builds on the results for lattices shown in previous work of Franchere, Ormsby, Osorno, Qin, and Waugh.

AI.tldr: 研究Hasse图为有根树的部分序集上的transfer system，证明其与有界保序函数之间的双射，给出递推并枚举若干树族；同时证明任意有限偏序集的对偶偏序集上的transfer system格与其对偶格同构。
AI.motivation: transfer system是代数拓扑与同伦论中刻画代数结构（如E∞结构、operad代数）的重要组合工具，但在一般偏序集上的计数与结构尚不清楚。作者希望针对Hasse图为有根树这一特殊但自然的偏序集类，建立可计算的组合描述，并揭示transfer system与weak factorization system之间的深层对应。
AI.method: 对Hasse图为有根树的部分序集，构造transfer system与有界保序函数（上界为rank函数）之间的双射；基于该双射给出函数集合的递推关系，用于枚举若干树族上的transfer system。同时，对任意有限偏序集P，通过建立weak factorization system与transfer system的双射，证明P^{op}上的transfer system格与P上transfer system格的对偶同构。
AI.result: 得到树形偏序集上transfer system与有界保序函数的一一对应，并导出计数递推及部分树族的枚举结果；证明对任意有限偏序集P，transfer system格满足对偶同构关系，即L(P^{op}) ≅ L(P)^{op}。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为树形偏序集上的transfer system提供了组合刻画与枚举方法，并将其与weak factorization system联系起来，推广了已有格上的结果，为更一般偏序集上的transfer system结构研究提供了新工具与视角。

title: On the hit problem of rank five
summary: Let $P_q$ be the graded polynomial algebra $\mathbb F_2[x_1,x_2,\ldots ,x_q]$ over the prime field of two elements, $\mathbb F_2$, with the degree of each $x_i$ being 1. We study the {\it hit Peterson problem} of finding a minimal set of generators for $P_q$ as a module over the mod-$2$ Steenrod algebra, $\mathcal{A}.$ In this note, we present the minimal sets of $\mathcal{A}$-generators for $P_5$ in the cases where the degree are sufficiently general.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模2 Steenrod代数 $\mathcal{A}$ 下多项式代数 $P_q$ 的 "hit Peterson problem"，即寻找 $P_q$ 作为 $\mathcal{A}$-模的极小生成元集。作者给出了 $P_5$ 在度数充分一般情形下的 $\mathcal{A}$-极小生成元集。
AI.motivation: 寻找多项式代数 $P_q$ 作为模2 Steenrod代数 $\mathcal{A}$ 上模的极小生成元集（hit Peterson problem）是该领域的核心问题。此前 $P_q$ 的极小生成元集已知在一般度数下对较小 $q$ 有结果，本文将结果推进到 $q=5$ 的一般度数情形。
AI.method: 在 $\mathbb F_2$ 上考虑分次多项式代数 $P_q=\mathbb F_2[x_1,\dots,x_q]$（各 $x_i$ 次数为1），以模2 Steenrod代数 $\mathcal{A}$ 为作用代数，针对 $q=5$ 且度数充分一般的情形，确定其 $\mathcal{A}$-极小生成元集。
AI.result: 给出了 $P_5$ 在度数充分一般情形下的 $\mathcal{A}$-极小生成元集。
AI.conclusion: 本文推进了 hit Peterson problem 的结果，明确了 $P_5$ 在充分一般度数下的极小 $\mathcal{A}$-生成元集。

title: A data structure for quotient flag complexes
summary: Vietoris-Rips filtrations, which are standard in topological data analysis, are flag complexes, and a simplex tree stores these without any attaching data. In this paper we ask what survives of this economy when a flag complex $K$ is divided by a subcomplex $A$, each connected component of $A$ being crushed to a point. Such a quotient is a CW complex whose cells are the simplices of $K\setminus A$, but their attaching maps are no longer implicit. We show that for flag $K$ the face order of the quotient is strictly graded exactly when $A$ is flag, and that the surviving labelled cells are determined by those of dimension at most 3. For $m$-flag pairs the threshold is $2m+1$, and it drops to $m+2$ when $K$ is flag. The prescribed cells form a regular CW decomposition only when $A$ is full in $K$. These results justify the QF-tree: a cell table that stores, for each surviving simplex, its ordered list of $d+1$ facets with collapsed facets flagged, indexed by a trie of quotient-vertex words. For bounded dimension its size is linear in the number of surviving simplices plus the retained provenance, and we derive and verify a simple formula for the collapsed fraction above which it is smaller than the homotopy-equivalent cone model. Because a collapse changes the attaching data only on the closed star of $A$, the QF-tree can also be applied locally inside a simplex tree. For a ball-shaped $A$ in the sampled Vietoris--Rips regime the closed star is a thin shell, and the median compact budget is below the cone model at every sampled radius. An accompanying library, modelled on Gudhi, implements the QF-tree, its local variant, an editable layer with local quotient updates, gluing, disc attachment, induced maps, cup products, fundamental-group presentations and zigzag persistence, and provided experiments separate the cost of maintaining a quotient from the cost of the algebra computed on it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旗复形被其子复形商掉后能否保持单纯树式的经济存储，提出并论证 QF-tree 数据结构，证明其适用条件与规模界，并在 Vietoris–Rips 场景中验证其优于锥模型。
AI.motivation: Vietoris–Rips 滤流以旗复形为基础，单纯树可无需附着数据地存储它们；但当旗复形 K 被连通分支被压成点的子复形 A 商掉后，得到的是附着映射不再隐式的 CW 复形。本文旨在刻画这种商复形中"哪些经济性得以保留"，为高效存储与计算提供理论基础。
AI.method: 引入 QF-tree：以胞腔表形式存储每个存活单形及其 d+1 个有序面，标记被塌缩的面，并用商顶点词的 trie 索引；定义并研究 m-flag 对、面序严格分次、正则 CW 分解等概念，给出局部商更新、黏合、圆盘附着、诱导映射、上积、基本群表示与 zigzag 持续同调等操作，并配套仿 Gudhi 的库实现。
AI.result: 证明：对旗复形 K，商的面序严格分次当且仅当 A 为旗；存活标号胞腔由维数 ≤3 的胞腔决定；m-flag 对的阈值为 2m+1，当 K 为旗时降为 m+2；仅当 A 在 K 中满时，指定胞腔才构成正则 CW 分解。给出 QF-tree 在有限维下规模为存活单形数加保留来源的线性界，并推导、验证其小于同伦等价的锥模型的塌缩比例公式；对球状 A 在采样 VR 情形下，闭星为薄壳，各采样半径下中位紧致预算均低于锥模型。
AI.conclusion: QF-tree 为旗复形商提供了紧凑且可局部嵌入单纯树的表示，其规模与适用性由 A 的旗性与维数阈值精确刻画；实验区分了维护商的成本与在其上做代数计算的成本，验证了相对锥模型的存储优势。

title: Measurement-Error-Aware Causal Distributed-Lag Quantile Modeling of Indoor Air Pollution and Short-Term Lung-Function Deterioration
summary: Low-cost indoor air-quality sensors could support personalized asthma prevention, but their nonlinear measurement error, delayed exposure effects, time-varying confounding, and heterogeneous lower-tail responses limit risk estimation. We present CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA, a measurement-error-aware causal quantile distributed-lag framework for short-horizon peak expiratory flow analysis. Sparse reference measurements train a nonlinear calibration model; stabilized sequential generalized-propensity weights address measured exposure assignment; and a susceptibility-modulated, smooth, noncrossing quantile model estimates lag-specific and sustained-exposure contrasts. Because no authorized cohort simultaneously provided dense indoor sensing, reference co-location, and outcome-compatible longitudinal data, evaluation used five semi-synthetic panels with known counterfactual truth, 150 patients and 12,600 patient-days per realization. Across eight methods, CAUSALQUANT achieved a dose-response integrated absolute error of 0.304 plus or minus 0.094, improving 24.2 percent over the strongest measurement-error and propensity-weighted baseline. It also obtained the lowest overall pinball loss, 1.065, while maintaining zero quantile crossings and 78.1 percent coverage for the nominal 80 percent interval. Sensor calibration reduced held-out exposure RMSE by 33.7 percent. Stress tests quantified degradation under sensor noise, missing personal measurements, and hidden confounding. These findings establish methodological feasibility and reproducibility, not clinical effectiveness; prospective, governance-approved external validation is required before patient-level interpretation or deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA框架，在测量误差、时变混杂与异质下尾响应下估计室内空气污染对呼气峰流量的因果分位数滞后效应；半合成面板验证显示优于基线，但尚属方法学可行性验证。
AI.motivation: 低成本室内空气质量传感器有望支持哮喘个性化预防，但其非线性测量误差、暴露效应的滞后性、时变混杂以及异质性下尾响应，共同限制了风险估计的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA：测量误差感知的因果分位数分布滞后框架。用稀疏参考测量训练非线性校准模型；以稳定化序贯广义倾向评分权重处理已测暴露分配；采用易感性调节的平滑非交叉分位数模型估计滞后特异性与持续暴露对比。因缺乏同时具备密集室内传感、参考同址与结局纵向数据的授权队列，改用五个半合成面板评估（每实现150名患者、12,600患者日，含已知反事实真值）。
AI.result: 在八种方法中，CAUSALQUANT的剂量-反应积分绝对误差为0.304±0.094，较最强的测量误差+倾向加权基线改善24.2%；总体pinball损失最低（1.065），零分位数交叉，名义80%区间覆盖率为78.1%。传感器校准使留出暴露RMSE降低33.7%。压力测试量化了传感器噪声、个体测量缺失与隐藏混杂下的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅确立方法学可行性与可复现性，而非临床有效性；在个体层面解读或部署前，需经前瞻性、符合治理要求的外部验证。

title: Emergent low-energy many-body Hilbert spaces in Chern bands
summary: We show that in Landau levels and more generic Chern bands, the most relevant many-body subspace selected by realistic two-body interactions alone (e.g., in the limit of vanishing bandwidth and band gap) depends strongly on the particle density and can be constructed systematically. Using the well-defined hierarchical structure of conformal Hilbert spaces (CHS), each with a highest-density vacuum state, we compute, for both fermionic and bosonic systems, the many-body quantum metric that quantifies the interaction energy scales of these subspaces. For a large family of short-range, Coulomb-based interactions, particles preferentially occupy the many-body states in the smallest accommodating CHS. This allows us to describe the low-energy physics of the interacting system in terms of the appropriate anyonic degrees of freedom. Our results also explain why, in any Chern band (in lattice or continuum systems), band mixing tends to be suppressed even in the limit of strong interaction; this suppression is stronger when the band deviates less from the ideal trace condition and when the two-body interaction is shorter-ranged.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在朗道能级和一般陈能带中，最相关的多体子空间由两体相互作用决定且强烈依赖粒子密度，可通过共形希尔伯特空间的层级结构系统构建，并给出量子度规判据。
AI.motivation: 现实两体相互作用（在带宽与带隙趋于零极限下）所选择的最相关多体子空间尚缺乏系统性刻画，其与粒子密度的关系以及陈能带中带混合为何被抑制的机制也未被清楚解释。
AI.method: 利用共形希尔伯特空间（CHS）的层级结构，每个空间具有最高密度真空态；对费米子和玻色子系统分别计算刻画各子空间相互作用能标的多体量子度规，并针对一大类短程、基于库仑的相互作用进行分析。
AI.result: 对于一大类短程库仑型相互作用，粒子优先占据最小可容纳CHS中的多体态；由此可用相应的任意子自由度描述低能物理。结果还表明，任何陈能带中带混合即使在强相互作用极限下也趋于被抑制，且当能带偏离理想痕条件越少、两体相互作用越短程时抑制越强。
AI.conclusion: 两体相互作用选择的多体子空间由粒子密度决定并可系统构造，CHS层级与多体量子度规为此提供了统一框架，同时解释了陈能带中带混合抑制的条件。

title: Model-independent searches and anomaly detection at the CMS experiment
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, submitted for PoS ICHEP conference proceedings
summary: The absence of a clear signal of physics beyond the standard model at the CERN LHC motivates search strategies that do not presuppose a specific signal hypothesis. This proceedings present machine-learning-based anomaly detection to search for new physics in a model-agnostic way. The first such search by CMS looks for dijet resonances whose jets have substructure atypical of jets initiated by light quarks or gluons, using five complementary anomaly detection methods applied to 138 fb$^{-1}$ of proton-proton collision data at $\sqrt{s} = 13$ TeV. The technique has been validated directly on data by recovering the top quark without the use of labels. The program has also moved into real time: two unsupervised algorithms, AXOL1TL and CICADA, now run on field-programmable gate arrays inside the CMS level-1 trigger and selected more than four billion collision events during 2024 data taking. Finally, the extension of resonant anomaly detection to event-level observables is outlined.

AI.tldr: 该会议报告综述了CMS利用机器学习进行模型无关的异常检测以搜寻新物理，包括首个双喷注共振搜索、实时触发器算法部署及向事件级观测量的扩展。
AI.motivation: LHC尚未观测到超越标准模型的明确信号，因此需要不预设特定信号假设的搜寻策略，实现模型无关的新物理探测。
AI.method: 采用基于机器学习的异常检测方法：CMS首个此类搜索针对双喷注共振，寻找具有非典型于轻夸克或胶子喷注子结构的喷注，应用五种互补的异常检测方法分析13 TeV下138 fb⁻¹的质子-质子碰撞数据；同时将两种无监督算法AXOL1TL与CICADA部署于CMS一级触发器的FPGA上。
AI.result: 通过在不使用标签的情况下恢复顶夸克，该技术在数据上得到直接验证；AXOL1TL与CICADA在2024年取数期间于CMS一级触发器中运行，筛选出超过40亿个碰撞事件。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了模型无关的新物理搜寻并通过数据验证，且已进入实时触发应用；未来将进一步把共振异常检测扩展到事件级观测量。

title: Tamagawa numbers and torsion of elliptic curves over function fields
summary: We study the divisibilities of Tamagawa numbers $ c(E) $ of elliptic curves $ E $ over global function fields $ K $ in terms of their torsion subgroups $ E(K)_{\operatorname{tors}} $. In particular, for a non-isotrivial elliptic curve $ E / k(t) $, where $ k $ is a finite field of characteristic greater than $ 3 $, we prove that $ |E(k(t))_{\operatorname{tors}}|^2 $ divides $ c(E) $, except possibly in four exceptional torsion families. More specifically, we give a complete characterisation of divisibilities for $ c(E) $ in each torsion family, and provide explicit examples to prove that they are best possible. Over a general global function field, we also prove that a rational point of prime order $ 5 \le N \le 101 $ on $ E / K $ forces $ N^2 $ to divide $ c(E) $, which motivates our result. Finally, we formulate a conjecture on the leading coefficient of the $ L $-function of $ E / K $, motivated by the integrality of Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer quotients.

AI.tldr: 本文研究与椭圆曲线Tamagawa数$c(E)$的整除性，建立了其与挠子群$E(K)_{\operatorname{tors}}$之间的联系，并给出完整刻画及BSD商整性动机的猜想。
AI.motivation: 作者希望用椭圆曲线的挠子群$E(K)_{\operatorname{tors}}$来控制其Tamagawa数$c(E)$的整除性，从而揭示算术不变量之间的定量关系，并为BSD商整性提供线索。
AI.method: 对全局函数域$K$上的椭圆曲线$E$，利用挠子群$E(K)_{\operatorname{tors}}$与Tamagawa数$c(E)$的关系进行研究；特别针对$k$为特征大于$3$的有限域上的非等平凡椭圆曲线$E/k(t)$，按挠族分类逐一分析整除性。
AI.result: 证明了对于$E/k(t)$，除四个例外挠族外，$|E(k(t))_{\operatorname{tors}}|^2$整除$c(E)$；给出了每个挠族中$c(E)$整除性的完整刻画，并提供显式例子说明结果最优。对一般全局函数域，证明若$E/K$有$5 \le N \le 101$的素阶有理点，则$N^2$整除$c(E)$。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出了Tamagawa数被挠子群大小平方整除的普遍规律及例外情形，并由此提出关于$E/K$的$L$-函数首系数、受BSD商整性启发的猜想。

title: Finite-Data Error Bounds for Approximating the Koopman Operator: Sampling Measures, Super-Polynomial Convergence and Regularization
summary: The Koopman operator is a well-established framework for lifting nonlinear dynamical systems to an infinite-dimensional space where dynamics are linear. Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) is a widely used method in data-driven dynamics as it provides a Galerkin approximation of the Koopman operator on the finite-dimensional span of a prescribed dictionary of observable functions. In particular, EDMD only requires samples from the dynamical system, describing the Koopman operator without knowledge of the underlying dynamics. While many studies analyze asymptotic convergence results for EDMD in terms of data, the question of more practical finite-data convergence results remains incomplete in general settings. In this work, we prove bounds for the finite-data EDMD Galerkin approximation of the Koopman operator by a rate proportional to the inverse of the root of the number of samples (the Monte Carlo rate). These results apply to multiple classes of problems, i.e., for discrete or continuous dynamics, including stochastic systems. In certain more structured setting, we demonstrate super-polynomial rates are achievable both theoretically and computationally. Finally, we derive recovery guarantees for an EDMD variant in the undersampled regime inspired by compressed sensing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文为EDMD对Koopman算子的有限数据Galerkin逼近建立以样本数平方根倒数为量级的误差界（蒙特卡洛速率），覆盖离散/连续及随机系统，并在结构化情形下证明超多项式速率，另给出欠采样下基于压缩感知的恢复保证。
AI.motivation: EDMD只需系统采样即可刻画Koopman算子而无需已知动力学，但其收敛性研究多集中于数据量趋于无穷的渐近结果，面向实际有限数据的收敛界在一般设定下尚不完整，因此需要建立有限样本下的收敛保证。
AI.method: 将非线性动力学提升到无穷维线性空间，利用EDMD在给定可观测函数字典张成的有限维空间上对Koopman算子做Galerkin逼近；通过分析有限样本下的逼近误差，推导与样本数相关的收敛速率；并针对欠采样情形，借鉴压缩感知思想构造EDMD变体进行恢复分析。
AI.result: 证明了有限数据EDMD Galerkin逼近的误差界与样本数平方根成反比（蒙特卡洛速率），适用于离散与连续动力学并包括随机系统；在更结构化的设定中，从理论与计算两方面展示可达到超多项式收敛速率；同时为欠采样区域下的EDMD变体推导出恢复保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥补了EDMD有限数据收敛理论的空白，给出通用且实用的收敛速率刻画，并借助压缩感知拓展到欠采样场景，为数据驱动动力学分析提供了理论支撑。

title: Locality of KMS states for infinite fermionic lattice systems
summary: We study how thermal equilibrium states of infinite fermionic lattices respond to perturbations of the Hamiltonian. Our main result concerns extensive perturbations of a chosen KMS state. We show that exponential decay of correlations and exponential local indistinguishability under the extensive perturbation yield stretched-exponential decay of correlations for the perturbed state. Neither the initial nor the perturbed state is required to be unique, allowing stability to be studied in the presence of phase coexistence. Our approach uses Quantum Belief Propagation (QBP), which we establish directly on the underlying $C^*$-algebra. Combining QBP with Lieb--Robinson bounds, we show implications between decay of correlations, the principle that local perturbations perturb locally, and local indistinguishability, closing the cycle for perturbations of the tracial state under the stated decay, support and uniformity assumptions. For extensive perturbations under uniform clustering conditions, we also obtain a differentiable path of local equilibrium expectations and bound their change linearly in the interaction norm of the perturbation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无限费米子格点系统热平衡态对哈密顿量微扰的响应，证明在指数衰减关联和指数局部不可区分性下，广延微扰导致扰动态呈现拉伸指数衰减关联，并借助量子信念传播（QBP）与Lieb-Robinson界建立若干等价关系。
AI.motivation: 以往关于热平衡态稳定性的研究通常要求平衡态唯一，难以处理相共存情形。本文旨在放宽唯一性假设，在存在相共存的条件下研究广延微扰对KMS态关联衰减与局部不可区分性的影响。
AI.method: 直接在底层C*-代数上建立量子信念传播（QBP），并将其与Lieb-Robinson界结合；在给定的衰减、支撑与均匀性假设下，分析局部微扰局部影响原则、关联衰减与局部不可区分性之间的关系。
AI.result: 证明了在指数关联衰减与指数局部不可区分性下，广延微扰使扰动态呈现拉伸指数关联衰减；在均匀聚簇条件下，得到局部平衡期望的可微路径，并将其变化以微扰相互作用范数线性界定。同时闭合了迹态微扰下关联衰减、局部微扰局部影响与局部不可区分性之间的循环。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将热平衡态稳定性分析推广至非唯一平衡态（相共存）情形，并表明QBP可作为C*-代数框架下研究广延微扰的有力工具。

title: Radiative properties and optical appearance of a thin accretion disk around a charged-PFDM black hole
summary: Accretion onto magnetically charged black holes in a perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM) background opens a new window for testing strong-field gravity. This paper investigates the radiative properties and optical appearance of a thin accretion disk surrounding a charged-PFDM black hole. We numerically compute the radiative energy flux, temperature distribution, and radiative efficiency, and employ a ray-tracing method to construct the direct images, secondary images, redshift distribution, and observed flux. By comparing with the Schwarzschild and pure PFDM cases, we find that the thin-disk efficiency of the charged-PFDM black hole lies between the two, with the magnetic charge partially counteracting the dark-matter-induced efficiency enhancement; for M87*, the efficiency is estimated to be 7\%--8\%. The optical appearance is predominantly governed by the PFDM parameter, while the magnetic charge plays only a marginal role. Larger inclination angles give rise to stronger Doppler asymmetry, producing the characteristic ``hat-like'' shape. These results provide falsifiable predictions for future high-resolution observations, such as those by ngEHT, to distinguish dark-matter environments from magnetic-charge effects.

AI.tldr: 研究磁荷黑洞在PFDM背景下的薄吸积盘辐射特性与光学外观，给出可证伪的观测预测。
AI.motivation: 利用磁荷黑洞与PFDM背景下的吸积过程，检验强场引力并区分暗物质环境效应与磁荷效应。
AI.method: 数值计算辐射能流、温度分布与辐射效率；采用光线追踪方法构建直接像、次级像、红移分布与观测流量；并与Schwarzschild及纯PFDM情形对比。
AI.result: 带电-PFDM黑洞薄盘效率介于Schwarzschild与纯PFDM之间，磁荷部分抵消暗物质引起的效率增强；M87*效率约7%–8%；光学外观主要由PFDM参数主导，磁荷影响微弱；大倾角导致更强多普勒不对称，形成典型“帽状”形状。
AI.conclusion: 结果为ngEHT等未来高分辨率观测提供可证伪预测，以区分暗物质环境与磁荷效应。

title: Holes in planar parallel sets: An integrated Betti-number bound and its pointwise failure
summary: Let A be a nonempty compact subset of the plane and let A (r) be its parallel set at distance r. We prove that the number of holes of A (r) the number of bounded components of its complement, which is its rst Betti number satises $\infty$ r 0 $β$1(A (r) ) dr $\le$ 4050 (diam A) 4 r -3 0 for every r0 > 0, the integrand vanishing for r $\ge$ diam A/ $\sqrt$ 3. The proof rests on Fu's theorem that the critical values of the distance function of a planar compact set form a set of vanishing half-dimensional Hausdor measure, on two lemmas of Rataj, Spodarev and Meschenmoser, and on a square-root summability estimate for the gaps of the critical-value set, of which we give a complete proof. We show by an explicit family of curves two combs facing each other that no analogous bound can hold at a xed radius: a connected curve of bounded length, diameter, oscillation count, parallel-set area and parallel-set perimeter can have arbitrarily many holes at one radius, so the integrated estimate cannot be replaced by a xed-radius bound in terms of these coarse geometric quantities. We also bound the hole count uniformly in the radius by the number of components of local maxima of the distance function, and record a bound on the boundary length of a parallel set by its area. The results supply the deterministic input for limit theorems on the persistent homology of the Wiener sausage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平面紧集的平行集A(r)的洞（互补集有界连通分支）数目，即第一Betti数β1(A(r))。证明了对r的积分估计∫_{0}^{r0} β1(A(r))dr ≤ 4050(diam A)^4 r0^{-3}，且被积函数在r≥diam A/√3时为零；并构造反例说明不存在固定半径下的类似界。
AI.motivation: 平行集的拓扑（洞数）随距离r变化，理解其定量行为对持久同调等问题很重要。作者希望为Wiener sausage的持久同调极限定理提供确定性输入，即对平面紧集平行集的洞数给出与粗几何量相关的积分型控制。
AI.method: 证明依赖Fu定理（平面紧集距离函数临界值集具有零半维Hausdorff测度）、Rataj-Spodarev-Meschenmoser的两个引理，以及临界值集间隙的平方根可和性估计（文中给出完整证明）。另外通过构造两个相对梳状曲线的显式族说明固定半径下界不成立；并用距离函数局部极大值分支数一致控制洞数，还记录了平行集边界长度由其面积控制的界。
AI.result: 证明了对任意r0>0有∫_0^{r0} β1(A(r))dr ≤ 4050(diam A)^4 r0^{-3}，且r≥diam A/√3时被积函数为零。构造显式曲线族表明：即使曲线连通且长度、直径、振荡数、平行集面积与周长均有界，在某个固定半径处仍可具有任意多的洞，因此积分估计不能替换为固定半径的粗几何量界。还给出洞数由距离函数局部极大值分支数的统一界，以及平行集边界长度受其面积控制的界。
AI.conclusion: 平面紧集平行集的洞数满足一个关于r的积分型上界，该上界随diam A的四次方增长且积分区间受diam A/√3限制；但固定半径处不存在仅由长度、直径、振荡数、面积、周长等粗几何量控制的界。所得结果可作为Wiener sausage持久同调极限定理的确定性输入。

title: From Individual Trajectories to Population Densities: Weak-Form Inference of Heterogeneous Growth Laws
summary: Single-cell time-lapse microscopy now provides high-resolution size trajectories for thousands of individual cells, yet principled methods for simultaneously learning the functional form of growth laws and the distribution of cell-to-cell physiological variability remain limited. We present a data-driven framework based on the recent Weak-form Estimation of Nonlinear Dynamics (WENDy) algorithm to (i) select the best supported growth law from a set of candidate laws, and (ii) recover individual-level growth parameters via empirical Bayes shrinkage within a random-effects model. We demonstrate the approach on both synthetic individual size data incorporating commonly found growth laws and recorded real size trajectories, showing that the method accurately recovers both growth-law structure and parameter heterogeneity at reasonable noise levels. We finally end with a discussion on how the results obtained by the method here can be upscaled to the population level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于WENDy弱形式估计的数据驱动框架，从单细胞延时显微数据中同时识别最优生长规律并估计个体生长参数的异质性。
AI.motivation: 单细胞延时显微技术可提供数千个细胞的高分辨率尺寸轨迹，但能同时学习生长律函数形式与细胞间生理变异分布的原则性方法仍很有限。
AI.method: 基于弱形式非线性动力学估计（WENDy）算法构建框架：一是从候选生长律集合中选出支持度最高的生长律；二是在随机效应模型内通过经验贝叶斯收缩恢复个体水平的生长参数。
AI.result: 在含常见生长律的合成单细胞尺寸数据及实测尺寸轨迹上验证，表明该方法在合理噪声水平下能准确恢复生长律结构与参数异质性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可有效联合推断生长律形式与个体参数异质性，并讨论了将所得结果向上扩展至群体水平的途径。

title: Gorenstein cotorsion pairs induced by balanced pairs
summary: Let $(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y})$ be an admissible balanced pair in a locally presentable abelian category $\mathcal{A}$, and let $\mathcal{E}$ be its induced exact structure. We study the class $G(\mathcal{X})$ of cycles of two-sided complexes with terms in $\mathcal{X}$ that are both right and left $\mathcal{X}$-acyclic. If $\mathcal{X}$ is closed under direct summands and finite direct sums and is $κ$-Kaplansky for every sufficiently large regular cardinal $κ$, we prove that $(G(\mathcal{X}),G(\mathcal{X})^{\perp *})$ is a hereditary cotorsion pair relative to $\mathcal E$. For relative purity determined by finitely presented modules, we give two criteria for functorial completeness and show that relative periodic modules generate a functorially complete hereditary cotorsion pair. We also compute the relative Gorenstein objects, their right orthogonal, and explicit approximations for a family of exact structures over Dedekind domains.

AI.tldr: 在局部可表现Abel范畴的容许平衡对诱导的精确结构下，研究双边复形的圈类G(X)，证明其与右正交类构成遗传余挠对，并给出相对纯性函子完备性判别及Dedekind域上的显式计算。
AI.motivation: 将经典Gorenstein同调代数中"双边复形圈类"的构造推广到更一般的局部可表现Abel范畴与容许平衡对诱导的相对精确结构框架中，并刻画相对纯性下的函子完备性。
AI.method: 设(X,Y)为局部可表现Abel范畴A中的容许平衡对，E为其诱导精确结构。取项在X中、且既右X-无环又左X-无环的双边复形的圈类G(X)。在X对直和项与有限直和封闭、且对充分大正则基数κ为κ-Kaplansky的条件下，构造相对精确结构E下的余挠对。对由有限表现模确定的相对纯性，给出函子完备性的两个判别准则。
AI.result: 证明(G(X), G(X)^{⊥*})是相对E的遗传余挠对；给出相对纯性函子完备性的两个判别准则，并证明相对周期模生成一个函子完备的遗传余挠对；对Dedekind域上一族精确结构，计算出相对Gorenstein对象、其右正交类及显式逼近。
AI.conclusion: 在容许平衡对诱导的精确结构下建立了双边复形圈类的遗传余挠理论，明确了相对纯性与函子完备性的联系，并通过Dedekind域上的显式计算验证了该框架的可操作性。

title: Applications of the Lorentz positive cone in nonconvex quadratic optimization
summary: We consider the Lorentz positive cone of $n\times m$ matrices that map the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^m$ into the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^n$. The Lorentz positive cone and its dual, the cone of Lorentz separable matrices, are shown to provide polynomial-time algorithms for the problem of minimizing a bilinear objective over variables contained in ellipsoids in $\Rbb^n$ and $\Rbb^m$. We also demonstrate how these cones can be used to strengthen SDP relaxations of other nonconvex quadratic optimization problems, including the two-trust-region subproblem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将 $\Rbb^m$ 中 Lorentz 锥映入 $\Rbb^n$ 中 Lorentz 锥的矩阵所构成的 Lorentz 正锥，并证明该锥及其对偶（Lorentz 可分矩阵锥）可为椭圆体上双线性目标极小化问题提供多项式时间算法，同时可用于加强其他非凸二次优化问题（如双信赖域子问题）的 SDP 松弛。
AI.motivation: 非凸二次优化（尤其是变量约束在椭圆体内、含双线性目标的问题，以及双信赖域子问题等）通常难以求解，或现有 SDP 松弛不够紧。作者希望借助 Lorentz 锥之间的正映射结构，找到可高效处理的锥类，从而给出精确或更强的松弛。
AI.method: 引入并研究 Lorentz 正锥（保 Lorentz 锥的矩阵集合）及其对偶锥，即 Lorentz 可分矩阵锥；基于这两个锥构造优化模型，用于处理椭圆体约束下的双线性极小化问题，并将其嵌入其他非凸二次问题的 SDP 松弛中。
AI.result: Lorentz 正锥与 Lorentz 可分矩阵锥被证明能为椭圆体变量上的双线性目标极小化提供多项式时间算法；同时这些锥可有效加强其他非凸二次优化问题的 SDP 松弛，包括双信赖域子问题。
AI.conclusion: Lorentz 正锥及其对偶为特定非凸二次优化提供了可多项式时间求解的锥规划框架，并能作为加强 SDP 松弛的有力工具，具有推广到更广泛二次优化问题的潜力。

title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
summary: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.

AI.tldr: 构建智能体系统让机器人在无人工编写代码情况下自我改进，经123轮迭代后，机器人可自主发现并部署新能力，但整体改进无法累积，目标任务始终失败。瓶颈不在智能体自身，而在于感知模块不懂关系、技能链锁定首步、以及评估框架决定学习内容这三点。
AI.motivation: 探索机器人能否像编码智能体改进软件一样自我改进，即能否通过自主发现缺失能力、编写技能、安装外部模型并在仿真中验证，实现无需人工编码的持续能力提升。
AI.method: 构建一个智能体系统：观察机器人失败、推断缺失能力、编写新技能或寻找并安装外部模型、在仿真中测试每次改动并迭代。在家庭操作任务上运行123轮改进，并分析失败原因。
AI.result: 智能体能自主发现能力缺口（如目标不在视野内时请求主动观察模型、调试并部署搜索技能）；但改进无法累积，改动虽持续通过测试，目标冷藏柜顶层置物任务始终未成功。瓶颈为三点：链式感知模块不理解关系（如SAM 3只能找到货架而非"顶层货架"）、技能链将学习锁定在第一步、评估框架决定智能体所学内容（弱测试与误导性记忆使活动陷入停滞）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体本身很少是瓶颈，真正制约自我改进的是其周边的感知、技能链结构与评估框架。论文据此提炼出构建可自我改进机器人系统的具体建议，并为每条建议配对一个可证伪实验。

title: Čech complexes for finite sets
summary: Let $\mathcal{F}^{m}=\{A\subset[m]\}$, endowed with the symmetric difference metric and the Cardinality Reverse-Lexicographic order. That way, we compute the homotopy type $\operatorname{Čech}\left(\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m; \frac{r}{2}=1\right)$ by relating it to consecutively adding vertices of $\mathbb{I}^m$, the unit hypercube of $m$th dimension, to point $0$. Further, for higher $r$, we propose a conjecture regarding contractibility of a subcomplex implying a formula for the exact number of wedges of $\mathbb{S}^ 3$'s and $\mathbb{S}^ 4$'s in the $\operatorname{Čech}$ complex.

AI.tldr: 本文在对称差度量与基数逆字典序下研究集合族 $\mathcal{F}^m$ 的子复形 $\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m$，通过将其与向 $m$ 维单位超立方体 $\mathbb{I}^m$ 顶点 $0$ 依次添加顶点的过程相联系，计算了 $r/2=1$ 时 $\operatorname{Čech}$ 复形的同伦型，并对更高 $r$ 提出关于子复形可缩性的猜想，进而导出 $\operatorname{Čech}$ 复形中 $\mathbb{S}^3$ 与 $\mathbb{S}^4$ 楔和的精确数目公式。
AI.motivation: 作者希望对 $\mathcal{F}^m$ 上按基数逆字典序截断得到的子复形 $\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m$ 的 $\operatorname{Čech}$ 复形进行拓扑刻画，从而理解其同伦结构，并进一步给出高维球面楔和的计数结果。
AI.method: 在 $\mathcal{F}^m=\{A\subset[m]\}$ 上赋予对称差度量与基数逆字典序；将 $\operatorname{Čech}(\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m; r/2=1)$ 的同伦型与向 $\mathbb{I}^m$ 的顶点 $0$ 依次添加顶点的过程建立联系进行计算；对更高 $r$，提出关于某子复形可缩性的猜想。
AI.result: 在 $r/2=1$ 情形下给出了 $\operatorname{Čech}(\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m; 1)$ 的同伦型；对更高 $r$，所提可缩性猜想蕴含 $\operatorname{Čech}$ 复形中 $\mathbb{S}^3$ 与 $\mathbb{S}^4$ 楔和的精确数目公式。
AI.conclusion: $\mathcal{F}_{\preceq a}^m$ 的 $\operatorname{Čech}$ 复形拓扑可由与超立方体顶点递增过程的对应来刻画；高维情形下的球面楔和计数依赖于一个可缩性子复形猜想。

title: Suitable Measures for the Potential Operational Utility of AI NWP Rainfall Forecasts Over Africa
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based weather prediction is approaching the skill of physical numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems at a fraction of the computational cost. This is particularly promising for Africa, where rainfall extremes are intensifying and many forecasting centres lack the infrastructure to run physical models at extended lead times. We present a calibrated comparison of GraphCast, GenCast and the Functional Generative Network (FGN) against the physical NWP model IFS for rainfall prediction across Africa. Deterministic and probabilistic forecasts are postprocessed using Isotonic Distributional Regression and evaluated with the Continuous Ranked Probability Score against IMERG, RFEv2 and CHIRPS across seasons, wet and dry regimes, elevation zones and lead times. All models retain skill beyond climatology across most seasons and at extended lead times. AI models generally outperform IFS in wet regions, whereas IFS performs better in dry, high-elevation areas, where its finer resolution better represents orographic controls on rainfall. Across observational datasets and seasons, AI models achieve a median improvement of approximately 5% over IFS. GraphCast achieves calibrated skill comparable to the ensemble-based FGN, although FGN provides greater significant skill at longer lead times. These results highlight the potential of calibrated AI weather prediction to provide accessible and computationally efficient rainfall forecasts across Africa, while demonstrating the continuing importance of spatial resolution, ensemble design and regional characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了GraphCast、GenCast与FGN三种AI天气模型与物理NWP模式IFS在非洲降雨预报上的表现，经校准后AI模型整体略优于IFS（中位提升约5%），但在干燥高海拔地区IFS因分辨率更高而更优。
AI.motivation: 非洲降雨极端事件加剧，而许多预报中心缺乏运行物理数值天气预报（NWP）模式所需的基础设施，难以进行延伸期预报。基于AI的天气预报以极低计算成本逼近物理NWP的技巧，因此有望为非洲提供可及且高效的降雨预报，但缺乏针对该区域的校准性对比评估。
AI.method: 对GraphCast、GenCast和FGN三种AI模型与物理NWP模式IFS进行校准对比。确定性与概率预报均采用等渗分布回归（Isotonic Distributional Regression）进行后处理，并以连续排序概率评分（CRPS）对照IMERG、RFEv2和CHIRPS三套观测数据，按季节、干湿状况、海拔带和预见期进行评估。
AI.result: 所有模型在多数季节及延伸预见期上均优于气候态。AI模型在湿润地区总体优于IFS，而IFS在干燥、高海拔地区表现更好，因其更细分辨率能更好刻画地形对降雨的控制。跨观测数据集与季节，AI模型相对IFS的中位提升约5%。GraphCast达到与集合式FGN相当的校准技巧，但FGN在更长预见期上具有更高的显著技巧。
AI.conclusion: 校准后的AI天气预报有望为非洲提供可及且计算高效的降雨预报，同时表明空间分辨率、集合设计和区域特征仍具持续重要性。

title: Zoology of chiral superconductors in Chern bands
summary: Evidence for chiral superconductivity has recently been observed in several van der Waals systems including rhombohedral multilayer graphene and twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$. In the latter, superconductivity emerges at carrier densities near a fractional Chern insulator. This raises the question of what kinds of superconductors may emerge in a system of electrons in a topological band with strong repulsive interactions. Here, we adapt the target-phase optimization method to search for chiral superconductors in a minimal model of interacting electrons in a Chern band. We construct a differentiable loss function for superconductors from the sign oscillation of the pair-binding energy and combine gradient-based optimization with a rigorous screening procedure to identify and characterize superconductors. Applying this framework within exact diagonalization to spinless electrons in periodically modulated Landau levels with screened Coulomb interactions, we uncover a broad family of chiral superconducting phases. At filling $ν=2/3$, we recover the previously identified $f-\mathrm{i} f$ hole superconductors and find additional $p\pm \mathrm{i} p$ and $f+\mathrm{i} f$ superconductors of both electrons and holes, occurring near and far from the limit of ideal quantum geometry. At $ν=1/2$, we identify $p- \mathrm{i} p$ electron and $f-\mathrm{i} f$ hole superconductors and find, for the first time, a direct transition between chiral superconductors and composite Fermi liquids. Our results reveal that chiral superconductivity in Chern bands comprises a diverse landscape of competing pairing instabilities and establish target-phase optimization as a general strategy for searching for quantum phases in complex interacting systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作将目标相优化方法引入Chern带相互作用电子系统，通过可微损失函数与严格筛选流程系统搜索手性超导相，揭示了丰富的配对竞争图景并首次发现手性超导与复合费米液体之间的直接相变。
AI.motivation: 近期在菱面多层石墨烯与扭转双层MoTe₂等范德华体系中观测到手性超导证据，且超导出现在分数Chern绝缘体附近的载流子密度。这引出核心问题：在具有强排斥相互作用的拓扑能带中，电子可能形成何种超导体。现有研究多聚焦孤立候选相，缺乏对Chern带中手性超导相的系统性搜索与统一表征。
AI.method: 将目标相优化方法适配到Chern带中相互作用电子的最小模型。基于配对束缚能（pair-binding energy）的符号振荡构造超导体的可微损失函数，结合梯度优化与严格筛选流程来识别和表征超导相。在精确对角化框架下，应用于周期调制朗道能级中自旋无极化电子与屏蔽库仑相互作用系统。
AI.result: 在填充ν=2/3处，复现了此前识别的f−if空穴超导体，并发现额外的p±ip与f+if超导体（电子型与空穴型兼具），它们出现在理想量子几何极限附近与远离该极限处。在ν=1/2处，识别出p−ip电子型与f−if空穴型超导体，并首次发现手性超导体与复合费米液体（composite Fermi liquids）之间的直接相变。
AI.conclusion: Chern带中的手性超导性构成一幅由多种竞争配对不稳定性组成的多样图景。目标相优化方法被确立为在复杂相互作用系统中搜索量子相的通用策略。

title: Recent CLFV searches at Belle and Belle II
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, Proceedings of the CLFV-2026 conference
summary: Charged lepton flavor violation (CLFV) is forbidden in the Standard Model (SM) due to massless neutrinos and absence of right-handed neutrinos. The discovery of neutrino oscillations established that the neutrinos are massive and the lepton flavor is not an exact symmetry of nature. A minimal extension of the SM that incorporates right-handed neutrinos gives rise to CLFV through loop-level diagrams involving neutrinos. However, such processes are extremely rare, for instance, the branching fraction of $μ\to eγ$ is expected to be at the level of $10^{-54}$, far beyond the sensitivity of current collider experiments. In contrast, several new physics models predict CLFV decay rates within the sensitivity of current experiments, such as the Belle and Belle II experiments, which have collected the world's largest asymmetric $e^+e^-$ collision data near the $Υ(4S)$ resonance. The large data sample has utilized to explore the possibility of CLFV decays of $τ$ leptons, $B$ mesons, and bottomonium states. The report reviews some latest results on these CLFV decays at Belle and Belle II.

AI.tldr: 该摘要综述了Belle与Belle II实验在带电轻子味破坏（CLFV）衰变方面的最新结果，涵盖τ轻子、B介子和底夸克偶素态。
AI.motivation: 标准模型中无质量中微子且无右手中微子，CLFV被禁戒；中微子振荡的发现表明轻子味并非严格对称。尽管SM最小扩展可通过圈图产生CLFV，但分支比极低（如μ→eγ约10^-54），远超现有对撞机灵敏度。而部分新物理模型预言的分支比可落入当前实验灵敏度范围，因此有必要利用高统计量数据开展搜寻。
AI.method: 利用Belle与Belle II实验在Υ(4S)共振附近采集的世界最大规模非对称e^+e^-对撞数据样本，对τ轻子、B介子及底夸克偶素态的CLFV衰变进行搜寻分析。
AI.result: 报告综述了Belle与Belle II在τ轻子、B介子和底夸克偶素态CLFV衰变方面取得的一系列最新实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 大统计量e^+e^-对撞数据为探测新物理模型预言的CLFV衰变提供了有效途径，Belle与Belle II的相关结果对检验轻子味守恒及约束新物理具有重要意义。

title: Efficient Computation and Congruences for Colored Partition Functions
summary: For a positive integer $α$, let $p_α(n)$ denote the number of $α$-colored partitions of $n$. The Rademacher-type expansion of Iskander, Jain, and Talvola is valid for every real $α>0$, but when $α>24$ it involves several polar terms and a two-parameter family of exponential sums $A_k^{(α)}(n,m)$. For integral $α$, we prove multiplicativity and prime-power reduction formulas for these sums, expressing their local factors as classical or quadratically twisted Kloosterman sums. Together with explicit truncation and precision bounds, these formulas yield an efficient algorithm for computing $p_α(n)$ exactly. Our SageMath implementation computes the 1,113,767-digit integer $p_{100}(10^{10})$ in less than one hour. As an application, we use the algorithm to certify new Ramanujan-type congruences.

AI.tldr: 本文研究整数染色分拆数 $p_\alpha(n)$ 的 Rademacher 型展开中的指数和 $A_k^{(\alpha)}(n,m)$，证明了其乘性及素数幂归约公式，并结合截断与精度界，给出了精确计算 $p_\alpha(n)$ 的高效算法。
AI.motivation: Iskander、Jain 与 Talvola 的 Rademacher 型展开对任意实数 $\alpha>0$ 成立，但当 $\alpha>24$ 时会出现多个极点项以及一个双参数指数和族 $A_k^{(\alpha)}(n,m)$，直接计算困难，因此需要理解这些指数和的结构以实现高效精确计算。
AI.method: 对整数 $\alpha$，证明 $A_k^{(\alpha)}(n,m)$ 的乘性以及素数幂归约公式，将其局部因子表示为经典或二次扭 Kloosterman 和；同时给出显式截断与精度界，从而构造精确计算 $p_\alpha(n)$ 的算法，并用 SageMath 实现。
AI.result: SageMath 实现在一小时内计算出具有 1,113,767 位的整数 $p_{100}(10^{10})$；并利用该算法验证了新的 Ramanujan 型同余式。
AI.conclusion: 指数和的乘性与素数幂归约公式使得 $p_\alpha(n)$ 的精确高效计算成为可能，并可应用于发现和验证新的 Ramanujan 型同余。

title: Mapped Multi-Patch Spectral Extreme Learning Machine for Partial Differential Equations
summary: We study a fixed-feature solver, referred to as Spectral-ELM, in which Chebyshev--Gauss--Lobatto (CGL) differentiation matrices are applied to the nodal values of an extreme learning machine (ELM) trial function. Curved domains are treated using a mapped multi-patch formulation. Each curved quadrilateral patch is represented as the image of a reference square, physical derivatives are computed from the associated metric terms, and adjacent patches are coupled by enforcing continuity of the solution and its normal flux. Local QR orthogonalization is used to reduce near-linear dependence among the discrete features. The numerical study includes comparisons with direct CGL collocation, an analytically differentiated ELM, a global Random Feature Method, and a TransNet sampling strategy. It also includes a matched KdV test, a small three-dimensional example, and a Poisson problem on a curved domain containing a hole. For a smooth elliptic problem on a square, direct CGL collocation gives the smallest error. When applied to the same fixed-feature trial space, spectral and analytic differentiation produce comparable errors. For the curved-domain problem, mapped direct CGL collocation and mapped Spectral-ELM achieve similar accuracy with comparable numbers of unknowns. The present formulation is particularly well suited to smooth PDEs in one to three dimensions, where tensor-product grids enable accurate high-order discretizations, while sparse-grid and dimension-adaptive strategies offer promising directions for extension to higher-dimensional problems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spectral-ELM 固定特征求解器，用 CGL 微分矩阵作用于 ELM 试验函数节点值，并以映射多片方法处理曲边区域。
AI.motivation: 探索将 CGL 谱微分矩阵与 ELM 固定特征试验空间结合，并扩展到曲边多片区域，以期在光滑 PDE 上获得高精度离散。
AI.method: 对 ELM 试验函数节点值施加 CGL 微分矩阵；曲边四边形片映射自参考正方形，通过度量项计算物理导数，相邻片以解及其法向通量连续性耦合；用局部 QR 正交化降低离散特征间近线性相关；与直接 CGL 配点、解析微分 ELM、全局随机特征方法及 TransNet 采样对比。
AI.result: 方形域光滑椭圆问题中直接 CGL 配点误差最小；在同一固定特征试验空间中，谱微分与解析微分误差相当；曲边域问题中映射直接 CGL 配点与映射 Spectral-ELM 在未知量数量相近时精度相似。数值研究含匹配 KdV 算例、小型三维算例及带孔曲边域 Poisson 问题。
AI.conclusion: 该形式适合 1 至 3 维光滑 PDE，张量积网格支持高精度高阶离散；稀疏网格与维度自适应策略有望推广到更高维问题。

title: Local Determinant Defects and Low-Energy Subspace Stability in Semifinite von Neumann Algebras
summary: We give a finite-temperature test for the stability of low-energy spectral subspaces. The test uses a local determinant defect for the alpha-z Renyi kernel of two Gibbs states and bounds the tracial L2 distance between their low-energy projections. The main tool is a spectral-flattening principle for bounded positive injective operators in a semifinite von Neumann algebra. It reduces the local product defect to an exact two-projection formula. The thermal result applies to lower-bounded affiliated Hamiltonians with trace-class Gibbs operators and does not require the Hamiltonians to be close in operator norm. We give an infinite-level example with unbounded Hamiltonians. For matrices, the result gives a sum of principal-angle remainders. For qubits, the defect and the thermal gaps determine the ground-state overlap exactly. The same estimate gives a uniform error bound for bounded observables in an effective low-energy model. We also prove the determinant inequalities, their equality cases, and z-monotonicity in matrix, finite, and semifinite settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个有限温度下低能谱子空间稳定性的检验方法，通过局部行列式缺陷界定两个吉布斯态低能投影之间的迹L2距离，核心工具是半有限冯诺依曼代数中有界正单射算子的谱平坦化原理。
AI.motivation: 研究低能谱子空间在有限温度下的稳定性，需要一种不依赖于哈密顿量在算子范数下接近程度的判据，以处理下界仿射哈密顿量与迹类吉布斯算子等一般情形。
AI.method: 对两个吉布斯态的alpha-z Renyi核构造局部行列式缺陷；利用半有限冯诺依曼代数中有界正单射算子的谱平坦化原理，将局部乘积缺陷约化为精确的双投影公式，从而界定低能投影间的迹L2距离。
AI.result: 该热学结果适用于具有迹类吉布斯算子的下界仿射哈密顿量，且不要求哈密顿量在算子范数下接近；给出无界哈密顿量的无限能级实例；对矩阵情形得到主角余项之和；对量子比特，缺陷与热隙精确决定基态重叠；同一估计给出有效低能模型中关于有界可观测量的一致误差界。
AI.conclusion: 作者还证明了矩阵、有限与半有限情形下的行列式不等式及其等号成立条件与z单调性，为低能谱子空间稳定性提供了统一的定量框架。

title: Discovery of minute-scale polarization angle rotation in a supermassive black hole jet
comment: Accepted for publication in ApJL, 9 pages, 5 figures
summary: Relativistic jets from supermassive black holes oriented towards our line of sight called blazars have puzzled the astronomical community for decades. Their fast jets and preferential alignment creates a fog of relativistic effects that obscures their true properties. Optical polarimetry - tracing the uniformity, direction, and evolution of the magnetic field in the jets, has revealed a unique phenomenon to blazars; coherent changes of the magnetic field manifesting as rotations of the polarization angle ($Ψ$). The origin of those rotations has been debated for decades with several proposed models to explain them. We detected an extremely fast - minute time-scale - rotation in the polarization angle of $\sim136^\circ$ over the span of about 80 minutes, making it the fastest known rotation by almost an order of magnitude. Our optical polarization observations combined with radio very long baseline interferometry allow us to reject different models of particle acceleration and strongly point to relativistic effects and the interaction of standing and moving shock waves as the origin of the extreme polarization variations in jets.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告了耀变体中偏振角以约80分钟完成约136°的超快旋转，为已知最快旋转，速度提升近一个数量级，并借助光学偏振与射电VLBI联合观测，排除了多种粒子加速模型，指向相对论效应及驻波与移动激波相互作用是极端偏振变化的成因。
AI.motivation: 耀变体（指向观测者视线的超大质量黑洞相对论喷流）因快速喷流与优先取向产生强烈的相对论效应，遮蔽了其真实物理性质。偏振角旋转的起源已争论数十年，多种模型并存，亟需高时间分辨的观测来判别。
AI.method: 对耀变体开展高时间分辨率的光学偏振测量，追踪喷流磁场的均匀性、方向与演化；并将光学偏振观测与射电甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）相结合，用于区分不同粒子加速模型。
AI.result: 探测到偏振角在约80分钟内旋转约136°，时间尺度为分钟级，是迄今已知最快的偏振角旋转，比此前记录快近一个数量级；联合观测结果排除了多种粒子加速模型，强烈支持相对论效应以及驻波与移动激波相互作用解释喷流中的极端偏振变化。
AI.conclusion: 分钟级、约136°的偏振角超快旋转表明耀变体喷流中磁场结构可在极短时间内发生相干重构；其成因更可能是相对论效应与驻波/移动激波相互作用，而非已有粒子加速模型所预测的机制。

title: Learned Localized Mesh Refinement
summary: We present a neural method for adaptive triangle mesh refinement, in which an autoregressive model adds geometric detail to selected regions of an input mesh while leaving the rest unchanged, a key capability for efficiently allocating mesh budget. Existing upsampling methods struggle to achieve this. Classical subdivision schemes refine triangulation without semantic awareness of the underlying shape or the ability to recover geometric details missing from a coarse input. Recent neural mesh models generate shapes globally, sacrificing region-specific control. We propose a novel tokenizer that yields combinatorially many valid upsampling trajectories from a single mesh. Trained on such data, our locally-conditioned autoregressive architecture allows for direct manipulation of topology and geometry within target regions of an input mesh. We validate our method against state-of-the-art approaches and demonstrate its ability to perform adaptive upsampling with region-selective control, a capability absent from existing approaches. This unlocks inference-time view-dependent refinement, physics-aware region refinement, and coarse-shape conditioned novel mesh synthesis. We provide code at https://github.com/seanxzhan/learned-localized-mesh-refinement/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经自适应三角网格细化方法，用局部条件自回归模型在选定区域增加几何细节，实现区域可控的网格上采样。
AI.motivation: 网格预算需要高效分配，但现有上采样方法难以做到区域选择性细化：传统细分方案缺乏语义感知与细节恢复能力，近期神经网格模型多为全局生成，牺牲了区域特异性控制。
AI.method: 设计一种新型tokenizer，可从单个网格产生组合数量级的大量有效上采样轨迹；在该数据上训练局部条件自回归架构，从而可直接操控输入网格目标区域内的拓扑与几何。
AI.result: 与当前最先进方法对比验证，展示了区域选择性控制的自适应上采样能力，这是现有方法所不具备的。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解锁了推理时视角相关细化、物理感知区域细化以及粗形状条件的新网格合成等应用；代码已开源。

title: Life-time patterns of reinfections: epidemic cohorts as traveling waves
summary: Infectious disease models that allow for reinfection, such as the SIS or SIRS frameworks, typically treat all infections as exchangeable and independent, erasing the temporal structure of individual reinfection histories. Here, we introduce a minimal "chain SIR" model that resolves this limitation by indexing compartments by reinfection count and allowing transmission, recovery, and waning rates to depend on that count. The dynamics generate an advective flux along the reinfection ladder, producing traveling waves in reinfection space and a coherent structure in the population's lifetime infection histories. We derive an analytical expression for the wave speed and identify the general conditions under which such cohort waves exist and persist, offering a new lens to interpret long-term prevalence patterns and the emergence of age- or immunity-structured endemicity. Finally, comparing the speed formula with longitudinal cohort data, we quantify the reduction in reinfection rate attributable to immunological responses for several seasonal viruses, including influenza A/H3N2 and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"链式SIR"（chain SIR）最小模型，按再感染次数对仓室进行编号，并允许传播率、恢复率与免疫衰减率随再感染次数变化，从而在再感染空间中产生平流输运与行波结构，并给出波速解析表达式及行波存在的一般条件。
AI.motivation: 现有可再感染的传染病模型（如SIS、SIRS）将所有感染视为可交换且相互独立，抹去了个体再感染史的时间结构，难以刻画终身感染史与免疫结构化的地方性流行。
AI.method: 构建按再感染计数索引仓室的chain SIR模型；允许传播、恢复、免疫衰减率依赖于再感染次数；通过动力学分析导出再感染空间中的平流输运与行波，推导波速的解析表达式，并给出队列波（cohort waves）存在与持续的一般条件；最后将波速公式与纵向队列数据进行对比。
AI.result: 模型动力学在再感染阶梯上形成平流Flux，产生再感染空间中的行波以及人群终身感染史的相干结构；获得波速的解析表达式并确定队列波存在与持续的条件；通过波速公式与纵向队列数据比较，量化了若干季节性病毒（包括甲型H3N2流感与呼吸道合胞病毒RSV）中免疫应答所导致的再感染率下降幅度。
AI.conclusion: chain SIR模型为理解长期流行模式及年龄或免疫结构化的地方性流行提供了新视角，并使再感染史的时间结构得以显式保留；波速公式可作为从纵向数据中估计免疫保护效应（再感染率降低）的实用工具。

title: Torsion proliferation
summary: This paper considers the generic behaviour of sheaves supported on Schubert varieties in finite flag varieties. Our main results are that, for any fixed prime $p$, as the rank of the associated algebraic group grows, almost every intersection cohomology sheaf admits $p$-torsion in its stalks or costalks, and almost every indecomposable parity sheaf is not perverse. For certain families of partial flag varieties we also determine explicit asymptotics for this growth.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究有限旗簇上Schubert簇支撑层的通用行为，证明了当代数群秩增长时，几乎所有交截上同调层的茎或余茎含p-挠，且几乎所有不可分解奇偶层不是反常层。
AI.motivation: 探究有限旗簇上Schubert簇支撑层（交截上同调层、奇偶层）的通用性质，特别是当相关代数群秩增长时这些层的p-挠和反常性行为。
AI.method: 考虑有限旗簇中以Schubert簇为支撑的层；对固定素数p，令相关代数群秩增长，分析交截上同调层茎与余茎的p-挠情况，以及不可分解奇偶层的反常性；对部分旗簇族确定增长的显式渐近。
AI.result: 对任意固定素数p，随相关代数群秩增长，几乎所有交截上同调层在其茎或余茎中带有p-挠；几乎所有不可分解奇偶层不是反常层。对某些部分旗簇族得到增长的显式渐近。
AI.conclusion: 有限旗簇上Schubert簇支撑层在秩增长下呈现普遍现象：交截上同调层的p-挠与奇偶层的非反常性几乎处处发生，并可对特定部分旗簇族给出定量渐近。

title: Tight Convergence Bounds for the Classical Kaczmarz Method
summary: The classical method of Kaczmarz, introduced in 1937, is a textbook iterative method for solving linear systems $A x = b.$ Despite its widespread use, particularly in the context of solving inverse problems where it is commonly included in software packages within Matlab, Python, and Julia, the precise characterization of convergence has long been deemed difficult to obtain. While different bounds on convergence rates have been established, they are largely unsatisfying as they cannot explain the classical, cyclic-update method's efficient convergence in practice. In this work, we obtain a tight characterization of convergence of the classical Kaczmarz method, establishing both linear and sublinear convergence bounds. The worst-case tight (i.e., exactly attained by some instances in the considered family) bounds are expressed in terms of a fixed matrix that depends only on $A,$ but are not fully interpretable in terms of the matrix spectrum and row correlations, which had been observed to have an impact on convergence. We thus provide relaxations of these bounds that are fully expressible in terms of matrix row norms, row correlations, rank, and extremal positive singular values. The provided relaxed bounds explain one-cycle convergence in special cases where the matrix rows are all either parallel or orthogonal to each other. We further argue that the dependence on different parameters appearing in the bounds is necessary and within a small constant factor of the best attainable in the worst case. Finally, our bounds explain why the classical cyclic update is faster than the randomized one when matrix rows are weakly correlated, which is often observed in inverse problems where the cyclic method is used.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了经典Kaczmarz方法收敛性的紧致刻画，包括线性与次线性收敛界，并将其松弛为可由矩阵行范数、行相关性、秩和极正奇异值表达的界。
AI.motivation: 经典Kaczmarz方法自1937年提出以来广泛用于求解线性系统与反问题，但其收敛速率的精确刻画长期被认为困难。已有界无法解释实践中经典循环更新方法的高效收敛现象，因此需要更紧致、可解释的收敛刻画。
AI.method: 作者对经典Kaczmarz方法进行收敛性分析，建立了线性与次线性收敛的紧致界。所给最坏情况紧界（在给定族中可被某些实例达到）由仅依赖A的固定矩阵表示；随后进一步给出这些界的松弛形式，使其完全可由矩阵行范数、行相关性、秩及极正奇异值表达。
AI.result: 所得松弛界能够解释矩阵行全部平行或正交等特殊情形下的“单周期收敛”。作者论证了界中不同参数的依赖性是必要的，且在最坏情况下与最优可达界相差不超过一个小常数因子。此外，这些界解释了当矩阵行弱相关时，经典循环更新为何快于随机更新。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为经典Kaczmarz方法提供了紧致且部分可解释的收敛刻画，弥合了理论与实践中观察到的收敛效率之间的差距，尤其是解释了反问题中循环方法优于随机方法的现象。

title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real
summary: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real.

AI.tldr: 该研究围绕由GPT-6-Astra控制的XLeRobot，在仿真与真机的电梯按钮任务中验证：提供机器可读的机体描述与同步演示、并将智能体自发生成的反馈程序重构为可复用技能，能显著缩短执行时间并实现sim2real复用。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽能编写机器人控制程序，但反复探索与模型中介的动作选择导致执行缓慢；作者希望探究外部机体知识、成功经验与可执行技能能否提升执行效率。
AI.method: 在仿真与物理电梯按钮任务中，以仅含通用控制接口、无先验经验的基线为对照，分别加入完整机器人几何与相机信息、同步动作-状态记录的图像、原始起点采集的经验，以及研究者重构的智能体自发视觉反馈程序，并开展配对比较与真机验证。
AI.result: 30次固定起点仿真试验中，完整机体几何与相机信息使平均完成时间降低57.4%，同步图像记录降低68.6%；起点偏移10–100 cm的9组配对比较（18次）中，原起点经验使平均时间降低58–63%；重构技能在27次仿真试验中使局部任务时间降低29–31%；12次真机试验中，仿真XML资产与仿真经验分别降低平均时间53.0%与49.9%，真机经验亦可迁移至两个新起点。
AI.conclusion: 构建通用操作实验的可行路径是：提供机器可读的机体描述与同步演示，将智能体生成的有用反馈例程转化为可复用技能，同时由智能体依据当前图像自适应调整动作；相关提示、试验级数据与技能实现已开源。

title: $L$-classes of symmetric products: a homological formula
summary: If $M$ is a closed oriented manifold of even dimension, then its $n$th symmetric product $M(n)=M^n/S_n$ is a rational homology manifold for any $n \geq 0$ and hence has a canonically defined $L$-class in $H^*(M(n);\mathbb{Q})$. A complicated formula for these classes was given many years ago in the second author's thesis. We obtain a simpler result by studying the dual classes in homology, showing that their generating function (after embedding each $H_*(M(n); \mathbb{Q})$ into the Hopf algebra $H_*(M(\infty); \mathbb{Q})$) is the product of an elementary factor depending only on the Euler characteristic of $M$ and the exponential of a series consisting of odd Adams twists of the Poincaré dual of the $L$-class of $M$. We also use this to obtain both a simpler proof and a simpler expression for the cohomological $L$-classes than the previous one.

AI.tldr: 该论文简化了偶数维闭定向流形对称积 $M(n)$ 的 $L$-类的计算公式，通过研究同调中的对偶类，给出其生成函数为初等因子与奇数次 Adams 扭变的 Poincaré 对偶 $L$-类指数之积。
AI.motivation: 偶数维闭定向流形的对称积 $M(n)=M^n/S_n$ 是 $\mathbb{Q}$-同调流形，具有典范的 $L$-类。此前第二作者学位论文给出的公式非常复杂，作者希望获得更简洁的表达与证明。
AI.method: 转而研究同调中的对偶 $L$-类，将每个 $H_*(M(n);\mathbb{Q})$ 嵌入 Hopf 代数 $H_*(M(\infty);\mathbb{Q})$，并分析其生成函数结构，利用初等因子与 Adams 扭变分解该生成函数。
AI.result: 同调对偶类的生成函数等于一个仅依赖 $M$ 的 Euler 特征的初等因子与一个由 $M$ 的 $L$-类的 Poincaré 对偶的奇数次 Adams 扭变所构成级数的指数之乘积。
AI.conclusion: 该结果同时给出了比以往更简洁的证明和更简单的上同调 $L$-类表达式，统一并简化了对称积 $L$-类的计算。

title: Feature-Based Likelihood Ratios for Forensic Science: Combining Neural Networks with Bayesian Probability Calculus
summary: In forensic science, when crime-scene evidence (CSE) and suspect-related evidence (SRE) is present, it is customary to report on the value of this evidence in the form of a likelihood ratio (LR). The LR can be calculated as the probability of CSE given SRE divided by the probability of CSE given that it was generated by a randomly selected person from an alternative culprit population. In forensic science, this is known as a feature-based LR, and intuitively the LR contrasts "similarity" by "typicality". Since it is generally a problem for feature-based LRs to find appropriate models for the data, one either resorts to score-based LRs or to adjusting the feature-based output post-hoc to well-calibrated output. Either way, the above definition of the LR is broken and interpretation of the LR as similarity between CSE and SRE divided by typicality of CSE is destroyed. Here, we report on progress in obtaining instantly well-performing feature-based LRs using gradient descent in combination with Bayesian probability theory to train a two-level model, the main LR model in forensic science for describing distributions of continuous data. For a dataset of laser-ablation inductively-coupled-plasma mass-spectrometry measurements on glass fragments from forensic casework, we show that our best model on validation data yields much better calibrated feature-based LRs on the test set when compared to state-of-the-art feature-based LR systems trained on the same type of data, and that it improves a factor of 4.5 on average on $C_{\mathrm{llr}}$. For LRs interpretable in terms of "similarity" contrasting "typicality", this is a major advancement. However, a state-of-the-art LR system still performs a factor of 1.5 better on $C_{\mathrm{llr}}$ for this data. We also present future plans to close this remaining gap. In order to facilitate collaboration, we have put relevant code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合梯度下降与贝叶斯概率理论训练两级模型的方法，直接获得校准良好的基于特征的似然比（LR），在玻璃碎片LA-ICP-MS数据上显著优于现有特征型LR系统。
AI.motivation: 在法科学中，基于特征的LR直观地将"相似度"与"典型度"进行对比，但传统上难以找到合适的特征数据模型，只能退而采用基于得分的LR或对特征型输出做事后校准，这两种做法都破坏了LR的原始定义及其"相似度除以典型度"的解释。
AI.method: 使用梯度下降结合贝叶斯概率理论训练一个两级模型，该模型是法科学中描述连续数据分布的主流LR模型，从而直接获得即时表现良好的基于特征的LR。在来自法医案件工作的玻璃碎片激光烧蚀电感耦合等离子体质谱（LA-ICP-MS）测量数据集上进行验证与测试。
AI.result: 在验证数据上得到的最佳模型，在测试集上产生的基于特征的LR校准效果远优于在同一类数据上训练的现有特征型LR系统，$C_{\mathrm{llr}}$ 平均提升约4.5倍；但一个现有最新LR系统在该数据上仍以约1.5倍的 $C_{\mathrm{llr}}$ 表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 对于可解释为"相似度"对比"典型度"的LR而言，这是重要进展；对剩余差距提出了未来收窄计划，并将相关代码发布于GitHub以促进合作。

title: Read-Rezayi fractional Chern insulators in modulated Bernal graphene
summary: Fibonacci anyons provide a universal platform for topological quantum computation, and emerge as low-energy excitations in the $\mathbb{Z}_3$ Read-Rezayi phase in the fractional quantum Hall effect. However, realistic microscopic realizations of this phase in the absence of a magnetic field have remained elusive. We study a model of periodically modulated Bernal bilayer graphene with gate-screened Coulomb interactions. Using the recently developed target-phase optimization method in conjunction with band-projected exact diagonalization, we identify at filling $ν=3/5$ a region of parameter space whose ground state is consistent with a Read-Rezayi fractional Chern insulator. The partially filled band from which it arises is a part of a two-band complex which mimics geometric aspects of the lowest and first Landau levels, with the ground state at $ν=1/2$ consistent with the Moore-Read state. Our results suggest that modulated Bernal graphene can realize delicate non-Abelian fractional quantum Hall states at zero magnetic field, while demonstrating target-phase optimization as a practical route to discovering such phases in realistic, high-dimensional microscopic models.

AI.tldr: 在周期性调制的Bernal双层石墨烯中，通过目标相优化与精确对角化，在ν=3/5填充下发现了与Z3 Read-Rezayi分数量子陈绝缘体一致的非阿贝尔基态。
AI.motivation: Fibonacci任意子是实现拓扑量子计算的理想平台，其在分数量子霍尔效应中作为Z3 Read-Rezayi相的低能激发出现，但零磁场下该相的真实微观实现一直难以找到。
AI.method: 研究周期性调制的Bernal双层石墨烯模型，包含栅极屏蔽库仑相互作用；结合新近发展的目标相优化方法与能带投影精确对角化进行计算。
AI.result: 在ν=3/5填充下识别出一个参数区域，其基态与Read-Rezayi分数量子陈绝缘体一致；该部分填充能带属于一个双能带复，具有最低与第一朗道能级的几何特征，且ν=1/2时基态与Moore-Read态一致。
AI.conclusion: 调制Bernal石墨烯可在零磁场下实现精细的非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔态，同时表明目标相优化是在现实高维微观模型中寻找此类相位的实用途径。

title: Improved search for $ψ(3770) \to γη_{c}(1S, 2S)$ radiative transitions
summary: Based on an integrated luminosity of $20.3~\mathrm{fb}^{-1}$ of $e^{+}e^{-}$ annihilation data collected at a center-of-mass energy of $3.773~\rm{GeV}$ with the BESIII detector operating at the BEPCII collider, an improved search for the radiative transitions $ψ(3770) \to γη_{c}(1S, 2S)$ is performed using the hadronic decays $η_{c}(1S, 2S) \to K^{0}_{S} K^{\pm} π^{\mp}$. No significant signal is observed. The corresponding 90$\%$ confidence level upper limits on the product branching fractions are set to be $5.0 \times 10^{-6}$ for the $η_{c}(1S)$ transition and $3.7 \times 10^{-6}$ for the $η_{c}(2S)$ transition. The 90$\%$ confidence level upper limits on the partial decay widths are also reported to be $Γ(ψ(3770) \to γη_{c}(1S)) < 5.5$ keV and $Γ(ψ(3770) \to γη_{c}(2S)) < 29.4~\rm{keV}$. With about seven times larger integrated luminosity than used previously, these results lower the upper limits by approximately a factor of three and two for the $η_{c}(1S)$ and $η_{c}(2S)$ transitions, respectively.

AI.tldr: 基于BESIII在3.773 GeV采集的20.3 fb⁻¹数据，利用η_c→K_S⁰K^±π^∓强子衰变道改进搜寻ψ(3770)→γη_c(1S,2S)辐射跃迁，未观测到显著信号，给出更严格的分支比与分宽度上限。
AI.motivation: 此前对ψ(3770)→γη_c(1S,2S)辐射跃迁的搜寻灵敏度有限，需借助更大积分亮度数据改进搜寻，以压低上限、检验该跃迁是否存在。
AI.method: 使用BEPCII上BESIII探测器在质心能量3.773 GeV处采集的20.3 fb⁻¹ e⁺e⁻湮灭数据，通过η_c(1S,2S)→K_S⁰K^±π^∓强子衰变道对ψ(3770)→γη_c(1S,2S)辐射跃迁进行改进搜寻。
AI.result: 未观测到显著信号。产物分支比90%置信水平上限为：η_c(1S)跃迁5.0×10⁻⁶，η_c(2S)跃迁3.7×10⁻⁶；对应分宽度上限为Γ(ψ(3770)→γη_c(1S))<5.5 keV和Γ(ψ(3770)→γη_c(2S))<29.4 keV。
AI.conclusion: 在约为先前七倍的积分亮度下，η_c(1S)与η_c(2S)跃迁的上限分别被压低约三倍和两倍，未发现该辐射跃迁的显著证据。

title: Quasimodular Forms, Partitions, and Primes in Intervals
summary: Recent developments in theories of partitions, quasimodular forms, multiple zeta values and $q$-multiple zeta values have led to connections between partitions and primes. Central to this progress are prime-detecting quasimodular forms, which are $q$-series whose non-negative coefficients vanish if and only if the input is prime. In this paper, we use properties of these quasimodular forms to motivate a proof of the infinitude of primes, to construct a novel partition theoretic factorization algorithm, and to show that the distribution of these coefficients relate to existence of primes in intervals. We also prove analogs of these results for primes in arithmetic progressions and discuss potential extensions of our results, including to Linnik's problem.

AI.tldr: 本文利用素数检测准模形式，证明素数无穷性，构造基于分拆的分解算法，并揭示其系数分布与区间素数存在性的联系。
AI.motivation: 分拆理论、准模形式、多重zeta值与q-多重zeta值的近期发展促成了分拆与素数之间的联系，其中核心是素数检测准模形式——其q级数的非负系数当且仅当输入为素数时消失。作者希望利用这些准模形式的性质来探索素数的结构性质与算法应用。
AI.method: 基于素数检测准模形式的性质：利用其非负系数消失与否判定素数的特性，来重新证明素数无穷性；并借助这些形式构造一种新颖的、基于分拆理论的分解算法；同时分析系数分布与区间中素数存在性之间的关系。
AI.result: 给出了素数无穷性的证明；构造了新的分拆理论分解算法；证明这些系数分布与区间中素数的存在性相关；并将上述结果推广到等差数列中的素数情形。
AI.conclusion: 素数检测准模形式为素数的经典问题（无穷性、区间分布、等差数列中的素数）提供了统一的分拆理论视角，并讨论了向Linnik问题等方向的潜在推广。

title: Accurate Density of States Estimation: A Comparative Study
summary: We study density of states (DOS) estimation for large sparse real symmetric matrices by fitting the cumulative density of states (CDOS) and differentiating the fit. We use a stochastic Lanczos method to supply Ritz values and weights, which we average across Lanczos runs to construct CDOS midpoint data. Monotone piecewise-cubic interpolation of these data yields a smooth CDOS approximation that can be easily differentiated to yield a nonnegative, normalized, piecewise-quadratic DOS without requiring a Gaussian smoothing with a fixed bandwidth in its construction. We also consider approximating CDOS by using Gaussian-process regression (GPR) with single- and double-Gaussian covariance kernels, yielding an approximation with uncertainty information. DOS approximation is then obtained by analytic derivative of the GPR-based CDOS. Experiments on matrices from diverse scientific applications are performed to compare these estimators with Gaussian-broadened stochastic Lanczos and Jackson-damped kernel polynomial approximations. At a common Gaussian validation resolution, we use error measures that assess local discrepancies, integrated errors, and agreement in the overall spectral shape. The results demonstrate that the midpoint spline can produce accurate approximations to the DOS with relatively few matrix--vector products, supporting the use of cumulative interpolation as a practical DOS estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于累积态密度(CDOS)拟合再求导的态密度(DOS)估计方法，包括单调分段三次插值与高斯过程回归(GPR)两类估计器，在稀疏对称矩阵上验证其精度与低矩阵-向量乘积开销优势。
AI.motivation: 大规模稀疏实对称矩阵的DOS估计在科学计算中很重要，但现有方法（如高斯展宽随机Lanczos、Jackson阻尼KPM）需要固定带宽的高斯平滑，且缺乏不确定性信息。作者希望无需固定带宽平滑即可获得非负、归一化的DOS，并降低矩阵-向量乘积开销。
AI.method: 用随机Lanczos方法提供Ritz值与权重，跨多次Lanczos运行平均以构造CDOS中点数据；对数据做单调分段三次插值得到光滑CDOS近似，求导得到非负、归一化、分段二次的DOS（无需固定带宽高斯平滑）。另用带单/双高斯协方差核的GPR逼近CDOS，经解析求导得到带不确定性信息的DOS。在多种科学应用矩阵上，以统一高斯验证分辨率，用局部差异、积分误差和整体谱形一致性指标，与高斯展宽随机Lanczos和Jackson阻尼KPM比较。
AI.result: 中点样条方法能够用相对较少的矩阵-向量乘积获得高精度的DOS近似，在局部差异、积分误差与整体谱形一致性上表现良好；GPR方法可额外提供不确定性信息。
AI.conclusion: 累积插值（尤其单调分段三次样条中点法）是实用的DOS估计手段，支持在低矩阵-向量乘积代价下实现准确DOS估计。

title: The Hamilton--Jacobi and Symplectic Analysis for Extended Hořava Gravity
summary: The Hamilton-Jacobi [HJ] analysis and the Faddeev-Jackiw [FJ] quantization for the linearized, non-projectable $λR$ model, extended by the lowest-order term of Blas, Pujolàs, and Sibiryakov and the higher-order term involving the square of the Cotton tensor, were carried out. The cases $λ\neq \frac{1}{3}$ and $λ= \frac{1}{3}$ are analyzed. Within the Hamilton-Jacobi framework, we obtain the complete set of Hamiltonians, generalized brackets, fundamental differential, characteristic equations, and gauge transformations of the theory. In the Faddeev-Jackiw framework, a symplectic tensor is constructed from which the fundamental brackets are identified. The HJ and FJ brackets coincide, and from the symplectic tensor, the measure for the quantum path integral is calculated. The differences between the cases $λ\neq \frac{1}{3}$ and $λ= \frac{1}{3}$ at the quantum path integral are discussed.

AI.tldr: 对线性化非投影λR模型（含BPS最低阶项与Cotton张量平方高阶项）分别用Hamilton-Jacobi分析与Faddeev-Jackiw量子化进行研究，区分λ≠1/3与λ=1/3两种情形。
AI.motivation: 研究该扩展引力模型在约束系统量子化下的结构，比较两种量子化框架的一致性，并考察λ=1/3这一特殊情形的量子路径积分差异。
AI.method: 采用Hamilton-Jacobi分析（HJ）与Faddeev-Jackiw量子化（FJ）两种方法，对线性化非投影λR模型（含BPS最低阶项及Cotton张量平方高阶项）进行分析；分λ≠1/3与λ=1/3两种情形讨论，并构造辛张量。
AI.result: 在HJ框架下得到完整的哈密顿量集合、广义括号、基本微分、特征方程与规范变换；在FJ框架下由辛张量识别基本括号，且HJ括号与FJ括号一致，并由此辛张量计算量子路径积分的测度。
AI.conclusion: HJ与FJ两种量子化给出相互一致的括号结构，并讨论了λ≠1/3与λ=1/3在量子路径积分上的差异。

title: Correlated Signatures of Plasma Lensing in Fast Radio Bursts
summary: Plasma lensing has been proposed to explain narrow spectra, multiple burst copies, frequency drifts, interference fringes, and polarization changes in fast radio bursts (FRBs). Because many of these features are not unique to lensing, a convincing identification requires several correlated observables to be reproduced by one lens model. We derive such relations for a one-dimensional Gaussian plasma lens near a fold caustic. We distinguish the phase separation of the merging images from their observable group-delay difference and identify three regimes: resolved burst copies, overlapping images with negligible mutual coherence, and coherent spectral interference. We connect the magnification, image delay, spectral-envelope width, fringe spacing, differential dispersion, time-frequency caustic curvature, and the brightness and ordering of the third image. We derive separate finite-source constraints from large fold magnification and from fringe visibility, and relate the wave-optics magnification scale to the plasma column of the lens. High-contrast fringes simultaneously constrain the source size and the mutual coherence of the two image fields, which limits the intrinsic coherence of the FRB radiation once the observed spectrum and instrumental bandpass are accounted for. We also derive the conditions for differential Faraday rotation in magnetized lenses. Finally, we show that clean lensing by a volume-filling turbulent screen requires fine tuning between rare strong fluctuations and caustic confusion, suggesting that sparse sheets, filaments, interfaces, or shocked clumps are more promising lensing structures.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了快速射电暴(FRB)在折痕焦散附近经一维高斯等离子体透镜产生的关联可观测量关系，区分三种成像区域，并据此约束源尺寸、辐射相干性及透镜结构类型。
AI.motivation: 等离子体透镜被用来解释FRB的窄谱、多拷贝爆发、频率漂移、干涉条纹和偏振变化，但这些特征并非透镜所独有，因此可靠的证认需要同一透镜模型同时复现多个相互关联的可观测量。
AI.method: 在折痕焦散附近建立一维高斯等离子体透镜模型，区分图像相位分离与可观测的群延迟差，划分解析爆发拷贝、图像重叠但互不相干、相干谱干涉三种区域，并推导放大率、图像延迟、谱包络宽度、条纹间距、差分色散、时频焦散曲率及第三像亮度与次序之间的关系；同时推导有限源尺寸约束、波光学放大尺度与透镜等离子体柱的关系，以及磁化透镜中差分法拉第旋转条件。
AI.result: 给出上述可观测量之间的定量关联；由大折痕放大率与条纹可见度分别得到独立的有限源约束；高对比条纹可同时约束源尺寸与两像场互相关；在计入观测谱与仪器带通后可反推FRB辐射的固有相干性；并给出磁化透镜差分法拉第旋转条件。
AI.conclusion: 干净的体填充湍流屏透镜需要稀有强涨落与焦散混淆之间的精细调节，因此稀疏片状、丝状、界面或激波团块结构更可能是FRB的透镜成因。

title: Using Persistent Homology to Analyze Access to Heterogeneous-Quality Resources and Heterogeneous-Severity Nuisances
summary: We develop a framework to use multiparameter persistent homology (PH) to examine access to heterogeneous-quality resources and exposure to heterogeneous-severity nuisances in a geographic region. Persistent homology, which is a type of topological data analysis {(TDA)}, has been employed previously to examine resource coverage. Unlike prior approaches, which used one-parameter PH to study resource coverage and nuisance exposure, our method accounts for heterogeneous-quality resources. Our framework, which employs a computationally-efficient approximation of multiparameter PH, allows one to study access to any resource ({or} exposure of any nuisance) using any notion of quality (or severity). Using the city of Chicago as an example region, we employ our framework to detect clusters of poor access to public parks, overexposure to landfills, and both underexposure and overexposure to pubs and bars.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于多参持续同调（multiparameter PH）的框架，用以分析地理区域内异质质量资源的可及性与异质严重程度干扰的暴露情况，并以芝加哥为例进行实证分析。
AI.motivation: 既有的持续同调方法在研究资源覆盖与干扰暴露时仅使用单参PH，无法刻画资源质量的异质性（或干扰严重程度的异质性），因此需要一个能同时考虑空间可达性与质量/严重程度差异的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用拓扑数据分析中的多参持续同调，并结合其计算高效的近似方法，构建可对任意资源（或干扰）依据任意质量（或严重程度）概念进行分析的通用框架。
AI.result: 以芝加哥为示例区域，运用该框架识别出公共公园可及性差的聚集区、垃圾填埋场过度暴露区，以及酒吧过度暴露与暴露不足的区域。
AI.conclusion: 多参持续同调的近似方法能够有效扩展拓扑数据分析在城市资源与干扰研究中的适用性，支持对异质质量资源及异质严重程度干扰进行细粒度空间分析。

title: Migration Genealogies in Multiregional Stable Populations: First-Return Decompositions, Recurrence, and Sensitivity
summary: When people of reproductive age move between regions, replacement-level fertility need not produce spatially balanced population replacement. Migration genealogies connect a woman's birth region, through survival and movement, to her daughters' birth regions across generations. We decompose existing genealogical series for stable births and reproductive value into first-return paths, on which a lineage again produces a descendant in its reference region without intermediate births there. Discounting at the intrinsic growth rate yields a first-return distribution with an Euler--Lotka-type normalization. Its mean recurrence generation, the expected generations until first return, equals the normalized product of stable births and reproductive value and, at replacement, reciprocal net reproduction sensitivity to within-region reproduction. Using Japan's 2010, 2015, and 2020 censuses, vital statistics, and life tables, we compare 47 prefectures under national replacement. Based on 2020 rates, mean recurrence is approximately 10 generations for Tokyo and 500 for Akita; Fukushima varies across observation years. Similar one-generation birth contributions conceal different descendant destinations and subsequent return pathways. These period-based results reveal how reproductive pathways generate regional differences in stationary populations. Population replacement must therefore be analyzed jointly through fertility, migration, and regional conditions, with mean recurrence identifying the strength of closed reproductive pathways.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“首次返回路径”分解方法，将稳定出生与生殖价值的谱系序列分解为首次返回分布，定义平均重现世代数，用于衡量区域封闭生殖路径的强度，并揭示人口更替在迁移下的空间不均衡。
AI.motivation: 育龄人口跨区域迁移时，更替水平生育率并不必然带来空间均衡的人口更替。现有研究缺乏刻画迁移谱系如何在区域间闭环生殖、以及区域封闭生殖路径强度的指标，因此需要新的分析框架。
AI.method: 将稳定出生与生殖价值的谱系序列分解为“首次返回路径”，即谱系在无中间本地出生的情况下再次于参照区域产生后代。以内在增长率贴现，得到带Euler–Lotka型归一化的首次返回分布。其平均重现世代数等于稳定出生与生殖价值归一化乘积，在更替水平下等于区域内部生殖的净生殖率敏感度倒数。利用日本2010、2015、2020年人口普查、生命统计与生命表，在全国更替水平下比较47个都道府县。
AI.result: 基于2020年率，东京平均重现约10代，秋田约500代；福岛在观测年份间变化明显。相似的单代出生贡献掩盖了不同的后代去向与后续返回路径。
AI.conclusion: 基于时期的结果揭示生殖路径如何造成静止人口的区域差异。人口更替须结合生育率、迁移与区域条件共同分析，平均重现世代数可识别封闭生殖路径的强度。

title: Classification of \(U(\mathfrak h)\)-Free Modules over the Heisenberg-Virasoro type Lie superalgebra via Polynomial Shift Operators
summary: Let \(\mathcal L\) be the Heisenberg-Virasoro type Lie superalgebra whose even part is the twisted Heisenberg-Virasoro algebra and whose odd part is an abelian ideal. We classify \(\mathbb Z_2\)-graded \(\mathcal L\)-modules that are free of super-rank \(1|1\) over \(U(\mathfrak h)=\mathbb C[L_0,F_0]\). Using polynomial shift operators, we express the defining relations as functional equations for the matrix entries of the generators. Assuming the rank one classification for the even subalgebra, we show that, up to parity reversal, every module with nontrivial odd action belongs to a triangular family \(Ω^+(λ,β,d)\), whereas every module with trivial odd action is a direct sum of two rank-one modules for the even subalgebra. We determine the graded isomorphism classes: within the triangular family, the coupling polynomial \(d\) is invariant up to multiplication by a non-zero scalar. We also describe canonical proper submodules and show that every module in the classification is reducible. In particular, we provide a new realization of the Heisenberg-Virasoro type Lie superalgebra using $2\times2$ matrices with entries associated with polynomial shift-differential operators.

AI.tldr: 本文分类了Heisenberg-Virasoro型Lie超代数 \(\mathcal L\)（偶部为twisted Heisenberg-Virasoro代数，奇部为交换理想）上在 \(U(\mathfrak h)=\mathbb C[L_0,F_0]\) 上超秩为 \(1|1\) 的自由 \(\mathbb Z_2\)-分次模。
AI.motivation: 研究Heisenberg-Virasoro型Lie超代数上的自由模结构，推广偶子代数的秩一分类结果，并给出该超代数的矩阵实现。
AI.method: 利用多项式平移算子将定义关系转化为生成元矩阵元素满足的函数方程；在偶子代数秩一分类假设下，分析奇部作用非平凡与平凡两种情形，并确定分次同构类。
AI.result: 在奇作用平凡时，模分解为两个偶子代数秩一模的直和；在奇作用非平凡时，模（至多相差宇称反转）属于三角族 \(\Omega^+(\lambda,\beta,d)\)。在三角族内，耦合多项式 \(d\) 在同构下可相差非零标量倍数。所有分类中的模均可约，并给出了用含多项式平移-微分算子元素的 \(2\times2\) 矩阵实现该超代数的新方法。
AI.conclusion: 完成了 \(\mathcal L\) 上超秩 \(1|1\) 自由模的分类，刻画了其同构类与可约性，并提供了该Lie超代数的矩阵实现。

title: An Efficient iLQR Algorithm for Optimal Control with Bounded States and Inputs: Application to Spacecraft Maneuvers
summary: This paper presents a constrained iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (Box-iLQR) method for nonlinear aerospace optimal-control problems with bounded states and controls. Logarithmic barrier functions are used with a two-fold objective: the barrier parameter is reduced toward zero to recover the constrained optimal trajectory, while a finite barrier is retained to construct a smooth, constraint-aware feedback policy for closed-loop operation. The method is demonstrated on spacecraft attitude control, a minimum-fuel planar orbit transfer, and an L2 to L2 halo-orbit transfer. Box-iLQR respects the imposed constraints and produces nominal trajectories together with time-varying feedback policies. Closed-loop simulations under disturbance, measurement noise, and control uncertainty show substantial reductions in terminal error. These results demonstrate that Box-iLQR provides both high-accuracy constrained trajectory optimization and practical constraint-aware feedback within a single framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Box-iLQR方法，利用对数障碍函数处理状态与控制受限的非线性航天器最优控制问题，实现约束轨迹优化与闭环反馈的统一。
AI.motivation: 非线性航天器最优控制需同时满足状态和控制的有界约束，且要求兼顾开环轨迹优化精度与闭环运行的实时反馈能力。
AI.method: 在迭代LQR框架中引入对数障碍函数，采用双重策略：将障碍参数趋近于零以恢复受约束的最优轨迹，同时保留有限障碍参数以构造光滑、约束感知的反馈策略。
AI.result: 在航天器姿态控制、最小燃料平面轨道转移及L2到L2晕轨道转移三类算例中，Box-iLQR均满足约束并给出标称轨迹与时变反馈策略；在扰动、测量噪声和控制不确定性下的闭环仿真中，终端误差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: Box-iLQR在单一框架内同时实现了高精度约束轨迹优化与实用的约束感知反馈控制。

title: Reduced Cartesian Kinetostatics for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots: Residual-Stabilized Full-Shape Propagation
summary: Many planning and control tasks for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) require the complete Cartesian backbone geometry. We present a reduced Cartesian framework for planar, axially compressible TDCRs that propagates equilibrium configurations along prescribed tendon-force and tendon-displacement trajectories. The backbone is represented by two global position fields. Following exact variation, a Taylor-Galerkin reduction condenses prescribed spatial properties and distributed loads into offline moment vectors, yielding analytic reduced residuals and Jacobians without online spatial quadrature or numerical differentiation. Analytical differentiation and residual correction yield first-order rate systems requiring one fixed-dimensional linear solve per rate evaluation after initial equilibrium alignment on a regular branch. Across four simulated cases covering variable tendon routing, nonuniform geometry, axial compression, and their combined effects, the propagated Cartesian shapes and distributed strains closely match pointwise geometrically variable-strain (GVS) equilibrium solutions. Residual correction suppresses propagation drift across the tested step sizes while adding only about 0.98% to the mean update time of uncorrected Euler. The proposed method requires 0.508 ms per update on average, approximately 11 times faster than pointwise GVS solves. Displacement-driven experiments yield a maximum normalized mean backbone position error of 1.02% and a maximum end-effector position error of 0.28%. These results support efficient and accurate Cartesian full-shape prediction along prescribed actuation paths.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向平面可轴向压缩腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR）的降阶笛卡尔框架，沿给定腱力/腱位移轨迹传播平衡构型，实现高效、精确的全形状预测。
AI.motivation: TDCR的许多规划与控制任务需要完整的笛卡尔主干几何，而逐点几何变应变（GVS）求解计算代价高，难以满足在线效率需求。
AI.method: 以两个全局位置场表示主干，基于精确变分，用Taylor-Galerkin降阶将空间属性与分布载荷凝聚为离线矩向量，得到解析降阶残差与雅可比，无需在线空间求积或数值微分；通过解析微分与残差修正构造一阶速率系统，每次速率评估仅需一次固定维线性求解（初始平衡对齐后）。
AI.result: 在变腱路由、非均匀几何、轴向压缩及其组合四类仿真中，传播的Cartesian形状与分布应变与逐点GVS解高度吻合；残差修正抑制传播漂移，仅使无修正Euler的平均更新时间增加约0.98%；平均每次更新0.508 ms，约为逐点GVS的11倍快；位移驱动实验最大归一化平均主干位置误差1.02%，最大末端位置误差0.28%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在给定驱动路径上实现高效且准确的笛卡尔全形状预测，适用于TDCR的规划与控制。

title: The third symmetric product of a set is a set in HoTT
summary: We deformalize an LLM-generated proof within the formalism of Homotopy Type Theory that an iterated pushout construction for $\operatorname{SP}^3(X)$ is a set whenever $X$ is a set. The proof expands on a similar proof by Buchholtz for $\operatorname{SP}^2(X)$, employing a similar encode-decode strategy and the same formal machinery.

AI.tldr: 本文将 LLM 生成的关于同伦类型论中 SP³(X) 迭代推出构造的证明进行了去形式化处理，证明当 X 是集合时 SP³(X) 也是集合，方法延续了 Buchholtz 对 SP²(X) 的编码-解码策略与形式化工具。
AI.motivation: 将机器（LLM）生成的形式化证明转译为人类可读的数学论证（去形式化），以检验并阐明该证明的数学结构，同时把 Buchholtz 关于 SP²(X) 的结果推广到 SP³(X)。
AI.method: 采用去形式化（deformalization）路径，移植并扩展 Buchholtz 对 SP²(X) 的证明框架：使用相同的编码-解码（encode-decode）策略与同伦类型论的同类形式化机器，对 SP³(X) 的迭代推出（iterated pushout）构造进行论证。
AI.result: 给出 SP³(X) 迭代推出构造在 X 为集合时是集合的非形式化证明，说明 LLM 生成的形式化证明可以在既有形式化机制下被重构为数学上可读的论证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明 LLM 生成的形式化证明可经去形式化被有效理解与检验，且 Buchholtz 的方法能自然推广到更高阶的对称幂 SP³(X) 情形。

title: Assessing the impact of climate change and rising temperature on life insurance portfolios
summary: Climate change may materially affect long-term life insurance liabilities by altering both the level and seasonal pattern of mortality. This article develops a multi-population mortality framework that combines a Hermite spline model with a distributed lag non-linear model to capture age-, region-, and temperature-specific mortality effects. We apply the framework to mortality and temperature data from 15 Spanish NUTS-2 regions and project future mortality under three shared socioeconomic pathway (SSP) scenarios.
