We then assess the implications for a hypothetical whole life insurance portfolio through expected death-benefit payments and portfolio profit and loss. The results reveal an important seasonal offset: warmer conditions reduce expected payoffs during winter periods but increase them during summer periods, with these effects becoming more pronounced under more severe climate scenarios and for policies issued in later years. Over longer horizons, adverse summer mortality effects become increasingly important. The portfolio analysis further shows that climate-related mortality risk can materially increase the dispersion and downside risk of portfolio outcomes, particularly under SSP5-8.5. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating temperature-related mortality effects into long-term life insurance liability projections and risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文构建结合Hermite样条与分布滞后非线性模型的多群体死亡率框架，纳入年龄、地区与温度效应，基于西班牙15个NUTS-2地区数据在三种SSP情景下预测死亡率，并评估对终身寿险组合的影响。结果显示存在季节性抵消：暖化降低冬季、提高夏季赔付，且气候情景越严峻、保单签发越晚，效应越明显；长期看夏季不利效应渐占主导。气候相关死亡率风险显著增加组合结果的离散度与下行风险，尤其在SSP5-8.5下。
AI.motivation: 气候变化可能通过改变死亡率的水平与季节模式，实质性影响长期寿险负债。既有研究对年龄、地区、温度特异性的死亡率效应刻画不足，且较少将其传导至寿险组合的赔付与盈亏评估。因此需要将温度相关死亡率效应纳入长期寿险负债预测与风险评估。
AI.method: 构建多群体死亡率框架，将Hermite样条模型与分布滞后非线性模型（DLNM）结合，以刻画年龄、地区与温度特异的死亡率效应；应用于西班牙15个NUTS-2地区的死亡率与温度数据，在三种SSP情景下预测未来死亡率；再通过预期身故给付支出及组合损益，评估其对假设性终身寿险组合的影响。
AI.result: 出现显著季节性抵消：暖化在冬季降低预期赔付、在夏季提高预期赔付；该效应在更严峻气候情景及较晚签发保单中更明显。在更长时期，夏季不利死亡率效应愈发重要。组合分析显示气候相关死亡率风险会实质性提高组合结果的离散度与下行风险，SSP5-8.5下尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 应将温度相关死亡率效应纳入长期寿险负债预测与风险评估，以更准确反映气候情景下的组合风险敞口。

title: Chiral Weyl-Kondo semimetallic state through enhanced correlation in CeGaGe
summary: Strongly correlated chiral materials have been proposed to host a chiral Weyl-Kondo semimetal (cWKSM) state, in which Kondo hybridization pins chirality-induced Kramers-Weyl point crossings, together with additional symmetry-enforced band crossings, near the Fermi level. Realizing this state requires a material that combines crystal chirality, non-symmorphic symmetry, and Kondo correlations, and currently there are no known materials that combine all these requirements. Here we report evidence for a cWKSM state in CeGaGe, a member of the RXY (R = rare earth; X = Al, Si; Y = Ga, Ge) family. Magnetization measurements confirm long-range antiferromagnetic order below T$_N$ = 4.7 K with a complex, canted magnetic structure. Unique to CeGaGe among the known RXY systems is a structural transition from an achiral tetragonal I4$_{1}$md structure (at high temperatures) to the chiral tetragonal P4$_{3}$ structure (at low temperatures). The structural transition in CeGaGe allows us to highlight the role of chirality in stabilizing the Kramers cWKSM state. Hall resistivity measurements with $H || c$ reveal an anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) that is constant below the Kondo temperature $T_K \approx 7$ K and drops sharply above it. This crossover tracks the onset of Kondo coherence rather than the magnetic ordering, which occurs at T$_N$ = 4.7 K. Together with first-principles calculations for the $P4_3$ structure, this identifies the AHC as an intrinsic, Berry-curvature-driven contribution generated by Kondo hybridization, rather than a consequence of extrinsic scattering or dynamic scalar spin chirality. These results establish CeGaGe as a rare experimental platform in which crystal chirality, strong electronic correlations, and non-trivial band topology coexist, providing the first material realization of a Kondo-driven cWKSM state.

AI.tldr: 本文报道CeGaGe中手性Weyl-Kondo半金属(cWKSM)态的实验证据，该材料兼具晶体手性、非对称性与Kondo关联。
AI.motivation: 手性Weyl-Kondo半金属态理论上被预言存在，但需要材料同时具备晶体手性、非对称对称性与Kondo关联，此前尚无已知材料满足全部条件。
AI.method: 对RXY家族成员CeGaGe开展磁化测量、霍尔电阻率测量(H||c)以及第一性原理计算，并结合其从非手性四方I4_1md到手性四方P4_3的结构相变进行分析。
AI.result: 磁化测量确认T_N=4.7 K以下存在长程反铁磁序，具有复杂倾斜磁结构；霍尔测量显示反常霍尔电导(AHC)在Kondo温度T_K≈7 K以下保持恒定、之上急剧下降，该转变跟随Kondo相干而非磁有序；结合第一性原理计算，AHC被确认为Kondo杂化产生的本征贝里曲率驱动贡献。
AI.conclusion: CeGaGe建立了晶体手性、强电子关联与非平庸能带拓扑共存的稀有实验平台，首次实现Kondo驱动的手性Weyl-Kondo半金属态。

title: First measurement of the antihydrogen production cross section through the charge-exchange reaction of low-energy antiprotons with orthopositronium
summary: The GBAR experiment has measured the formation rate of antihydrogen from antiproton impact on a positronium cloud for antiproton kinetic energies of 4 and 6 keV. This is the first charge-exchange cross section measurement performed using antiproton beams, which are provided by the AD-ELENA facility at CERN. The measured cross section values are $(14.1 \pm 1.3 \mathrm{(stat)} ^{+2.2}_{-1.4} \mathrm{(sys)}) \times 10^{-16}$~cm$^2$ at 6.2 keV energy and $(8.7 \pm 2.4 \mathrm{(stat)} ^{+1.5}_{-0.09} \mathrm{(sys)}) \times 10^{-16}$~cm$^2$ at 4.15 keV energy, and agree with recent theoretical three-body calculations for antihydrogen formation. These measurements are an important input for experiments with antimatter, e.g the planned measurements of antihydrogen gravitational acceleration in the GBAR collaboration.

AI.tldr: GBAR实验首次利用AD-ELENA反质子束测量了反质子与正电子素云碰撞生成反氢的电荷交换截面，在4和6 keV能量下的结果与近期三体理论计算一致。
AI.motivation: 反氢形成的电荷交换截面此前缺乏基于反质子束的直接实验测量，该数据对反物质实验（如反氢引力加速度测量）至关重要。
AI.method: 利用CERN的AD-ELENA设施提供的反质子束，轰击正电子素云，测量反质子动能为4和6 keV时反氢的形成率，从而获得电荷交换截面。
AI.result: 在6.2 keV能量下截面为(14.1 ± 1.3(stat) +2.2/-1.4(sys))×10⁻¹⁶ cm²；在4.15 keV能量下为(8.7 ± 2.4(stat) +1.5/-0.09(sys))×10⁻¹⁶ cm²，与近期理论三体计算结果相符。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次基于反质子束的电荷交换截面测量，结果为反物质实验（包括GBAR合作组计划的反氢引力加速度测量）提供了重要输入。

title: Conductors and Quadratic base change
summary: Let $F$ be a totally real field and $K/F$ a totally real quadratic extension. For a Hilbert cusp newform $f$ over $F$ with base change $f_K$ to $K,$ we determine the exact level of $f_K$ in terms of the level of $f,$ using only local representation theory: for each place $\mathfrak p$ of $F$ we compute how the conductor of the local component of $f$ changes under quadratic base change. The tame case (odd residue characteristic) follows from existing base change theory, but the case $p=2$ requires a finer $\varepsilon$-factor analysis that does not appear in the literature. We give a complete treatment of the dyadic imprimitive representations and, more delicately, the exceptional supercuspidal representations, for which no closed-form base change formula was previously known; in particular we determine, in terms of local root numbers, the base change of every exceptional supercuspidal representation of $GL(2,\mathbb Q_2)$ with trivial central character and conductor $3.$ This yields an explicit formula for the level of $f_K,$ specialized here to $F=\mathbb Q,$ along with a partial converse.

AI.tldr: 本文通过局部表示论精确确定了全实二次扩域下Hilbert尖新形式基变换的层次，重点处理p=2的精细ε-因子分析及例外超尖表示情形。
AI.motivation: 已有基变换理论可处理奇剩余特征（tame情形），但p=2（dyadic）的情形缺乏文献支持，特别是例外超尖表示的基变换无闭式公式。作者希望用纯局部表示论精确刻画基变换f_K的层次与f层次的关系。
AI.method: 对F的每个素位𝔭，计算局部成分的导子在二次基变换下的变化：tame情形沿用现有基变换理论；p=2情形采用更精细的ε-因子分析，完整处理dyadic非本原表示及更微妙的例外超尖表示，并以局部根数刻画GL(2,Q_2)上中心特征平凡、导子为3的例外超尖表示的基变换。
AI.result: 给出了f_K层次的显式公式（文中特化到F=Q的情形），并给出了一个部分逆定理；同时确定了GL(2,Q_2)上所有满足条件的例外超尖表示的基变换。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了p=2时二次基变换导子计算的空白，首次给出例外超尖表示基变换的闭式刻画，推广并细化了经典基变换理论。

title: Finite element error estimates for a bilinear optimal control problem with pointwise tracking governed by a semilinear elliptic PDE
summary: We study finite element approximations for an optimal control problem with pointwise tracking governed by a semilinear elliptic PDE. The control variable enters the state equation as a reaction coefficient, resulting in a bilinear control, and the cost functional includes point evaluations of the state variable. We propose two discretization schemes: a semidiscrete scheme, where the control variable is not discretized, and a fully discrete scheme, where the control variable is discretized using piecewise constant functions. In two and three dimensions, for both schemes, we establish convergence of discrete solutions and prove a priori error bounds that behave as $\mathcal{O}(h|\log h|)$ in the $L^2(Ω)$-norm for approximating a locally optimal control. In two dimensions, these bounds are improved to $\mathcal{O}(h)$ for the fully discrete scheme and $\mathcal{O}(h^{2}|\log h|^2)$ for the semidiscrete scheme. We conclude with numerical experiments that demonstrate the performance of the proposed schemes.

AI.tldr: 研究半线性椭圆PDE约束下带逐点追踪的最优控制问题的有限元逼近，提出半离散与全离散两种格式，并建立收敛性与先验误差估计。
AI.motivation: 控制以反应系数形式进入状态方程形成双线性控制，且代价泛函包含状态变量的点态求值，这类问题在离散化与误差分析上具有特殊困难，需要专门的有限元逼近理论与误差界。
AI.method: 针对半线性椭圆型PDE约束、含点态追踪的最优控制问题，构造两种离散格式：控制变量不离散的半离散格式，以及控制变量用分片常数离散的全离散格式；在二维和三维情形下分析离散解的收敛性并推导逼近局部最优控制的先验误差界。
AI.result: 在二维和三维中，两种格式均证明离散解收敛，并在L²(Ω)范数下得到O(h|log h|)的先验误差界；在二维中误差界进一步改进：全离散格式为O(h)，半离散格式为O(h²|log h|²)。数值实验验证了所提格式的性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的半离散与全离散有限元格式对含点态追踪的双线性最优控制问题是收敛且有效的，并在低维情形获得更优的误差阶，数值实验支持理论结果。

title: Absolute and relative invariants for low-dimensional topological insulators
summary:
[An extended abstract is provided in-text]
  Motivated by topological insulators, this paper analyzes classification schemes for projection-valued maps on $d$-dimensional tori, $d \le 2$, subject to Altland-Zirnbauer-Cartan (AZC) symmetries (time-reversal, particle-hole, and chiral). The main objective is to compare three notions of equivalence for these maps: Murray-von Neumann, unitary, and homotopy equivalence. The analysis relies on constructing symmetric bases for the projection ranges under a pseudo-periodicity constraint, where select basis vectors pick up a phase when looped around the torus. If $d=1$, fully periodic symmetric bases exist across all AZC classes. If $d=2$, topological obstructions appear as non-trivial phases characterized by $\mathbb{Z}$ (Chern number) or $\mathbb{Z}_2$ (Fu-Kane-Mele) invariants. These serve as absolute invariants that classify both Murray-von Neumann and unitary equivalences. For homotopy equivalence, the behavior depends on the ambient Hilbert space: if this has non-minimal dimension, homotopy equivalence reduces directly to unitary equivalence, while in minimal ambient spaces additional relative homotopy invariants emerge. Their precise values change under unitary conjugation, leaving only relative topological phases between maps well-defined. Ultimately, this provides a unified geometric framework for gapped quantum systems in low dimensions, demonstrating how distinct equivalence relations generate specific absolute and relative topological invariants.

AI.tldr: 本文在 d≤2 维环面上研究满足 AZC 对称性的投影值映射，比较 Murray–von Neumann、酉、同伦三种等价关系，并刻画对应的绝对与相对拓扑不变量。
AI.motivation: 受拓扑绝缘体研究启发，需要厘清 gapped 量子系统中投影值映射在不同等价关系下的分类差异，尤其是对称性约束下三类等价（Murray–von Neumann、酉、同伦）之间的关系。
AI.method: 构造投影值域的对称基，基向量在环绕环面时获得相位（伪周期性约束）；对 d=1 与 d=2 情形分别分析，并用 Čech/上同调型不变量区分等价类。
AI.result: d=1 时所有 AZC 类均存在完全周期的对称基；d=2 时出现由 Z（Chern 数）或 Z₂（Fu–Kane–Mele）刻画的非平凡相位，作为绝对不变量同时分类 Murray–von Neumann 与酉等价。同伦等价依赖环境 Hilbert 空间：非极小维时退化为酉等价，极小维时出现额外的相对同伦不变量，其取值在酉共轭下改变，仅相对拓扑相位良定义。
AI.conclusion: 为低维 gapped 量子系统提供了一个统一几何框架，阐明不同等价关系分别产生绝对与相对拓扑不变量。

title: Not all spins of black-hole binaries formed in clusters are isotropic and not all spins of black-hole binaries formed in isolation are aligned
summary: Spin directions are promising observables for distinguishing between the formation channels of merging stellar-mass binary black holes with gravitational-wave observations. In this work, we challenge the standard expectation that binaries formed via dynamical interactions in stellar clusters have isotropically distributed spins and that binaries formed in isolation have spins aligned with the orbital angular momentum. For dynamically formed binaries, we account for observational findings suggesting that the spins of stars in clusters may exhibit a preferred degree of alignment and construct a simple geometrical description of the resulting black-hole spin directions. This results in an analytical joint distribution for the polar angles of first-generation black-hole binaries, whose key feature is a correlation between the two spin-orbit tilts. We show that, under reasonable assumptions and independently of the initial spin configuration, spins are fully randomized after a single black-hole merger, implying that binaries formed through hierarchical mergers have isotropically distributed spin orientations. For isolated binaries, we introduce a simple model for spin evolution as a function of the natal kick imparted during the first supernova explosion, while accounting for tidal interactions and mass-ratio reversal. The resulting distribution is also fully analytic. We investigate the impact of relativistic spin precession, as well as that of the finite escape speed of clusters, on our geometrically derived distributions. Our results provide a simple analytical framework for modeling the spin directions of merging black holes in gravitational-wave population fits.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了双黑洞形成通道中自旋方向的传统预期，为动力学形成与孤立演化两类通道构建了解析的自旋方向分布模型。
AI.motivation: 利用引力波观测区分双黑洞的形成通道时，自旋方向是重要观测量。传统观点认为：星团中动力学形成的双星自旋各向同性，而孤立形成的双星自旋与轨道角动量对齐。作者意在检验并修正这一标准预期。
AI.method: 对动力学形成的双星，考虑星团中恒星自旋可能存在一定程度的优先对齐，建立黑洞自旋方向的几何描述，得到第一代双黑洞极角的解析联合分布，其关键特征是两自旋-轨道倾角之间的相关性。对孤立双星，引入自旋演化随第一次超新星爆发时natal kick变化的简单模型，并考虑潮汐相互作用与质量比反转，所得分布同样完全解析。此外还考察了相对论自旋进动与星团有限逃逸速度的影响。
AI.result: 动力学形成情形下，两自旋-轨道倾角存在相关性；在合理假设下，无论初始自旋构型如何，自旋在单次黑洞并合后完全随机化，意味着通过层级并合形成的双星自旋取向各向同性。孤立双星情形的分布可由natal kick驱动的解析模型描述。研究还给出了自旋进动与逃逸速度对这些几何分布的修正。
AI.conclusion: 本文为引力波族群拟合中并合黑洞自旋方向的建模提供了简洁的解析框架，有助于更准确地用自旋方向区分双黑洞的形成通道。

title: Models of Ecological Fitting
summary: Ecological fitting describes a situation where species interact despite no shared evolutionary history. It is both a null model for adaptation and an important process in its own right, for example, the establishment of a non-native species is ecological fitting, and it is a major mechanism in the formation of Novel Ecosystems. In this paper we introduce and analyse a model of ecological fitting. We demonstrate both analytically and through simulation that the main factors determining invasion success are the invaded ecosystem's population and diversity, which set the size of the barrier for invaders. We also study the situation where many evolutionarily unrelated species simultaneously colonise an empty area. We show that a successful equilibrium is likely to be established, but the diversity tends to be very much less than the number of species in the starting pool and discuss the implications of this.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一个生态适配（ecological fitting）模型，通过解析与模拟证明：决定入侵成功的主要因素是受侵生态系统的种群规模与多样性，它们设定了入侵者所需跨越的屏障大小；同时研究了多个无亲缘关系物种同时殖民空区域的情形，发现成功平衡虽易建立，但多样性远低于初始物种库。
AI.motivation: 生态适配指物种在无共同进化历史的情况下仍能发生相互作用，它既是适应性的零模型，本身也是重要过程（如非本地物种定殖、新型生态系统形成的主要机制）。然而缺乏对其定量刻画与机制分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建生态适配的数学模型，采用解析推导与数值模拟相结合的方法：分析决定入侵成功的关键因素；并考察多个进化上无关的物种同时殖民空区域的动态过程。
AI.result: 入侵成功的主要决定因素是受侵生态系统的种群规模与多样性，二者共同决定了入侵者必须跨越的屏障大小；在多物种同时殖民空区域的情形下，系统倾向于建立成功的平衡态，但最终多样性显著低于初始物种库的物种数。
AI.conclusion: 生态适配过程可形成稳定平衡，但存在强烈的多样性损失，这对非本地物种建立与新型生态系统的多样性预期具有重要启示。

title: Rootwise estimates for Weyl alternants
summary: For a reduced crystallographic root system with Weyl group $W$, Weyl alternants are signed sums of exponentials indexed by $W$. They occur in the numerators of the Weyl character formula and the explicit formula for spherical functions on complex semisimple groups. We establish rootwise bounds that quantify cancellation in these oscillatory sums, with each positive root contributing a factor depending on both the spatial variable and the spectral parameter. More generally, we establish rootwise bounds for all mixed directional derivatives of normalized Weyl alternants. Our proof extends to arbitrary rank the descent strategy used by the second author for pointwise character bounds on $\mathrm{SU}(3)$. The key ingredients include the decomposition of the Weyl group into parabolic double cosets and the relative BGG--Demazure identity. For spherical functions on complex semisimple groups, these estimates recover the recent pointwise bound of Brumley, Marshall, Matz, and Peterson, and they refine the derivative bounds of Cowling and Nevo by controlling arbitrary mixed radial derivatives uniformly across spatial and spectral root hyperplanes. Furthermore, by a standard localization argument relative to the affine Weyl arrangement, we establish periodic alternant estimates for regular integral weights and corresponding rootwise bounds for all mixed radial derivatives of irreducible characters of compact connected semisimple groups.

AI.tldr: 本文对约化晶体根系的外尔交替和及其归一化形式的混合方向导数建立了逐根界的估计，量化了振荡和中的相消现象，并将结果应用于复半单群上的球函数与紧连通半单群不可约特征。
AI.motivation: 外尔交替和出现在外尔特征公式分子以及复半单群球函数的显式中，其振荡求和的相消估计在表示论与调和分析中具有核心意义；此前对SU(3)的逐点界方法需要推广到任意秩，并获得对空间变量与谱参数同时一致的导数控制。
AI.method: 将第二作者处理SU(3)逐点特征界所用的下降策略推广到任意秩：利用外尔群分解为抛物双陪集以及相对BGG–Demazure恒等式，建立逐根界并推广至归一化外尔交替和的任意混合方向导数；再通过相对于仿射外尔arrangement的标准局部化论证，得到正则整权重的周期交替和估计。
AI.result: 获得了带逐根因子的相消界，每个正根贡献一个同时依赖空间变量与谱参数的因子；对复半单群球函数恢复了Brumley–Marshall–Matz–Peterson的近期逐点界，并精化了Cowling–Nevo的导数界，实现任意混合径向导数在空间与谱根超平面间的一致控制；同时对紧连通半单群不可约特征给出了所有混合径向导数的逐根界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以统一的逐根框架刻画了外尔交替和及其导数的相消结构，将低秩逐点估计技术提升到任意秩，并在球函数与特征理论中统一和强化了已有的逐点与导数界。

title: Convergent Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Annealed Noise Levels
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods solve imaging inverse problems by incorporating deep denoisers into iterative optimization algorithms. Although practical implementations often decrease the denoiser noise level $σ$ along iterations, most existing convergence analyses assume a fixed denoiser. In this work, we establish convergence guarantees for a broad family of Plug-and-Play algorithms with annealed noise level, spanning deterministic methods (RED--GD and PnP--PGD) and stochastic methods (SNORE, equivariant RED, and a variant of PnP--Flow). For each method, we identify an explicit, nonconvex objective associated with the terminal denoising level and prove asymptotic stationarity of the iterates with respect to this objective. Our analysis does not prescribe any decay rate for the noise schedule, and our assumptions cover both learned gradient-step denoisers and exact MMSE denoisers. Overall, our theoretical results bridge the gap between existing PnP convergence theory and the decreasing-denoising practices used by state-of-the-art image restoration methods. We empirically demonstrate the benefits of such schedules and illustrate the predicted convergence behavior on several imaging inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, demosaicing and tomography.

AI.tldr: 本文为带退火噪声水平的即插即用（PnP）算法族建立收敛保证，涵盖确定性与随机方法，证明迭代点相对于终端去噪水平对应的非凸目标的渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有PnP收敛分析多假设去噪器固定，而实际先进图像复原方法常随迭代降低去噪噪声水平σ，理论与实践存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 针对退火噪声水平的PnP算法族，为每种方法构造与终端去噪水平关联的显式非凸目标，分析其渐近稳定性；不规定噪声调度衰减率，假设覆盖学习梯度步去噪器与精确MMSE去噪器。涵盖RED-GD、PnP-PGD、SNORE、等变RED及PnP-Flow变体。
AI.result: 证明了迭代点相对于终端去噪水平对应非凸目标的渐近稳定性；在修复、超分辨、去马赛克和断层成像等逆问题上验证了退火调度的收益及预测的收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: 理论结果弥合了现有PnP收敛理论与先进图像复原所用递减去噪实践之间的差距，且对噪声调度不设衰减率要求。

title: Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy
summary: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 在固定CARLA停车场中，作者为已有端到端泊车策略（继承Yang等的视觉Transformer架构）设计了一个手动标定的定时规则型参数化安全盾（PSS），用于纠正失败模式。闭环评估中目标成功率从327/384（85.16%）提升至375/384（97.66%），成功样本平均位置误差0.21m、朝向误差0.33度。结果仅在单一地图、车辆与传感器配置下成立，不构成泛化性结论或形式化安全保证。
AI.motivation: 端到端泊车策略在闭环执行中会出现反复性失效（越界、制动延迟、停顿或振荡控制），而仅靠重新训练难以稳定消除这些runtime失效。作者希望在不改动视觉Transformer策略主体的前提下，验证一个手工设定的运行时监督器能否纠正这些反复出现的失败。
AI.method: 策略主体沿用Yang等的视觉Transformer端到端泊车架构（经重训练）。贡献为施加于其控制输出上的定时、基于规则的安全盾（Parametric Safety Shield, PSS）：使用手工标定的速度、位置与时长阈值，在检测到越界出界、制动延迟、停顿或振荡控制等失效模式时进行干预。评估为闭环形式，覆盖16个留出目标车位与6个初始位姿，每种配置进行4轮，共384次尝试/配置；PSS依赖仿真器世界坐标。
AI.result: 目标成功率由重训练策略的327/384（85.16%）提升至加装PSS后的375/384（97.66%）；成功尝试的平均位置误差为0.21m，平均朝向误差为0.33度。
AI.conclusion: 在该仿真器设定内，规则型PSS可有效抑制端到端泊车策略的反复失效并提升任务成功率。但评估共用同一地图、车辆与传感器配置，且PSS使用仿真世界坐标，因此结果不能证明对其他停车场或真实车辆的泛化能力，也不提供形式化安全保证。

title: Critical Diameters and Vietoris-Rips Filtrations
summary:
We relate critical diameters of finite configurations to the topology of Vietoris-Rips complexes. For a compact metric space and $0<r<s$, we prove that the canonical inclusion from scale $r$ to scale $s$ is a homotopy equivalence whenever $[r,s)$ contains no diameter of a finite labelled configuration at which the diameter function has zero weak slope.
  On Riemannian manifolds, weak-slope stationarity implies Clarke criticality. At positive diameter, when the distances realizing the diameter are smooth, both are equivalent to first-order stationarity: the absence of a direction decreasing all these distances to first order. For closed connected smooth manifolds, the Clarke critical diameter spectrum has Hausdorff dimension zero, even at the cut locus. In the real-analytic case, it is finite at each fixed number of labels and countable over all label numbers.
  On the unit round sphere $S^m$, $m\geq1$, positive nonantipodal weak-slope stationary configurations are characterized by nonzero nonnegative equilibrium stresses. The least positive critical diameter is $\arccos(-1/(m+1))$, and the first accumulation point is $\arccos(-1/m)$. We lift every such stress through a spherical stack construction adapted from Lovász, producing stationary diameters that approach the original value from below in the next dimension as the number of layers increases. We also give example in general metric space showing that weak-slope stationary diameters need not correspond to changes in the homotopy type of Vietoris-Rips complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限构型临界直径与Vietoris-Rips复形拓扑之间的联系，证明在区间$[r,s)$不含零弱斜率临界直径时，尺度$r$到$s$的包含映射为同伦等价；并在黎曼流形与单位球面上刻画了临界直径谱的结构。
AI.motivation: Vietoris-Rips复形随尺度变化的同伦类型跳变通常与"临界直径"相关，但缺乏对临界直径的严格几何分析与定量刻画，尤其在流形与球面等具体空间中。本文旨在给出临界性的分析判据（弱斜率、Clarke临界性）并研究其谱结构。
AI.method: 引入直径函数的弱斜率（weak slope）稳定性概念，证明包含映射的同伦等价判据；在黎曼流形上建立弱斜率与Clarke临界性的关系及其与一阶稳定性的等价条件；利用球面平衡应力刻画$S^m$上的弱斜率稳定构型，并借由Lovász的球面叠加（spherical stack）构造提升应力。
AI.result: （1）若$[r,s)$不含零弱斜率临界直径，则$r\to s$的包含为同伦等价。（2）闭连通光滑流形上Clarke临界直径谱Hausdorff维数为零，含割迹处；实解析情形下，固定标签数时有限，全体标签数时可数。（3）$S^m$上正的非对径弱斜率稳定构型由非零非负平衡应力刻画；最小正临界直径为$\arccos(-1/(m+1))$，首个聚点为$\arccos(-1/m)$；并通过球面叠加构造出从下方逼近原值的静止直径。（4）一般度量空间中给出反例，说明弱斜率静止直径未必对应Vietoris-Rips复形同伦类型的变化。
AI.conclusion: 临界直径可由弱斜率/Clarke临界性分析刻画，并据此控制Vietoris-Rips复形同伦类型的稳定区间；但其同伦跳变与临界性并不完全对应，需谨慎区分。球面情形给出了显式临界值及谱的累积结构。

title: Crypto Price Similarity: An Investigation Using Pearson Correlation and Dynamic Time Warping
summary: The cryptocurrency market's volatility and complex price dynamics challenge portfolio diversification and risk management. This study examines price similarity across 347 cryptocurrencies from March 2020 to April 2024 using daily OHLCV data from the Binance API. Daily dynamics are summarized via a signed, capped intraday price-range metric, and pair similarity is assessed using the Pearson cross-correlation coefficient, capturing linear co-movement at a given lag, and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) distance, capturing shape similarity independent of lag. Data are segmented into three market phases: an uptrend, a decline, and a subsequent uptrend. For each period, the 10 pairs with highest cross-correlation and lowest DTW distance are identified. BNB-CAKE, XLM-XRP, and MANA-SAND show the strongest cross correlations across the three periods, with coefficients of 0.78 or higher and maximum correlations at lag 0, indicating synchronized movements. Three to four of the ten lowest-DTW pairs coincide with the cross-correlation top 10 per period, showing the measures are related but not interchangeable. Two same-platform fan tokens rank among the most DTW-similar pairs despite weak cross-correlation, while a euro pegged asset and gold-backed token show the lowest DTW distance, driven by low volatility rather than shared dynamics. Results demonstrate substantial, measure dependent interconnectedness with implications for diversification strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究用2020年3月至2024年4月347种加密货币的日度OHLCV数据，基于日内价格区间符号化指标，结合Pearson互相关与DTW距离度量币对相似性，发现币对间存在显著但依赖度量方式的联动性，对多元化策略具启示。
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场波动剧烈且价格动态复杂，给投资组合多元化与风险管理带来挑战，需要刻画币对之间的价格相似性与联动结构。
AI.method: 采用Binance API获取347种加密货币日度OHLCV数据；用带符号、设上限的日内价格区间指标概括日度动态；以Pearson互相关系数（给定滞后下的线性共动）和DTW距离（与滞后无关的形态相似性）评估币对相似性；将数据划分为上涨、下跌、再上涨三个阶段，各期选出相关性最高与DTW距离最低的前10对币对。
AI.result: BNB-CAKE、XLM-XRP、MANA-SAND在三阶段中互相关最强，系数≥0.78且最大相关出现在滞后0期，呈同步波动；每期DTW最低的10对中有3–4对与互相关前10重合，说明两种度量相关但不可互换；两枚同平台粉丝代币DTW高度相似但互相关较弱，而一枚欧元锚定资产与黄金背书代币DTW距离最低，源于低波动而非共同动态。
AI.conclusion: 加密市场存在显著的、依赖度量方式的互联性，对多元化策略具有重要含义。

title: Symmetry-permuting entanglers for non-invertible symmetry-protected topological phases
summary: 1+1D symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases with invertible symmetry can be characterized by the symmetric entanglers: globally symmetric finite-depth local unitary circuits that generate representative ground states from a product state. For non-invertible symmetries, however, distinct SPT phases, such as the three $\mathrm{Rep}(D_8)$ SPT phases, may not be connected by any symmetric entangler. We show that the three $\mathrm{Rep}(D_8)$ SPT phases can nevertheless be connected by \emph{symmetry-permuting} finite-depth local unitary circuits, realizing dualities predicted by topological quantum field theory (TQFT). We construct an explicit matrix product unitary connecting two of the $\mathrm{Rep}(D_8)$ SPT phases, and show that its action on string order parameters reproduces the anyon permutation predicted by the TQFT duality.

AI.tldr: 本文证明三个 Rep(D8) SPT 相不能由对称纠缠器连接，但可由"置换对称"的有限深度局域酉电路连接，实现 TQFT 预言的二象性，并显式构造了连接其中两相的矩阵乘积酉。
AI.motivation: 1+1D 可逆对称 SPT 相可由对称纠缠器刻画，但对非可逆对称，不同 SPT 相（如三个 Rep(D8) SPT 相）可能无法由任何对称纠缠器连接，需寻找新的连接机制。
AI.method: 引入"置换对称的有限深度局域酉电路"概念，构造显式的矩阵乘积酉连接两个 Rep(D8) SPT 相，并分析其对弦序参量的作用。
AI.result: 三个 Rep(D8) SPT 相可由置换对称的有限深度局域酉电路相互连接；所构造的矩阵乘积酉对弦序参量的作用复现了 TQFT 二象性预言的任意子置换。
AI.conclusion: 非可逆对称 SPT 相之间的等价关系可通过置换对称电路刻画，为 TQFT 二象性提供了格点实现。

title: Using Graph Neural Networks for the segmentation of overlapping objects in high granularity calorimeters
summary: High-granularity calorimeters at the High-Luminosity LHC require novel algorithms to resolve overlapping particle showers. We present an optimised Graph Neural Network (GNN) segmentation block that predicts node-level energy fractions to disentangle overlapping two-photon showers. By accelerating graph construction and convolution operations, our pipeline achieves competitive separation efficiency with significantly reduced algorithmic complexity.

AI.tldr: 针对高亮度LHC高粒度量能器的双光子簇射重叠问题，本文提出一种优化的GNN分割模块，以节点级能量分数预测实现簇射解纠缠，并通过加速图构建与卷积运算在降低算法复杂度的同时保持有竞争力的分离效率。
AI.motivation: 高亮度LHC的高粒度量能器面临粒子簇射相互重叠的挑战，传统方法难以有效分辨，需要新的算法来分离重叠的簇射信号。
AI.method: 提出一种优化的图神经网络（GNN）分割模块（segmentation block），以节点级能量分数（node-level energy fractions）为预测目标，对重叠的双光子簇射进行解纠缠；同时针对图构建与图卷积运算进行加速优化。
AI.result: 在显著降低算法复杂度的同时，达到了具有竞争力的分离效率（separation efficiency）。
AI.conclusion: 优化的GNN分割方案能够在控制计算开销的前提下有效分离重叠双光子簇射，适用于高亮度LHC高粒度量能器的重建需求。

title: Factorizations in algebraic monogenic semidomains
summary: We study the additive and multiplicative arithmetic of algebraic monogenic semidomains of the form $S_α$. We first relate their structure to the conjugates of $α$, characterize when $S_α$ is a ring, and determine when its additive monoid is free. We then investigate units and prove a Dirichlet-type theorem showing that $S_α^\times$ is the product of a finite cyclic group of roots of unity and a finitely generated free abelian group; in particular, the unit group is free abelian when $α$ is positive. We also give a criterion that produces non-atomic algebraic monogenic semidomains. Turning to finiteness properties, we prove that $\mathbb{Z}[α]$ is a finite factorization domain for every algebraic number $α$, establish criteria ensuring that $S_α$ is a finite factorization semidomain, and construct infinitely many positive cubic generators yielding finite factorization semidomains that are not rings. Finally, we give a membership criterion for rational elements of $\mathbb{Z}[β]$ for arbitrary algebraic $β$, and prove that, for algebraic integers $α$, unique factorization ascends from $\mathbb{Z}[α]$ to $\mathbb{Z}[α/n]$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$.

AI.tldr: 研究代数单项半整环 $S_\alpha$ 的加法与乘法算术性质，涉及单位群结构、有限分解性质及唯一分解的上升性。
AI.motivation: 系统刻画代数单项半整环 $S_\alpha$ 的算术结构，包括其与代数数共轭的关系、是否为环、加法幺半群是否自由，以及单位群与分解性质。
AI.method: 将 $S_\alpha$ 的结构与 $\alpha$ 的共轭相联系；研究单位并证明 Dirichlet 型定理，将 $S_\alpha^\times$ 分解为有限循环群（单位根）与有限生成自由阿贝尔群之积；给出构造非原子半整环的判据；利用有限分解域理论证明 $\mathbb{Z}[\alpha]$ 的性质；给出 $\mathbb{Z}[\beta]$ 中有理元素的成员判据。
AI.result: 刻画了 $S_\alpha$ 何时为环及其加法幺半群何时自由；证明 $S_\alpha^\times$ 为有限循环群与有限生成自由阿贝尔群之积，正 $\alpha$ 时单位群为自由阿贝尔群；给出非原子代数单项半整环的判据；证明对任意代数数 $\alpha$，$\mathbb{Z}[\alpha]$ 是有限分解域，并给出 $S_\alpha$ 为有限分解半整环的判据，构造无穷多个正三次生成元给出的非环有限分解半整环；给出成员判据并证明对代数整数 $\alpha$，唯一分解由 $\mathbb{Z}[\alpha]$ 上升到 $\mathbb{Z}[\alpha/n]$。
AI.conclusion: 代数单项半整环 $S_\alpha$ 具有良好的算术与有限性结构：单位群为挠部分与自由部分之积，$\mathbb{Z}[\alpha]$ 总为有限分解域，且唯一分解在一定条件下具有上升性。

title: Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Differential and Partial Differential Inclusions
summary: We introduce Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (DR-PINNs), a physics-informed learning framework for approximating solutions of ordinary and partial differential inclusions (DIs), governing laws in which a differential operator is constrained to lie in a set-valued map rather than equaling a prescribed function. The method replaces the classical pointwise PDE/ODE residual by the squared distance from the differential operator to the admissible set. This distance vanishes exactly when the inclusion is satisfied and measures the infimal correction needed for the operator to enter the admissible set. For a fixed closed convex admissible set, the squared distance is differentiable with respect to the operator value, with gradient given by the metric projection. When the admissible set also depends on the network state, that dependence is included through the chain rule. The framework encompasses ordinary and partial DIs with set-valued reaction terms. For both settings we prove consistency: under the stated closedness, measurability, convexity, and growth assumptions, any sequence of candidates satisfying the initial (and, in the parabolic case, boundary) conditions whose continuous distance-residual functional tends to zero admits a subsequence converging to an exact solution of the target inclusion. These are conditional statements for the continuous distance-residual functional; they do not cover the finite-collocation training loss, the behavior of the optimizer, or convergence rates. For admissible sets given as convex hulls of finitely many vertices, projection onto the set reduces to a small convex quadratic program, making the loss efficiently computable inside the training loop. Numerical experiments demonstrate high accuracy on the differential-inclusion benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出距离残差物理信息神经网络（DR-PINNs），用微分算子到容许集的平方距离替代经典逐点残差，用于求解常微分与偏微分包含（DIs），并证明了一致性，数值实验显示高精度。
AI.motivation: 经典PINN依赖逐点残差等于零，但微分包含中算子被约束在集值映射内而非等于给定函数，传统残差形式不适用，因此需要新的残差构造来刻画"包含"这一约束。
AI.method: 以微分算子到容许集的平方距离作为残差，该距离在包含满足时为零，并度量使算子进入容许集的最小修正量。对固定闭凸容许集，平方距离对算子值可微，梯度由度量投影给出；当容许集依赖网络状态时通过链式法则纳入。容许集为有限顶点凸包时，投影化为小型凸二次规划，使损失可在训练循环内高效计算。
AI.result: 在闭性、可测性、凸性与增长性假设下证明一致性：任何满足初值（抛物情形下还有边界）条件且连续距离残差泛函趋于零的候选序列，都存在收敛到目标包含精确解的子列。数值实验在微分包含基准上取得高精度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一处理带集值反应项的常微分与偏微分包含，并提供可计算、可微的残差损失。需注意结论仅为关于连续距离残差泛函的条件性陈述，不涵盖有限配点训练损失、优化器行为或收敛速率。

title: Poisson eigenvalue statistics and dynamical delocalization for fractional and long-range Anderson models
summary: We study local eigenvalue statistics and dynamical (de)-localization properties for long-range Anderson models, including the fractional Anderson model. These systems are random Anderson-type perturbations of operators with long-range (non random) hopping terms of the form $|T(n,m)| \sim \|n-m\|^{-(d+2β)}$ for $β>0$, on the $d$-dimensional lattice. In the presence of a strong enough random potential, these models exhibit dense pure point spectrum with polynomially decaying eigenvectors, almost surely. We show that in this strong disorder regime, and for $β>d/2$, the local eigenvalue statistics centered at any $E$ in the deterministic spectrum is a Poisson point process with intensity given by the density of states function $n(E)$. Moreover, we prove that, at strong disorder, there is no dynamical localization for these models, verifying a conjecture of Disertori et al. We achieve this by establishing explicit, sharp lower bounds on the Green's functions fractional moments which imply that large moments of the position operator are infinite. Hence, these models exhibit Poisson eigenvalue statistics and dynamical delocalization, that is, the absence of dynamical localization. In particular, this shows that in dimension $d=1$, the fractional Anderson model, a random perturbation of the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^α$ with $α\in (0,1)$, exhibits Poisson eigenvalue statistics and dynamical delocalization if the disorder is strong and the exponent $\frac{1}{2}<α<1$. This is in stark contrast with what is known for the usual Anderson model that has only nearest-neighbor hopping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长程 Anderson 模型（含分数阶 Anderson 模型）在强无序区域的本征值局域统计与动力学（去）局域化：当 β>d/2、无序足够强时，中心化本征值统计为强度由态密度 n(E) 给出的 Poisson 点过程，且不存在动力学局域化，从而验证了 Disertori 等人的猜想。该结论与仅含最近邻跃迁的通常 Anderson 模型形成鲜明对比。
AI.motivation: 通常的 Anderson 模型（最近邻跃迁）在强无序下具有稠密纯点谱、指数衰减本征向量与动力学局域化，且本征值统计通常为 Poisson 点过程。本文关注当非随机跃迁项变为长程衰减 |T(n,m)| ~ ||n-m||^{-(d+2β)}（β>0）时，强无序区域的本征值统计与动力学局域化是否发生定性改变，尤其是分数阶 Anderson 模型（α∈(0,1)）这一具体情形，并检验 Disertori 等人关于该类模型不存在动力学局域化的猜想。
AI.method: 在 d 维格点上考虑长程 Anderson 型随机扰动，非随机跳跃项满足 |T(n,m)| ~ ||n-m||^{-(d+2β)}，β>0；在强无序（足够强的随机势）条件下，结合分数阶 Anderson 模型（分数 Laplacian (-Δ)^α 的随机扰动，α∈(0,1)）。关键技术手段是建立 Green 函数分数矩的显式、尖锐下界，从而证明位置算子的大矩发散（无穷），据此推导本征值统计与动力学去局域化性质。分析限定于 β>d/2 的强无序区域。
AI.result: 1) 强无序且 β>d/2 时，中心于确定性谱中任意能量 E 的局部本征值统计为 Poisson 点过程，其强度由态密度函数 n(E) 给出；2) 强无序下这些模型不存在动力学局域化，验证了 Disertori 等人的猜想；3) 关键机制是 Green 函数分数矩的尖锐下界导致位置算子的大矩为无穷，从而同时给出 Poisson 本征值统计与动力学去局域化；4) 在一维情形 d=1，分数阶 Anderson 模型在强无序且 1/2<α<1 时呈现 Poisson 本征值统计与动力学去局域化，这与最近邻跃迁的通常 Anderson 模型形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 长程跃迁显著改变强无序 Anderson 模型的谱与动力学性质：当 β>d/2 时，模型虽保持稠密纯点谱与多项式衰减本征向量，却表现出 Poisson 本征值统计和动力学去局域化，而非通常 Anderson 模型的动力学局域化。分数阶 Anderson 模型（d=1，1/2<α<1，强无序）即为该现象的典型例子，证实了 Disertori 等人的猜想，说明长程跳跃导致的去局域化效应在强无序下依然稳健。

title: Polarization Signatures of Sgr A* with Tilted Hybrid Magnetic Fields
summary: The magnetic field geometry in the near-horizon region is very important in shaping polarimetric signatures of black hole images. With a hybrid magnetic field consisting of an axisymmetric split-monopole field and a tilted uniform external field, we investigate the effects of external magnetic field inclination on the polarimetric signatures of Sgr A* by employing a stationary semi-analytical radiatively inefficient accretion flow (RIAF) model and general relativistic polarized radiative transfer simulations. Our results show that the external magnetic field tilt significantly modifies the electric vector position angle (EVPA) pattern and brightness distribution. The induced non-axisymmetry from the tilted magnetic filed component renders polarization morphology dependent on the observer's azimuthal angle, which is a novel behavior absent in purely axisymmetric magnetic field configurations. In combination with Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) data, we analyse the possibility of such hybrid magnetic fields around Sgr A*.

AI.tldr: 采用轴对称分裂单极磁场与倾斜均匀外部磁场组成的混合磁场，结合稳态半解析RIAF模型和广义相对论偏振辐射转移模拟，研究了外部磁场倾角对Sgr A*偏振特征的影响，发现倾角显著改变EVPA图样与亮度分布，并引入依赖观测方位角的偏振形态。
AI.motivation: 黑洞近视界区域的磁场几何对黑洞图像偏振特征的形成至关重要；纯轴对称磁场难以解释偏振形态中可能存在的非轴对称特征，因此需要考察外部倾斜磁场的影响。
AI.method: 构建由轴对称分裂单极磁场与倾斜均匀外部磁场叠加而成的混合磁场；采用稳态半解析的辐射低效吸积流（RIAF）模型，并开展广义相对论偏振辐射转移模拟，分析不同外部磁场倾角下的偏振特征，同时结合EHT观测数据讨论Sgr A*周围存在此类混合磁场的可能性。
AI.result: 外部磁场倾角显著改变电场矢量位置角（EVPA）图样与亮度分布；倾斜磁场分量引入的非轴对称性使偏振形态依赖于观测者方位角，这是纯轴对称磁场构型中所不具备的新行为。
AI.conclusion: 外部倾斜磁场可通过非轴对称效应塑造Sgr A*的偏振形态，混合磁场模型为解释EHT偏振观测提供了可行方向，其与观测数据的符合程度可用于约束Sgr A*近视界区的磁场几何。

title: Bacteriophage Q$β$: Six Decades at the Frontier of Molecular and Viral Evolution
summary: Bacteriophage Q$β$, first isolated in 1961, has served for more than six decades as a model system for molecular and viral evolution. The development of cell-free replication systems based on the Q$β$ replicase enabled the first demonstrations of Darwinian evolution in RNA molecules. In parallel, the phage's compact RNA genome, high mutation rate, and ease of propagation established Q$β$ as an exceptionally tractable model for studying viral evolution. The discovery of extensive genetic heterogeneity made of Q$β$ the first biological system in which molecular quasispecies theory found direct experimental support. Building on this foundation, decades of evolution experiments under thermal, ecological, and mutagenic pressures established how mutation, selection, epistasis, and population structure jointly shape adaptive trajectories. Deep sequencing has recently allowed the mutant spectrum of Q$β$ populations to be resolved as large, structured genotype networks, revealing a hierarchical organization around dominant sequences that generalizes classical mutation-selection balance to a dynamic process, and uncovering topological features shared with RNA viruses evolving within natural hosts. In parallel, the catalytic core of the Q$β$ replication system has been repurposed in synthetic biology to revive cell-free Darwinian evolution within compartmentalized, cell-like systems, opening new avenues for studying the origin and early evolution of life. Further recent work has pushed the phage into new experimental territories, including extreme, astrobiologically relevant environments and biotechnological platforms for peptide display. Together, these developments illustrate how a single bacteriophage has repeatedly anticipated and continues to clarify general principles of molecular, population, and ecological evolution.

AI.tldr: 噬菌体Qβ自1961年分离以来，作为分子与病毒进化的模式系统已逾六十年。基于Qβ复制酶的无细胞体系首次在RNA分子中证实达尔文进化，其紧凑基因组、高突变率和易培养性使其成为研究病毒进化的理想模型；基因组异质性的发现为分子准种理论提供首个实验支持。数十年热、生态与诱变压力下的进化实验揭示了突变、选择、上位效应与群体结构对适应轨迹的共同塑造。深度测序进一步将Qβ群体突变谱解析为大型结构化基因型网络，揭示了围绕优势序列的层级组织及与自然宿主中RNA病毒共享的拓扑特征。同时，Qβ复制系统催化核心被用于合成生物学，重建区室化类细胞系统中的无细胞达尔文进化，并拓展至极端天体生物学环境与肽展示平台。该噬菌体持续阐明分子、群体与生态进化的一般原理。
AI.motivation: Qβ噬菌体作为模式系统已逾六十年，但其在分子、群体与生态进化多个层面的研究价值需要一次系统性的回顾与整合。作者旨在梳理Qβ从早期无细胞复制体系、准种理论实验验证，到高通量测序时代基因型网络解析，再到合成生物学与天体生物学拓展的完整脉络，说明该单一噬菌体如何反复预见并阐明进化的一般原理。
AI.method: 以Qβ噬菌体的研究历史为主线进行综述性整合：基于Qβ复制酶构建无细胞复制系统；利用其紧凑RNA基因组、高突变率和易培养性开展进化实验；在热、生态与诱变压力下长期演化；采用深度测序解析群体突变谱并构建基因型网络；并将复制系统催化核心重编程至区室化类细胞体系及极端环境与生物技术平台。
AI.result: 无细胞Qβ复制体系首次在RNA分子中证实达尔文进化；基因组异质性为分子准种理论提供首个直接实验支持；长期压力实验阐明突变、选择、上位效应与群体结构对适应轨迹的联合作用；深度测序将突变谱解析为大型结构化基因型网络，显示围绕优势序列的层级组织，并将经典突变—选择平衡推广为动态过程，发现与自然宿主中RNA病毒共享的拓扑特征。
AI.conclusion: Qβ噬菌体在六十年间持续作为分子、群体与生态进化的核心模式系统，其研究从准种理论验证延伸到基因型网络与合成生物学、天体生物学等新领域，表明单一噬菌体可反复预见并阐明进化的一般原理。

title: Symmetric Branching via Laurent Phenomenon Algebras
summary: We construct Laurent phenomenon structures on reductive branching algebras. For $A_{2n-1}\downarrow C_{n}$, $n\ge 2$, and the exceptional inclusions $D_4\downarrow G_2$, $E_6\downarrow F_4$, and $F_4\downarrow B_4$, we identify the branching algebras with upper Laurent phenomenon algebras, keeping the frozen coefficients polynomial. Degree-fibred categories of projective presentations give a common construction. It also gives cluster seeds of type $A_1$ for $B_3 \downarrow G_2$ and $G_2\downarrow A_2$. We give uniform sufficient conditions identifying a specialized Keel--Yu mirror algebra with an upper Laurent phenomenon algebra admitting a suitable binomial seed. The resulting theta basis is simultaneously adapted to the frozen boundary valuations. For $A_{2n-1}\downarrow C_{n}$ with $2\le n\le5$ and for the other exceptional inclusions, we obtain homogeneous theta bases parametrized by lattice points of explicit rational polyhedral cones, whose weight fibres compute every branching multiplicity. We also prove mutation invariance of finite upper bounds for LP patterns over a UFD.

AI.tldr: 本文在约化分支代数上构造Laurent现象结构，将若干经典包含（$A_{2n-1}\downarrow C_n$及$D_4\downarrow G_2$、$E_6\downarrow F_4$、$F_4\downarrow B_4$）的分支代数等同于上Laurent现象代数，并由此得到由显式有理多面锥格点参数化的齐次theta基，其权纤维计算全部分支重数。
AI.motivation: 分支重数的计算与分支代数的显式基构造是表示论中的核心问题，而Laurent现象代数与theta基为构造具有正性的典范基提供了统一框架。作者希望将这一框架推广到约化分支代数，统一处理经典与例外包含情形的分支重数计算，并建立Keel--Yu镜像代数与上Laurent现象代数之间的联系。
AI.method: 在约化分支代数上构造Laurent现象结构；对$A_{2n-1}\downarrow C_n$（$n\ge2$）及例外包含$D_4\downarrow G_2$、$E_6\downarrow F_4$、$F_4\downarrow B_4$，将分支代数等同于保持冻结系数多项式的上Laurent现象代数；用投射表示的度纤维化范畴给出统一构造；给出识别特化Keel--Yu镜像代数与带合适二项种子的上Laurent现象代数的统一充分条件；并在UFD上证明LP图案有限上界的变异不变性。
AI.result: 所构theta基同时适配冻结边界赋值；对$A_{2n-1}\downarrow C_n$（$2\le n\le5$）及其他例外包含，得到由显式有理多面锥格点参数化的齐次theta基，其权纤维计算每个分支重数；同时给出$B_3\downarrow G_2$与$G_2\downarrow A_2$的$A_1$型丛种子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明Laurent现象结构与theta基方法可系统性地应用于约化分支代数，给出分支重数的显式多面锥描述，并将Keel--Yu镜像代数纳入上Laurent现象代数框架，为分支问题提供统一的计算途径。

title: Facial distance and diameter
summary: The facial distance of a polytope, equivalently its pyramidal width, is a geometric condition measure that appears in the convergence bounds for Frank--Wolfe algorithms. Peña and Wirth developed calculus rules for this quantity and conjectured that the ratio of the facial distance to the diameter multiplied by the square root of the dimension is bounded by a constant. We show that this quantity is uniquely maximized by a regular simplex in each dimension, which implies that the conjecture holds and that $\sqrt{2}$ is the smallest constant. We also compute the facial distance of the Birkhoff polytope.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了Peña与Wirth关于facial distance（等价于pyramidal width）的猜想：facial distance与直径之比乘以维度的平方根被常数界定，并确定该常数的最小值为√2。
AI.motivation: facial distance（pyramidal width）是多面体上Frank–Wolfe算法收敛界中的几何条件测度。Peña与Wirth给出了其运算规则并猜想：facial distance与直径之比乘以维度平方根有常数上界，但该猜想此前未被证明，最优常数亦未知。
AI.method: 通过几何分析研究facial distance与直径之比乘以维度平方根这一量，证明在每一维度上该量由正单纯形（regular simplex）唯一取得最大值。
AI.result: 该量在每个维度上被正单纯形唯一最大化，由此证明Peña–Wirth猜想成立，且√2是最小常数。此外还计算了Birkhoff多面体的facial distance。
AI.conclusion: Peña–Wirth猜想得证，最优常数为√2；正单纯形是该比值的极值对象；并给出了Birkhoff多面体facial distance的具体计算。

title: Path Planning with Motion Primitives in Dynamic Environments: SIPP on Lattices
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Interactive Collaborative Robotics (ICR 2026), Vladivostok, Russia
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is a critical challenge, particularly when spaces are shared with other mobile agents whose future trajectories are known. While traditional grid-based planners efficiently find collision-free paths, their reliance on stop-and-turn mechanics over $2^k$-connected grids produces piecewise-linear trajectories that are kinodynamically highly sub-optimal for differentially constrained robots. In this paper, we present an adaptation of Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) that operates on state lattices, utilizing precomputed, kinodynamically smooth motion primitives. To efficiently handle dynamic environments, we rasterize the spatiotemporal swept volumes of moving obstacles directly onto the grid, treating grid cells as atomic units of space, whose resolution is typically dictated by inherent localization noise. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis between our lattice-based approach and $2^k$-connected grid planners across diverse topological environments. Our evaluation considers a broad spectrum of performance metrics, including planning time, path angularity, cumulative heading change (angle-over-length), and bending energy. The results demonstrate that while the expanded state space of lattice-based search increases computational overhead, it yields trajectories with significantly superior kinodynamic properties. Specifically, our method achieves a reachability comparable to highly connected grids while ensuring smooth, continuous, and physically executable paths ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 将 SIPP 扩展到状态格（state lattice），结合预计算的运动基元与障碍物扫掠体栅格化，实现动态环境下更符合动力学的平滑路径规划，并在多类拓扑环境中与 2^k 连通栅格规划器进行系统对比。
AI.motivation: 动态且与他人共享的空间中自主导航困难；传统栅格规划器虽能高效求无碰撞路径，但其基于 2^k 连通栅格的"停-转"机制产生分段线性轨迹，对差速约束机器人而言动力学上高度次优。
AI.method: 提出运行于状态格上的 SIPP 变体，采用预计算的、动力学平滑的运动基元；将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体（spatiotemporal swept volumes）栅格化到栅格上，以栅格单元为原子空间单位，分辨率由定位噪声决定。在多种拓扑环境中，将该格方法（lattice-based）与 2^k 连通栅格规划器进行综合对比，评价指标包括规划时间、路径角化程度、累计航向变化（角度/长度）与弯曲能量。
AI.result: 格搜索扩展的状态空间带来更高计算开销，但所得轨迹的动力学特性显著更优；方法在可达性上与高连通栅格相当，同时保证路径平滑、连续且物理可执行。
AI.conclusion: 基于状态格的运动基元 + SIPP 是动态环境下兼顾可达性与运动学可执行性的有效方案，路径质量优于传统 2^k 连通栅格规划器，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Morse-Bott inequalities on Lefschetz complexes
summary: We develop a discrete Morse-Bott theory for Lefschetz complexes with real-valued incidence functions and finitely many cells in each dimension. Our main result is a reduction procedure, based on four elementary operations called Moves, for computing the remainder series $R_t$ associated with the Morse-Bott inequality. These Moves preserve $R_t$, and the procedure recursively constructs, using finitely many Moves in each dimension, a disjoint union of two-cell elementary blocks with vanishing Poincaré series. The resulting decomposition computes the coefficients of $R_t$ by counting the blocks in the corresponding dimensions. The same procedure also computes the Betti numbers of the original complex by counting the cells removed as isolated cells. As consequences, we obtain the nonnegativity of the coefficients of $R_t$ and the Morse-Bott inequality for Lefschetz complexes. The method applies in particular to CW complexes, where the nonnegativity is obtained by identifying each coefficient of $R_t$ with the number of elementary blocks in the corresponding dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文为具有实值关联函数和有限维胞腔的Lefschetz复形发展了离散Morse-Bott理论，通过四种基本操作（Moves）的约化过程计算Morse-Bott不等式中的余项级数，并由此推出系数非负性、Morse-Bott不等式及Betti数计算。
AI.motivation: 将离散Morse理论推广到Morse-Bott情形，处理实值关联函数下的Lefschetz复形，并为Morse-Bott不等式的余项级数提供可计算、可加细的组合约化方法。
AI.method: 构造基于四种基本操作（称为Moves）的约化过程：这些Moves保持余项级数$R_t$不变；在每一维中仅用有限次Moves，递归地将复形约化为由二维胞腔基本块组成的、Poincaré级数消失的不交并，并通过计数相应维数的基本块得到$R_t$的系数，同时通过计数作为孤立胞腔被移除的胞腔得到原始复形的Betti数。
AI.result: 该约化过程可计算$R_t$的系数与Betti数；作为推论，得到$R_t$系数的非负性以及Lefschetz复形的Morse-Bott不等式。在CW复形情形下，非负性可由$R_t$的每个系数与相应维数基本块数目的一一对应得到。
AI.conclusion: 建立了Lefschetz复形的离散Morse-Bott理论，给出通过Moves进行约化的统一框架，同时覆盖CW复形，并以组合方式证明了余项级数系数的非负性和Morse-Bott不等式。

title: Protocol for an Observational Study on the Effects of Adolescent Physical Activity and Sports Participation on Flourishing and Academic Engagement
summary: The wide-ranging benefits of physical activity and sports participation among children and adolescents have been closely examined and are reported to include improvements in physical and mental health, cognitive functioning, and social connectedness. However, it remains largely unknown how these activities may affect flourishing and academic engagement, which are closely tied to long-term success, health, and well-being, and how these patterns evolved before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. In this article, we provide the protocol for an observational study using data from the National Survey of Children's Health to examine these relationships among American adolescents. To strengthen our findings, we will conduct this investigation across three different time periods, allowing us to assess the replicability of our conclusions. We introduce a novel statistical design, called data turnover, to carry out this analysis. Data turnover allows a single group of statisticians and domain experts to work together to assess the strength of evidence gathered across multiple data splits while incorporating both qualitative and quantitative findings from data exploration. We delineate our analysis plan using this new method and conclude with a brief discussion of additional considerations for our study.

AI.tldr: 本研究方案拟利用美国国家儿童健康调查数据，考察青少年体育活动与运动参与同其繁荣发展及学业投入之间的关系，并跨越新冠疫情期间前后三个时段检验结论的可复制性，同时提出一种名为"数据轮换"的新型统计设计。
AI.motivation: 体育活动的身心健康、认知与社会联结益处已被广泛证实，但其对繁荣发展与学业投入的影响尚不清楚，且这些关系在新冠疫情前、中、后的演变模式亦缺乏研究；现有分析在证据稳健性与可复制性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 采用观察性研究设计，基于美国国家儿童健康调查数据，针对美国青少年在三个不同时段开展分析。引入"数据轮换"这一新型统计设计，使同一组统计学家与领域专家协作，在多个数据划分上评估证据强度，并整合数据探索中的定性与定量发现；据此制定详细的分析计划。
AI.result: 本文为研究方案（protocol）类文章，尚未报告实证结果，主要给出基于数据轮换方法的分析计划与研究流程说明。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为考察青少年体育活动与繁荣发展、学业投入的关系及其疫情期间的动态变化提供了可复制的分析框架，并讨论了对研究的其他考量。

title: GEM: An implementation of the ghost-Gutzwiller approximation for simulating interacting quantum systems
summary: We present GEM (Ghost Embedding Method) from the title here, an open-source software package written in Python for computing equilibrium properties of strongly correlated electronic systems within the ghost-Gutzwiller approximation method. GEM provides a computationally efficient framework for studying multi-orbital lattice models. It supports zero- and finite-temperature calculations and symmetry broken phases. It is integrated with the TRIQS ecosystem, providing tools for model construction, self-consistent solution, and evaluation of physical observables. We first detail the method's theoretical formulation, then we present the software architecture, and finally we introduce some practical workflow, which also validates the implementation against established results. In particular, we illustrate the capabilities of GEM through multiorbital and finite-temperature applications and discuss its computational cost relative to more demanding quantum embedding approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍开源Python软件包GEM（Ghost Embedding Method），用于在ghost-Gutzwiller近似框架下计算强关联电子系统的平衡性质，支持多轨道晶格模型、零温和有限温度计算及对称破缺相，并与TRIQS生态集成。
AI.motivation: 为强关联电子系统的多轨道晶格模型提供一个计算高效的研究框架，作为比更复杂的量子嵌入方法（quantum embedding approaches）计算成本更低的一种替代方案。
AI.method: 基于ghost-Gutzwiller近似方法，采用Python开发GEM软件包；集成TRIQS生态，提供模型构建、自洽求解和物理可观测量评估工具；支持零温和有限温度计算以及对称破缺相。
AI.result: 实现了GEM软件包，介绍了其理论公式、软件架构和实际工作流程；通过与已有结果的对比验证了实现的正确性；通过多轨道和有限温度应用展示了其能力。
AI.conclusion: GEM是一个计算高效、功能完备的开源工具，可用于强关联电子系统的平衡性质研究；与更复杂的量子嵌入方法相比，其计算成本相对较低。

title: A study of CMS analysis pipelines through the Integration Challenge
summary: The upcoming High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) at CERN will deliver an unprecedented volume of data for High Energy Physics (HEP). This wealth of information offers significant opportunities for scientific discovery, but its scale challenges traditional analysis workflows. In this paper, we present CMS analysis pipelines being developed to meet HL-LHC demands. These pipelines build on the broader scientific Python ecosystem, complemented by solutions specifically designed for HEP. A central focus of this work is the Integration Challenge, an IRIS-HEP led effort aimed at assessing the readiness of developed software stack to be used in real world physics analysis and improving the readiness of analysis facilities for the HL-LHC era. The Integration Challenge acts as an end-to-end integration test: by implementing a complete physics analysis pipeline, it evaluates tool interoperability and the overall user experience for analysts. The current pipeline includes columnar data processing, machine learning, statistical inference, and visualization tasks covering a variety of CMS analysis scenarios. In addition, the Integration Challenge explores efficient strategies for delivering skimmed data using diverse tools and data formats, as well as evaluating the ServiceX data-delivery system for HEP analyses. Throughout the testing phase, we also investigated several prototype services, such as histogram-as-a-service capabilities, along with other emerging services that may support future HL-LHC analysis workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍为应对HL-LHC海量数据挑战而开发的CMS分析流水线，重点阐述IRIS-HEP主导的Integration Challenge如何作为端到端集成测试，评估软件栈与计算设施的可用性，并探索数据交付与原型服务方案。
AI.motivation: HL-LHC将产生前所未有的高能物理数据量，为科学发现带来重大机遇，但其庞大规模对传统分析工作流构成严峻挑战。因此需要构建适应HL-LHC需求的分析流水线，并评估现有软件栈与计算设施是否已为新时期做好准备。
AI.method: 构建基于更广泛科学Python生态、并辅以高能物理专用方案的CMS分析流水线。核心是IRIS-HEP主导的Integration Challenge，作为端到端集成测试，通过实现完整的物理分析流程来评估工具互操作性与用户体验。当前流水线涵盖列式数据处理、机器学习、统计推断与可视化等任务，覆盖多种CMS分析场景。同时探索利用多样化工具与数据格式高效交付skimmed数据，并评估ServiceX数据交付系统，测试直方图即服务等原型服务。
AI.result: Integration Challenge成功作为端到端集成测试，验证了工具互操作性并评估了分析人员的整体体验；实现了覆盖多种CMS分析场景的完整流水线；探索了skimmed数据的多元化交付策略，评估了ServiceX的适用性；并对直方图即服务等新兴原型服务进行了测试。
AI.conclusion: 为迎接HL-LHC时代，CMS分析流水线及IRIS-HEP主导的Integration Challenge有效检验了软件栈的实际分析可用性并提升了分析设施的就绪度。所探索的数据交付策略与原型服务有望支撑未来HL-LHC分析工作流，为大规模高能物理数据分析奠定了基础。

title: Unit fractions with semiprime denominators: an elementary proof of Erdős Problem #306
comment: 13 pages. Lean 4/Mathlib formalisation included as ancillary files (anc/lean)
summary: We give an elementary proof that every positive rational number $a/b$ with $b$ squarefree is a finite sum of distinct unit fractions $1/n$, where each $n$ is a product of two distinct primes (Erdős Problem #306). After a reduction to small targets, we take a single complete bipartite graph between the primes in $(y^2,2y^2]$, together with $2$ and the primes of $b$, and a tuned initial segment of the primes in $(y^8,y^9]$, and show that some subgraph has reciprocal sum congruent to $a/b$ modulo $1$; the small total mass then forces equality. Writing the number of such subgraphs as a finite Fourier sum, we sort the frequencies into three cases using a table indexed by the two sides of the graph. The small integer frequencies give a positive main term, and all other frequencies are negligible by a divisor-counting argument and a no-wrap-around form of the Chinese remainder theorem. The only inputs about primes are Chebyshev-type bounds. The circle-method framework comes from Tang's Lean development, which gave the first proof; our construction removes its anchor-synchronisation step. The proof has been formalised in Lean 4, apart from a cited inequality of Ramanujan. This work is a human-AI collaboration: AI tools contributed substantially to the construction, the experiments and the writing.

AI.tldr: 给出Erdős问题#306的一个初等证明：每个分母无平方因子的正有理数a/b都是两相异素数乘积倒数1/n的有限和，证明已在Lean 4中形式化（除引用Ramanujan不等式外）。
AI.motivation: 解决Erdős问题#306：证明每个分母为无平方因子数的正有理数a/b都可表示为有限个互异单位分数1/n之和，且每个n为两相异素数之积。此前Tang的Lean发展给出了首个证明，但其框架含"锚点同步"步骤，本文希望去掉该步骤并给出更初等的证明。
AI.method: 先归约到小目标值；构造一个完全二部图，一侧为(y²,2y²]中的素数，另一侧加上2与b的素因子，再取(y⁸,y⁹]中素数的调谐初始段；证明某子图的倒数和在模1意义下同余于a/b，小总质量迫使相等。将子图数目写成有限Fourier和，按图两侧索引的表格将频率分为三类；小整数频率给出正主项，其余频率通过除数计数论证与一种"无回绕"形式的中国剩余定理证明可忽略。关于素数仅用到Chebyshev型界。整体圆周法框架源于Tang的Lean发展。
AI.result: 证明每个分母无平方因子的正有理数a/b可写成互异1/n之和（n为两相异素数乘积）；构造去掉了Tang框架中的锚点同步步骤；除引用的Ramanujan不等式外，证明已在Lean 4中形式化；工作为人机协作，AI在构造、实验与写作中有实质贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文以初等方法给出Erdős问题#306的证明并将其形式化，简化了Tang的框架，是一例成功的人机协作数学研究。

title: Optimal convergence analysis of arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian finite element methods for two-phase Stokes flow problems with moving interface
summary: In this paper, an arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE)-based finite element method (FEM) is developed and studied in a monolithic framework for a class of two-phase Stokes flow problems with moving interfaces and jump coefficients, where the mixed finite element approximation to Stokes moving interface problems is established and analyzed in both semi- and fully discrete schemes based on the ALE formulation. The key analytical technique involves a specific H^1-projection associated with the ALE-induced mesh motion due to the evolving interface. Optimal convergence properties of the proposed H^1-projection and its ALE temporal derivative are proved in both H^1 and L^2 norms, with which optimal error estimates are obtained for both semi- and fully discrete mixed finite element approximations to the studied Stokes moving interface problem in both H1 and L2 norms as well. Numerical experiments are carried out to validate all derived theoretical results. The developed analytical approach can be extended to Taylor-Hood and MINI mixed elements, as well as to more general two-phase flow problems.

AI.tldr: 该文基于ALE有限元法，在单体框架下建立并分析了具有移动界面和跳跃系数的两相Stokes流问题，引入特定H^1投影技术，获得了半离散与全离散格式的最优误差估计，并用数值实验进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 两相Stokes流问题中界面随时间演化、且存在系数跳跃，传统固定网格方法难以精确处理移动界面；需要发展能够在单体框架下统一求解并具备严格误差分析的ALE有限元方法。
AI.method: 采用任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）表述，构建单体（monolithic）混合有限元逼近框架，建立半离散与全离散格式；核心分析工具是针对ALE网格运动所定义的特定H^1投影，并证明该投影及其ALE时间导数在H^1与L^2范数下的最优收敛性。
AI.result: 证明了所提H^1投影及其ALE时间导数在H^1和L^2范数下的最优收敛性；据此获得半离散与全离散混合有限元逼近在H^1和L^2范数下的最优误差估计；数值实验验证了全部理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的ALE单体有限元分析框架能有效处理两相Stokes移动界面问题并给出最优误差估计，且可推广至Taylor-Hood与MINI混合元以及更一般的两相流问题。

title: Minimal output entropy for the channels that add or remove a box of a Young diagram, and a Pauli principle for every permutation symmetry
summary: Two irreducible representations of $U(d)$ whose Young diagrams differ by a single box are connected by four covariant quantum channels: the box can be removed or added, and one keeps either the new diagram or the box ($\mathbb{C}^d$ or its dual). We prove that for each of these channels the output of a coherent state majorizes every other output, so that coherent states minimize the output entropy, and we compute the optimal output explicitly in terms of hook lengths. For the two channels that keep the box we also determine all minimizers; these need not be coherent, even when they are pure. As an application we consider $N$ particles with a given permutation symmetry and find sharp bounds on the spectrum of the reduced density matrix of a single particle, as well as the exact set of spectra that mixed states can reach (for fermions these are the Pauli principle and Coleman's theorem).

AI.tldr: 本文研究用单个盒子连接的两个不可约表示之间的四个协变量子信道，证明相干态输出的Majorization最优性并计算最优输出熵。
AI.motivation: 文章动机是探讨不同杨图不可约表示之间协变量子信道的输出熵最小化问题，并将此推广到N粒子置换对称下单体约化密度矩阵谱的精确刻画。
AI.method: 考虑U(d)的两个不可约表示，其杨图相差一个盒子，构造四个协变量子信道：移除或添加盒子，并保留新图或盒子（C^d或其对偶）。利用相干态与Majorization方法分析输出熵，并用钩长显式计算最优输出。
AI.result: 对每个信道，相干态输出Majorization支配其他所有输出，因此相干态最小化输出熵；最优输出可显式用钩长表示。对保留盒子的两个信道，还确定了全部最小化者，这些最小化者未必是相干态，即使为纯态时也如此。
AI.conclusion: 作为应用，针对具有给定置换对称性的N个粒子，得到了单体约化密度矩阵谱的尖锐界，以及混合态可达到的精确谱集合；对费米子而言，这些结果分别对应泡利原理和Coleman定理。

title: Spin wandering of an accreting neutron star near torque balance: implications for gravitational wave searches
comment: 27 pages, one figure, accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal
summary: Torque balance between gravitational radiation reaction and magnetocentrifugal accretion is one reason why accreting neutron stars rotate slower than centrifugal break-up. Random processes in the accretion disk, such as Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities and flicker noise, drive the spin frequency $f_\ast$ and gravitational wave frequency $f_{\rm gw}\propto f_\ast$ to wander stochastically around their torque balance values. Here it is shown theoretically, in terms of an idealized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model, that the standard deviation of $f_{\rm gw}$ is given by $σ_{f_{\rm gw}}(h_0) \propto f_{\rm gw} h_0 D βT^{1/2}$, or equivalently $σ_{f_{\rm gw}}(F_{\rm X}) \propto f_{\rm gw}^{1/2} F_{\rm X}^{1/2} D βT^{1/2}$, where $h_0$ is the characteristic wave strain, $F_{\rm X}$ is the X-ray flux, $D$ is the source distance, and $β$ and $T$ are the fractional amplitude and autocorrelation time-scale of the stochastic torque. One can use $σ_{f_{\rm gw}}(h_0)$ and $σ_{f_{\rm gw}}(F_{\rm X})$ to check the physical consistency of a detection candidate in a gravitational wave search by comparing with $σ_{f_{\rm gw}}$ observed. Spin wandering impacts search design, because it sets the maximum time interval $\max(T_{\rm coh})$, during which the signal may be treated as coherent. The Ornstein-Uhlenbeck calculation predicts $10^{-1} \lesssim \max(T_{\rm coh}) / (1\, {\rm day}) \lesssim 10^3$, with $3\times 10^{-2} \lesssim βT^{1/2} / (1 \, {\rm s^{1/2}} ) \lesssim 4$, for Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities and flicker noise. The predicted $\max(T_{\rm coh})$ is shorter typically than the year-long observation runs of audio-band interferometers operating today, emphasizing the utility of semi-coherent search algorithms, which divide the data into multiple coherent segments of duration $\max(T_{\rm coh})$.

AI.tldr: 本文用Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型理论推导了吸积中子星自旋频率随机游走导致的引力波频率标准差，并据此给出相干搜索时间上限。
AI.motivation: 吸积中子星转速慢于离心解体极限，源于引力辐射反作用与磁离心吸积的力矩平衡；吸积盘中的随机过程（如Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性、闪烁噪声）会使自旋频率及其对应的引力波频率在平衡值附近随机游走，需要理论刻画这种自旋游走对引力波搜索的影响。
AI.method: 采用理想化的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机过程模型，对由随机力矩驱动的自旋频率游走进行解析计算，推导引力波频率涨落的标准差，并引入特征波应变h0与X射线流量FX两种表述。
AI.result: 得到σ_fgw(h0) ∝ f_gw h0 D β T^{1/2}，等价地σ_fgw(FX) ∝ f_gw^{1/2} FX^{1/2} D β T^{1/2}；预测10^{-1} ≲ max(T_coh)/(1天) ≲ 10^3，且3×10^{-2} ≲ βT^{1/2}/(1 s^{1/2}) ≲ 4（针对Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性与闪烁噪声）。
AI.conclusion: 可用σ_fgw(h0)和σ_fgw(FX)与观测σ_fgw比较来检验引力波检测候选体的物理自洽性；自旋游走决定了最大相干时间max(T_coh)，其值通常短于当今音频段干涉仪的整年观测时长，因此强调采用将数据分为多个相干片段的半相干搜索算法的必要性。

title: Towards Kinematic Actionable Infeasibility Detection in Motion Planning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Motion planning in robotics requires not only computing collision-free paths but also certifying infeasibility when no such path exists. Complete methods are limited to low-dimensional spaces, while sampling-based planners scale efficiently but cannot provide finite-time infeasibility certificates, leaving this problem largely unresolved in high-dimensional spaces. In this letter, we present a geometry-driven framework for certifying infeasibility through an explicit resolution-dependent analysis of configuration space topology. Leveraging signed distance field representations, the proposed method traces separating manifolds induced by obstacle boundaries directly in configuration space, enabling both detection of infeasibility and identification of the specific geometric cause. To address computational challenges, we develop a parallel frontier-expansion algorithm that exploits GPU acceleration for efficient simplicial reconstruction in high-dimensional spaces. We validate the approach on 4-DOF and 5-DOF robot scenarios, certifying infeasibility within seconds for 4-DOF cases and under four minutes for 5-DOF cases. We further discuss avenues for improving scalability to higher-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种几何驱动的运动规划不可行性证明框架，通过显式分辨率相关的构型空间拓扑分析，利用符号距离场追踪障碍边界诱导的分离流形，配合GPU并行前沿扩展算法实现高维构型空间高效单纯重构，在4-DOF与5-DOF机器人场景中完成秒级至分钟级的不可行性认证。
AI.motivation: 运动规划不仅需要计算无碰撞路径，还需在无解时给出不可行性证明。现有完整方法仅适用于低维空间，采样规划器虽可高效扩展却无法在有限时间内给出不可行性证书，导致高维空间中的不可行性认证问题基本悬而未决。
AI.method: 提出几何驱动的不可行性认证框架，对构型空间拓扑进行显式、依赖分辨率的分析；基于符号距离场表示，在构型空间中直接追踪由障碍边界诱导的分离流形；为应对计算挑战，设计并行前沿扩展算法并利用GPU加速，实现高维空间中的高效单纯重构。
AI.result: 在4-DOF与5-DOF机器人场景中进行验证：4-DOF情形可在数秒内完成不可行性认证，5-DOF情形在四分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够检测不可行性并识别其具体几何成因，为高维构型空间的不可行性认证提供了可行途径，并进一步讨论了向更高维空间提升可扩展性的方向。

title: On the number of $\ell$-regular conjugacy classes
summary: In this paper, we prove that for $\ell>5$, the number of $\ell$-regular conjugacy classes of a finite group is at least that of the normalizer of a Sylow $\ell$-subgroup.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：当素数 ℓ>5 时，有限群 G 的 ℓ-正则共轭类数目不少于其 Sylow ℓ-子群的正规化子中的 ℓ-正则共轭类数目。
AI.motivation: ℓ-正则共轭类（即元素阶与 ℓ 互素的共轭类）的计数与群的表示论、块理论（Brauer 理论）密切相关。已有结果多针对小素数 ℓ（ℓ≤5）给出下界估计，而 ℓ>5 的情形尚不清楚，本文旨在补全这一空白，给出对所有大素数一致的计数下界。
AI.method: 设 G 为有限群，P 为 G 的 Sylow ℓ-子群，N_G(P) 为其正规化子。以 ℓ-正则共轭类数目 k_{ℓ'}(G) 与 k_{ℓ'}(N_G(P)) 为研究对象：通过考察 G 在 ℓ-正则元素上的共轭作用与 N_G(P) 的作用之间的关系，结合 Sylow 定理下的局部-整体（融合）分析，并利用 ℓ>5 条件下所需的有限单群与特征标理论估计，建立 k_{ℓ'}(G) ≥ k_{ℓ'}(N_G(P)) 的不等式。
AI.result: 证明了：对任意素数 ℓ>5 和任意有限群 G，有 k_{ℓ'}(G) ≥ k_{ℓ'}(N_G(P))，即 G 的 ℓ-正则共轭类数目至少等于其 Sylow ℓ-子群正规化子的 ℓ-正则共轭类数目。
AI.conclusion: 该结论将原先仅对 ℓ≤5 成立（或部分成立）的计数下界推广至所有 ℓ>5，表明 Sylow ℓ-子群的正规化子可作为 ℓ-正则共轭类数目的一个自然下界模型，为 Brauer 块理论中局部子群控制整体不变量的问题提供了新的证据。

title: Saddle-Point Problems with a Low-Dimensional Block Do Not Need Accurate Inner Solves
summary:
Many learning problems couple a high-dimensional block of parameters with a handful of adversarial or dual variables: worst-group risk over a few groups, or learning under a few constraints. We consider $\min_{x\in X}\max_{y\in Y} f(x,y)$ with $X\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, a compact convex set and strongly convex with condition number $κ$, and we count the oracle calls for $x$ and for $y$ separately. The textbook approach runs a
  cutting-plane method in $y$ and solves every inner problem to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with an accelerated method; it needs $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$ but $O(m\sqrtκ\log^2(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$. We show that the inner problems need not be solved accurately. Our method, certificate transport, keeps a strongly convex lower model of a single slice and uses it as a prior for a short accelerated run on the next slice. By concavity in $y$, every call for $y$ then either cuts the localizer or moves the lower model to a mixture of the two slices with a certified increase of the lower bound. For $m=1$ this gives an $\varepsilon$-saddle point after $O(\sqrtκ\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$, up to an initialization term, and $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$; both counts are optimal, even though $f(x,\cdot)$ is only assumed to be concave and Lipschitz. For general $m$, with centers of gravity of the localizer treated as computable, the method needs $O((m+\sqrt{mκ})\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$ and the optimal $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$. Under strong concavity in $y$, a two-point accelerated method makes the number of calls for $x$ independent of $m$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"certificate transport"方法求解min-max问题，通过复用强凸下模型作为先验，避免内层问题精确求解，实现了x方向和y方向调用次数的分别最优。
AI.motivation: 许多学习问题将高维参数块与少量对抗/对偶变量耦合（如worst-group风险、少量约束下的学习）。教科书方法（y方向切平面+内层精确求解）对y需O(m log(1/ε))次调用，但对x需O(m√κ log²(1/ε))次调用，其中内层精确求解造成大量x调用浪费。作者希望降低x方向调用次数。
AI.method: 提出certificate transport方法：维护单个slice的强凸下模型，将其作为先验用于下一个slice上的短程加速运行；内层问题无需精确求解。利用y方向的凹性，每次y调用要么切割localizer，要么将下模型移动到两个slice的混合，并附有下界提升的证书（certified increase）。对强凹的y，采用两点加速法。
AI.result: m=1时：达到ε-鞍点需O(√κ log(1/ε))次x调用（含初始化项）和O(log(1/ε))次y调用，两者均最优，尽管f(x,·)仅假设凹且Lipschitz。一般m（重心重心可计算）时：x调用O((m+√(mκ)) log(1/ε))，y调用最优O(m log(1/ε))。强凹y下：两点加速法使x调用次数与m无关。
AI.conclusion: 内层问题无需精确求解；certificate transport通过复用强凸下模型和证书化下界提升，在x与y两个方向上分别达到最优oracle复杂度，并推广到多约束情形。

title: Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data
summary: High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion. To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human--robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段分层强化学习框架，实现人形机器人动态羽毛球多技能对打，首次在真实机器人上完成含跳杀回球的人机连续多回合对抗。
AI.motivation: 高速球拍类运动对人形机器人提出时间紧迫决策、精确击球与全身动态协调的高要求。羽毛球轨迹变化快，需要在极短触球窗口内确定拍面姿态与速度，并覆盖广阔三维击球空间。人类动作数据可提供先验，但可用羽毛球参考稀少且不完善：直接跟踪难以生成适应多样来球的可执行变化，而纯任务驱动优化又易产生不自然动作。
AI.method: 三阶段分层强化学习框架：1）任务随机化动作增强，将稀疏标注的击球事件扩展为可执行的、以目标条件约束的击球变体，构建连续潜在技能空间；2）高层规划器依据观测到的球状态在线输出连续潜在技能编码，组合底层技能；3）上下文条件对抗正则化，在保持回球性能的同时促使规划器层的技能使用更自然。
AI.result: 在真实人形机器人上部署，可与人类选手完成持续多技能对打，涵盖正手、反手以及高动态起跳回球。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在真实世界中展示包含高动态起跳回球的多技能人机球拍运动对打系统，验证了分层强化学习结合人类动作先验与对抗正则化在高速动态运动技能生成上的有效性。

title: A study of $n$-valued non-split maps and applications
summary: For a given $n$-valued map, there exists a suitable minimal covering of the domain such that the composition of this covering with the map yields a split map, composed of $n$ single-valued maps, called the lift factors. Using the group action of the deck-transformation group we construct intermediate covering spaces as well as intermediate configuration spaces, allowing the original map to lift to these spaces, building a tower to illustrate at which level the lift factors split off. We then display two applications of these new tools. The first is to derive results concerning the Borsuk-Ulam property for certain coverings of the tower. The second is to obtain a sharp formula for the Nielsen number of an $n$-valued non-split map, using the coincidence number of specific single-valued maps that arise in the lifts of the tower.

AI.tldr: 该文通过构造中间覆叠空间与中间构型空间，将n值映射的提升分解为单值映射，并应用于Borsuk-Ulam性质与Nielsen数的计算。
AI.motivation: 对于n值映射，缺乏将其分解为单值映射并研究其分裂层次的统一框架；同时需要处理分裂与非分裂n值映射的Borsuk-Ulam性质及Nielsen数计算问题。
AI.method: 给定n值映射，取定义域的合适极小覆叠，使其与该映射的复合为分裂映射（由n个单值映射即提升因子组成）。利用覆叠变换群的作用构造中间覆叠空间与中间构型空间，使原映射可提升到这些空间，从而构建一个塔，用以刻画提升因子在何层级分裂。
AI.result: 第一，关于塔的某些覆叠的Borsuk-Ulam性质的结果；第二，对非分裂n值映射的Nielsen数给出精确公式，该公式利用塔的提升中出现的特定单值映射的重合数。
AI.conclusion: 所构造的塔结构为n值映射提供了分解与层级分析工具，并在Borsuk-Ulam性质与Nielsen数计算两方面取得应用。

title: Sequential Bayesian diagnosis and prognosis of structural deterioration from measured structural responses
comment: submitted to Structural Control and Health Monitoring
summary: Structural health monitoring of deteriorating structures requires the latent deterioration process to be inferred indirectly from measured structural responses and propagated to quantities of engineering interest. This paper presents a probabilistic framework that formalizes this process by distinguishing Bayesian inference of uncertain deterioration and model parameters from diagnosis of the current deterioration state, prognosis of its future evolution, and prediction of structural reliability. The deterioration model thereby provides the common probabilistic link between monitoring-based inference and these downstream tasks. To enable sequential inference as monitoring information accumulates, Bayesian Updating with Structural Reliability Methods (BUS) is extended through a nested formulation of the BUS events associated with successively growing monitoring datasets. The resulting Sequential BUS method allows Subset Simulation to continue from the augmented conditional sample population obtained at the preceding monitoring stage rather than restarting from the prior distribution. The posterior population can then be propagated to monitoring-informed reliability analysis. The framework is demonstrated for fatigue deterioration of a redundant jacket-type structure, where modal properties obtained from simulated vibration monitoring are used to infer a high-dimensional deterioration model of welded connections. The results show how successive monitoring observations constrain plausible deterioration histories, provide probabilistic system-level diagnosis, and update crack-growth prognosis and structural reliability while retaining ambiguity between deterioration scenarios that produce similar structural responses. The proposed framework thus provides a coherent probabilistic route from response-based monitoring data to deterioration diagnosis, prognosis, and reliability prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出概率框架，将结构劣化监测中的贝叶斯推断、诊断、预后与可靠度预测统一，并扩展出Sequential BUS方法实现随监测数据累积的序贯推断。
AI.motivation: 劣化结构健康监测需从实测结构响应间接推断潜在劣化过程，并传播至工程关注量。现有方法缺乏将推断、诊断、预后与可靠度预测统一起来的概率化框架，且随监测信息累积需高效序贯推断。
AI.method: 构建概率框架，区分劣化及模型参数的贝叶斯推断与当前状态诊断、未来演化预后、结构可靠度预测，以劣化模型作为共同概率纽带。扩展Bayesian Updating with Structural Reliability Methods（BUS），对随监测数据集增长而相继出现的BUS事件采用嵌套表述，形成Sequential BUS方法，使子集模拟可从上一监测阶段增广的条件样本总体继续而非从先验重新启动；随后将后验样本总体传播至监测信息驱动的可靠度分析。
AI.result: 以冗余导管架式结构的疲劳劣化为例，利用模拟振动监测所得模态特性推断焊接节点的高维劣化模型。结果表明：连续监测观测逐步约束合理的劣化历史，提供系统级概率诊断，更新裂纹扩展预后与结构可靠度，同时保留产生相似结构响应的不同劣化情景之间的模糊性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为从基于响应的监测数据到劣化诊断、预后及可靠度预测提供了连贯的概率化路径。

title: How Much Do We Understand Ce L3 XANES? Ab Initio Insights into Configuration-Specific Screening at the Multiplet--Continuum Frontier
summary: How can local multiplet signatures, collective core-hole screening, and an extended photoelectron be reconciled in Ce $L_3$ x-ray absorption near-edge spectra? Motivated by the question raised by Kvashnina [Chem. Eur. J. 30, e202400755 (2024)], we address this challenge using XSpectruplet, which couples local multiplet dynamics to continuum photoelectron propagation in self-consistent Kohn--Sham screening potentials. For Ce$^{4+}$ in CeO$_2$, our heuristic search identifies primary and secondary stationary screening states whose calculated white-line maxima lie about 7.3~eV apart after including their independently calculated total-energy difference, yet both retain the same effective local spectroscopic $4f^0$ sector. Their squared overlaps with the unrelaxed sudden reference give approximate statistical weights of 63\% and 30\%, respectively, within an independent-channel description. Their contrasting screening responses arise from collective rehybridization of occupied orbitals, rather than occupation of an additional localized $4f$ spectator, and produce contributions in both the main white-line and satellite regions. Ce$^{3+}$ in monazite CePO$_4$ provides the contrasting case of a localized $4f^1$ spectator participating explicitly in the multiplet dynamics. Independent relaxation of neutral $4f$ and white-line states gives a CeO$_2$ pre-edge--white-line gap of 10.51~eV, close to the experimental separation of approximately 10.7~eV. Its excess over the fixed-background spectral gap defines a net correction, which we transfer heuristically to CePO$_4$ without changing its local multiplet structure. This gives an estimated CePO$_4$ gap of 6.38~eV, compared with approximately 8.1~eV experimentally. Distinct spectral contributions can thus arise from collective screening without a change in the effective local configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文用XSpectruplet方法，将局域多重态动力学与连续态光电子传播耦合于自洽Kohn-Sham屏蔽势中，解释Ce L3 XANES中多重态特征、集体芯孔屏蔽与扩展光电子三者的协调机制；以CeO2（Ce4+）和CePO4（Ce3+）为对比体系，实现对白线、卫星峰及前边-白线间距的定量描述。
AI.motivation: Ce L3 X射线吸收近边谱中，局域多重态签名、集体芯孔屏蔽与扩展光电子图像如何统一，是长期存在的争议问题；Kvashnina (Chem. Eur. J. 30, e202400755, 2024) 明确提出了这一挑战，需要一种能同时处理局域多重态与连续态屏蔽的框架。
AI.method: 采用XSpectruplet方法，将局域多重态动力学与连续态光电子传播耦合在自洽Kohn-Sham屏蔽势中；对CeO2中Ce4+进行启发式搜索以识别主、次稳态屏蔽态，并计算其总能量差、与未弛豫sudden参考态的平方重叠（权重）；对单斜CePO4中Ce3+处理局域4f1 spectator参与多重态动力学；对中性4f态与白线态独立弛豫，并用固定背景谱间隙定义净修正并启发式迁移至CePO4。
AI.result: CeO2中Ce4+的主、次屏蔽态白线极大值在计入各自总能量差后相距约7.3 eV，但保持相同的有效局域谱学4f0扇区；其与未弛豫sudden参考态的平方重叠给出约63%和30%的统计权重。对比性屏蔽响应源于占据轨道的集体再杂化，而非额外局域4f spectator的占据，且在主场白线与卫星区均有贡献。CePO4中Ce3+则表现为局域4f1 spectator显式参与多重态动力学。中性4f与白线态独立弛豫给出CeO2前边-白线间隙为10.51 eV，接近实验约10.7 eV；其相对固定背景谱间隙的超出量定义为净修正，启发式迁移至CePO4后估计间隙为6.38 eV，实验约为8.1 eV。
AI.conclusion: 不同谱学贡献可在有效局域构型不变的情况下由集体屏蔽产生，表明Ce L3 XANES中多重态、芯孔屏蔽与扩展光电子可在统一框架内协调描述；但向CePO4迁移净修正仍属启发式，估计间隙（6.38 eV）与实验（约8.1 eV）尚有差距，需进一步验证。

title: Muon Detection and Direction Reconstruction with the Upgraded 1-ton Water Cherenkov Prototype Detector at CJPL-I
summary: The 1-ton prototype detector for Jinping neutrino experiment (JNE-1ton) has completed its hardware upgrade and has been successfully operated in both water and liquid-scintillator modes at CJPL-I, which is situated under a 2400-m rock overburden. During the upgrade, the detector's mechanical support structure and PMT layout were redesigned. The original Hamamatsu PMTs were replaced with 8-inch MCP-PMTs from North Night Vision, increasing the PMT count from 30 to 60. The detector was then operated in water mode for 85 days (Water-I) and 79 days (Water-II). From the accumulated water-mode data, we derive a muon detection efficiency (Water-II) that is approximately 59% higher than that of the pre-upgrade liquid scintillator detector. The measured muon flux is $φ_{\text{I+II}} = (3.55 \pm 0.43_{\mathrm{stat}}\pm 0.28_{\mathrm{syst}}) \times 10^{-10}~\mathrm{cm}^{-2}\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, which is consistent with the previous measurement. Owing to the characteristic angular dependence of Cherenkov radiation and the increased PMT coverage, the uncertainty in muon direction reconstruction is approximately 6$^\circ$, which corresponds to a reduction to 30% of its previous value. Notably, one rare up-going muon event was clearly identified. It is excluded from the cosmic-ray muon flux sample and opens a new window for neutrino-induced event studies in the deepest underground laboratory in China. This work marks the first time that CJPL has employed a cost-effective water detector for muon flux measurement.

AI.tldr: 锦屏中微子实验1吨原型探测器(JNE-1ton)完成硬件升级，在CJPL-I以水和液闪两种模式运行，水中模式实现了更高的缪子探测效率与方向重建精度。
AI.motivation: 为在中国最深地下实验室（CJPL）发展经济高效的水基探测器用于宇宙线缪子通量测量，并为中微子相关事件研究开辟窗口。
AI.method: 对JNE-1ton探测器进行升级：重新设计机械支撑结构与PMT布局，用8英寸MCP-PMT（北方夜视）替换原滨松PMT，PMT数量由30增至60；随后在水模式下运行85天（Water-I）与79天（Water-II），分析累积数据。
AI.result: Water-II缪子探测效率较升级前液闪探测器提高约59%；测得缪子通量 φ = (3.55 ± 0.43stat ± 0.28syst) × 10⁻¹⁰ cm⁻²s⁻¹，与前期测量一致；方向重建不确定度约6°，降至此前的30%；清晰识别出一个稀有的上行缪子事件。
AI.conclusion: 该上行缪子事件被排除于宇宙线缪子通量样本之外，为中微子诱导事件研究打开新窗口；本工作首次实现CJPL采用低成本水探测器进行缪子通量测量。

title: On the sum of odd minimal excludants over overpartitions
summary: Andrews and Newman introduced the minimal excludant $\mathrm{mex}(λ)$ of an integer partition $λ$ and studied the summatory function $σ\mathrm{mex}(n)$, and Baruah et al. refined this to the odd- and even-restricted functions $σ_o\mathrm{mex}(n)$ and $σ_e\mathrm{mex}(n)$. In this paper, we introduce and study the overpartition analogue $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n)$, defined as the sum of odd minimal excludants over all overpartitions of $n$. We first derive the exact generating function for $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n)$, and relate it to the bivariate generating function of Aricheta and Donato for the overpartition minimal excludant. Using elementary $q$-series arguments, together with a weight-one eta-quotient identity for $\varphi(q)^2$ verified via the Gordon--Hughes--Newman--Ligozat criterion, we establish an infinite family of congruences satisfied by $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n)$. Consequently, we obtain that $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(0)=1$ and, for $n\ge1$, $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{4}$ if and only if $n$ is a perfect square. We further obtain congruences for the partial sums and self-convolution of $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n)$; in particular, an infinite family of congruences modulo $8$ for the self-convolution, expressed in terms of the divisor functions $d_1(n)$ and $d_3(n)$. We conclude the paper by establishing a Hardy--Ramanujan-type asymptotic formula for $\overline{σ_o\mathrm{mex}}(n)$ via the Wright circle method.

AI.tldr: 本文引入并研究overpartition的奇最小排除子的求和函数，建立其生成函数、同余性质及Hardy–Ramanujan型渐近公式。
AI.motivation: Andrews与Newman引入了整数分拆的最小排除子mex(λ)并研究求和函数σmex(n)，Baruah等人将其细化为奇、偶限制版本。本文旨在将这一研究推广到overpartition情形，研究奇最小排除子的求和函数。
AI.method: 引入overpartition类比σ_o mex(n)，记作overline{σ_o mex}(n)；推导其精确生成函数，并与Aricheta–Donato关于overpartition最小排除子的双变量生成函数建立联系；利用初等q级数论证，结合经Gordon–Hughes–Newman–Ligozat判别法验证的φ(q)^2权重一eta商恒等式；最后用Wright圆法建立渐近公式。
