AI.conclusion: 相互作用连续费米子系统的海森堡动力学普遍地破坏CAR代数（乃至其规范不变子代数）的不变性，且不变性失效在时间上几乎处处发生。

title: Testing Spin Prior Assumptions of Binary Black Hole Parameter Inference and Their Astrophysical Implications
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 1 table; submitted to MNRAS. Comments welcome
summary: With the growing number of binary black hole (BBH) candidates in the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog 5.0 (GWTC-5.0), an increasing number of BBH systems with distinct properties have been reported. The individual spins are relatively less constrained in the parameter estimations for most events. While the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (LVK) adopts a uninformative spin prior by default, some binary evolution scenarios have strong predictions on component spins. In this work, we perform Bayesian parameter inference for a subset of BBH events spanning a broad range of properties in the chirp mass, mass ratio, and effective inspiral spin ($\mathcal{M}_{\rm c}$-$q$-$χ_{\rm eff}$) parameter space. We consider three different spin priors: the LVK spin prior and two astrophysically motivated priors, assuming a non-spinning primary BH ($χ_1 = 0$) or a non-spinning secondary BH ($χ_2 = 0$). We find that the non-spinning primary BH prior is disfavored by the data for several systems with high effective inspiral spins, including GW190517_055101, GW190412, GW241113_163507, and GW231028_153006. We suggest that standard common-envelope evolution represents a promising formation channel that can be tested with gravitational-wave observations, and propose a novel method for estimating the merger rate of systems formed through alternative evolutionary channels. We further suggest that the binary evolution involving mass-ratio reversal may provide a possible formation pathway for these systems.

AI.tldr: 通过贝叶斯参数推断比较三种自旋先验，发现非自旋主黑洞先验被多个高有效自旋双黑洞事件数据所否定，并提出标准共同包层演化是可检验的形成通道及新的并合率估计方法。
AI.motivation: GWTC-5.0中双黑洞事件增多且部分系统性质独特，但多数事件个体自旋约束较弱；LVK默认采用无信息自旋先验，而部分双星演化情景对分量自旋有强预言，故需检验不同自旋先验与数据的相容性。
AI.method: 对覆盖啁啾质量、质量比和有效旋进自旋（Mc-q-χ_eff）参数空间广泛范围的BBH事件子集进行贝叶斯参数推断，采用三种自旋先验：LVK自旋先验，以及假设主黑洞不自旋（χ_1=0）或次黑洞不自旋（χ_2=0）两种具天体物理动机的先验。
AI.result: 对于若干高有效旋进自旋系统（包括GW190517_055101、GW190412、GW241113_163507和GW231028_153006），非自旋主黑洞先验被数据所否定。
AI.conclusion: 标准共同包层演化是有前景且可用引力波观测检验的形成通道；提出估算经由替代演化通道形成系统并合率的新方法，并指出涉及质量比反转的双星演化可能为这些系统提供形成途径。

title: Block Relations and Clifford Theory for H-Triples
summary: We study block relations between H-triples of finite groups. We prove a Clifford correspondence theorem in which a single pair of associated projective representations satisfies both the mixed comparison-function identities and the block conditions on every intermediate group. The resulting correspondence preserves relative character heights and yields a common defect group for each pair of corresponding blocks. We also establish induction and gluing results, including an induction criterion that allows unequal Clifford indices. Direct products, wreath products and changes of ambient group are treated within the same framework. These results provide character-triple tools for Galois-equivariant local-global correspondences.

AI.tldr: 研究有限群H-triple之间的block关系，证明了一个Clifford对应定理，并给出一系列诱导、粘合及直积/圈积结果，保持相对特征高度并给出公共亏群。
AI.motivation: 为Galois等变局部-整体对应提供character-triple工具，需要刻画block之间稳定且精细的对应关系（含高度与亏群信息）。
AI.method: 引入H-triple框架下的Clifford对应：用一对关联射影表示同时满足混合比较函数恒等式与各中间群上的block条件，并结合诱导与粘合方法（含不等Clifford指数的诱导判据）。
AI.result: 得到单对射影表示即同时满足混合比较函数恒等式与所有中间群block条件的Clifford对应；该对应保持相对特征高度，并为每一对对应block给出公共亏群；同时建立诱导、粘合、直积、圈积及环境群变更结果。
AI.conclusion: 该文为有限群block对应提供了统一的character-triple工具，能处理不等Clifford指数与群变更情形，可用于Galois等变局部-整体对应研究。

title: No Spurious Local Minima in Full-Order Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control
summary: This paper studies the nonconvex optimization landscape of Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control under direct state-space parameterization. Although the LQG cost may possess suboptimal stationary points, whether it admits suboptimal local minima has remained open. We answer this question negatively: Every local minimum of the full-order LQG cost is globally optimal. More generally, at any controller order, every local minimum corresponding to an uncontrollable or unobservable realization attains the globally optimal LQG cost over all stabilizing policies of arbitrary orders. We further show that any suboptimal policy can be augmented with decoupled stable controller states, so that the augmented policy admits a direction of negative curvature with probability one. Consequently, any suboptimal stationary point in full-order LQG cost can be converted into a strict saddle with probability one. One key proof idea connects the state-space Hessian to a frequency-domain global-optimality condition derived from the Youla parameterization. These results reveal a benign local-minimum landscape despite the presence of suboptimal stationary points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了直接状态空间参数化下LQG控制的非凸优化景观，证明全阶LQG代价的所有局部极小值都是全局最优的，且次优驻点可几乎必然转化为严格鞍点。
AI.motivation: LQG代价可能存在次优驻点，但其是否含有次优局部极小值此前尚属公开问题。本文旨在刻画LQG优化景观中局部极小值的性质，澄清优化是否存在陷阱。
AI.method: 在直接状态空间参数化下分析全阶LQG代价的Hessian，将状态空间Hessian与基于Youla参数化的频域全局最优性条件建立联系；并对次优策略引入解耦稳定控制器状态扩展，分析其负曲率方向。
AI.result: 证明全阶LQG代价的每个局部极小值均为全局最优；更一般地，任意控制器阶数下，对应不可控或不可观实现的局部极小值达到所有阶数镇定策略中的全局最优LQG代价。此外，任何次优策略可添加解耦稳定控制器状态，使扩展策略以概率一存在负曲率方向，从而将全阶LQG代价中的次优驻点以概率一转为严格鞍点。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LQG代价存在次优驻点，其局部极小值景观是良性的，不存在次优局部极小值，次优驻点均为可逃逸的严格鞍点。

title: GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/.

AI.tldr: GT-VLA 是一个可引导框架，借助通用 VLM 生成语义引导并将其转化为 2D 视觉轨迹，通过轨迹条件化的动作生成，把 VLM 的常识泛化能力注入 VLA 控制，在 LIBERO 与真实机器人上取得更好的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在机器人操作上表现良好，但难以泛化到未见任务、配置和长时程场景，核心问题是 VLA 过拟合训练场景、无法遵循新语言指令；而现成 VLM 虽泛化更强却无法直接控制机器人动作，因此需要一种既能利用 VLM 常识又能驱动 VLA 控制的方法。
AI.method: 提出 GT-VLA：接受外部通用 VLM 的引导，进行轨迹条件化动作生成。流程为先用通用模型识别当前技能的语义引导，将引导转换为 2D 视觉轨迹，再把轨迹渲染到观测上，条件化动作策略。设计上将语义目标获取、轨迹生成与底层动作执行解耦，使高层引导能传播到机器人动作；并采用混合专家（MoE）架构，配备技能专属的轨迹模块与动作模块以提升执行鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准和真实机器人平台上评估，相比近期 VLA 基线在两种设置下均展现出更好的泛化能力。代码与补充材料见项目网站 https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/。
AI.conclusion: 通过将通用 VLM 的语义引导转化为视觉轨迹并条件化动作策略，GT-VLA 有效结合了 VLM 的常识泛化与 VLA 的精细控制，缓解了 VLA 在未见任务、配置及长时程场景中的泛化瓶颈。

title: Understanding Sectoral Responses to Tariff Uncertainty via a High-Dimensional Mediation Analysis
summary: This paper conducts an empirical mediation analysis to examine how U.S. stock-market sectors responded to the 2025 tariff-policy episode. Using S&P 500 stock data along with hundreds of firm-level financial variables, we study whether sector membership was associated with differences in stock returns and whether these differences were statistically related to firm financial characteristics. For each of five economically distinct tariff-policy windows, we use high-dimensional linear causal mediation models to estimate the direct sector effects. We use a linear regression model to estimate the total sector effects, and then estimate the indrect sector effects by using the difference between the total sector effects and the direct sector effects. To accommodate a large number of candidate mediators, we use a partially penalized least-squares procedure that regularizes financial-variable coefficients while unpenalizes coefficients of all sector indicators. Wald and F-type tests are used to examine whether indirect and direct effects are significant or not, respectively. The results show that tariff news did not produce one uniform market response. Sector effects vary across five economically distinct tariff-policy windows. The clearest findings are in the direct sector effects. Technology was the sector most negatively affected during the initial decline and escalation collapse, but it also rebounded most strongly during the April 9 relief rally. The results indicate that in addition to Technology, Energy and other trade-exposed sectors were particularly affected during the initial decline and escalation phases. The selected mediators provide evidence that growth, investment, liquidity, profitability, and cash-flow characteristics helped characterize firms associated with sector-level return differences.

AI.tldr: 本文对2025年关税政策事件进行中介分析，发现关税消息未引发统一的市场反应；行业效应在五个政策窗口中各不相同，科技、能源及贸易敞口行业受影响最明显，且成长性、投资、流动性、盈利能力与现金流等财务特征可解释部分行业收益差异。
AI.motivation: 考察2025年关税政策冲击下美国股市各行业反应是否存在差异，以及这些差异是否与企业财务特征在统计上相关，从而识别行业效应的直接与间接传导机制。
AI.method: 使用S&P 500股票数据与数百个企业层面财务变量；划分五个经济上不同的关税政策窗口；采用高维线性因果中介模型，以部分惩罚最小二乘（对财务变量系数正则化、对行业指示变量系数不惩罚）估计直接行业效应，用线性回归估计总效应，间接效应为总效应与直接效应之差；用Wald检验与F检验分别检验间接效应与直接效应的显著性。
AI.result: 关税消息未产生统一的市场反应，行业效应在五个窗口间存在差异；最清晰的证据出现在直接行业效应中。科技行业在初始下跌与升级崩塌阶段受负面冲击最大，但在4月9日缓解性反弹中回升最强；能源及其他贸易敞口行业在初始下跌与升级阶段亦受显著影响。所选中介变量表明成长、投资、流动性、盈利能力与现金流特征有助于刻画与行业层面收益差异相关的企业。
AI.conclusion: 行业层面关税冲击效应具有窗口依赖性与异质性，直接效应比间接效应更清晰；企业财务特征在解释行业收益差异中起中介作用，为评估关税政策的股市传导提供了高维中介分析框架与经验证据。

title: Electronic and topological properties of Ce-based honeycomb ferromagnet Ce$_2$Zn$_6$Ge$_3$
summary: Ce$_2$Zn$_6$Ge$_3$ is a rare example of the Ce-based honeycomb ferromagnet. Here, we report its Fermi surface and topological properties by quantum oscillations via the magnetoresistance and tunnel diode oscillator (TDO) based measurements, in combination with the density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Four fundamental frequencies are observed in the quantum oscillations, and their angle dependence is more compatible with the DFT calculations assuming that the 4$f$-electrons are localized, suggesting a localized nature of ferromagnetism in Ce$_2$Zn$_6$Ge$_3$. Furthermore, the observations of negative longitudinal magnetoresistance and non-zero Berry phase, as well as the existence of two pairs of Weyl points near the Fermi level as revealed from the calculated electronic structures, provide strong evidence for nontrivial topology in Ce$_2$Zn$_6$Ge$_3$. These findings suggest that Ce$_2$Zn$_6$Ge$_3$ could provide a unique platform to study magnetism, topology, quantum criticality and their interplay.

AI.tldr: 通过量子振荡、纵向磁阻和Berry相位测量结合DFT计算，揭示Ce₂Zn₆Ge₃中铁磁性的局域本质与Weyl拓扑特性，表明其可作为研究磁性与拓扑相互作用的独特平台。
AI.motivation: Ce₂Zn₆Ge₃是罕见的Ce基蜂窝铁磁体，其费米面与拓扑性质尚待实验澄清，尤其是4f电子的局域/巡游性质及是否存在非平凡拓扑。
AI.method: 采用磁阻与隧道二极管振荡器（TDO）测量量子振荡，获取四个基本频率及其角度依赖关系，并与基于4f电子局域假设的DFT计算结果进行对比；同时测量负纵向磁阻和非零Berry相位，结合电子结构计算寻找Weyl点。
AI.result: 观察到四个量子振荡基本频率，其角度依赖与4f电子局域的DFT计算更吻合；测得负纵向磁阻与非零Berry相位；DFT计算显示费米能级附近存在两对Weyl点。
AI.conclusion: Ce₂Zn₆Ge₃的铁磁性源于局域4f电子，并具有非平凡拓扑特征，可为研究磁性、拓扑、量子临界及其相互作用提供独特平台。

title: Lower Bounds for Moments of Automorphic L-functions
summary: In this article, we describe a method to obtain lower bounds for the 2kth moment of values of L-functions localised at the central point for all real k > 0. In particular, we handle the families of quadratic twists of self-dual irreducible unitary cuspidal automorphic representations of GL_2(A_Q) and GL_3(A_Q).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种方法，可对任意实数 k>0 给出 L-函数中心点处取值的 2k 阶矩的下界，并具体处理了 GL_2(A_Q) 与 GL_3(A_Q) 的自对偶不可约酉尖点自守表示族的二次扭族。
AI.motivation: L-函数中心点取值的高阶矩是解析数论的核心问题，与阶的估计、非零性及算术应用密切相关。已有结果多集中于整数阶矩，对任意实数阶 2k 的矩下界（尤其是 k>0 的连续范围）研究不足，且往往限于特定低次族。
AI.method: 通过构造并分析针对中心点局部化取值的矩方法，推广至任意实数 k>0 的 2k 阶矩；结合自守 L-函数的解析性质与二次扭族的族平均工具，分别处理 GL_2(A_Q) 和 GL_3(A_Q) 上的自对偶不可约酉尖点自守表示。
AI.result: 获得了任意实 k>0 时中心点处 L-函数取值 2k 阶矩的下界，并成功覆盖 GL_2(A_Q) 与 GL_3(A_Q) 自对偶不可约酉尖点自守表示的二次扭族两类族。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法具有一般性，可给出任意实数阶矩的下界，为 L-函数中心点取值矩问题提供了新工具，并扩展了适用族类至 GL_3 情形。

title: Application of Machine Learning to the Computation of Parameters in the SUPG Method for Unstructured and Anisotropic Meshes
summary: Solution of convection-dominated problems using stabilized methods often requires to specify stabilization parameters whose optimal choice is not known but which considerably influence the quality of the approximate solution. In a recent work of the authors, an approach for computing these parameters by machine learning was proposed and applied to the streamline upwind/Petrov-Galerkin (SUPG) method for convection-diffusion equations. In the present paper, this approach is studied numerically for unstructured meshes and extended to meshes obtained by anisotropic mesh adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于机器学习计算稳定化参数的方法从结构网格推广到非结构网格及各向异性自适应网格，并进行了数值研究。
AI.motivation: 对流占优问题的稳定化方法通常需要指定稳定化参数，其最优取值未知且显著影响近似解质量。作者此前已提出用机器学习计算这些参数并应用于对流扩散方程的SUPG方法，本文旨在进一步验证和拓展该方法。
AI.method: 沿用作者先前提出的机器学习方法计算稳定化参数，针对非结构网格进行数值研究，并将其扩展到各向异性网格自适应所生成的网格上，应用于SUPG方法求解对流扩散方程。
AI.result: 在非结构网格上对该机器学习方法进行了数值验证，并成功将其推广至各向异性自适应网格。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的机器学习参数计算方法可有效应用于非结构网格和各向异性自适应网格，为对流占优问题的稳定化参数选取提供了可行途径。

title: Classical BV Pushforward
summary: We define the classical BV pushforward and establish its two main properties. First, we prove that it maps solutions of the classical master equation (CME) on the total space to solutions of the CME on the smaller space. Second, we prove that, for isolated critical points, it maps BV canonically equivalent solutions to BV canonically equivalent solutions. We illustrate the construction with examples and discuss its applications.

AI.tldr: 本文定义经典BV前推(pushforward)，并证明其保持经典主方程(CME)解及在孤立临界点上保持BV规范等价性，最后给出示例与应用讨论。
AI.motivation: 在BV-BRST形式体系中，通常需要将大空间(总空间)上的经典主方程解约化到更小的空间上，但缺乏严格定义且保持CME解与规范等价性的自然操作。本文旨在填补此空白。
AI.method: 作者给出经典BV前推的定义，然后通过证明两条性质来刻画它：(1)将总空间上CME的解映为小空间上CME的解；(2)在孤立临界点情形下，把BV规范等价的解映为BV规范等价的解。并结合示例进行说明。
AI.result: 证明了经典BV前推确实把CME解保持为CME解；并且当临界点孤立时，该前推保持BV规范等价类。示例展示了该构造的具体运作。
AI.conclusion: 经典BV前推是一个良定义的映射，适合用于BV-BRST约化，并具有在物理学与数学中(如约化、局部化)的潜在应用。

title: Evidence for an extended Galactic proton component beyond the cosmic-ray knee
comment: 5 pages main text with 2 figures + 5 pages appendix with 1 figure, submitted on Sep 18
summary: The cosmic-ray (CR) \textit{knee} at a few petaelectronvolts (PeV) is commonly associated with the acceleration limit of Galactic protons. Recent detection of multi-PeV photons from the microquasar Cygnus X-3 suggests proton acceleration to tens of PeV. However, the contribution of such type of sources to CRs remains unclear. Here we analyse proton and helium spectral data spanning from 0.1 to 1000~PeV and find that the knee strongly disfavours a single terminal cutoff. Full-spectrum analyses incorporating measurements down to tens of gigaelectronvolts (GeV) require a proton contribution extending beyond $100\,\mathrm{PeV}$. This contribution either extends continuously from GeV to 100~PeV energies or belongs to a distinct component whose spectrum has a spectral break at the knee. Within source-population interpretations, its connection to lower-energy Galactic cosmic rays suggests a Galactic origin. The component from GeV energies is conventionally associated with supernova remnants, but extending it beyond $100\,\mathrm{PeV}$ challenges acceleration theory and $γ$-ray observations of ordinary remnants . A spectral break, by contrast, can arise naturally from rigidity-dependent transport. This interpretation makes the knee a probe of Galactic CR transport, and connects the extended proton spectrum to extreme Galactic accelerators, such as super-Eddington X-ray binaries, that can also produce PeV $γ$ rays and neutrinos.

AI.tldr: 对0.1–1000 PeV质子与氦谱的分析表明，"膝"区不支持单一终端截断，需要一个延伸至100 PeV以上的质子成分；该成分可能连续来自GeV能段，或是在膝处发生谱折断的独立成分。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将几PeV处的宇宙线"膝"归因于银河系质子的加速上限；Cyguns X-3等微类星体多PeV光子的探测暗示质子可被加速至数十PeV，但此类源对宇宙线的贡献仍不清楚。本文意在通过宽能段质子与氦谱的联合分析澄清膝的成因与高能质子成分的来源。
AI.method: 联合分析0.1–1000 PeV的质子与氦谱数据，检验单一终端截断模型；并结合低至数十GeV的测量进行全谱拟合，考察需要何种质子成分以描述数据。
AI.result: 膝强烈不支持单一终端截断。全谱拟合要求存在延伸至100 PeV以上的质子贡献；该贡献或从GeV连续延伸至100 PeV，或属于在膝处存在谱折断的独立成分。在源族群解释框架下，其与低能银河系宇宙线的联系指向银河系起源。
AI.conclusion: 从GeV连续延伸的成分通常被归因于超新星遗迹，但延伸至100 PeV以上会挑战加速理论与普通遗迹的γ射线观测；谱折断则可自然地由依赖刚度的输运产生。该解释使膝成为银河系宇宙线输运的探针，并将延展的质子谱与极端银河系加速器（如可产生PeV γ射线与中微子的超高爱丁顿X射线双星）联系起来。

title: Explicit $H_3$ relation in the diagrammatic Hecke category
comment: Ancillary files contain the coefficient certificate and verification code
summary: We compute the missing three-color relation in type $H_3$ as an explicit $R$-linear combination of double leaves. The expression has $43\,424$ nonzero polynomial coefficients with scalars in $\mathbb{Z}[\varphi]$, where $\varphi = (1 + \sqrt{5})/2$. We verify the relation using exact arithmetic in the computer algebra system GAP. This completes the diagrammatic presentation of the Hecke category of Elias and Williamson.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了类型 $H_3$ 中缺失的三色关系，将其显式表示为双叶（double leaves）的 $R$-线性组合，含 $43\,424$ 个系数在 $\mathbb{Z}[\varphi]$ 中的非零多项式，并用 GAP 精确算术验证。该工作补全了 Elias–Williamson Hecke 范畴的图解表示。
AI.motivation: Elias 与 Williamson 给出的 Hecke 范畴图解表示在类型 $H_3$ 中尚缺少一条三色关系，该缺口使图示呈现不完整，因此需要显式补全这一关系。
AI.method: 以双叶为基，将该三色关系写成 $R$-线性组合；系数为 $\mathbb{Z}[\varphi]$（$\varphi=(1+\sqrt{5})/2$）中的多项式；并在计算机代数系统 GAP 中使用精确算术进行验证。
AI.result: 所得到的关系式含 $43\,424$ 个非零多项式系数，系数标量取自 $\mathbb{Z}[\varphi]$，且经 GAP 精确算术验证成立。
AI.conclusion: 类型 $H_3$ 的缺失三色关系被显式确定，从而完成了 Elias–Williamson Hecke 范畴的图解表示。

title: On the T-Adaptive Segment Routing Problem
summary: In this paper, we present a multi-period optimization problem arising from the traffic engineering of core IP/MPLS networks, called T-ASR. This problem aims at computing a sequence of segment routing paths that adapt to a multi-period scheduled maintenance, while allowing limited number of path reconfigurations between successive time steps. Rather than focusing solely on minimizing the classical Maximum Link Utilization (MLU) criteria, we introduce a more refined lexicographic objective that minimizes the entire sorted vector of link loads providing a more efficient resource utilization for all the links. We propose a generic approach that decomposes this problem into a sequence of subproblems. To model each subproblem, we introduce two Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulations, ALEXA and STELA, resulting in two variants of our approach. Finally, we evaluate and compare the efficiency of both variants on small to medium-sized network instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出核心IP/MPLS网络流量工程中的多周期优化问题T-ASR，计算适应多周期计划维护的分段路由路径序列，并限制相邻时间步间的路径重构次数。采用字典序目标最小化整个链路负载排序向量而非仅MLU，通过分解方法建模为MILP（ALEXA与STELA两种变体），在中小规模网络上验证比较。
AI.motivation: 核心IP/MPLS网络的流量工程需应对多周期计划维护，路径需随周期调整，但频繁重配置代价高。传统仅最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）的目标较粗糙，无法优化所有链路的资源利用。
AI.method: 将T-ASR问题分解为一系列子问题，并对每个子问题提出两种混合整数线性规划（MILP）建模方式——ALEXA与STELA，从而形成两种求解变体；目标采用字典序优化，最小化链路负载的完整排序向量。
AI.result: 在中小规模网络实例上对两种变体进行了评估与比较。
AI.conclusion: 所提分解方法及两种MILP变体能够处理多周期分段路由优化，字典序目标相比MLU提供更均衡的链路资源利用，且两种变体在中小规模网络上具备可评估的效率差异。

title: End-to-end QP-based policies: A unified perspective on robust control and robot learning
summary: We present an end-to-end QP-based policy framework that enables systematic policy construction with minimal domain-specific design, while preserving the transparency and interpretability of model-based control. The proposed policy representation supports both domain-randomized model-based auto-tuning, where policy parameters are optimized over distributions of disturbances and model variations, and black-box policy construction, where the problem is formulated in terms of a (possibly) unknown model without requiring explicit notions of states, inputs, or the underlying system dynamics. We establish connections to existing policy representations and control paradigms, including robust control, multilayer perceptrons, and robot learning, and interpret our end-to-end QP policies as a common abstraction of these approaches. We validate the resulting framework in both simulation and hardware, demonstrating a broad range of applications spanning robustness, automatic policy tuning, and control under unknown system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端二次规划(QP)策略框架，以最少领域设计实现系统化策略构建，并保持模型控制的透明性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有策略构建往往依赖大量领域特定设计，且难以同时兼顾可解释性与端到端学习能力；需要在系统化策略构建、透明性、可解释性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 基于QP的策略表示：支持域随机化模型驱动的自动调参（在扰动与模型变化分布上优化策略参数），及黑盒策略构建（在未知模型下形式化，无需显式状态、输入或动力学）；建立与鲁棒控制、多层感知机(MLP)、机器人学习的联系，并将端到端QP策略统一为这些方法的通用抽象。
AI.result: 在仿真与硬件上验证框架，覆盖鲁棒性、自动策略调优、未知系统动力学下的控制等广泛应用。
AI.conclusion: 端到端QP策略可作为多种控制与学习方法（鲁棒控制、MLP、机器人学习）的通用抽象，兼具系统化构建、透明度与可解释性，并在仿真与硬件中展示广泛适用性。

title: Artificial Intelligence for early detection of circulatory shock in ICU patients
summary:
Circulatory shock is one of the leading causes of mortality in intensive care units (ICUs), and its early detection is critical to enable timely treatment and improve clinical outcomes.
  This study aimed to develop and evaluate a two-stage cascade machine learning framework for the early detection and etiological classification of circulatory shock in critically ill patients. Using data from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care (MIMIC)-IV database, four patient groups were defined: septic shock, cardiogenic shock, hypovolemic shock, and a non?shock control group, comprising a total of 32,907 patients. Vital signs and laboratory data were collected during the first six hours after ICU admission. After data cleaning and missing-value imputation, the mean value of each variable was used for model development.
  Several machine learning algorithms were compared, including logistic regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and multilayer perceptron (MLP) networks. Random Forest and XGBoost achieved the highest overall performance, with an AUROC of approximately 0.82-0.83 for shock detection, and a macro-averaged sensitivity of approximately 0.61 and precision of approximately 0.58 across all four classes. Classification performance was highest for the non?shock group, followed by septic and cardiogenic shock, while hypovolemic shock showed the lowest performance.
  These results indicate that machine learning models can identify early signs of hemodynamic deterioration associated with circulatory shock and may support clinical decision-making in the ICU. However, further improvements are needed for the classification of specific shock subtypes, particularly hypovolemic and cardiogenic shock, as well as for real-time clinical implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于MIMIC-IV数据库构建两阶段级联机器学习框架，用于ICU危重患者循环性休克的早期检测与病因分类，共纳入32,907例患者。
AI.motivation: 循环性休克是ICU主要死亡原因之一，早期识别对及时治疗和改善临床结局至关重要，因此需要开发有效的早期检测与分型方法。
AI.method: 使用MIMIC-IV数据，定义感染性休克、心源性休克、低血容量性休克及非休克对照组四类人群；采集ICU入科后前6小时的生命体征与实验室数据，经数据清洗与缺失值插补后以各变量均值建模。比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost与多层感知机（MLP）等算法。
AI.result: 随机森林与XGBoost整体表现最佳，休克检测AUROC约为0.82–0.83，四分类的宏平均敏感度约0.61、精确率约0.58。分类性能在非休克组最高，其次为感染性休克与心源性休克，低血容量性休克表现最差。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习模型可识别循环性休克相关的早期血流动力学恶化征象，有望辅助ICU临床决策；但特定休克亚型（尤其低血容量性与心源性休克）的分类及实时临床部署仍需进一步改进。

title: Enhanced sliding in the coexisting Charge Density Wave phase of strained TbTe3
summary: In the last years, the application of mechanical tensile stress has been shown to trigger unconventional phases in quantum materials. Recently, an orientational transition of the charge density wave (CDW) of TbTe3 was reported under the application of moderate uniaxial tensile stress, associated to the in-plane a/c lattice anisotropy. This leads to the disappearance of the pristine c-oriented CDW (CDWc) and to the appearance of the orthogonal a-oriented one (CDWa). A coexistence phase with a superposition of CDWa and CDWc appears when a=c. Here, we probe the sliding dynamics of both CDWc and CDWa as a function of applied tensile stress, i.e. in the pure CDWc, pure CDWa and coexistence phases, by measuring current-voltage characteristics and associated differential resistances. If the pristine CDWc has been known to display non-linear dynamics and thus sliding for several years, we show here that the strain-induced CDWa phase also displays the same characteristics, proving its incommensurate nature. Moreover, we show that sliding also takes place both for CDWc and CDWa, with reduced threshold currents, in the coexistence phase, which questions the microstructure of these coexisting orthogonal CDWs in real space. Finally, the linearity of the threshold fields is kept for all deformation states, with finite threshold fields at Tc, which is discussed in terms of commensurability and pinning potentials. This work opens new questions for the theoretical description of sliding CDWs in quasi-2D systems.

AI.tldr: 通过施加单轴拉伸应力调控TbTe₃中电荷密度波（CDW）取向，研究纯CDWc、纯CDWa及共存相的滑动动力学，发现应变诱导的CDWa同样表现出非线性滑动行为，证实其非公度性。
AI.motivation: 机械拉伸应力可诱导量子材料出现非常规相。TbTe₃中已报道在中等单轴拉伸应力下CDW发生取向转变（由c取向CDWc转为a取向CDWa），并在a=c时出现共存相，但该取向转变对CDW滑动动力学的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在不同拉伸应力下测量电流-电压特性及相应的微分电阻，对比纯CDWc相、纯CDWa相和共存相中两种CDW的滑动行为，并分析阈值电流与阈值场随温度和形变状态的变化。
AI.result: 应变诱导的CDWa相表现出与CDWc相同的非线性动力学特征，证明其非公度性质；共存相中CDWc和CDWa均可发生滑动且阈值电流降低；所有形变状态下阈值场保持线性关系，并在Tc处存在有限阈值场。
AI.conclusion: CDWa与CDWc均具有非公度滑动特性，共存相中正交CDW的实空间微观结构仍存疑问；阈值场的线性行为可用公度性与钉扎势解释，为准二维体系中滑动CDW的理论描述提出新问题。

title: The infinite sum of the cubes of reciprocal balancing numbers
summary: In this paper, we study the infinite reciprocal cubic sum $\sum_{k=n}^{\infty}\frac{1}{B_k^3}$ of balancing numbers. We obtain explicit bounds for this sum and use them to determine the integer part of its reciprocal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平衡数（balancing numbers）的无穷倒数立方和 ∑_{k=n}^{∞} 1/B_k^3，给出了该和的显式上下界，并据此确定其倒数的整数部分。
AI.motivation: 平衡数的无穷倒数幂和是数论中经典的研究对象，已有关于倒数平方和的估计，但对倒数立方和的显式界及其倒数整数部分的刻画尚缺乏系统结果，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以平衡数序列 {B_k} 为研究对象，利用其递推关系（如 B_{k+1}=6B_k-B_{k-1}）与通项表达式，构造对该无穷倒数立方和的显式上下界估计，进而通过夹逼（squeeze）方法确定其倒数的整数部分。
AI.result: 得到 ∑_{k=n}^{∞} 1/B_k^3 的显式上下界，并由此精确确定该和数的倒数的整数部分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将平衡数倒数幂和的显式估计推广到立方情形，所给界的精度足以刻画和式倒数的整数部分，为后续研究更高次幂和或类似递推数列提供了方法与参考。

title: Active Subspace-Guided Free-Form Deformation with Sinkhorn Autoencoders for Reduced-Order Modelling of Parametrised Shape Problems
summary: Geometrically parametrised PDEs arise in shape optimisation, where solving a PDE over many deformed domains at manageable cost is a central challenge. Free-form Deformation (FFD) parametrises shape variations through a lattice of control points, but the resulting parameter space is typically high-dimensional, with most directions barely affecting the quantity of interest (QoI). We address this with a two-stage reduction pipeline. An Active Subspace (AS)-guided structured control-point selection identifies the low-dimensional subspace of FFD weights driving the QoI. A Sinkhorn Autoencoder (SAE) is then trained on the reduced weights, learning their distribution in a compact latent space by minimising the Wasserstein distance between aggregated posterior and prior. We compare three non-intrusive Reduced-order Models (ROMs), mapping full FFD weights, AS-reduced weights, or SAE latent codes to the QoI, each using Random Forests, Gaussian Processes, and K-Nearest Neighbours. We test the methodology on a non-linear heat equation with Gaussian random Robin boundary data on a deformed Stanford Bunny, and on drag prediction for the DTC Hull bulb under FFD deformations. In both cases, the generative model captures the bulk of the QoI distribution over a comparable support, thinning the shoulder opposite the design objective, while its extremes in the design-relevant direction match the FFD sample within numerical and sampling uncertainty. ROMs learned in the SAE latent space yield smaller test errors than those on full FFD weights in most regressor-metric combinations, whereas AS-reduced weights give no comparable gain. Only the latent representation attains a positive predictive coefficient $Q^2$.

AI.tldr: 提出AS引导的控制点选择+SAE两阶段降维流程，用于几何参数化PDE的形状优化，SAE潜空间ROM精度最优且唯一获得正Q²。
AI.motivation: 几何参数化PDE（如形状优化）需在大量变形域上以可控成本求解PDE。FFD通过控制点格架参数化形状变化，但参数空间维度高，多数方向对目标量（QoI）影响甚微，导致直接建模效率低。
AI.method: 两阶段降维流水线：(1) 基于Active Subspace (AS) 引导的结构化控制点选择，识别驱动QoI的FFD权重低维子空间；(2) 在约减权重上训练Sinkhorn Autoencoder (SAE)，通过最小化聚合后验与先验间的Wasserstein距离学习紧凑潜空间分布。比较三种非侵入式ROM：以全FFD权重、AS约减权重、SAE潜码为输入映射到QoI，回归器分别采用随机森林、高斯过程、K近邻。
AI.result: 在变形Stanford Bunny上的非线性热方程（高斯随机Robin边界数据）以及DTC Hull球鼻艏在FFD变形下的阻力预测两个算例中：生成模型在相当支撑集上捕获QoI分布主体，削弱设计目标对侧的肩部，其在设计相关方向上的极值在数值与采样不确定度内与FFD样本一致。多数回归器-度量组合下，SAE潜空间ROM的测试误差小于全FFD权重ROM，而AS约减权重无相当增益。仅潜表示获得正的预测系数Q²。
AI.conclusion: AS引导的结构化控制点选择结合SAE潜空间建模可有效降低FFD参数维度，且基于潜空间的ROM在精度上优于全FFD与AS约减权重方案，仅潜表示达到正Q²，验证了该两阶段降维流程的有效性。

title: Scattering Measures and Information Geometry
summary: We formulate scattering experiments in terms of parameterized finite measures on outcome spaces and develop the associated information geometry defined by the Fisher metric. The decomposition of a scattering measure into total mass and normalized shape separates Fisher information into contributions from changes in overall scattering strength and redistribution among outcomes. Measurement processes are represented by probability or sub-probability kernels acting on the scattering measure. Such kernels contract Fisher information, placing a broad class of experimental operations within a common information-theoretic framework. This formulation connects scattering experiments to the theory of optimal experimental design through the Fisher geometry of scattering measures. The same finite-measure structure arises naturally in quantum measurements with incomplete detection, clarifying its place in the hierarchy from quantum measurement to classical outcome statistics.

AI.tldr: 该文用参数化有限测度刻画散射实验，建立基于Fisher度量的信息几何，将散射测度分解为总质量与归一化形状，并把测量过程表示为概率/次概率核，证明其收缩Fisher信息，从而统一散射实验与最优实验设计，并联系到不完整检测的量子测量。
AI.motivation: 散射实验通常以截面或事件率描述，缺乏统一的、与信息论和实验设计相衔接的几何框架；作者希望用有限测度与Fisher信息几何来统一刻画散射强度变化、结果重分布以及测量操作对信息的影响。
AI.method: 将散射实验表述为结果空间上的参数化有限测度，引入由Fisher度量定义的信息几何；把散射测度分解为总质量与归一化形状两部分，使Fisher信息分解为散射强度变化与结果间重分布的贡献；用作用在散射测度上的概率或次概率核表示测量过程。
AI.result: 测量核会收缩Fisher信息，因而一大类实验操作被纳入共同的信息论框架；该表述把散射实验与最优实验设计通过散射测度的Fisher几何联系起来；同样的有限测度结构自然出现于带不完整检测的量子测量中。
AI.conclusion: 有限测度+Fisher几何为散射实验提供了统一的信息论语言，明确了从量子测量到经典结果统计的层级位置，并为实验设计与测量优化给出几何基础。

title: Observations of Repeating Tidal Disruption Events
comment: Invited review chapter for the book "Mysterious Repeating Signals from Centers of Galaxies" (Eds. Dheeraj Pasham, Eric Coughlin, Riccardo Arcodia, Petra Sukova, Itai Linial, Springer Singapore, expected in 2027). After first referee review, before re-submission, comments welcome
summary: The disruption of stars by supermassive black holes (SMBHs) as tidal disruption events (TDEs) can produce transient flares across the electromagnetic spectrum. Such flares can be used to probe SMBH properties, accretion physics and stellar dynamics in galactic nuclei. However, it can be difficult to distinguish TDE flares and those arising from other accretion phenomena around SMBHs, such as active galactic nuclei disk instabilities. Repeated flares from the same location can be produced by either such instabilities or by repeated partial disruptions of the same star, with the former expected to be at random intervals and the latter roughly periodic. Repeating nuclear transients can thus be used to distinguish between full and partial TDEs, as well as between TDEs and other accretion phenomena. Here we review observations of such repeating nuclear flares at various wavelengths. As time domain surveys become wider, deeper and faster, and as they accumulate longer baselines of data, more repeating phenomena at various time scales are being revealed. While these events show the potential for constraining several open questions regarding SMBH accretion phenomena, the small number of cases so far, the limited observational coverage for many of them, and the overall diversity of emission and repetition properties observed make it difficult to robustly associate most cases with physical scenarios at this stage. However, in the near future, as more data accumulate, the nature of various classes of repeating nuclear transients should become more clear, and with it the nature of many of the one-time flares as well.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了重复性核暂现源（repeating nuclear transients）在多种波段下的观测，指出其可用于区分完全/部分潮汐瓦解事件（TDE）以及TDE与其他吸积现象，但目前样本少、覆盖有限，尚难确证其物理本质。
AI.motivation: 超大质量黑洞（SMBH）潮汐瓦解恒星产生的暂现耀发可探测SMBH性质、吸积物理和核区恒星动力学，但难以区分TDE耀发与其他吸积现象（如活动星系核盘不稳定性）。重复耀发为区分这些机制提供了判据：盘不稳定性预期间隔随机，而同一恒星重复部分瓦解预期近似周期性，因此重复核暂现源有助于鉴别完全与部分TDE，以及TDE与其他吸积现象。
AI.method: 综述性研究：梳理各波段对重复性核耀发的观测，结合时域巡天在广度、深度、速度和基线时长上的进展，分析重复现象的时标特征与发射/重复性质。
AI.result: 随着时域巡天更广、更深、更快并积累更长基线，越来越多不同时标的重复现象被揭示；这些事件显示出约束SMBH吸积若干开放问题的潜力。但已发现的案例数量少、多数事件观测覆盖有限，且观测到的发射与重复性质总体多样，现阶段难以将大多数案例稳健地对应到具体物理情景。
AI.conclusion: 当前尚难稳健确定重复核暂现源的物理归属；随着未来数据积累，各类重复核暂现源的本质应会逐渐清晰，进而也有助于理解许多单次耀发的本质。

title: Quasi-cellular categories and the structure of the Brauer category
summary:
We introduce the notion of a quasi-cellular category, which is a variant of cellular algebras and cellular categories. Many diagram categories, such as the Brauer category and the partition category, are quasi-cellular.
  We study the Brauer category $B$ over a commutative ring $\mathbb k$ with parameter $δ$ through its quasi-cellular structure. We construct a linear functor $L:B\to mB$ to the \emph{matrix Brauer category} $mB$, which has the same objects and hom-spaces as $B$ but a matrix-like composition. For a non-singular parameter $δ$, we show that $L$ is an isomorphism of linear categories, and that $B$ is Morita equivalent to its subcategory $\mathbb S$ spanned by permutations, whose endomorphism algebras are the group algebras of symmetric groups. These results generalize those of Brown and König and Xi for the Brauer algebras.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"拟胞腔范畴"概念，并以拟胞腔结构研究Brauer范畴，通过构造到矩阵Brauer范畴的线性函子，证明了在参数非奇异时该函子为线性范畴同构，且Brauer范畴与其由置换张成的子范畴Morita等价，推广了Brown及König–Xi关于Brauer代数的结果。
AI.motivation: 胞腔代数与胞腔范畴已有丰富理论，但许多重要的图解范畴（如Brauer范畴、partition范畴）并不严格属于胞腔范畴，因此需要更宽泛的框架来统一处理。作者希望借助这一新框架重新刻画Brauer范畴的结构，并把Brauer代数上已有的Morita等价等经典结论提升到范畴层面。
AI.method: 首先定义拟胞腔范畴，作为胞腔代数与胞腔范畴的变体，并指出Brauer范畴、partition范畴等图解范畴均属此类。随后针对交换环k上带参数δ的Brauer范畴B，利用其拟胞腔结构构造线性函子L:B→mB，其中mB为矩阵Brauer范畴——与B有相同对象与hom空间，但复合为矩阵式。进而对非奇异参数δ分析L的性质及B与子范畴S（由置换张成、其自同态代数为对称群群代数）之间的关系。
AI.result: 当参数δ非奇异时，函子L是线性范畴的同构；并且B与其由置换张成的子范畴S（其对象自同态代数为对称群群代数）Morita等价。
AI.conclusion: 这些结论将Brown以及König和Xi关于Brauer代数的相应结果推广到Brauer范畴，表明拟胞腔范畴是研究图解范畴的有效工具。

title: The Complexity of Convex Optimization with Mismatched Geometry
summary: Optimal first-order methods on non-Euclidean domains such as the $\ell_1$ ball $B_1^n(R)=\{x\in\mathbb R^n:\|x\|_1\le R\}$ pair the prox-function with the norm in which smoothness is measured. When the gradient is $L$-Lipschitz in the Euclidean norm only, the accelerated method with a Euclidean prox-setup reduces the functional gap $f(x_N)-\min_{B_1^n(R)}f$ to $O(LR^2/N^2)$ after $N$ first-order queries (an entropic $\ell_1$ prox-setup replaces $L$ by the $\ell_1\to\ell_\infty$ constant $L_1\le L$, at the cost of a factor $\log n$ and with the same exponent). The lower bound of Guzmán and Nemirovski is of order $LR^2/N^3$, and whether the upper bound can be brought down to that order is a question of A. S. Nemirovski. We show that for this mismatched problem the minimax value of the gap is of order $LR^2/N^3$ up to logarithmic factors, for deterministic and for randomized methods alike, and already in dimension proportional to the number of queries. The upper bound is attained by a Steiner-point level method: every supporting hyperplane seen so far is kept as a level cut, and the next query is made near the Steiner point of the resulting localization polytope. The analysis rests on a single geometric fact: along nested subsets of the ball the Steiner points travel a distance that is polylogarithmic in the dimension, in contrast to $\sqrt n$ for the Euclidean ball. All queries stay feasible, and a randomized selector keeps the internal work polynomial. The same geometry yields optimal rates for nonsmooth objectives, Hölder gradients, higher-order oracles and Lipschitz monotone operators, the last with a matching deterministic lower bound. For convex quadratics, a curvature-learning method attains the optimal rate on every $\ell_p$ ball with $1\le p<2$ and without logarithmic loss. Experiments confirm the predicted $N^{-3}$ behaviour on objectives that are hard for Euclidean methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了梯度仅在欧氏范数下Lipschitz光滑、但定义域为ℓ1球的"非匹配"一阶优化问题。作者证明了该问题的极小极大最优间隙为Θ(LR²/N³)（忽略对数因子），维度与查询次数成正比时即成立，对确定性和随机方法均适用。上界由Steiner点层级法达到，核心几何事实是ℓ1球嵌套子集上Steiner点移动距离关于维度为多对数级，远优于欧氏球的√n。该几何还给出非光滑目标、Hölder梯度、高阶预言机和Lipschitz单调算子的最优速率，凸二次情形下曲率学习法在1≤p<2的ℓp球上达到最优且无对数损失。
AI.motivation: 非欧域（如ℓ1球）上的一阶方法通常将prox函数与度量光滑性的范数配对。但当梯度仅在欧氏范数下L-Lipschitz时，采用欧氏prox-setup的加速方法只能将函数间隙降至O(LR²/N²)，而Guzmán与Nemirovski的下界为LR²/N³。A. S. Nemirovski提出能否将上界提升至该阶的核心开放问题。本文旨在解决这一"范数不匹配"问题的最优速率。
AI.method:
采用Steiner点层级法：将迄今见到的每个支撑超平面作为层级切割保留，下一次查询取在所得定位多面体的Steiner点附近。分析基于单一几何事实——沿ℓ1球的嵌套子集，Steiner点的移动距离关于维度为多对数级（对比欧氏球的√n）。所有查询保持可行，随机选择器使内部计算保持多项式时间。

（无法获取更多细节，因为输入仅包含摘要。）
AI.result: 证明该不匹配问题的极小极大间隙为Θ(LR²/N³)（至对数因子），对确定性与随机方法均成立，且在维度与查询数成正比时即成立。通过Steiner点层级法达到该上界。相同几何还给出非光滑目标、Hölder梯度、高阶预言机和Lipschitz单调算子的最优速率，其中单调算子还给出匹配的确定性下界。对凸二次问题，曲率学习法在任意1≤p<2的ℓp球上达到最优速率且无对数损失。实验验证了在欧氏方法难以处理的目​​标上呈现预测的N⁻³行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了A. S. Nemirovski提出的开放问题，确立了ℓ1球上范数不匹配一阶优化的极小极大最优速率Θ(LR²/N³)，匹配Guzmán–Nemirovski下界（至对数因子）。Steiner点层级法是达到该上界的关键，其几何特性（Steiner点移动的多对数维度依赖）还可推广至非光滑、Hölder、高阶及单调算子等多种设定，凸二次情形下更可完全消除对数损失。

title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
summary: Contact-rich manipulation depends on force sensing that is hard to infer from visual signals alone, both for collecting demonstrations and for training policies. Force-annotated data, however, remains hard to obtain at scale: real-robot collection ties every demonstration to physical hardware, physics simulators report contact forces that deviate systematically from real measurements, and learned world simulators, though scalable and realistic, are vision-only, so operators feel nothing during data collection and the data carries no force/torque (F/T) labels. We present HapticWorld, an interactive world simulator that predicts joint torque together with observations and renders it back to the operator in real time, closing the haptic loop between a human and a learned world model. Across three contact-rich tasks, torque feedback raises data collection throughput by 1.6 times on average. Policies trained on HapticWorld-generated demonstrations succeed in 54/60 real-world trials, approaching the 56/60 upper bound of real-world data, and far exceeding the 19/60 success rate of the vision-only baseline. Moreover, the success rates measured inside HapticWorld closely match real-world evaluation, demonstrating that HapticWorld can serve as a stand-alone F/T-conditioned policy evaluation platform.

AI.tldr: HapticWorld 是一个可交互的世界模拟器，能同时预测关节力矩与观测并实时回馈给操作者，形成"人类—学习型世界模型"的触觉闭环，从而低成本规模化地生成带力/力矩标注的演示数据并支持策略评估。
AI.motivation: 富接触操作依赖力感知，而力信号难以从纯视觉中推断，这对演示采集与策略训练都构成障碍。然而带力标注的数据难以规模化获取：真机采集受硬件约束、物理仿真器的接触力与实测存在系统性偏差、学习型世界模拟器虽可扩展且逼真却仅支持视觉——操作者在采集时无触觉反馈，数据也不含F/T标签。
AI.method: 提出 HapticWorld：一个可交互世界模拟器，在预测观测的同时预测关节力矩，并将其实时渲染回馈给操作者，从而闭合人与学习型世界模型之间的触觉回路，实现带力/力矩标注演示数据的采集与F/T条件下的策略评估。
AI.result: 在三个富接触任务上，力矩反馈使数据采集吞吐量平均提升1.6倍；用 HapticWorld 生成演示训练的策略在真机试验中成功54/60，接近真机数据上界56/60，远超纯视觉基线的19/60；且 HapticWorld 内部测得的成功率与真机评估高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: HapticWorld 通过实时触觉反馈闭环，解决了力标注数据规模化获取的难题，其生成数据训练的策略性能接近真机数据水平，并可作为一个独立的F/T条件策略评估平台。

title: Bitcoin UTXO Values Are Heavy-Tailed but not Power-Law Distributed: A Clauset-Shalizi-Newman Test across Eight Snapshots
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 26 tables. Data, analysis outputs and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22922174
summary: Power laws are often claimed for Bitcoin quantities from the slope of a log-log plot. We test one such claim with a formal protocol: whether the upper tail of the values of live unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) follows a power law. We reconstruct the exact UTXO set at eight block heights from 2012 to 2025, validate it against an independent Bitcoin Core snapshot, and apply the Clauset-Shalizi-Newman protocol with three adaptations the data require: exact discrete support, several near-tied cutoffs retained and reselected in every bootstrap replicate, and resampling by transaction, because the outputs of one transaction are not independent. The protocol was fixed before inference and every later change is recorded. The pure power law is rejected at every height, with observed Kolmogorov-Smirnov distances five to forty times those the fitted law produces, and where the exponent is below 2 its extrapolation predicts, in expectation, several outputs each larger than the total coin supply. A lognormal, a stretched exponential and a power law with an exponential cutoff near a thousand bitcoin fit better in sample at every height, as families that contain the power law must, by margins that exceed those seen on simulated power-law tails at six of the eight heights, and they predict held-out transactions better at nearly every height. They rank differently from height to height, and the lognormal and the cutoff power law differ clearly at only two. The tail's shape and the share of supply it holds drifted slowly while the number of outputs grew seventy-fold. The rejection survives a null that reproduces the dependence measured within transactions, which halves the one exceptional effect size in the panel and changes no verdict. Bitcoin UTXO values are heavy-tailed but not power-law distributed.

AI.tldr: 本文以严格协议检验比特币UTXO值上尾是否服从幂律，在2012至2025年八个区块高度重建精确UTXO集并采用修正的Clauset-Shalizi-Newman方法分析，结论是比特币UTXO值虽为厚尾但并非幂律分布。
AI.motivation: 比特币相关量常仅凭log-log图斜率被宣称服从幂律，缺乏正式统计检验；本文旨在对“活跃UTXO值上尾服从幂律”这一具体主张进行正式检验，并处理该数据特有的离散性、截断点相近与交易内非独立等问题。
AI.method: 在2012至2025年的八个区块高度重建精确UTXO集，并用独立Bitcoin Core快照验证；采用Clauset-Shalizi-Newman协议并作三项适配：精确离散支撑、保留多个近似并列截断点并在每次自助复制中重新选择、按交易而非按输出重采样（因同一交易输出不独立）。协议在推断前固定，后续改动全部记录；并用可复现交易内依赖的零模型检验。
AI.result: 在所有高度纯幂律均被拒绝，观测KS距离为拟合幂律产出的5至40倍；当指数低于2时，其外推在期望上预测出多个超过总币量规模的输出。对数正态、拉伸指数与约一千比特币处带指数截断的幂律在每个高度样本内拟合更优，且在八个高度中的六个其优势超过模拟幂律尾上的表现，并在几乎所有高度对留出交易预测更好；三者排序随高度变化，仅对数正态与截断幂律在两个高度有明确差异。尾部形状及其占供应份额缓慢漂移，而输出数量增长七十倍。在再现交易内依赖的零模型下拒绝依然成立，仅使面板中一个例外效应量减半，未改变任何判定。
AI.conclusion: 比特币UTXO值是厚尾的，但不是幂律分布；此前基于log-log斜率得出的幂律主张不成立，替代的厚尾族（对数正态、拉伸指数、带指数截断幂律）拟合与预测更优。

title: Quantum-Geometric Amplification of Nonperturbative Interaction Scales
comment: We welcome any suggestion and comment about content and missing important references. Main text consists of 5 pages + references. Supplemental Material consists of 68 pages
summary: Weak interactions at a two-dimensional quadratic band touching (QBT) can generate an exponentially small symmetry-breaking gap, $m\sim e^{-A/V_1}$, that cannot be captured by every finite order of perturbation theory. We show that the singular quantum geometry of the gapped QBT converts this beyond-all-orders scale into an algebraically enhanced response. The quantum metric develops a momentum-space hot spot whose Brillouin-zone integral diverges logarithmically, and therefore grows algebraically when the gap is dynamically generated by interactions. Through the inverse-frequency Souza--Wilkens--Martin optical sum rule, the same amplification appears in the negative-first longitudinal optical moment, even though the ordinary optical conductivity remains $O(e^2/\hbar)$ and its absorption threshold is exponentially small. We establish these results analytically for a massive QBT and verify them microscopically in an interacting kagome lattice model known to develop a spontaneous quantum anomalous Hall mass at its QBT from loop currents order. Our results identify quantum geometry as an asymptotic amplifier of nonperturbative interaction scales.

AI.tldr: 在二维二次能带接触(QBT)处，弱相互作用产生的指数小对称破缺能隙的"超越所有阶"尺度，可被QBT的奇异量子几何转化为代数增强的光学响应，并在相互作用kagome格子上得到微观验证。
AI.motivation: 弱相互作用在二维二次能带接触处可生成指数小的对称破缺能隙 m~e^{-A/V_1}，该能隙无法由任意有限阶微扰论捕获。作者希望研究这种"超越所有阶"(非微扰)的能标如何通过QBT的奇异量子几何被转换为可观测的、代数增强的物理响应。
AI.method: 对具有质量项的QBT进行解析分析，考察其量子几何(量子度规)；解析计算量子度规在动量空间的积分与光学响应；利用逆频率Souza–Wilkens–Martin光学求和规则分析负一次纵向光学矩；并在已知会在QBT处经环路电流序自发产生量子反常霍尔质量的相互作用kagome格子上进行微观验证。
AI.result: 量子度规在动量空间中出现热点，其布里渊区积分对数发散，因此当能隙由相互作用动力学产生时，该积分随能隙代数增长。通过Souza–Wilkens–Martin求和规则，同样的放大效应出现在负一次纵向光学矩中，尽管普通光电导仍为O(e^2/ℏ)、吸收阈值指数小。上述结论对质量化QBT解析成立，并在相互作用kagome格子中得到微观验证。
AI.conclusion: QBT的奇异量子几何可将非微扰的、指数小的相互作用能标放大为代数增强的可观测响应，从而把量子几何确立为非微扰相互作用尺度的"渐近放大器"。

title: Pseudo-Effectivity in the Skolem-Mahler-Lech Theorem
summary: The Skolem--Mahler--Lech Theorem asserts that a non-degenerate linear recurrence sequence (LRS) has only finitely many zeros, but is ineffective in the sense that no general procedure is known to determine them. In this paper a \emph{pseudo-effective} approach is introduced: rather than seeking effective bounds for every sequence, one obtains explicit bounds valid for all but a controlled number of sequences of bounded height, up to a natural equivalence. Such results are established for order $3$ LRS's, and extended to all higher orders subject to suitable height constraints on the characteristic roots. The underlying mechanism is a quantitative theory for exponential-polynomial equations subject to low-height multiplicative perturbations. In particular, it is shown that the finiteness phenomenon underlying the Skolem--Mahler--Lech Theorem persists under arithmetic perturbations whose height is permitted to grow linearly at a sufficiently small rate. As a further application, a moving-target finiteness result is established for linear orbits entering expanding arithmetic neighbourhoods of proper linear subspaces.

AI.tldr: 本文对Skolem–Mahler–Lech定理提出一种伪有效(pseudo-effective)方法：不追求对每个序列给出有效零点界，而是对高度有界、除受控个数外的所有序列给出显式界。结果首先对3阶线性递推序列(LRS)建立，并在特征根具适当高度限制时推广到任意高阶。其机制是低高度乘性扰动下指数多项式方程的定量理论，并证明SML有限性现象在高度以足够小线性速率增长的算术扰动下仍成立；进一步应用于线性轨道进入真线性子空间扩张算术邻域的动靶有限性结果。
AI.motivation: Skolem–Mahler–Lech定理断言非退化线性递推序列(LRS)只有有限多个零点，但该定理是非有效的：一般情形下没有已知的通用方法确定这些零点。本文试图绕开逐序列有效界的困难，转而寻找一种"伪有效"途径，在自然等价意义下、对高度有界的序列中除受控少数例外给出显式界。
AI.method: 核心技术是低高度乘性扰动下指数多项式方程的定量理论。作者借此建立：对3阶LRS给出显式界，并在特征根满足适当高度约束时推广到任意高阶；同时证明在高度以足够小的线性速率增长的算术扰动下，SML所依赖的有限性现象依然保持。
AI.result: 得到3阶LRS的伪有效显式界，并推广到满足高度约束的任意高阶情形；证明SML有限性现象在高度线性增长且速率足够小的算术扰动下持续成立；作为进一步应用，得到线性轨道进入真线性子空间扩张算术邻域的动靶(moving-target)有限性结果。
AI.conclusion: 伪有效方法为SML定理提供了一个在自然等价类下适用于绝大多数有界高度序列的显式定量框架，将研究重点从无条件的有效界转向受控例外，并借助指数多项式方程的定量扰动理论获得高阶推广与动靶有限性等应用。

title: A Structure-Preserving LOBPCG Method for Computing Several of the Largest Generalized Singular Triplets
summary: We develop a structure-preserving locally optimal block preconditioned conjugate gradient(LOBPCG) method for computing several of the largest positive generalized singular values of a matrix pair \((A, B)\), where \(B\) has full column rank, together with the associated generalized singular vectors. The method is derived from the Hermitian-definite Jordan--Wielandt pencil and therefore avoids explicitly forming the normal-equation matrices. By exploiting the block structure and spectral symmetry of this pencil, we construct separate search subspaces for the left and right generalized singular vectors. The resulting Rayleigh--Ritz procedure requires only a singular value decomposition of a small projected cross matrix. We adapt the improved Hetmaniuk--Lehoucq (IHL) trick to construct stable conjugate search directions in the two component spaces. We also establish an explicit correspondence between the coefficient matrices produced by the componentwise and augmented Rayleigh--Ritz procedures. This correspondence permits the componentwise IHL construction to be used in an augmented, structure-preserving LOBPCG formulation without explicitly assembling the augmented basis. Numerical experiments demonstrate the computational advantages of the proposed method over unstructured and Gram-matrix-based LOBPCG implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种保结构的局部最优块预条件共轭梯度（LOBPCG）方法，用于计算矩阵对 (A, B)（B 列满秩）的若干最大正广义奇异值及对应的广义奇异向量，避免了显式构造正规方程矩阵。
AI.motivation: 计算矩阵对的最大广义奇异值及广义奇异向量是重要问题，但已有方法常需显式构造正规方程矩阵，或采用非结构化的 LOBPCG 实现，导致计算代价与数值稳定性方面存在不足，亟需一种保结构且高效的方法。
AI.method: 基于 Hermitian-definite Jordan-Wielandt 束导出方法，避免显式形成正规方程矩阵；利用该束的块结构与谱对称性，为左右广义奇异向量分别构造搜索子空间；Rayleigh-Ritz 过程仅需对小型投影交叉矩阵做奇异值分解；将改进的 Hetmaniuk-Lehoucq (IHL) 技巧推广以在两个分量空间中构造稳定的共轭搜索方向；并建立分量式与增广式 Rayleigh-Ritz 过程所产生系数矩阵之间的显式对应关系，从而在无需显式组装增广基的情况下，将分量式 IHL 构造用于增广的保结构 LOBPCG 形式。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提方法相较于非结构化实现和基于 Gram 矩阵的 LOBPCG 实现在计算性能上具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 该保结构 LOBPCG 方法通过利用 Jordan-Wielandt 束的块结构与谱对称性，避免显式正规方程矩阵，并结合分量式 IHL 技巧与增广 Rayleigh-Ritz 的对应关系，实现了高效稳定的最大广义奇异值计算。

title: Notes on Magnetostatic Interactions in $\mathbb R^3$
summary: A compact formulation of magnetostatics is presented. Without using constitutive relations, including the aether relations, an expression is proposed for the potential energy of a region carrying a distribution of magnetic dipoles under a vector potential field, where the dipole distribution is specified by a current density potential field. Assuming that during a virtual motion of the dipole distribution the virtual work expended by the field is equal to minus the time derivative of the potential energy, an expression for the mechanical force functional is derived. In addition to the Lorentz and Kelvin force densities, the force functional contains an asymmetric active stress field, the skew-symmetric part of which is the mechanical couple density, and a pressure term.

AI.tldr: 本文提出磁静力学的一种紧凑表述，通过引入电流密度势场描述磁偶极子分布，在不使用本构关系（含以太关系）的前提下导出势能表达式，并基于虚功原理推导出包含洛伦兹力、开尔文力、非对称主动应力场及压力项的机械力泛函。
AI.motivation: 现有磁静力学表述通常依赖本构关系（包括以太关系）来联系场量与物质响应，这限制了对力密度的独立推导。作者希望在不依赖这些关系的情况下，直接从势能与虚功原理出发，得到更一般的机械力表达式。
AI.method: 以电流密度势场指定偶极子分布，提出载有磁偶极子分布区域在矢量势场中的势能表达式；假设偶极子分布作虚运动时场消耗的虚功等于势能的时间导数负值，据此推导机械力泛函。
AI.result: 导出的机械力泛函除包含洛伦兹力密度和开尔文力密度外，还包含一个非对称主动应力场（其反对称部分为机械力偶密度）以及一个压力项。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑表述在不引入本构关系的前提下，给出了一类包含应力与力偶效应的更一般磁静力学力泛函，为分析磁偶极子分布受力提供了新框架。

title: Discovery of a 62-min long-period transient with near-orthogonal rotator geometry
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal
summary: We report the serendipitous discovery of J155543.7$-$563102 (hereafter LPT J1555$-$5631) with a period of 62.2 min in MeerKAT and ASKAP survey data. The source emitted bright (10-30 mJy), steep-spectrum ($α\sim-1.5$), highly polarized radio pulses during a 15-hr active window in May 2022, with no other quiescent or pulsed emission detected before or after over $\sim5$ years. The mean light curve exhibits two alternating pulses per cycle. A main pulse (MP) and an interpulse (IP) separated by $Δφ=165.4^\circ$ with similar amplitudes, but different polarization properties: the wider MP (3.9\%) is partially linearly and circularly polarized and shows a constant polarization position angle, while the narrow IP (1.1\%) is $\sim$100\% circularly polarized. We classify LPT J1555$-$5631 as a near-orthogonal rotator, for which emission from both magnetic poles is visible during one rotation and the magnetic and rotation axes are almost perpendicular. The 14.6$^\circ$ deviation from an antipodal separation and the nearly constant polarization position angle suggest that the emission does not arise from the standard dipolar polar-cap geometry of ordinary pulsars, but instead originates within a broader, more complex magnetosphere. The observed properties of LPT J1555$-$5631 can be accommodated by extended emission regions, and favor coherent emission mechanisms such as the electron cyclotron maser instability, although they do not uniquely determine the progenitor or emission physics. If these inferences apply more broadly to the LPT population, they could account for why their beam widths are decoupled from rotation periods, the prevalence of flat polarization position angles, and may favor an elevated incidence of orthogonal rotators.

AI.tldr: 在MeerKAT与ASKAP巡天数据中发现周期62.2分钟的长周期射电瞬变LPT J1555−5631，其双脉冲结构与偏振特征偏离常规脉冲星偶极极冠几何，更支持扩展发射区与电子回旋脉泽不稳定性等相干辐射机制。
AI.motivation: 长周期射电瞬变（LPT）的辐射几何与发射物理尚不明确，其束宽与自转周期解耦、偏振位置角平坦等普遍特征缺乏统一解释，需通过新样本的精细偏振与脉冲形态分析加以约束。
AI.method: 利用MeerKAT和ASKAP巡天数据发现并证认LPT J1555−5631；分析其2022年5月约15小时活动窗口内的流量、谱指数与偏振特性；测量主脉冲（MP）与中间脉冲（IP）的相位间隔Δφ=165.4°、宽度、振幅及偏振性质；并与标准偶极极冠几何进行对比判据分析。
AI.result: 源在约5年内仅于15小时窗口内出现10–30 mJy、陡谱（α∼−1.5）、高偏振脉冲；平均光变曲线每周期呈两个交替脉冲，MP较宽（3.9%）、部分线偏振与圆偏振且偏振位置角恒定，IP较窄（1.1%）、近100%圆偏振，二者振幅相近；脉冲间隔偏离反极对称14.6°。
AI.conclusion: LPT J1555−5631被归类为近正交转子（磁轴与自转轴近乎垂直），双磁极发射可见；其非反极对称间隔与恒定偏振位置角表明发射不来自标准偶极极冠，而源于更宽、更复杂的磁层结构，可由扩展发射区解释，并倾向电子回旋脉泽不稳定性等相干辐射机制。若该解释适用于LPT群体，可解释束宽与周期解耦、平坦偏振位置角普遍存在及正交转子比例偏高等现象，但尚不能唯一确定其前身星与发射物理。

title: On Representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathrm{D})$ admitting a generalized linear period
summary: Let $\mathrm{D}$ be a quaternion division algebra over a non-Archimedean local field $\mathrm{F}$ of characteristic zero, and let $\mathrm{G}_n=\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathrm{D})$. Let $\mathrm{H}_{1,n-1}=\{\mathrm{diag}(g_1,g_2)\in\mathrm{G}_1,\ g_2\in\mathrm{G}_{n-1}\}$ and, for $s \in \mathbb{R}$, define $χ_s(\mathrm{diag}(g_1,g_2))=ν(g_1)^{2s}ν(g_2)^{-2s}$. We classify, for $n=3,4$, the irreducible smooth representations of $\mathrm{G}_n$ admitting a generalized linear period with respect to $(\mathrm{H}_{1,n-1},χ_s)$. Motivated by these results, we conjecture a complete classification for all $n>2$. Assuming this conjecture, we characterize such representations in terms of Langlands parameters: an irreducible smooth representation $π$ of $\mathrm{G}_n$ admits such a period if and only if $\mathfrak{L}(π)$ contains a Weil-Deligne subrepresentation isomorphic to $\mathfrak{L}(ν^{-2s})$, the $(2n-4)$-dimensional parameter of $ν^{-2s}$ on $\mathrm{G}_{n-2}$, and the four-dimensional quotient is the Langlands parameter of either the trivial representation of $\mathrm{G}_2$, with $s=\pm\frac{n-2}{2}$, or an irreducible infinite-dimensional $\mathrm{H}_{1,1}$-distinguished representation of $\mathrm{G}_2$. We also verify the Lapid-Prasad conjecture in this setting: the $L$-packet of an irreducible representation of $\mathrm{G}_n$ admitting a linear period with respect to $\mathrm{H}_{1,n-1}$ is invariant under $ρ\mapsto\widetildeρ^θ$.

AI.tldr: 对四元数除代数上 GL_n(D)（n=3,4）关于 (H_{1,n-1},χ_s) 的广义线性周期表示进行分类，猜想并（在猜想下）用 Langlands 参数刻画，同时验证 Lapid-Prasad 猜想。
AI.motivation: 研究非交换除法代数上一般线性群上由子群 H_{1,n-1} 与特征 χ_s 定义的广义线性周期（线性周期的推广），这是自守表示相对迹公式与周期积分理论的核心问题之一，并希望将其与 Langlands 参数、端表示及 L-包结构联系起来。
AI.method: 设 D 为特征零非阿基米德局部域 F 上的四元数除代数，G_n=GL_n(D)，取 H_{1,n-1}=diag(g_1,g_2)，定义 χ_s=ν(g_1)^{2s}ν(g_2)^{-2s}。对 n=3,4 直接分类承认关于 (H_{1,n-1},χ_s) 的广义线性周期的不可约光滑表示；以此为基础对 n>2 提出完整分类猜想，并在假设猜想成立的前提下，用 Langlands 参数中的 Weil-Deligne 子表示条件刻画这些表示。
AI.result: n=3,4 时完成分类；由此猜想 n>2 的完整分类。在猜想下一不可约光滑表示 π 承认该周期当且仅当 L(π) 含有同构于 L(ν^{-2s})（即 G_{n-2} 上 ν^{-2s} 的 2n-4 维参数）的 Weil-Deligne 子表示，且四维商分别为 G_2 平凡表示的 Langlands 参数（此时 s=±(n-2)/2），或 G_2 的一个无穷维不可约 H_{1,1}-端表示。此外验证了 Lapid-Prasad 猜想：承认关于 H_{1,n-1} 的线性周期的不可约表示的 L-包在 ρ↦ρ̃^θ 下不变。
AI.conclusion: 给出了除法代数上广义线性周期表示的显式刻画，将其归约为 Langlands 参数中的 ν^{-2s} 子表示与四维商的条件，并由此确认该情形下 Lapid-Prasad 猜想的 L-包不变性。

title: Obtaining Game-Stationary Points for Smooth Nonconvex-Nonconcave Minimax Problems via First-Order Methods
summary: Minimax optimization is a fundamental framework in machine learning, robust optimization, and game theory, yet finding first-order stationary points of general nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems remains challenging without additional structural assumptions. Existing guarantees often rely on global PL- or KL-type conditions that connect max-player stationarity to global inner optimality, or on Minty-type conditions that impose a global relation on the game gradient field relative to a reference solution; local KL variants relax the former requirement but typically require initialization and tracking within a near-optimal region. Such conditions may be difficult to satisfy in many applications. In contrast, we develop a first-order method that finds an $ε$-stationary point within $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ first-order iterations under a local inverse-Lipschitz regularity condition around approximate max-player stationary points, together with a compactness condition on a penalty sublevel set. Our condition places no optimality requirement on stationary points of the inner maximization problem: they need not be globally, or even locally, maximizing. We further provide sufficient conditions for the required regularity. In the unconstrained setting, it follows from uniform nonsingularity of the maximization-variable Hessian near stationary points; for constrained upper Moreau envelopes, it follows from standard KKT regularity conditions. These results establish first-order complexity guarantees for classes of nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems not covered by the above PL-, KL-, or Minty-type frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文在局部逆Lipschitz正则与罚函数下水平集紧致条件下，提出一阶方法，可在Õ(ε⁻²)次一阶迭代内找到非凸-非凹极小极大问题的ε-稳定点，且不要求内层极大化问题稳定点具有最优性。
AI.motivation: 一般非凸-非凹极小极大问题求一阶稳定点很困难。现有保证依赖全局PL/KL型条件（要求max-player稳定性与全局内层最优性挂钩）、Minty型条件（对博弈梯度场施加全局关系）或局部KL变体（需在近优区域内初始化和跟踪），这些条件在很多应用中难以满足。
AI.method: 提出一种一阶方法，在近似max-player稳定点附近的局部逆Lipschitz正则性条件，以及罚函数下水平集的紧致性条件下分析其收敛性；并给出该正则性的充分条件：无约束情形由极大化变量Hessian在稳定点附近的一致非奇异性导出，约束上Moreau包络情形由标准KKT正则条件导出。
AI.result: 在Õ(ε⁻²)次一阶迭代内找到ε-稳定点；条件不要求内层极大化问题的稳定点是全局甚至局部极大点，从而覆盖PL、KL、Minty型框架未涵盖的一类非凸-非凹极小极大问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为更广泛的一类非凸-非凹极小极大问题建立了首阶复杂度保证，放松了对内层最优性和全局结构的假设。

title: Inertia-Corrected Newton Method For Generalized Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games with Optimality Verification
summary:
Newton methods efficiently find Generalized Nash Equilibria (GNE) in dynamic games by solving for the KKT necessary conditions. These methods are fast and can support multi-agent Model Predictive Control (MPC) for highly dynamic robots. However, a small KKT residual alone does not certify that the returned solution satisfies the second-order sufficient conditions for a local GNE.
  In this paper, we propose an efficient numerical method to verify the second-order sufficient conditions (SOSC) for a local GNE. We connect the inertia of the agent KKT matrix with the positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian of the cost function, projected onto the null space of the constraints. Furthermore, we introduce an inertia-corrected update step that improves convergence to local GNEs by destabilizing strict saddle points with weak cross-agent coupling.
  Our main contribution is a fast Newton solver for Constrained Dynamic Games that provides efficient optimality checking. Through numerical benchmarks, we demonstrate the proposed solver's runtime and convergence performance in practical multi-agent planning problems. We also validate the solver's real-time capabilities in physical experiments using a platform of miniature autonomous race cars.

AI.tldr: 提出一种快速牛顿求解器，用于约束动态博弈，通过关联KKT矩阵惯性与约化Hessian正定性来高效验证局部GNE的二阶充分条件，并引入惯性校正更新步，经数值基准与微型赛车实车实验验证其实时性。
AI.motivation: 牛顿法求解动态博弈的GNE速度快，可支撑高动态机器人的多智能体MPC，但KKT残差小并不能证明解满足局部GNE的二阶充分条件（SOSC），因此需要高效的最优性验证手段。
AI.method: 将智能体KKT矩阵的惯性（惯量特征）与代价函数约化Hessian在约束零空间投影上的正定性建立联系；引入惯性校正（inertia-corrected）更新步，通过 destabilizing 弱跨智能体耦合下的严格鞍点来改善局部GNE的收敛。
AI.result: 数值基准实验展示了所提求解器在实际多智能体规划问题中的运行时间与收敛性能；并在微型自主赛车平台上通过物理实验验证了其实时能力。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一个面向约束动态博弈的快速牛顿求解器，可高效进行最优性检查，兼顾收敛性与实时性，适用于多智能体规划与实车场景。

title: t-J model at 50
summary: I briefly overview the original formulation of the t-J model starting from Hubbard model, as well as stress its unique features, i.e., advantages and shortcomings when discussing its physical properties. Particular emphasis is put on a brief characterization of connection between magnetism, unconventional superconductivity, and the Mott-Hubbard localization of the correlated carriers in a narrow band. In the second part I summarize the model generalization to the three--orbital situation. The main purpose is to list some basic features of the physics associated with t--J model.

AI.tldr: 该文概述了t-J模型的原始推导（源于Hubbard模型）及其在窄带关联载流子系统中磁性与非常规超导电性、Mott-Hubbard局域化之间关系的核心物理，并总结了向三轨道情形的推广。
AI.motivation: 阐明t-J模型的来龙去脉，明确其相对于Hubbard模型的独特优势与不足，以厘清讨论其物理性质时的适用边界与理论定位。同时，将模型从单带推广至三轨道情形，以对应多轨道关联体系的物理背景。
AI.method: 从Hubbard模型出发推导t-J模型，梳理其基本特征；重点刻画窄带中关联载流子的磁性、非常规超导电性与Mott-Hubbard局域化之间的联系；进一步给出模型在三轨道情形下的推广形式与基本物理特征。
AI.result: 给出了t-J模型的原始构建逻辑与优缺点评述，明确了磁性、非常规超导电性与Mott-Hubbard局域化三者的关联刻画，并列出三轨道推广情形下的若干基本物理特征。
AI.conclusion: t-J模型是描述窄带关联电子体系（含磁性、非常规超导电性与Mott-Hubbard局域化）的重要有效模型；其单带形式与三轨道推广形式共同构成理解相关物理的框架。

title: Skew cyclic codes through Drinfeld modules
summary: We construct skew cyclic codes in the rank metric from the torsion of the supersingular Drinfeld module $φ_T=t+τ^n$ over $\mathbb{F}_{q^r}$, where $t$ is a root of a monic irreducible $\mathfrak{p}_0\in\mathbb{F}_q[T]$ of degree $r$ coprime to $n$. For every prime $\mathfrak{p}\neq\mathfrak{p}_0$ of degree $d$ and every divisor $m$ of $n$, the torsion $φ[\mathfrak{p}]$ is a free module over the subring $R_0=κ[π^m]$ generated by a power of the Frobenius $π=τ^r$, $κ=\mathbb{F}_q[T]/\mathfrak{p}$, and the codes are the left ideals of the centralizer $R\cong\mathrm{Mat}_m(R_0)$ of $R_0$. We prove a lattice anti-isomorphism between codes and $R_0$-submodules of $φ[\mathfrak{p}]$, and a rank-BCH bound whose designed distance is the true distance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超奇异Drinfeld模$\phi_T=t+\tau^n$的挠元构造了秩度量下的斜循环码，证明了码与挠子模之间的格反同构，并给出设计距离等于真实距离的秩-BCH界。
AI.motivation: 在秩度量框架下构造具有良好距离性质的代数码，并借助Drinfeld模的挠结构为斜循环码提供新的代数来源与界估计工具。
AI.method: 取$\mathbb{F}_{q^r}$上超奇异Drinfeld模$\phi_T=t+\tau^n$，$t$为$\mathbb{F}_q[T]$中次数$r$且与$n$互素的单项不可约$\mathfrak{p}_0$的根。对每个次数$d$的素理想$\mathfrak{p}\neq\mathfrak{p}_0$及$n$的因子$m$，挠$\phi[\mathfrak{p}]$是子环$R_0=\kappa[\pi^m]$上的自由模，其中$\pi=\tau^r$，$\kappa=\mathbb{F}_q[T]/\mathfrak{p}$。码定义为$R_0$的中心化子$R\cong\mathrm{Mat}_m(R_0)$的左理想。
AI.result: 建立了码与$\phi[\mathfrak{p}]$的$R_0$-子模之间的格反同构，并证明了秩-BCH界，其设计距离等于真实距离。
AI.conclusion: 该构造将超奇异Drinfeld模挠与斜循环码的秩度量理论相联，所得秩-BCH界是紧的（设计距离即真实距离），为秩度量码提供了新的代数构造途径。

title: Spectral Reality for Certain Fourth-Order Nonsymmetric Finite-Difference Laplacians
summary: Finite-difference discretizations of Laplace operators yield discrete Laplacians whose spectral properties are closely tied to the stability, convergence, and physical fidelity of numerical solvers. While symmetric discretizations are well understood, many high-order finite-difference schemes produce nonsymmetric matrices for which rigorous spectral analysis is overlooked. Surprisingly, we prove that two fourth-order schemes with Dirichlet boundary conditions yield nonsymmetric discrete Laplacians whose spectra are purely real and strictly positive. Computer-assisted computations show that this property does not hold for higher-order extensions of these schemes in general.

AI.tldr: 本文证明两种四阶有限差分格式（Dirichlet边界）产生的非对称离散Laplacian具有纯实且严格正的特征值，并借助计算机辅助计算表明该性质对更高阶格式一般不成立。
AI.motivation: 对称离散格式的谱性质已被充分理解，但许多高阶有限差分格式会产生非对称矩阵，其严格的谱分析长期被忽视。然而离散Laplacian的谱性质直接关系到数值求解器的稳定性、收敛性与物理保真度，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对带Dirichlet边界条件的两种四阶有限差分格式，对其产生的非对称离散Laplacian进行严格谱分析（理论证明），并结合计算机辅助计算考察这些格式在更高阶推广下的谱性质。
AI.result: 证明这两种四阶格式所对应的非对称离散Laplacian的谱为纯实且严格正；计算机辅助计算显示，对于这些格式的更高阶推广，该性质一般不成立。
AI.conclusion: 非对称高阶离散Laplacian同样可能具备良好的实正谱，但这一优良性质并非在高阶推广中普遍保持，提示高阶格式的谱分析需要个案严格处理。

title: A renormalized Lee Model: resolvent and spectral analysis
summary: We construct and analyze a renormalized three-dimensional massive Lee model; its renormalized Hamiltonian is defined intrinsically through an abstract construction which explicitly provides the operator domain, action and a Kre\uın-like resolvent formula. Conservation of the total excitation number reduces the spectral analysis of the full Hamiltonian to a sector-wise study of the spectral profile of an explicit operator pencil, playing the role of an operator-valued Weyl function. We construct essential spectrum components in a sector generated by lower excitation sectors and obtain the inclusion in the expected sector-wise HVZ type formula; the full formula is proved in the first two sectors and, under explicit conditions, in every sector. Below the free or one-excitation threshold, the point spectrum in every higher sector is described by a bounded self-adjoint nonnegative Birman--Schwinger operator. In every sector with at least two excitations we prove absence of sub-threshold spectrum for arbitrary coupling when the renormalized gap is not smaller than the boson mass, and under an explicit weak-coupling condition when it is smaller. In the latter case we also derive a sufficient condition for the existence of a simple bound state in the two-excitation sector.

AI.tldr: 构建并分析了重整化三维大质量Lee模型，其重整化哈密顿量通过抽象构造内在定义（给出算子域、作用及Krein型预解公式）；利用总激发数守恒将谱分析约化为显式算子束（算子值Weyl函数）的分区谱研究，证明前两个扇区的HVZ型公式并在一定条件下推广至所有扇区，刻画了阈下谱与束缚态存在性。
AI.motivation: 三维Lee模型的重整化构造通常依赖截断等非内在方式，且其谱结构（连续谱位置、阈下束缚态）缺乏严格的算子论刻画。本文旨在给出一个完全内在的重整化哈密顿量定义，并系统研究其谱性质，特别是分区HVZ型公式与阈下谱的判定。
AI.method: 通过抽象构造内在定义重整化哈密顿量：给出算子域、作用及Krein型预解公式。利用总激发数守恒，将全哈密顿量的谱分析约化为对显式算子束（充当算子值Weyl函数）的逐扇区谱刻画。据此构造由低激发扇区生成的本质谱分量，并证明扇区式HVZ型公式。借助有界自伴非负Birman-Schwinger算子刻画阈下点谱，分情形（重整化间隙与玻色子质量比较）证明阈下谱的不存在性。
AI.result: 得到由低激发扇区生成的本质谱分量，并证明其属于预期的扇区式HVZ型公式；该完整公式在前两个扇区成立，并在显式条件下对每个扇区成立。在自由阈值或单激发阈值之下，每个高扇区的点谱由有界自伴非负Birman-Schwinger算子描述。在每个至少含两个激发的扇区中：当重整化间隙不小于玻色子质量时，对任意耦合证明阈下谱不存在；当间隙较小时，在显式弱耦合条件下同样证明不存在。在后者情形还给出二激发扇区存在单束缚态的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为三维大质量Lee模型提供了内在的重整化框架与完整的逐扇区谱分析，建立了HVZ型公式的适用范围及阈下谱的判定准则，并给出弱耦合下二激发扇区单束缚态存在的充分条件。

title: Comment on "Fermi-LAT Galactic Center Excess Morphology of Dark Matter in Simulations of the Milky Way Galaxy"
summary: Muru et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 161005 (2025)] conclude from the HESTIA constrained simulations that the $γ$-ray morphologies of the Galactic Center Excess predicted by dark matter annihilation and by an old stellar population are essentially indistinguishable. Their "quadratic dark matter" maps, however, show the square of the mass projected along the line of sight, $\bigl[\intρ\,s^{2}\,ds\bigr]^{2}$, rather than the annihilation integral $\intρ^{2}\,ds$. Squaring a nonnegative map preserves its isophote shapes at corresponding intensity levels, as confirmed by the reported contour axis ratios. The corrected calculation on the same simulations does not support their conclusion.

AI.tldr: 质疑Muru等（PRL 135, 161005 (2025)）关于银河系中心过剩γ射线形态无法区分暗物质湮灭与老年恒星族结论的评论。
AI.motivation: Muru等人基于HESTIA约束模拟，认为暗物质湮灭与老年恒星族产生的银河系中心过剩（GCE）γ射线形态基本不可区分。但作者注意到其"二次暗物质"图的构建方式可能存在问题，需要核实其结论是否成立。
AI.method: 指出Muru等人所绘制的"二次暗物质"图实际展示的是沿视线方向质量投影的平方：[∫ρ s² ds]²，而非湮灭积分∫ρ² ds。论证对非负图取平方会保持其等照度线形状在对应强度水平上不变，并以文中报道的等值线轴比作为佐证。
AI.result: 由于平方操作保持等照度线形状不变，Muru等人报告的等值线轴比无法区分两种情形。基于同一批模拟进行修正计算后，结果并不支持他们关于两种形态不可区分的结论。
AI.conclusion: Muru等人的结论源于对湮灭积分图的错误构造（将质量投影平方误作湮灭积分），修正后其结论不成立。

title: Bounded functor cohomology and comparison theorem
summary: Let $k$ be a finite field. We consider the category of all functors $\mathcal{F}_n$ from the category of $k$-vector spaces of dimension $\leq n$ into the category of all $k$-vector spaces. We compare its derived category to the derived category of representations of the general linear group $GL_n(k)$ using the extension by zero functor procedure. We upgrade the well-known recollement of abelian categories into the recollement of the corresponding derived categories. Then we obtain some translations of the cohomology the general linear group over finite field. We also compare $\mathcal{F}_n$ with the category of polynomial functors $\mathcal{P}_{d,n}$, giving further reformulations over big finite fields.

AI.tldr: 本文将有限域上低维向量空间函子范畴 $\mathcal{F}_n$ 的导出范畴与 $GL_n(k)$ 表示导出范畴进行比较，利用零延拓函子把已知的 Abel 范畴 recollement 提升为导出范畴的 recollement，并据此得到有限域上一般线性群上同调的转换与多项式函子 $\mathcal{P}_{d,n}$ 的重新表述。
AI.motivation: 研究对象是有限域 $k$ 上维数不超过 $n$ 的 $k$-向量空间范畴到 $k$-向量空间范畴的函子范畴 $\mathcal{F}_n$。作者希望将其导出范畴与一般线性群 $GL_n(k)$ 表示的导出范畴建立联系，从而用函子范畴的视角来理解 $GL_n(k)$ 的上同调，并进一步与多项式函子范畴 $\mathcal{P}_{d,n}$ 对接。
AI.method: 采用零延拓函子（extension by zero functor）构造两个导出范畴之间的比较；将已有的 Abel 范畴 recollement 升级为相应导出范畴的 recollement；并在此基础上讨论 $\mathcal{F}_n$ 与多项式函子范畴 $\mathcal{P}_{d,n}$ 的关系。
AI.result: 作者成功把 Abel 范畴的 recollement 提升到导出范畴层面，得到 $\mathcal{F}_n$ 导出范畴与 $GL_n(k)$ 表示导出范畴之间的 recollement；由此获得了有限域上一般线性群上同调的一些转换（translations）；同时将 $\mathcal{F}_n$ 与多项式函子范畴 $\mathcal{P}_{d,n}$ 进行比较，并在大有限域情形给出进一步重新表述。
AI.conclusion: 函子范畴 $\mathcal{F}_n$ 的导出范畴可作为研究 $GL_n(k)$ 表示与上同调的有效工具；导出范畴层面的 recollement 提供了两者之间的系统对应，并通过与多项式函子范畴的联系推广到大有限域情形。

title: Optimal Parameter-Free Second-order Acceleration with Inexact Hessians under Generalized Smoothness
summary: We study second-order convex optimization under generalized Hessian smoothness, where the local Hessian Lipschitz constant may grow linearly with the gradient norm. For inexact Hessians, we develop adaptive algorithms, including an accelerated Monteiro-Svaiter-type method whose complexity matches the lower bound for second-order methods with $δ$-inexact Hessians in the classical Lipschitz-Hessian setting. Our methods are parameter-free in the sense that they require no problem-specific parameters as input, including the Hessian inexactness level $δ$ and smoothness constants. Instead, their backtracking adapts a single regularization parameter that jointly captures Hessian inexactness and local Hessian smoothness. The resulting rates split into two regimes. Far from the solution, the gradient-dependent smoothness term yields geometric convergence. Near the solution, the rate is governed by the ordinary Hessian smoothness and the inexactness level $δ$, recovering the classical Lipschitz-Hessian guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义Hessian光滑性下的二阶凸优化，提出参数自适应的非精确Hessian算法（含加速Monteiro-Svaiter型方法），复杂度在经典Lipschitz-Hessian设定下达到下界，且无需问题相关参数。
AI.motivation: 经典二阶优化通常假设Hessian Lipschitz连续，但实际中局部Hessian Lipschitz常数可能随梯度范数线性增长，且Hessian往往只能非精确获取。现有方法通常依赖问题相关参数（如非精确度δ和光滑常数），难以实用。因此需要在广义Hessian光滑性与非精确Hessian条件下，设计无需参数、性能最优的自适应算法。
AI.method: 在广义Hessian光滑性（局部Hessian Lipschitz常数随梯度范数线性增长）假设下，针对非精确Hessian设计自适应算法；核心是加速Monteiro-Svaiter型方法，并采用回溯机制，通过调节单一正则化参数同时刻画Hessian非精确性与局部Hessian光滑性，从而实现无需问题特定参数的参数自由（parameter-free）算法。
AI.result: 所提方法的复杂度在经典Lipschitz-Hessian设定下与带δ-非精确Hessian二阶方法的下界相匹配；收敛速率呈现两阶段：远离解时由梯度相关光滑项主导，呈几何收敛；接近解时由普通Hessian光滑性与非精确度δ主导，恢复经典Lipschitz-Hessian保证；算法无需输入δ及光滑常数等参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将二阶凸优化的分析从经典Hessian Lipschitz假设推广到广义Hessian光滑性，并同时处理非精确Hessian；所提出的参数自由自适应（加速）方法在理论上达到最优复杂度，且在解附近退化为经典保证，兼具理论最优性与实用性。

title: Low Cost Eye Tracking for Vision Screening
summary: This engineering study assesses gaze-assisted data acquisition during visual screening with a Gaze Quest implementation via webcam and GC308 near infrared camera with an Orlosky eye tracking pipeline. Ten subjects performed under both acquisition conditions. Accuracy of Tumbling E orientation, reported application logMAR value,and response latency were determined from keyboard responses and hence are behavioral outputs as opposed toeye tracker screening results. Frame-to-frame change in theangle between successive normalized gaze vectors (28.2degrees) served as the GC308 eye tracker derived diagnostic with an effective sampling rate of roughly 8 FPS. No screen target calibration or gaze to screen translation was done on the GC308 eye tracker output data for the current analysis and hence, these data represent acquisition stability and not gaze accuracy in relation to the target. The webcam pipeline relied on 25-point screen calibration. Because the display resolution and pixel pitch could not be retained in the records of the study, the reported application logMAR values cannot be viewed as measures of visual acuity in any way.

AI.tldr: 该工程研究评估了在视觉筛查中基于注视辅助的数据采集，比较了网络摄像头与GC308近红外摄像头两种条件，但所报告指标为行为输出及采集稳定性，而非真正的注视精度或视力测量。
AI.motivation: 评估在视觉筛查任务中引入注视辅助数据采集的可行性，并比较网络摄像头与GC308近红外摄像头两种采集条件下的表现。
AI.method: 10名被试在两种采集条件下完成Gaze Quest视觉筛查任务。行为指标（Tumbling E方向正确性、应用记录的logMAR值、反应潜伏时间）由键盘反应确定。GC308眼动数据采用Orlosky眼动追踪流程，以相邻归一化注视向量间夹角的逐帧变化（28.2度）作为诊断指标，有效采样率约8 FPS，未进行屏幕目标校准或注视到屏幕的映射。网络摄像头流程采用25点屏幕校准。
AI.result: GC308的有效采样率约为8 FPS，相邻归一化注视向量夹角的逐帧变化为28.2度。行为层面的Tumbling E方向正确性、应用logMAR值与反应潜伏时间均来自键盘反应。
AI.conclusion: GC308数据反映的是采集稳定性而非相对目标的注视精度；由于显示分辨率和像素间距未能保留，所报告的应用logMAR值不能视为视力测量结果。该研究更多是工程层面的可行性评估，方法学上限制明显。

title: Chiral Weyl--Kondo semimetal and circular photogalvanic effect in a prototype Kondo lattice system
summary: Chiral Weyl--Kondo semimetals (cWKSM) provide a setting in which chiral Weyl quasiparticles emerge in the immediate vicinity of the Fermi energy from a Kondo-driven reconstruction of the strongly correlated electronic states in chiral heavy fermion systems (K.-S. Lin et al., arXiv:2602.22185). A defining characteristic of this strongly correlated topological state is the Kramers chiral Weyl fermions in the low-energy quasiparticle states. Recently, experiments in CeGaGe have emerged as a concrete realization of the proposed effect (Arushi et al., preprint). Motivated by these findings, here we go beyond the materials-specific effects by constructing a prototype Kondo lattice model; it incorporates only the essential couplings that respect the associated tetragonal crystalline symmetries. This simplification allows us to robustly demonstrate the symmetry-enforced Kramers Weyl fermions and related topological nodal states in the spectrum of heavy quasiparticles. Furthermore, the simplification provides a tractable setting to determine the salient features in the system's nonlinear optical response, the circular photogalvanic effect, in chiral Weyl--Kondo semimetals. Both analytical and numerical calculations identify sharp peaks in the frequency domain as signatures of the Kondo-driven chiral Weyl nodes; the sharpness of the spectrum reflects the resonant nature of the underlying strongly correlated electronic excitations. Thus, cWKSM provides a unique setting to spectroscopically identify topological fermions that are induced by strong electron correlations. As such, our results are expected to bring about much needed new insights into the understanding of strongly correlated gapless topological matter.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了仅保留四方晶格对称性所需耦合的Kondo晶格原型模型，稳健地展示了强关联重准粒子谱中的对称性强制Kramers外尔费米子及拓扑节线态，并预测圆偏振光电效应中的尖锐共振峰可作为Kondo驱动手性外尔节点的谱学特征。
AI.motivation: 手性重费米子体系中Kondo驱动电子态重构可在费米能级附近产生手性外尔准粒子（cWKSM），且CeGaGe实验已初步实现该效应。然而既有研究多依赖具体材料细节，缺乏能够稳健揭示对称性强制拓扑费米子及其非线性光学响应的一般性模型，因此需要超越材料特异性效应进行原型化研究。
AI.method: 构建原型Kondo晶格模型，仅纳入尊重四方晶体对称性的本质耦合，以简化处理并稳健展示重准粒子谱中的对称性强制Kramers外尔费米子与相关拓扑节线态；在此基础上，结合解析与数值计算求解该体系的非线性光学响应——圆偏振光电效应（circular photogalvanic effect）。
AI.result: 解析与数值计算一致地在频率域中识别出尖锐峰值，将其确认为Kondo驱动手性外尔节点的特征信号；该谱的尖锐性反映了底层强关联电子激发的共振本质。
AI.conclusion: cWKSM为谱学识别由强电子关联诱导的拓扑费米子提供了独特平台，研究结果有望为强关联无能隙拓扑物质的理解带来新的认识。

title: Adelic reduction of module lattices
summary: We give a strict generalization of the LLL algorithm over number fields, based on the reduction theory of $\GL(n)$ over the adele ring of a number field. Our algorithm is free of heuristics, with rigorous bounds on output quality and complexity. As a consequence, we obtain a hierarchy of reductions from module-(H)SVP to ideal-HSVP, an example of which has runtime and approximation factors subexponential in the field degree. More importantly, we uncover a close connection between structured lattice reduction and a Diophantine approximation over number fields.

AI.tldr: 该文基于数域adele环上GL(n)的约化理论，给出LLL算法在数域上的严格推广，无启发式、具严格输出质量与复杂度界，并由此建立从module-(H)SVP到ideal-HSVP的归约层级及与数域Diophantine逼近的联系。
AI.motivation: 经典LLL算法及其在数域/结构化格上的推广常依赖启发式假设或缺乏严格界；作者希望在数域框架下获得无启发式、可证明质量与复杂度保证的约化算法，并借此理解结构化格困难问题（module-SVP、ideal-SVP等）之间的关系。
AI.method: 以数域adele环上GL(n)的约化理论为基础，构造LLL算法在数域的严格推广；随后利用该算法建立从module-(H)SVP到ideal-HSVP的归约层级，并将结构化格约化与数域上的Diophantine逼近建立联系。
AI.result: 算法无需启发式假设，输出质量与复杂度均有严格界；得到从module-(H)SVP到ideal-HSVP的一系列归约，其中一个实例的运行时间与逼近因子在域次数上呈subexponential；同时揭示了结构化格约化与数域Diophantine逼近的密切联系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为结构化格约化提供了严格理论工具，说明module-(H)SVP可由ideal-HSVP归约求解（部分情形达subexponential性能），并开辟了用Diophantine逼近视角研究结构化格困难问题的新方向。

title: Fast Differentiable SVD on GPU via Polar Decomposition
summary: We present a fully GPU-oriented SVD pipeline based on polar decomposition, motivated by iterative methods that rely solely on matrix multiplications, such as the Newton-Schulz iteration. We show that this approach enables up to a $2\times$ speedup compared to standard implementations. Furthermore, we derive a numerically stable backward pass for the polar decomposition and leverage it to obtain a fully differentiable SVD. Our methods are released as open-source implementations in both PyTorch and JAX: https://github.com/fallnlove/cans_svd.

AI.tldr: 提出基于极分解的纯GPU导向SVD流水线，利用仅需矩阵乘法的迭代法（如Newton-Schulz），实现最高2倍加速，并推导数值稳定的反向传播以获得完全可微SVD，已开源PyTorch与JAX实现。
AI.motivation: 标准SVD实现难以充分利用GPU并行能力，需借助以矩阵乘法为核心的迭代方法提升计算效率与可微性。
AI.method: 基于极分解构建SVD流水线，采用仅依赖矩阵乘法的迭代法（Newton-Schulz迭代），并推导极分解的数值稳定反向传播，从而获得完全可微的SVD。
AI.result: 相比标准实现最高获得2倍加速；实现了数值稳定的可微SVD。
AI.conclusion: 该GPU导向极分解SVD方案在性能与可微性上均有优势，并已作为开源实现发布于PyTorch和JAX。

title: GR-FM: Geometrically Regularized Flow Matching for SDF-Based Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in terms of accurate boundary localization and complex-structure preservation, as target regions often exhibit weak boundaries, fine-grained structures, and irregular shapes, while high-quality images and precise annotations are usually limited. Existing generative segmentation approaches based on Flow Matching mainly learn velocity fields in the state space but lack explicit constraints on the spatial regularity and distance-field properties of the recovered representation. This limitation may lead to spatial oscillations, boundary displacement, and discontinuities in fine structures. To address these issues, we propose an image-conditioned Geometrically Regularized Flow Matching framework, termed GR-FM, which formulates segmentation as a continuous probability transport process from an initial distribution to a target implicit representation distribution. Instead of directly modeling binary masks, GR-FM adopts the SDF to describe the target structure, where each pixel is represented by its signed distance to the object boundary, resulting in a continuous geometric field. Flow Matching and ordinary differential equations are then employed to achieve deterministic and efficient distribution transport. The training objective further incorporates a biharmonic regularization term and an Eikonal constraint to enhance the spatial smoothness, structural consistency, and distance-field characteristics of the recovered representation. Moreover, we analyze the continuous transport process under geometric constraints and investigate the evolution of the zero level set. Experiments conducted on the MoNuSeg, GlaS, and DRIVE datasets demonstrate that GR-FM achieves competitive performance in both region overlap and boundary accuracy, reduces performance variation, and maintains stable segmentation results with only a small number of integration steps.

AI.tldr: 提出图像条件几何正则化流匹配框架GR-FM，用SDF描述目标结构并引入双调和正则项与Eikonal约束，实现连续概率传输的医学图像分割，在MoNuSeg、GlaS、DRIVE上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割在边界定位和复杂结构保持方面仍有挑战：目标区域常呈弱边界、细粒度结构和不规则形状，且高质量图像与精确标注通常有限。现有基于Flow Matching的生成式分割方法主要在状态空间学习速度场，缺乏对恢复表示的空间规律性与距离场性质的显式约束，可能导致空间振荡、边界位移及细结构不连续。
AI.method: 提出图像条件几何正则化流匹配框架（GR-FM），将分割建模为从初始分布到目标隐式表示分布的连续概率传输过程。不直接建模二值掩码，而采用SDF描述目标结构，每个像素由其到目标边界的符号距离表示，形成连续几何场；使用Flow Matching与常微分方程实现确定且高效的分布传输。训练目标引入双调和正则项与Eikonal约束，增强恢复表示的空间平滑性、结构一致性与距离场特性。此外，分析几何约束下的连续传输过程，研究零水平集的演化。
AI.result: 在MoNuSeg、GlaS和DRIVE数据集上的实验表明，GR-FM在区域重叠度和边界精度上均取得有竞争力的性能，降低了性能波动，并且仅需少量积分步数即可维持稳定的分割结果。
AI.conclusion: GR-FM通过将分割形式化为SDF空间中的几何正则化流匹配过程，显式约束空间平滑性与距离场性质，缓解了边界位移与细结构不连续等问题，兼顾精度、稳定性与计算效率。

title: Gravitational Waves from Core-Collapse Supernovae: Dependence on the Progenitor Star, Rotation Rate and Nuclear Equation of State
summary: We simulate 137 axisymmetric core-collapse supernova explosions to systematically investigate the impact of different progenitor properties, rotation rates, and equations of state on the supernova gravitational-wave emission.
