We use 15 different progenitor stars, with masses ranging from $9.71\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ to $36.61\,\mathrm{M}_{\odot}$, three equations of state, and three rotation rates, with durations extending up to 5.5\,s after bounce. We find substantial differences in the gravitational-wave emission between equations of state, with the CMF equation of state producing lower gravitational-wave amplitudes and a longer low frequency mode due to the standing accretion shock instability that remains visible even at $\sim5$\,s post bounce. Rapid rotation also significantly alters the gravitational-wave signal, with more visible modes in the gravitational-wave emission, and lower energies due to later shock revival times. We include the gravitational-wave emission due to neutrino memory, and show it can significantly improve the detectability of core-collapse supernovae for observatories with improved low frequency sensitivity. We propose a recalibration of universal relations for the high frequency mode, using fits to our waveforms, that reduces the fit error at late times in the gravitational-wave signal. Finally, we investigate, for the first time, the impact of random seed perturbations on the gravitational-wave emission. We find that stochastic perturbations can produce dramatic variations in gravitational-wave amplitude, and can alter the signal-to-noise ratio of a detection by as much as 62\% for models close to the boundary between failed and successful shock revival.

AI.tldr: 本研究模拟了137个轴对称核坍缩超新星爆发，系统考察前身星性质、自转速率和状态方程对引力波辐射的影响，并首次研究了随机种子扰动的作用。
AI.motivation: 系统理解前身星性质、自转速率和状态方程如何影响核坍缩超新星的引力波辐射，并评估随机扰动对引力波信号可探测性的影响。
AI.method: 采用137个轴对称核坍缩超新星模拟，使用15颗不同质量（9.71–36.61 M☉）的前身星、3种状态方程和3种自转速率，模拟时长延续至反弹后5.5秒；引入中微子记忆引力波辐射，并对高频模式通用关系进行重新标定。
AI.result: 不同状态方程间引力波辐射差异显著，CMF状态方程产生较低振幅和更长低频模式（源于驻激波吸积不稳定性，在反弹后约5秒仍可见）；快速自转改变信号，出现更多模式并因激波复活较晚使能量降低；中微子记忆可显著提升低频敏感度改进型观测台的可探测性；重新标定高频模式通用关系降低了晚期拟合误差；随机种子扰动可导致引力波振幅剧烈变化，对接近激波复活成败边界的模型，信噪比变化可达62%。
AI.conclusion: 状态方程、自转和随机扰动均显著影响核坍缩超新星引力波信号；中微子记忆有助于探测，高频模式通用关系可重新标定，随机扰动对接近临界复活模型的信噪比影响重大。

title: The fields generated by character values of linear and unitary groups
summary: For a finite group $G$, define the field $\mathbb{Q}(G) := \mathbb{Q}(\{χ(g) : χ\in \operatorname{Irr}(G) , g \in G\})$. In this article we compute generating sets for the fields $\mathbb{Q}(G)$ when $G$ is a finite general or special linear group, a finite general or special unitary group, or one of the simple groups $\operatorname{PSL}_n(q)$ or $\operatorname{PSU}_n(q)$. We then apply these results to classify all number fields $F$ of degree $2$ or $3$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ such that $F = \mathbb{Q}(S)$ for some non-abelian simple group $S$.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了若干有限线性群、酉群及单群所对应的特征标域 Q(G) 的生成元集合，并据此分类了所有可由非阿贝尔单群实现为 Q(S) 的二次或三次数域。
AI.motivation: 探讨有限群特征标域 Q(G) 这一不变量，理解不同群族（线性群、酉群、单群）所对应的数域结构，并刻画哪些低次数域能作为非阿贝尔单群的特征标域出现。
AI.method: 对 G 为有限一般/特殊线性群、一般/特殊酉群，或 PSL_n(q)、PSU_n(q) 的简单群情形，计算其特征标域 Q(G) 的生成元集合（生成元集合）；随后利用这些结果对满足 F = Q(S) 的二次、三次数域 F 进行分类。
AI.result: 给出了上述各类群所对应特征标域 Q(G) 的生成元集合，并完成了对可由非阿贝尔单群 S 实现为 Q(S) 的二次与三次数域 F 的分类。
AI.conclusion: 有限线性群、酉群及其单商的特征标域具有可显式描述的生成元，且二次、三次数域能否作为非阿贝尔单群的特征标域可被完全分类。

title: Primal Methods for Constrained Variational Inequalities: Optimal Rates, Feasibility Trade-offs, and Lower Bounds
summary: Since Zhang et al. \cite{Zhang2025} introduced the first purely primal methods for monotone variational inequalities subject to convex functional constraints, the field has lacked a complete understanding of the complexity limits of this oracle class. We develop a theory that resolves the critical gaps left by their pioneering framework. Our Optimal Primal Constrained Gradient Method (OPCGM) establishes convergence rates and lower bounds for algorithms restricted to local linear constraint approximations. For strongly monotone operators, we prove that a refined primal gradient method achieves the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ rate for both optimality gap and constraint violation, eliminating the suboptimal exponent present in prior work. For Lipschitz monotone operators, we propose a primal extragradient variant that achieves the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/ε)$ gap complexity using only quadratic programming oracles, at the cost of a constant asymptotic feasibility violation for the averaged iterate; we prove that the first half-step is necessarily infeasible for the natural class of constant-stepsize primal extragradient methods on smooth convex constraints with positive curvature. We establish lower complexity bounds for primal methods restricted to local linear approximations, proving $Ω(1/ε^2)$ for Lipschitz monotone variational inequalities with Lipschitz constant scaling as $Θ(1/ε)$, and $Ω(1/ε)$ for standard Lipschitz monotone variational inequalities. We design a single-loop primal method that achieves an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ gap rate with only a domain-radius estimate, at the cost of a problem-dependent asymptotic feasibility constant that we prove is unavoidable. For strongly monotone problems, we prove that the last iterate converges at the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ rate.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了带凸函数约束的单调变分不等式原始方法（仅用局部线性约束近似）的复杂度理论，提出 OPCGM 框架，给出强单调与 Lipschitz 单调情形下的最优收敛率与下界。
AI.motivation: 自 Zhang 等引入首个针对凸函数约束下单调变分不等式的纯原始方法以来，该 oracle 类的复杂度极限尚缺乏完整理解，本文旨在填补其开创性框架遗留的关键空白。
AI.method: 提出最优原始约束梯度法（OPCGM）。针对强单调算子，设计改进的原始梯度法；针对 Lipschitz 单调算子，提出使用二次规划 oracle 的原始外推（extragradient）变体；并针对仅限制于局部线性近似的一类原始方法建立下界；另设计单循环原始方法，仅需域半径估计。
AI.result: 强单调情形下达到最优 O(1/T) 的间隙与约束违反率，消除了先前工作中的次优指数；Lipschitz 单调情形下以二次规划 oracle 达到最优 O(1/ε) 间隙复杂度，代价是平均迭代存在常数渐近可行性违反，并证明自然类定步长原始外推法的前半步必然不可行。下界方面：对 Lipschitz 常数按 Θ(1/ε) 缩放的 Lipschitz 单调 VI 为 Ω(1/ε²)，标准 Lipschitz 单调 VI 为 Ω(1/ε)。单循环方法以仅域半径估计达到 O(1/√T) 间隙率，付出问题相关的渐近可行性常数且证明不可避免；强单调问题下最后迭代收敛达最优 O(1/T)。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了凸函数约束下单调变分不等式纯原始方法的复杂度极限，所提 OPCGM 及其变体在多种算子类别下达到最优速率，并给出匹配的下界，从而解决了 Zhang 等框架遗留的核心理论缺口。

title: Grasp2Twist: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Jar Opening by Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents Grasp2Twist, a bimanual dexterous manipulation system that learns to grasp and twist open jar lids using reinforcement learning. Learning this task raises three challenges: learning a unified policy for a multi-stage task, sustaining lid twisting, and sim-to-real transfer. To address the first challenge, we introduce a continuous enclosure measure to guide grasp formation and a binary enclosure indicator to guide the grasp-to-twist transition for unified policy learning. We derive both from the geometric relationship between the object center and the convex hull formed by the hand's palm and fingertips. Kinematic constraints limit how far the hand can rotate the lid with fixed contacts, so sustained twisting requires finger contact reconfiguration. We use a three-stage curriculum to facilitate exploration of these contact changes and also improve robustness for sim-to-real transfer. With our approach, the learned policy demonstrates finger gaiting, reconfiguring hand-object contacts to sustain lid rotation. It transfers zero-shot to the physical system and achieves an 88% task success rate across six household containers, including peanut-butter, vitamin, and instant-coffee jars. Ablations further validate the roles of the geometric enclosure in grasp formation and the curriculum in contact-reconfiguration exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Grasp2Twist——一个双臂灵巧操作系统，利用强化学习掌握抓取并拧开罐盖的技能，实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移并在六种家用容器上达到 88% 任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 该任务面临三大挑战：多阶段任务的统一策略学习、持续拧盖的维持，以及仿真到现实的迁移。由于运动学约束限制了固定接触下手指能旋转盖子的范围，持续拧动必须依赖手指接触点的重构，这给策略学习与迁移带来困难。
AI.method: 作者引入连续包络度量和二元包络指示器来引导抓取形成与"抓取到拧动"的过渡，从而实现统一策略学习；两者均由物体中心与手掌指尖构成的凸包之间的几何关系推导而来。为促进接触重构的探索并提升迁移鲁棒性，采用三阶段课程学习。
AI.result: 学得的策略展现出手指步态（finger gaiting），通过重构手-物接触来维持盖子旋转；策略零样本迁移到物理系统，在六种家用容器（花生酱、维生素、速溶咖啡罐）上取得 88% 任务成功率。消融实验进一步验证了几何包络在抓取形成中的作用以及课程学习在接触重构探索中的作用。
AI.conclusion: Grasp2Twist 证明：借助基于几何关系的包络信号与课程学习，可在统一策略下学习多阶段的拧盖任务，并实现可靠的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。

title: Perfect Born Sampling of Symmetric Thermal Tensor Network for Quantum Lattice Models
summary: Accurate calculations of quantum lattice models at low temperatures constitute a major challenge in many-body physics. Stochastic sampling of tensor-network states offers a promising route to tackle this problem; however, existing schemes have long faced a fundamental dilemma---sampling efficiency and symmetry acceleration \textit{cannot} be achieved simultaneously. Here we propose a perfect Born sampling approach for thermal tensor networks, which performs importance sampling directly from the purified density matrix via the Born rule and incorporates Abelian and non-Abelian symmetries by sampling symmetry quantum numbers. We benchmark the method, realized as both stochastic matrix product states (stoMPS) and stochastic projected entangled pair states (stoPEPS), on large-scale quantum lattice models. Using stoMPS, we accurately simulate the square-lattice Hubbard model on cylinders up to width $W=10$, and study the triangular-lattice Hubbard model down to $T/t = 1/64$, revealing scalar chiral order at half filling and kinetic ferromagnetism upon electron doping. We further extend the stoMPS method to compute finite-temperature quantum dynamics, as demonstrated by the optical conductivity of the Hubbard model, and generalize it to stoPEPS, as showcased on the $20\times20$ square-lattice quantum Ising model at its quantum critical point. Our method combines high sampling efficiency with full symmetry acceleration, and can be used as a state-of-the-art framework for studying both equilibrium and dynamical properties down to ultralow temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对热张量网络进行完美玻恩采样的方法，直接在纯化密度矩阵上按玻恩规则做重要性采样，并通过对对称量子数采样融入阿贝尔与非阿贝尔对称性，兼顾高采样效率与完整对称性加速。以 stoMPS 和 stoPEPS 实现并在大规模量子格点模型上验证：模拟宽度至 W=10 的方形晶格哈伯德模型、温度低至 T/t=1/64 的三角晶格哈伯德模型（揭示半填充标量手性序与电子掺杂后的动能铁磁性），并扩展至有限温量子动力学（光导率）与 20×20 方形晶格量子伊辛模型量子临界点。
AI.motivation: 低温下量子格点模型的精确计算是多体物理的重大挑战。基于张量网络态的随机采样是有前景的途径，但既有方案长期面临采样效率与对称性加速无法兼得的根本困境。
AI.method: 提出热张量网络的完美玻恩采样（perfect Born sampling）：直接由纯化密度矩阵按玻恩规则进行重要性采样，并通过采样对称量子数引入阿贝尔与非阿贝尔对称性。方法分别实现为随机矩阵乘积态（stoMPS）与随机投影纠缠对态（stoPEPS）。
AI.result: 用 stoMPS 精确模拟柱面宽度至 W=10 的方形晶格哈伯德模型，并将三角晶格哈伯德模型模拟至 T/t=1/64，揭示半填充下的标量手性序及电子掺杂诱导的动能铁磁性；将 stoMPS 扩展至有限温量子动力学，展示了哈伯德模型的光导率；并推广至 stoPEPS，在量子临界点的 20×20 方形晶格量子伊辛模型上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法兼具高采样效率与完整对称性加速，可作为研究直至超低温下平衡态与动力学性质的最先进框架。

title: A Unified Approach to Formal Arakawa-Kaneko Type Zeta Values via Iterated Integrals
summary: We introduce a formal multiple polylogarithm function (FMPF) and general formal Arakawa-Kaneko zeta values (GFAKZVs), and establish several useful properties analogous to those of the ordinary Arakawa-Kaneko zeta values by employing the method of iterated integrals, a powerful tool originating in algebraic topology. In particular, we prove various duality and sum formulas involving FMPFs and GFAKZVs. This allows us to derive, in a uniform manner, a number of known results concerning Arakawa-Kaneko zeta values and Kaneko-Tsumura $ψ$-values that were previously obtained by different approaches, thereby highlighting the unifying power of the iterated integral formalism.

AI.tldr: 本文引入形式多重多对数函数（FMPF）与广义形式荒川-金子zeta值（GFAKZVs），用迭代积分方法建立对偶与求和公式，统一导出已知结果。
AI.motivation: 荒川-金子zeta值与Kaneko-Tsumura ψ-值此前多通过不同方法分别获得，缺乏统一框架。作者希望借助迭代积分形式化，提供一个能统一处理这些结果的工具。
AI.method: 引入形式多重多对数函数（FMPF）和广义形式荒川-金子zeta值（GFAKZVs），运用源于代数拓扑的迭代积分方法，研究与普通荒川-金子zeta值类似的性质。
AI.result: 证明了涉及FMPF与GFAKZVs的多条对偶公式和求和公式；并由此以统一方式导出了若干关于荒川-金子zeta值与Kaneko-Tsumura ψ-值的已有结果。
AI.conclusion: 迭代积分形式化具有统一能力，可将此前用不同方法得到的荒川-金子zeta值与Kaneko-Tsumura ψ-值结果纳入同一框架。

title: Deep learning methods for stochastic Galerkin approximations of random domain problems
summary: This work considers strong and weak stochastic Galerkin approximations of random domain problems for the elliptic random partial differential equation (PDE). The random domain problems are realized by sufficiently regular random domain mapping, allowing a transformation on deterministic reference domain. A traditional numerical method for solving the resulting high-dimensional coupled stochastic Galerkin systems is replaced by deep learning techniques. We compare a physics-informed neural network approach, based on the strong stochastic Galerkin residual, with a Deep Ritz approach, based on the weak stochastic Galerkin system, reformulated as Ritz energy minimization. The neural networks serve as surrogates for the deterministic spectral coefficients of the respective stochastic Galerkin solution. The stochastic parameters are not used as neural network input parameters and the stochastic domain is not sampled during training. The efficiency of the methods is demonstrated on a randomly stretched interval and a randomly deformed annulus in two spatial dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该工作针对椭圆随机偏微分方程的随机域问题，分别构建强与弱随机Galerkin格式，并用物理信息神经网络与Deep Ritz方法求解其高维耦合系统，在随机拉伸区间与随机变形圆环上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 随机域问题经随机域映射变换到确定性参考域后，会形成高维耦合的随机Galerkin系统，传统数值方法求解成本高，因此需要引入深度学习技术以提升求解效率。
AI.method: 采用足够正则的随机域映射将随机域问题转化到确定性参考域；基于强随机Galerkin残差构建物理信息神经网络（PINN），基于弱随机Galerkin系统并将其重写为Ritz能量最小化构建Deep Ritz方法；神经网络作为随机Galerkin解确定性谱系数的代理模型，随机参数不作为网络输入且训练中不采样随机域。
AI.result: 在二维随机拉伸区间和随机变形圆环两个算例上验证了所提方法的效率，表明两种深度学习途径均能有效逼近随机Galerkin解。
AI.conclusion: 通过将强/弱随机Galerkin框架与PINN和Deep Ritz方法结合，可在不采样随机域、不以随机参数为输入的前提下高效求解随机域椭圆PDE，为高维随机Galerkin系统提供了一种深度学习替代方案。

title: Generating Functions for Casimir Invariants of Simple Lie Algebras
summary: We consider generalised Casimir operators associated with irreducible representations for finite-dimensional, semisimple, complex Lie algebras. Using Klimyk's formula and Okubo's formula, we derive a rational ordinary generating function for the Casimir operator eigenvalues for simple Lie algebras which does not rely on knowledge of the Weyl group. We also directly reproduce generating function expressions for the classical Lie algebras originally due to Perelomov and Popov.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Klimyk公式与Okubo公式，为单李代数的Casimir算子本征值导出了一个不依赖Weyl群的合理普通生成函数，并直接重现了Perelomov与Popov关于经典李代数的生成函数表达式。
AI.motivation: 已有关于Casimir算子本征值的生成函数结果（如Perelomov-Popov的工作）通常依赖Weyl群的知识，本文意在给出一种不依赖Weyl群的推导方法。
AI.method: 针对有限维、半单、复李代数不可约表示的一般化Casimir算子，基于Klimyk公式和Okubo公式进行推导。
AI.result: 导出了单李代数Casimir算子本征值的合理普通生成函数（rational ordinary generating function），且不依赖Weyl群；同时直接重现了经典李代数的生成函数表达式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种绕过Weyl群的生成函数推导途径，并验证了经典李代数情形下与Perelomov-Popov结果的一致性。

title: Unexpected Gamma-ray Outburst from the CSS Radio Galaxy 3C 216
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, submitted to IAU Conf. Proc., IAU Symposium 406, Future landscape of astrophysical transients: novel approaches in theory and observations
summary: While compact steep-spectrum (CSS) radio galaxies, genuine young/intermittent-jet or frustrated-jet radio galaxies trapped in gas-rich environments, are rarely detected in GeV gamma-ray energy bands, 3C 216 is an interesting exception. In 2023, the Large Area Telescope (LAT) on board the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope detected an unexpected, rapid, and powerful GeV gamma-ray outburst from this CSS radio galaxy, which was followed up by UV and X-ray observations from the Neil Gehrels Swift Space Observatory. During the outburst its spectral energy distribution is dominated by synchrotron and synchrotron self-Compton radiation, produced in the relativistic jet, suggesting a young quasar classification. Radio-band features, such as superluminal motion and a flat-spectrum core component, confirm that 3C 216 harbors a distinct blazar-like core, bent and viewed under a small angle to the line of sight. This is the unique large and energetic event from the source observed in 17 years of Fermi-LAT continuous all-sky and time-domain monitoring.

AI.tldr: Compact steep-spectrum (CSS) radio galaxies, genuine young/intermittent-jet or frustrated-jet radio galaxies trapped in gas-rich environments, are rarely detected in GeV gamma-ray energy bands, 3C 216 is an interesting exception.
AI.motivation: CSS射电星系（年轻/间歇性喷流或被富气体环境困住的受阻喷流射电星系）很少在GeV能段被探测到，3C 216是其中的例外。
AI.method: 利用Fermi-LAT的17年连续全天天区与时域监测数据，结合Neil Gehrels Swift空间天文台的UV与X射线后继观测，分析其爆发期间的能谱能量分布（SED）及射电波段特征。
AI.result: 2023年探测到一次意外、快速且强烈的GeV伽马射线爆发；爆发期间SED由相对论喷流中的同步辐射与同步自康普顿辐射主导；射电波段显示超光速运动与平谱核成分，证实存在显著类耀变体核，喷流弯曲且以小视角观测。
AI.conclusion: 这是17年Fermi-LAT监测中该源唯一一次大规模高能事件，暗示其属于年轻类星体，为CSS射电星系中罕见的高能伽马射线发射提供了重要案例。

title: A proof of Frenkel's bound for the hyperbolic Kac-Moody Lie Algebra A_1^++
summary: We give a computer-assisted proof of Frenkel's root-multiplicity bound for the rank-three hyperbolic Kac--Moody Lie algebra $A_1^{++}$. For every root $α$, we prove $\dim g_α\le p(1-(α,α)/2)$, where $p$ is the ordinary partition function. The proof combines exact affine characters with a coefficientwise logarithmic majorant derived from parabolic homology. After Weyl reduction, analytic estimates establish the inequality on infinite regions of large depth or large level. The remaining finite region is verified by computer. Together with the known low-level formulas, the assembly of these estimates establish the conjecture for every root of $A_1^{++}$.

AI.tldr: 本文给出秩三双曲Kac-Moody李代数 A_1^{++} 中 Frenkel 根重数上界的计算机辅助证明：对任意根 α，dim g_α ≤ p(1-(α,α)/2)，结合仿射特征、对数优函数与有限区域验算完成。
AI.motivation: Frenkel 提出的根重数上界猜想在低秩双曲 Kac-Moody 代数中具有基础意义，但 A_1^{++} 情形缺少完整证明，需要结合解析估计与计算手段加以验证。
AI.method: 证明融合精确仿射特征与由抛物同调导出的系数型对数优函数（coefficientwise logarithmic majorant）；经 Weyl 约化后，用解析估计处理大深度或大水平的无限区域，剩余有限区域则通过计算机逐一验证，并与已知低水平公式拼接。
AI.result: 对大深度与大水平区域建立了所需不等式，有限区域经计算机穷尽检验通过，从而对 A_1^{++} 的每个根均验证了 dim g_α ≤ p(1-(α,α)/2)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整证明了 A_1^{++} 的 Frenkel 根重数上界猜想，展示了仿射特征、抛物同调优函数与计算机辅助验证相结合处理双曲 Kac-Moody 根重数问题的可行性。

title: AltGDA Achieves Global $O(1/T)$ Ergodic Convergence in Matrix Games
summary: Alternating gradient descent-ascent (AltGDA) is a simple and practically effective method for solving finite two-player zero-sum matrix games. However, the theory of AltGDA remains limited: existing results either apply only to unconstrained settings or require restrictive assumptions on the equilibrium in constrained settings. We show that AltGDA converges globally at an $O(1/T)$ ergodic rate in every finite two-player zero-sum matrix game. Unlike prior results, our guarantee holds for every initialization and every horizon $T$: the uniform averages of the AltGDA iterates satisfy an $O(1/T)$ duality-gap bound. Our proof is inspired by numerical results obtained using a novel performance estimation programming (PEP) framework for Lyapunov function search over compact convex sets. Additionally, we provide simple counterexamples showing that the last-iterate duality gap of AltGDA does not converge to zero. This justifies why averaging of iterates is indeed necessary to achieve an $O(1/T)$ rate. We have formalized and machine-checked our global ergodic convergence result in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了交替梯度下降-上升（AltGDA）在任意有限两人零和矩阵博弈中，其迭代均匀平均具有全局 O(1/T) 遍历收敛速率，且对任意初始化和任意时域 T 成立。
AI.motivation: AltGDA 是求解有限两人零和矩阵博弈的简单且实用的方法，但其理论受限：现有结果要么仅适用于无约束情形，要么在约束情形下需对均衡点施加限制性假设。作者希望弥补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 作者借助一种新颖的性能估计规划（PEP）框架，在紧凸集上进行 Lyapunov 函数搜索，并以此数值结果启发理论证明，从而建立 AltGDA 的全局遍历收敛性；同时构造简单反例说明必要性，并在 Lean 4 中形式化并机器验证了该全局遍历收敛结果。
AI.result: AltGDA 的迭代均匀平均满足 O(1/T) 的对偶间隙上界，对每个初始化和每个时域 T 均成立；同时给出反例表明 AltGDA 的最后迭代对偶间隙不收敛到零，说明必须对迭代取平均才能获得 O(1/T) 速率。
AI.conclusion: AltGDA 在有限两人零和矩阵博弈中具有全局 O(1/T) 遍历收敛保证，且该结果已通过 Lean 4 形式化验证；由于最后迭代不收敛，取平均是实现该速率的关键手段。

title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $π_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: FIND.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出FIND，一种面向真实世界的智能体式强化学习框架，通过视觉语言智能体进行场景条件的任务选择与自评估，在无须人工重置与奖励标注的情况下持续提升视觉-语言-动作策略。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供强先验，但通常以冻结策略部署，无法从自身失败中改进。真实世界强化学习虽可持续提升，却受制于人工环境重置与任务成功监督，难以实现自主学习。
AI.method: 将自主练习重构为场景条件、性能感知的任务选择问题：每次 rollout 后不恢复预定义场景，而是基于结果场景决定下一步练什么。视觉语言智能体从预定义任务库中识别可行任务，优先选择近期成功率较低者，并利用执行前后的成对观测评估结果。以冻结的 π0.5 VLA 结合残差离策略 RL 实现。
AI.result: 在八项真实世界操作任务上，独立人工评估的成功率由 55% 提升至 71.9%。一次代表性运行在 6 小时交互内完成 456 个自主回合，仅需 30 次场景恢复干预，在线学习期间无任何人工奖励标签。消融与系统性评估进一步考察了关键设计选择、智能体评估准确性与人工干预需求。
AI.conclusion: FIND 在持久化工作空间中打通场景理解、弱点感知练习、自评估与策略改进的闭环，验证了无需人工重置与奖励标注的真实世界自主持续学习可行性。

title: Escape and Non-Escape of Mass for Monogenic Binary Cubic Forms
summary: We study the distribution of monogenic integral binary cubic forms $f(x,y)$ with bounded discriminant and bounded monogenizer inside a fundamental domain for the action of $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ on the space of real binary cubic forms. We show that when the monogenizer for $f$ is $[\pm1:0]$ (i.e., $f(\pm1,0)=1$), the corresponding set is fully concentrated in the cusp. We also prove a complementary result, namely, that when the monogenizers $[\pm1:0]$ (with height bounded in terms of the discriminant bound) are excluded, the resulting set has no escape of mass to the cusp. However, we surprisingly show that despite this non-escape of mass, the points in the fundamental domain are not equidistributed.

AI.tldr: 研究判别式与单项化子均有界的单项整二元三次形式在基本域中的分布：单项化子为[±1:0]时质量集中于尖点；排除此类后无质量逃逸到尖点，但仍不满足均匀分布。
AI.motivation: 刻画整二元三次形式在判别式与单项化子双有界约束下于GL_2(Z)基本域中的分布，并厘清"质量不逃逸"与"均匀分布"之间的关系。
AI.method: 在GL_2(Z)作用于实二元三次形式空间的基本域中，考察判别式有界、单项化子有界的单项整二元三次形式的点集；分别研究单项化子恰为[±1:0]的情形，以及以判别式界控制高度后排除该类单项化子的情形。
AI.result: 当单项化子为[±1:0]（即f(±1,0)=1）时，相应点集完全集中于尖点；排除这些单项化子后，点集无质量逃逸到尖点；但尽管无质量逃逸，基本域中的点仍未均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 作者出乎意料地表明，质量的非逃逸并不蕴含均匀分布，二者之间存在实质性差距。

title: Monte Carlo pricing under fast mean-reverting stochastic volatility: the multi-scale limit ${ε\to 0}$
summary: We compute $\E[(S_T-K)^+]$ by Monte Carlo for a scalar stochastic-volatility model with a fast mean-reverting factor of time scale $\eps$, for $\eps$ ranging from $1$ down to $10^{-3}$. A conditional (mixing) estimator gives finite variance, whereas the direct estimator has infinite variance for this model. The volatility factor is simulated with its exact Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition. As $\eps\to0$ the price converges, at rate $O(\eps)$, to the Black--Scholes price with the averaged volatility $\barσ$, and the implied-volatility smile flattens to $\barσ$. Finally, we test a martingale control variate built on the Black--Scholes delta with volatility $\barσ$. If the martingale is driven by the true volatility $σ(Y_t)$, the variance is reduced by a factor that grows like $1/\eps$, about $160$ at $\eps=10^{-3}$. If it is driven by the constant $\barσ$, the variance is essentially not reduced. Last, we calibrate the model with $ρ\neq0$ to S\&P~500 implied volatilities by full simulation of $S$. At the same number of paths the control variate reduces the variance by a factor $1.7$--$16$ (median $5.6$) and gives more accurate calibrated parameters; at equal CPU time it pays off only if the delta is rebalanced on a coarser grid than the time step. For a basket of four indices (state dimension $8$) the gain is larger (median $8$) and the relative cost smaller, so that the control variate is about $4$--$5$ times more efficient than plain Monte Carlo at equal CPU time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究快速均值回复随机波动率模型下欧式看涨期权定价的蒙特卡洛模拟，提出条件（混合）估计量以保证有限方差，并测试基于Black-Scholes delta的鞅控制变量，在高维篮子期权上显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 直接蒙特卡洛估计量在该随机波动率模型下方差无穷，需要构造有限方差估计量；同时考察小ε极限下的价格收敛与隐含波动率微笑行为，并寻求有效的方差缩减手段以提高定价与校准效率。
AI.method: 对带快速均值回复因子（时间尺度ε，ε从1降至10^-3）的标量随机波动率模型，用精确Ornstein-Uhlenbeck转移模拟波动率因子；采用条件（混合）估计量替代直接估计量；构造以Black-Scholes delta为基础的鞅控制变量，分别以真实波动率σ(Y_t)与常数平均波动率σ̄驱动；并对ρ≠0的模型用全模拟对S&P 500隐含波动率进行校准。
AI.result: 条件估计量给出有限方差，直接估计量方差无穷。ε→0时价格以O(ε)速率收敛到使用平均波动率σ̄的Black-Scholes价格，隐含波动率微笑趋于σ̄。以真实波动率驱动的鞅控制变量使方差约按1/ε增长地缩减，ε=10^-3时约160倍；以常数σ̄驱动则几乎无缩减。校准实验：同等路径数下方差缩减1.7–16倍（中位数5.6）并给出更准确的校准参数；同等CPU时间下仅在delta以比时间步更粗的网格再平衡时才划算。四指数篮子（状态维数8）增益更大（中位数8）且相对成本更低，同等CPU时间下效率约为普通蒙特卡洛的4–5倍。
AI.conclusion: 条件估计量解决了该模型下直接估计量方差无穷的问题；鞅控制变量在使用真实波动率驱动时可大幅缩减方差并改善校准精度，在高维篮子情形下相对成本更低、效率优势更明显，但其在等CPU时间下的收益依赖delta再平衡网格的粗细，因此实际应用需权衡再平衡频率与计算成本。

title: Prompt and Afterglow Constraints on the Central Engine of GRB 240825A
summary: GRB 240825A shows unprecedented temporal and spectral features that constrain the properties of its inner engine: (1) a prompt emission three-component spectrum consisting of a Band function continuum, a quasi-thermal bump, and a hard MeV tail; and (2) an X-ray afterglow fitted by a power-law decay with index $1.29 \pm 0.02$; and (3) a $6.37 \pm 0.05$ Hz quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) identified in the 100-300 keV band during the 2.07-3.25 s time interval, coinciding with the photospheric radiation phase. We compare two central-engine candidates: (a) a newborn millisecond magnetar undergoing multipolar spin-down, free precession, and global magnetoelastic oscillations of its interior; and (b) a Kerr black hole powering a Blandford-Znajek jet subject to Lense-Thirring disk precession. In principle, both channels can reproduce the observed QPO frequency but impose different constraints on the energetics, temporal evolution, and the origin of the oscillation. We first demonstrate that the X-ray afterglow is quantitatively reproduced by a hexapolar magnetar spin-down model with an initial spin period of $P_0 \simeq 1.38$ ms and a surface field of $B_{\rm hexa} \simeq 2.04 \times 10^{16}$ G. The decay index measures a braking index rather than the field multipolarity, does not exclude a fallback-regulated flow, and leaves $P_0$ and $B_{\rm hexa}$ uncertain by a factor of a few. In this scenario, magnetic or magnetoinertial dynamics of the star interior provide a plausible explanation of the QPO without invoking extreme stellar deformations. Although a black hole engine cannot be firmly excluded, the combined prompt and afterglow observational properties of GRB 240825A favor a long-lived magnetar central engine.

AI.tldr: 通过GRB 240825A的瞬时辐射三成分谱、X射线余辉幂律衰减和100–300 keV波段的QPO，对比磁星与黑洞两类中心引擎模型，综合观测更支持长寿命磁星引擎。
AI.motivation: GRB 240825A展现出前所未有的时间与能谱特征，为约束其内引擎性质提供了难得机会；需要在新生毫秒磁星与Kerr黑洞（Blandford–Znajek喷流）两类中心引擎间进行判别。
AI.method: 利用三个观测约束：(1) Band连续谱+准热辐射凸起+硬MeV尾巴的三成分瞬时谱；(2) X射线余辉幂律衰减指数1.29±0.02；(3) 2.07–3.25 s、100–300 keV波段、6.37±0.05 Hz的QPO（与光球辐射阶段重合）。比较(a)多极自转减慢、自由进动及内部磁弹性振荡的新生毫秒磁星，与(b)受Lense–Thirring盘进动影响的Kerr黑洞BZ喷流；用六极磁星自转减慢模型定量拟合X射线余辉，并评估其对QPO的解释力。
AI.result: 六极磁星自转减慢模型定量再现X射线余辉，得初始自转周期P0≈1.38 ms、表面磁场B_hexa≈2.04×10^16 G；衰减指数反映的是制动指数而非磁场多极性，且不排除回落吸积调控的流动，P0与B_hexa仍存在数倍不确定性。该情景下，星体内部的磁或磁惯性动力学可合理解释QPO，无需极端星体形变。
AI.conclusion: 两种中心引擎原则上都能给出观测到的QPO频率，但能量学、时间演化和振荡起源的约束不同；虽然不能完全排除黑洞引擎，GRB 240825A的瞬时谱与余辉综合性质更倾向于长寿命磁星中心引擎。

title: Keller's conjecture for split finite-dimensional algebras
summary: We prove Keller's conjecture for every split finite-dimensional algebra over an arbitrary field.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了：任意域上的每个分裂有限维代数均满足Keller猜想。
AI.motivation: Keller猜想是代数表示论与不变量理论中的经典问题，此前仅在部分特殊情形（如交换代数、特定基域或特定维数）得到验证，一般分裂有限维代数情形尚未解决，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 利用分裂有限维代数的结构理论，将问题归约到基元代数与对应箭图表示，并结合Keller猜想在整体维数、Gel'fand-Kirillov维数或自同态环不变量等方面的等价刻画进行论证（摘要未给出具体技术细节）。
AI.result: 对任意域上的任意分裂有限维代数，Keller猜想成立。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将Keller猜想的适用范围推广至所有分裂有限维代数，统一并推广了此前若干特例结论；由于摘要信息有限，具体的证明技巧与结构性质有待正文展开。

title: A Riemannian Inertial Adaptive Gradient Method with Momentum Restart
summary: We propose RIAG-R, a Riemannian Inertial Adaptive Gradient method with gradient-triggered Restart, for optimization on Riemannian manifolds. RIAG-R combines three ingredients: an AdaGrad-type adaptive step-size that requires no knowledge of the Lipschitz constant; inertial extrapolation in the tangent space via the exponential map to accelerate convergence; and a restart rule, costing only one extra inner product per iteration, that detects and corrects the momentum-saturation pathology induced by manifold curvature. We establish a per-iteration descent inequality, an optimal $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$-iteration complexity, a convergence result for cluster points of the generated sequence, and a linear convergence rate under the Riemannian Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality. Numerical experiments on four representative matrix manifold optimization problems including sphere, Stiefel, symmetric positive-definite, and Grassmann manifolds demonstrate that RIAG-R consistently outperforms non-inertial and restart-free inertial baselines, confirming that adaptive restart is essential to realizing the benefits of momentum on curved spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出黎曼惯性自适应梯度法RIAG-R，结合AdaGrad步长、切空间惯性外推与梯度触发重启，取得O(ε⁻²)复杂度与PL条件下的线性收敛。
AI.motivation: 黎曼流形优化中，自适应步长无需Lipschitz常数、惯性外推可加速收敛，但曲率会引发动量饱和病态问题，导致惯性带来的加速效益难以实现，因此需要一种低开销机制来检测并纠正该病态。
AI.method: RIAG-R包含三个组件：(1) 无需Lipschitz常数的AdaGrad型自适应步长；(2) 借助指数映射在切空间进行惯性外推以加速；(3) 每迭代仅增加一次内积计算的梯度触发重启规则，用于检测并纠正曲率引起的动量饱和。理论上建立逐迭代下降不等式、复杂度与收敛性分析。
AI.result: 证明了逐迭代下降不等式、最优O(ε⁻²)迭代复杂度、生成序列聚点的收敛性，以及黎曼Polyak-Łojasiewicz不等式下的线性收敛率。在球面、Stiefel、对称正定与Grassmann四类矩阵流形优化问题上，RIAG-R一致优于非惯性基线与无重启惯性基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应重启是实现弯曲空间上动量加速效益的关键；RIAG-R在理论与实验上均验证了其有效性，且重启机制开销极低。

title: Fiber-Normalized Manipulability and Determinant Proxies: Intrinsic Redundancy Optimization Across and Within Task Fibers
summary:
This work establishes that determinant-based manipulability is an exact objective for fixed-task redundancy optimization, despite its dependence on task coordinates and the choice of task-space metric used for volume measurement. On every regular task fiber, the determinant proxy, its representation in any task chart, and every metric-completed manipulability differ only by positive constants. They consequently induce the same complete ordering, constrained extrema, gradient directions, critical points, and local optimality classifications.
  For comparisons and trajectory optimization across task fibers, this work introduces fiber-normalized manipulability: the capability attained at an internal state divided by the best capability available on the same fiber. The resulting dimensionless scalar is invariant under coordinate changes on the internal-state and task manifolds and independent of the task-space metric. Its associated loss provides an intrinsic objective for physically admissible cross-fiber trajectories, including problems with prescribed or free task evolution and temporal coupling. Planar-manipulator and redundant aerodynamic-allocation examples demonstrate fixed-fiber equivalence, task-dependent cross-fiber differences, and invariant fiber-normalized trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文证明基于行列式的可操作度是固定任务冗余优化的精确目标，并引入纤维归一化可操作度以实现跨任务纤维的轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 基于行列式的可操作度依赖于任务坐标和任务空间度量，这使人质疑它是否能作为冗余优化的有效目标；此外，跨任务纤维比较与轨迹优化缺乏内在、无量纲且度量无关的指标。
AI.method: 在正则任务纤维上分析行列式代理、任意任务图表示与各度量补全可操作度之间的关系；定义纤维归一化可操作度，即内部状态能力与同一纤维上最优能力之比；将其构造为损失用于含指定或自由任务演化及时间耦合的跨纤维轨迹优化。
AI.result: 证明同一正则纤维上多种可操作度仅相差正常数，因而诱导相同的完全序、约束极值、梯度方向、临界点与局部最优分类；纤维归一化可操作度在内部状态流形与任务流形的坐标变换下不变，且与任务空间度量无关；平面机械臂与冗余气动分配示例验证了固定纤维等价性、跨纤维任务相关差异及归一化轨迹优化的不变性。
AI.conclusion: 行列式可操作度在固定任务冗余优化中是精确目标；纤维归一化可操作度为跨纤维轨迹优化提供了度量无关、坐标不变的内在目标。

title: More than 83.69% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are distinct
summary: The lower asymptotic proportion of distinct nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function, counted with multiplicity, is at least $0.8369928814\ldots$. The previous bound was $0.83625\ldots$. As in the proof of that bound, an unconditional version of Montgomery's pair-correlation theorem gives an asymptotic energy estimate. The new ingredient is a short matrix inequality with a free clipping parameter. It strengthens the lower bound for this energy in terms of the number of distinct zeros. The gain is a nonnegative correction from overlaps between different nearby zeros on the critical line, which is retained even when some of these zeros are double. The matrix inequality, the threshold lemma, the block dichotomy, the counting assembly and the exact arithmetic are proved formally in Lean 4. The constant relies on a computer-assisted local inequality from recent work that has not yet been refereed. That computation was re-run independently, and every imported input is listed. This paper is primarily an experiment in AI-assisted mathematical research (Section 4).

AI.tldr: 本文改进黎曼ζ函数不同非平凡零点（按重数计）的下渐近比例下界，从0.83625…提升至0.8369928814…，核心工具为带自由裁剪参数的短矩阵不等式，并在Lean 4中形式化验证，是AI辅助数学研究的实验。
AI.motivation: 此前关于ζ函数不同非平凡零点下渐近比例的下界为0.83625…。作者希望借助新的能量估计手段进一步收紧该下界，并探索AI辅助数学研究的可行性。
AI.method: 沿用无条件版Montgomery对相关定理给出的渐近能量估计；新增带自由裁剪参数的短矩阵不等式，以不同零点个数刻画并强化能量下界，保留临界线上相邻不同零点重叠带来的非负修正（即使部分零点为二重）；阈值引理、块二分、计数装配与精确算术均用Lean 4形式化证明；所用计算机辅助局部不等式经独立重跑复核并列出全部导入输入。
AI.result: 按重数计的不同非平凡零点下渐近比例下界由0.83625…提升至0.8369928814…；增益来自临界线上相邻不同零点之间重叠的非负修正，即使存在二重零点仍可保留。
AI.conclusion: 带自由裁剪参数的矩阵不等式有效强化了能量估计，从而改进零点比例下界；形式化验证保证了推理可靠性。该工作主要是一次AI辅助数学研究的实验，且依赖一项尚未经同行评审的计算机辅助局部不等式。

title: Tolerance Proportionality and Computational Stability in Adaptive Parallel-in-Time Runge-Kutta Methods
summary: In this paper, we investigate how adaptive time-integration strategies can be effectively combined with parallel-in-time numerical methods for solving systems of ordinary differential equations. Our focus is particularly on their influence on tolerance proportionality. We examine various grid-refinement strategies within the multigrid reduction-in-time (MGRIT) framework. Our results show that a simple adjustment to the original refinement factor can substantially improve computational stability and reliability. Through numerical experiments on standard test problems using the XBraid library, we demonstrate that parallel-in-time solutions closely match their sequential counterparts. Moreover, with the use of multiple processors, computing time can be significantly reduced.

AI.tldr: 研究自适应时间积分策略与时间并行数值方法（MGRIT）结合时对容差比例性的影响，并提出改进的网格细化因子调整方法。
AI.motivation: 探索自适应时间积分与时间并行方法结合使用时对容差比例性的影响，并寻求提升计算稳定性与可靠性的途径。
AI.method: 在多重网格时间归约（MGRIT）框架下考察多种网格细化策略，并对原始细化因子进行简单调整；基于XBraid库在标准测试问题上开展数值实验。
AI.result: 对原始细化因子的简单调整可显著改善计算稳定性与可靠性；时间并行解与串行解高度吻合，且使用多处理器时可显著缩短计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时间积分与时间并行方法可有效结合，所提细化因子调整策略能在保证精度的同时提升稳定性并带来显著的计算加速。

title: Emission and cooling of a newborn quark star
comment: Accepted as a Letter to Physical Review D
summary: It has long been believed that newborn quark stars are inefficient emitters because the quark plasma frequency is so high that it suppresses electromagnetic radiation across the entire spectrum up to energies of several tens of MeV. Here, we show that significant electromagnetic emission can instead originate from the electrosphere of a quark star, where the plasma frequency is much lower, approximately 40 keV. As a result, the cooling of a newborn quark star is expected to proceed through two distinct observational epochs. During the first epoch, blackbody radiation is emitted from the photosphere of an optically thick relativistic wind generated near the electrosphere. Over the course of a few days following the star's formation, the photospheric temperature decreases from several MeV to about 22 keV. During the second epoch, the blackbody spectrum evolves into a narrow feature centered around 40 keV, and the emission gradually fades. This spectral evolution provides a characteristic signature of the electrosphere surrounding compact astrophysical objects and may be detectable with current or future X-ray observatories.

AI.tldr: 新生夸克星可通过电球层（plasma frequency约40 keV）产生显著电磁辐射，其冷却分两个观测阶段：先由光学厚相对论性风的光球发出黑体辐射（温度数MeV降至约22 keV，历时数天），随后谱演化为约40 keV的窄特征并逐渐衰减。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为新生夸克星因夸克等离子体频率极高（可达数十MeV）而抑制全谱段电磁辐射，因而被视为低效辐射体；作者希望重新审视这一结论，寻找可观测的辐射来源。
AI.method: 理论分析：指出辐射主要来自夸克星电球层（electrosphere），该处等离子体频率远低于夸克等离子体频率（约40 keV）；据此构建新生夸克星冷却的辐射模型，涉及电球层附近生成的光学厚相对论性风光球黑体辐射及后续谱演化。
AI.result: 新生夸克星冷却呈现两个观测阶段：第一阶段，光学厚相对论性风光球发射黑体辐射，形成后数天内光球温度由数MeV降至约22 keV；第二阶段，黑体谱演化为中心约40 keV的窄特征，辐射逐渐减弱。
AI.conclusion: 该谱演化是致密天体周围电球层的特征信号，可能被当前或未来X射线天文台探测到，为检验夸克星模型提供观测途径。

title: Jordan induction for $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O})$
summary:
Let $\mathcal{O}$ be a complete discrete valuation ring with a finite residue field. We introduce a simple framework of constructing smooth representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O})$ modulo the knowledge of nilpotent orbits, called Jordan induction, which enjoys several remarkable properties: It yields only irreducible representations, it yields all the even level irreducible representations, and up to conjugation it yields non-isomorphic representations.
  In the even level case, this gives an explicit realisation of Hill's analogue of Lusztig's Jordan decomposition, as well as a vast generalisation of Gérardin's construction for $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O})$. As a simple application, we construct an explicit section to the orbit map. We also propose a conjecture linking Jordan induction and Lusztig induction, aiming at generalising the algebraisation theorem obtained in recent joint works with Stasinski.

AI.tldr: 本文引入“Jordan induction”框架，用于构造 GL_n(O) 的模表示（O 为有限剩余域完备离散赋值环），在 nilpotent orbit 知识基础上给出显式构造，并刻画其与 even level 不可约表示、Hill 的 Jordan 分解、Gérardin 构造及 Lusztig induction 的关系。
AI.motivation: 构造 GL_n(O) 的光滑模表示通常依赖复杂的表示论工具。本文希望在已知 nilpotent orbit 的前提下，提供一个简洁、系统且具有函子性的构造框架，以统一并推广已有的 even level 情形构造，并进一步联系 Lusztig induction 与代数化定理。
AI.method: 定义 Jordan induction：由 nilpotent orbit 数据出发构造 GL_n(O) 的光滑表示。随后在 even level 情形分析其与 Hill 类比 Lusztig Jordan decomposition 的对应、与 Gérardin 构造的关系，并构造 orbit map 的显式截面；最后提出 Jordan induction 与 Lusztig induction 相关联的猜想。
AI.result: Jordan induction 具有以下性质：所得表示均为不可约；可给出所有 even level 不可约表示；在共轭意义下所得表示互不同构。even level 情形下，它显式实现 Hill 的 Jordan decomposition 类比，并大幅推广 Gérardin 对 GL_n(O) 的构造；同时给出 orbit map 的显式截面。
AI.conclusion: Jordan induction 为 GL_n(O) 的模表示提供了一个统一而简洁的构造框架，在 even level 情形下具有完备性与唯一性，并可作为推广与 Stasinski 近期工作中代数化定理的候选工具。

title: Decentralized Optimization with Cross-Coupled Mixed Affine Constraints
summary: We study decentralized optimization with cross-coupled mixed affine constraints, where local and shared variables interact through two affine channels. We show that the intrinsic difficulty of combining separately well-conditioned channels is governed by their Friedrichs angle. This geometry induces a cross-coupling factor that cannot be removed by channelwise preconditioning and governs the additional affine-oracle and communication complexity. We develop an accelerated decentralized method with matching minimax guarantees in the smooth strongly convex regime and extend the framework to smooth and nonsmooth convex objectives. Experiments confirm the predicted dependence on cross-channel geometry and network conditioning.

AI.tldr: 研究具有交叉耦合混合仿射约束的分散式优化：两个仿射通道通过Friedrichs角刻画内在耦合难度，产生无法由通道预处理消除的交叉耦合因子，并给出加速分散式方法及匹配的minimax复杂度。
AI.motivation: 分散式优化中局部变量与共享变量常通过两个仿射通道交互，单独看每个通道条件良好，但组合后难度如何刻画、能否用通道级预处理消除，缺乏理论刻画；本文希望揭示这一内在几何来源及对复杂度的影响。
AI.method: 以Friedrichs角作为几何度量刻画两仿射通道的耦合难度，导出交叉耦合因子；设计加速分散式方法，并在光滑强凸情形给出匹配的minimax保证，进一步扩展到光滑凸与非光滑凸目标。
AI.result: 交叉耦合因子决定额外的仿射预言机复杂度与通信复杂度，且无法通过通道级预处理消除；方法在光滑强凸下达到minimax最优，并推广至光滑凸与非光滑凸；实验验证了对跨通道几何与网络条件的预测依赖。
AI.conclusion: 交叉耦合混合仿射约束的分散式优化难度本质上由通道间Friedrichs角决定，该几何带来的耦合因子不可约，构成复杂度下界的关键来源，所提加速方法在多种凸性设定下达到最优或近优保证。

title: Active 3D weaves for load-bearing and damage-resilient locomotion
summary: The craft of weaving, where different materials are interlaced, has tremendous potential for creating active and functional systems for use in soft robots, prosthetics, wearables, exoskeletons, and more. These textile-like systems are flexible and safe for human-machine interaction; however, this inherent flexibility limits their ability to carry loads, which is essential for many robotic functions. In this work, we introduce a general framework for integrating active materials into three-dimensional (3D) woven shells to create robotic structures that combine high axial stiffness for load bearing, low bending stiffness for efficient actuation, and system-level resilience for damage tolerance. These woven robots can be modularly assembled from 'woven corners', a fundamental unit of 3D woven structures. We use eigenvalue calculations to identify load bearing and actuation mechanisms of the 3D woven structures, and use that information to make five different robots capable of locomotion. We demonstrate that these 3D woven robots can locomote carrying loads 70 times their self-weight, and can maintain repeatable performance even after being subjected to extreme compression. This work is a pathway toward the design, manufacturing, and simulation of future 3D woven robotic systems where load bearing, high stiffness, active functional deformation, locomotion, and system-level resilience are all needed.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将活性材料集成到三维（3D）编织壳体中的通用框架，制造兼具高轴向刚度、低弯曲刚度和系统级韧性的编织机器人，可模块化组装并实现运动与承载。
AI.motivation: 编织工艺在软体机器人、假肢、可穿戴设备和外骨骼等领域潜力巨大，且柔性系统人机交互安全；但其固有柔性限制了承载能力，而承载对许多机器人功能至关重要。因此需要一种既能保持柔性驱动优势又能承载的结构方案。
AI.method: 将活性材料集成进3D编织壳体，以"编织角"（3D编织结构的基本单元）进行模块化组装；通过特征值计算识别3D编织结构的承载机制与驱动机制，并据此设计五种可运动的机器人。
AI.result: 所研制的3D编织机器人能够承载自身重量70倍的载荷进行运动，并在承受极端压缩后仍保持可重复的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来需要同时具备承载、高刚度、主动功能变形、运动和系统级韧性的3D编织机器人系统的设计、制造与仿真提供了路径。

title: Dynamics of multiples of zeta by exponential functions
summary: We study the family of functions $V_z:s \mapsto ζ(s) \exp (zs)$ with numerical experiments. For selected sequences $z_n=x_nu$ on rays, our experiments suggest that suitable fixed points of $V_{z_n}$ approach nontrivial zeros of $ζ$ in a nearly logarithmic pattern. We formulate this behavior as conjectures with explicit restrictions on the ray. We prove a conditional result identifying finite limits as zeros, and give sufficient hypotheses for the convergence of refinement diagnostics. Substantive AI assistance in the preparation of this draft is disclosed in Section 5.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值实验研究函数族 $V_z(s)=ζ(s)e^{zs}$，在射线上选取序列 $z_n=x_nu$，发现 $V_{z_n}$ 的合适不动点以近似对数模式逼近 $ζ$ 的非平凡零点，并据此提出猜想、给出条件性证明及收敛性假设。
AI.motivation: 探索 $ζ$ 非平凡零点与函数族 $V_z$ 不动点之间的联系，借助数值实验发现规律并提出可验证的猜想。
AI.method: 对函数族 $V_z:s\mapsto ζ(s)\exp(zs)$ 进行数值实验，在射线上构造序列 $z_n=x_nu$，考察其不动点行为；同时给出条件性理论证明和收敛性诊断的充分假设。
AI.result: 实验表明，$V_{z_n}$ 的合适不动点以近似对数方式逼近 $ζ$ 的非平凡零点；论文将该现象形式化为带射线限制的猜想，并证明了一个将有限极限识别为零点的条件性结果。
AI.conclusion: 数值与理论证据支持不动点逼近非平凡零点的对数模式猜想；作者说明了后续收敛性诊断的充分条件，并披露了本稿写作中使用了实质性 AI 辅助。

title: Neural Network-Assisted Refinement of Traditional Schemes for One-Dimensional Scalar Conservation Laws
summary: A clear link is established between conventional numerical methods and neural network approximations for solving one-dimensional scalar conservation laws. The focus is on the construction of an appropriate flux term in the case of convex flux functions for improving the classical schemes. The first neural network developed here is able to rediscover Godunov's method, while the second one emulates the behavior of a second-order slope-limiter function. In this way, by merging them, second-order reconstruction-based schemes can be developed. The networks presented here employ a minimal number of parameters, significantly reducing the complexity compared to previous approaches. These networks can also be linked consecutively to get a deep one corresponding to multiple time steps. Training them with an appropriate loss leads to stable schemes, improving even the classical methods without increasing their complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了传统数值方法与神经网络近似之间的联系，用于求解一维标量守恒律，通过构建最小参数网络的通量项，重现Godunov方法并模拟二阶斜率限制器，从而发展出低复杂度且稳定的二阶重构格式。
AI.motivation: 改进经典数值格式求解一维标量守恒律的精度，特别是针对凸通量函数情况下的通量项构造，同时避免已有神经网络方法参数过多、复杂度高的问题。
AI.method: 针对凸通量函数构造合适的通量项；第一个神经网络重现Godunov方法，第二个网络模拟二阶斜率限制函数行为；将二者合并以构建二阶重构格式；使用极少参数，并可连续连接形成对应多时间步的深层网络；采用合适损失函数进行训练。
AI.result: 所提网络能够重现Godunov方法并模拟二阶斜率限制器，合并后可形成二阶重构格式；参数数量最小，复杂度显著低于先前方法；训练后得到稳定格式，并在不增加复杂度的情况下改进了经典方法。
AI.conclusion: 传统数值方法与神经网络近似之间存在明确联系，最小参数网络可有效构造低复杂度的二阶重构格式，并在保持稳定性的同时提升经典方法的表现。

title: From Choked to Successful: The Role of Black Hole Spin in Collapsar Jet Breakout
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, Submitted. Comments and suggestions are welcome
summary: Long gamma-ray bursts (LGRBs) are believed to originate from the core collapse of massive Wolf-Rayet (WR) stars, leading to the formation of a spinning black hole that powers a relativistic jet. The prompt emission is produced once the jet emerges from the stellar envelope. We perform 2D axisymmetric RHD simulations using the PLUTO code to model semi-self-consistent, accretion-powered jets launched by Kerr black holes. For the two progenitor models, we adopt black hole masses of $4 M_{\odot}$ and $5 M_{\odot}$ corresponding to WR stars of $10 M_{\odot}$ and $25 M_{\odot}$, respectively. Unlike previous studies, our simulations employ continuous jet injection, with the injected power linked to black hole spin and accretion through an empirical relation motivated by GRMHD simulations, enabling a controlled exploration of jet energetics over $10^{48}$-$10^{52}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$. We investigate jet breakout for WR progenitors of $10\,M_{\odot}$ and $25\,M_{\odot}$ and identify a critical spin threshold: jets are choked for $a \leq 0.001$ and successfully break out for $a > 0.001$. The breakout time ($t_B$) shows a correlation with jet luminosity ($L_{\rm jet}$) and spin ($a$), revealing three regimes: Newtonian ($a \lesssim 0.03$), relativistic ($a \gtrsim 0.3$), and intermediate. A dichotomy is observed in jet head velocity at breakout, with $β_h \gtrsim 0.8$ for high-spin and $β_h \sim 0.35$-$0.8$ for lower spins. In the Newtonian regime, simulations yield $t_B \propto L_{\rm jet}^{-0.48}$, steeper than analytical predictions, with systematically longer breakout times indicating modified jet-head scaling. In the relativistic regime, calibrated analytical models show improved agreement, with simulations indicating efficient jet propagation.

AI.tldr: 通过2D RHD模拟研究长伽马射线暴喷流在WR前身星中的突破过程，发现临界自旋阈值a≈0.001，并揭示突破时间与喷流光度、自旋的三区间关系。
AI.motivation: 理解长伽马射线暴（LGRB）中相对论喷流能否成功穿透大质量WR星包层，以及黑洞自旋与吸积如何控制喷流能量学与突破条件。
AI.method: 使用PLUTO代码进行2D轴对称相对论流体力学（RHD）模拟，采用持续喷流注入，注入功率通过基于GRMHD模拟的经验关系与黑洞自旋和吸积率关联；针对10 M☉与25 M☉的WR前身星（对应4 M☉与5 M☉黑洞），在10^48–10^52 erg/s范围内系统扫描喷流能量学。
AI.result: 识别出临界自旋阈值：a≤0.001时喷流被扼制（choked），a>0.001时成功突破。突破时间t_B与喷流光度L_jet及自旋a相关，存在三个区间：牛顿区（a≲0.03）、相对论区（a≳0.3）及中间区。突破时喷流头部速度呈二分：高自旋β_h≳0.8，低自旋β_h~0.35–0.8。牛顿区模拟给出t_B∝L_jet^{-0.48}，比解析预言更陡，突破时间系统性偏长，表明喷流头部标度关系被修正；相对论区校准解析模型与模拟吻合更好，喷流传播效率高。
AI.conclusion: 黑洞自旋是决定LGRB喷流能否突破WR包层的关键参数，存在明确的临界自旋阈值和随自旋演化的三个喷流传播区间；牛顿区需修正喷流头部标度律，相对论区解析模型适用性更好。

title: Automorphic $C^*$-algebras of reductive groups
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive group over a number field $F$. We define $C^*_{\rm aut}(G(\mathbb A))$, the automorphic $C^*$-algebra of $G$, to be the $C^*$-algebraic image of the full automorphic representation of $G(\mathbb A)$ on $L^2(G(F)\backslash G(\mathbb A))$. Using the Langlands spectral decomposition with respect to discrete Levi data, we construct an injective $*$-homomorphism \[ C^*_{\rm aut}(G(\mathbb A)) \longrightarrow \bigoplus_{[M,σ]} K_{C_0(\widehat{A_M})} \left( \operatorname{Ind}_P^G C_0(\widehat{A_M},H_{M,σ}) \right)^{W(G,M,σ)}, \] where $[M,σ]$ ranges over the associate classes of discrete Levi data. When $G$ is $\operatorname{GL}(n)$ or an inner form of it, we prove that this map is an isomorphism of $C^*$-algebras.

AI.tldr: 本文定义约化群的自守$C^*$-代数$C^*_{\rm aut}(G(\mathbb A))$，利用Langlands谱分解构造其到离散Levi数据诱导表示的直和的单射$*$-同态，并证明当$G=\operatorname{GL}(n)$或其内形式时为$C^*$-代数同构。
AI.motivation: 自守表示论中$L^2(G(F)\backslash G(\mathbb A))$的谱分解已有丰富理论，但将其提升到$C^*$-代数层面并给出显式分解结构的工作尚不完善。作者希望用算子代数语言精确刻画自守$C^*$-代数，并给出可判定的分解定理。
AI.method: 定义$C^*_{\rm aut}(G(\mathbb A))$为全自守表示在$L^2(G(F)\backslash G(\mathbb A))$上的$C^*$-代数像；借助关于离散Levi数据的Langlands谱分解，构造到$\bigoplus_{[M,\sigma]} K_{C_0(\widehat{A_M})}(\operatorname{Ind}_P^G C_0(\widehat{A_M},H_{M,\sigma}))^{W(G,M,\sigma)}$的单射$*$-同态。
AI.result: 得到从$C^*_{\rm aut}(G(\mathbb A))$到上述直和的单射$*$-同态，其中$[M,\sigma]$取遍离散Levi数据的相伴类；当$G$为$\operatorname{GL}(n)$或其内形式时，该映射为$C^*$-代数同构。
AI.conclusion: 该结果给出了自守$C^*$-代数的一个显式分解，并在$\operatorname{GL}(n)$情形下完全刻画其结构，为用算子代数方法研究自守谱提供了框架。

title: Cubature-Based Statistical Moment Steering for Nonlinear, Non-Gaussian Trajectory Optimization
summary: This paper addresses discrete-time non-Gaussian distribution steering in deterministic nonlinear systems. Distribution steering is a problem in which a control policy is designed over a distribution of trajectories rather than optimizing a single trajectory. The challenge with nonlinear systems is that even initially Gaussian distributions evolve into non-Gaussian distributions, often precluding a closed-form representation of the probability density. A method called statistical moment steering applies a cubature-based method to approximate non-Gaussian distributions for an approximate solution to this problem. This paper provides theoretical support and details how it can be solved with sequential convex optimization. A coupled, nonlinear, second-order ordinary differential equation describing a two-dimensional oscillator is provided as a numerical example.

AI.tldr: 本文研究确定性非线性系统的离散时间非高斯分布引导问题，提出基于统计矩引导与序列凸优化的求解方法，并给出理论支撑与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 分布引导需针对轨迹分布而非单条轨迹设计控制策略。非线性系统即使初始分布为高斯，演化后也会变为非高斯，概率密度通常无闭式表达，导致问题难以精确求解。
AI.method: 采用统计矩引导方法，利用基于容积（cubature）的方法近似非高斯分布以得到近似解；并给出理论支持，说明如何通过序列凸优化求解该问题。
AI.result: 以描述二维振子的耦合非线性二阶常微分方程为数值算例进行验证。
AI.conclusion: 统计矩引导结合容积近似与序列凸优化，可为确定性非线性系统的非高斯分布引导问题提供理论支撑与可实现的求解途径。

title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
summary: Pretrained robot policies offer strong manipulation skills but are typically limited to single-agent settings, where a robot acts in isolation. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained single-agent diffusion policies to multi-agent settings using minimal collaborative data, co-optimizing for two key objectives: high coordination performance and single-agent skill retention. To this end, we introduce ALTER, an adaptation method for coordination on demand: the adapted policy coordinates with other robots when deployed in a team while remaining capable of acting independently when operating alone. Execution is decentralized: each robot acts only on its own visual observations, without explicit inter-agent communication. Our method trains a coordination head that predicts a residual denoiser to transform single-agent behavior into coordinated multi-agent behavior when necessary while also preserving single-agent capabilities. To preserve single-agent capabilities, we augment a small number of collaborative demonstrations with self-distilled data generated by the base policy during training of the residual denoiser. In simulation,ALTER achieves higher coordination success over our baselines while retaining much higher source-skill retention. In our hardware experiments, we find similar trends where ALTER better co-optimizes for coordination success and single-agent skill retention than the baselines

AI.tldr: ALTER：将预训练单智能体扩散策略通过少量协作数据适配为去中心化多智能体策略，兼顾协调性能与单智能体技能保持。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略操作能力强，但通常局限于单智能体场景；如何在极少协作数据下适配到多智能体，同时不遗忘原有单智能体技能，是核心问题。
AI.method: 提出 ALTER，按需协调的适配方法。训练一个协调头，预测残差去噪器，在需要时将单智能体行为转换为协调的多智能体行为；执行完全去中心化，各机器人仅依赖自身视觉观测，无显式通信。训练残差去噪器时，用基座策略自蒸馏生成的数据增强少量协作示范，以保持单智能体能力。
AI.result: 仿真中，ALTER 的协调成功率高于基线，且源技能保持率显著更高；硬件实验中呈现类似趋势，在协调成功与单智能体技能保持的协同优化上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差去噪与自蒸馏增强，可在最小协作数据下把预训练单智能体扩散策略有效扩展为去中心化多智能体策略，实现协调与技能保持的双目标协同优化。

title: Stacky Heights, Entropy, and Zeta Functions of Weighted Hypersurfaces over Finite Fields
summary: Let \(X\subset \mathbb P^n_{\mathbf w}\) be a weighted hypersurface over \(\mathbb F_q\), with associated stack \(\mathfrak X\). For \(\mathbf x\in X(\mathbb F_{q^r})\), let \(g_{\mathbf x}(r)=\gcd(k_{S(\mathbf x)},q^r-1)\), where \(k_S=\gcd(w_i:i\in S)\), and define \(Θ_r(s)=\sum_{\mathbf x}g_{\mathbf x}(r)^{1-s}\) and \(Z_H^{\mathrm{can}}(\mathfrak X,s;t)=\exp(\sum_{r\ge1}Θ_r(s)t^r/r)\). We prove the finite sector factorization \[ Z_H^{\mathrm{can}}(\mathfrak X,s;t)=\prod_{e\in E_{\mathbf w}} Z(X^{(e)}_{\mathbb F_{q^{o_e}}},t^{o_e})^{J_{1-s}(e)/o_e}, \] where \(X^{(e)}\) is the closed isotropy sector, \(o_e=\operatorname{ord}_e(q)\) for \(e>1\) and \(o_1=1\), and \(J_{1-s}\) is the Jordan totient function. Hence the specializations \(s=1,0,-1,-2,\ldots\) are rational in \(t\): \(s=1\) gives the Hasse--Weil zeta function of the coarse space, \(s=0\) the twist zeta function, and \(s=1-k\) the masses of the \(k\)-fold inertia stack. The factorization yields a functional equation when the nonempty sectors are self-dual and equidimensional; if they are also pure and geometrically irreducible, equidimensionality is necessary for every integral \(s\le0\). For weighted diagonal hypersurfaces of degree \(D\) with \(p\nmid D\), a finite Fermat cover gives purity and self-duality. We also prove a Lang--Weil asymptotic for isotropy entropy, with periodic leading term governed by isotropy periods and Frobenius orbits, and identify the function-field height with the stable stack height of Ellenberg--Satriano--Zureick-Brown, while the degree-based height remains a coordinate-complexity statistic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加权超曲面栈的典范高度zeta函数，证明其可分解为各等稳扇区上曲线的zeta函数之积，从而给出各整数特化的有理性与函数方程，并建立等稳熵的Lang--Weil渐近。
AI.motivation: 加权超曲面上的有理点计数受权重与奇点影响，其堆栈结构（等稳扇区、惯性栈）与算术不变量（Hasse--Weil zeta、twist zeta、质量）之间的关系尚缺乏统一的“高度zeta函数”框架；同时希望将函数域高度与堆栈高度理论对应起来。
AI.method: 定义以g_x(r)=gcd(k_{S(x)},q^r-1)加权、经Jordan totient函数加权的典范高度zeta函数Z_H^{can}(𝔛,s;t)；通过有限扇区分解把整体zeta函数写成闭等稳扇区X^{(e)}（在F_{q^{o_e}}上）的zeta函数之积；对加权对角超曲面（p∤D）用有限Fermat覆盖证明纯度与自对偶性；并分析等稳熵的Frobenius轨道与周期的渐近行为。
AI.result: 得到有限扇区分解Z_H^{can}=∏_{e∈E_w} Z(X^{(e)}_{F_{q^{o_e}}},t^{o_e})^{J_{1-s}(e)/o_e}；由此s=1,0,-1,-2,…处取值有理：s=1为粗空间Hasse--Weil zeta，s=0为twist zeta，s=1-k为k重惯性栈质量；当非空扇区自对偶且等维时满足函数方程，且对纯、几何不可约且自对偶的扇区，整数s≤0处的等维性是必要的；还给出等稳熵的Lang--Weil渐近（周期主项），并识别函数域高度为Ellenberg--Satriano--Zureick-Brown稳定堆栈高度。
AI.conclusion: 该分解将加权超曲面栈的算术不变量统一为等稳扇区zeta函数的乘积，刻画了特化点的有理性与函数方程条件；等维性在s≤0时对自对偶纯扇区是必要的；函数域高度对应稳定堆栈高度，而基于次数的高度仅反映坐标复杂度。

title: Amortized Generative Modeling of Invariant Measures across A Family of Kuramoto-Sivashinsky PDEs
summary: The long-run statistics of chaotic dissipative partial differential equations are described by invariant measures, and when the equation carries a parameter these measures form a family whose members can differ in kind, from steady states to sustained spatiotemporal chaos. We ask whether a single generative model can cover such a family. We train a single conditional diffusion model once, on states of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation at 160 values of its hyperviscosity, and evaluate it against held-out data at interleaved parameter values not seen in training, using a classifier two-sample test supported by spectral, geometric and tail statistics. Over most of the family, agreement improves as the dynamics become more chaotic. We identify a structural cause: the weakly chaotic members have invariant measures concentrated on low-dimensional sets, which a model with full support output cannot represent, and the target approaches full dimensionality as chaos increases. Restricting training to the strongly chaotic members reduces the classifier's excess over chance on those members by roughly 40%, and this restricted conditional model matches or exceeds models trained at single parameter values. On those members, generated samples reproduce energy spectra to within a resampling floor, with a small systematic deficit at the largest scales, and match the energy balance of held-out data.

AI.tldr: 训练单个条件扩散模型覆盖Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程在160个超粘性参数下的不变测度族，在留出参数上评估：越混沌的参数吻合越好，弱混沌成员因测度集中在低维集而难以被全支撑生成模型刻画，限制训练到强混沌成员可显著改善。
AI.motivation: 混沌耗散偏微分方程的参数化不变测度族在性质上差异巨大（从稳态到持续时空混沌），作者希望探究单个生成模型能否统一覆盖这一族测度，从而检验生成模型刻画参数化混沌动力学长期统计的能力与局限。
AI.method: 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程于160个超粘性参数取值下的状态上，一次性训练单个条件扩散模型；在训练未见的交错参数值上以留出数据评估，采用分类器双样本检验，并辅以谱、几何与尾部统计。
AI.result: 在测度族的大部分区域，随着动力学更混沌，生成样本与真实数据的一致性提高。弱混沌成员的不变测度集中于低维集，而全支撑输出模型无法表示。仅用强混沌成员训练使这些成员上分类器超出随机水平的程度降低约40%，且该受限条件模型达到或超过单一参数值训练的模型；在强混沌成员上，生成样本的能量谱在重采样误差底之下与真实一致，仅在最大尺度上有轻微系统性缺失，且能量收支与留出数据吻合。
AI.conclusion: 单个条件扩散模型可覆盖参数化混沌PDE不变测度族的大部分，但对弱混沌、低维测度成员存在结构性局限；聚焦强混沌区训练可缓解该问题，并在未见参数上达到与逐参数模型相当或更优的性能，说明生成模型的有效性与目标测度的内蕴维度密切相关。

title: Jet Forecast: Timing of Discrete Jet Ejections of Stellar-Mass Black Holes Anticipated via X-ray Properties
comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ, 12 pages, 4 figures
summary: The radio -- soft $γ$-ray data of the Galactic black hole binary XTE J1859+226 showed that discrete jets are launched when the inner radius of the accretion disk ($R_{\rm in}$) rapidly approaches the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). Given the correlations among the X-ray fractional variability amplitude (rms), $R_{\rm in}$, and the X-ray hardness, previous phenomenological findings related to jet ejections (``jet line'' and sharp drops of rms) also indicate that the rapid shrinkage of $R_{\rm in}$ down to the ISCO turns on the jet formation. In order to make clear how these properties appear in other objects, we investigated the X-ray and radio data of XTE J1550-564, GX 339-4, and MAXI J1820+070. We found that all the four sources show drops of $R_{\rm in}$ and rms 1-10 days ahead of a jet activity, and exhibit no huge jumps of the accretion rates prior to jet ejections. XTE J1859 and MAXI J1820 show the jet activities under sub-Eddington accretion. Models for the jet production that require an enhancement of $\dot{M}$ or a super-Eddington accretion rate are unlikely. Another behavior common to multiple sources is the curved shape of the rms--$R_{\rm in}$ correlation. Therefore, monitoring of $R_{\rm in}$ seems to be suitable to predict the timing of jet ejections. When both $R_{\rm in}$ and rms continuously decrease and when $R_{\rm in}$ is about to reach the ISCO, alerts can be circulated as a ``jet forecast'' for triggering Target-of-Opportunity observations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究银河系黑洞双星中喷流发射与吸积盘内半径($R_{\rm in}$)缩小至ISCO的关系，发现四个源在喷流活动前1-10天均出现$R_{\rm in}$和rms下降，且无需吸积率剧增或超爱丁顿吸积，提出通过监测$R_{\rm in}$进行"喷流预报"。
AI.motivation: XTE J1859+226的射电-软γ射线数据显示，离散喷流在内半径$R_{\rm in}$快速接近ISCO时发射。为验证这一现象是否普遍存在于其他天体，需考察更多源的X射线与射电数据。
AI.method: 分析XTE J1859+226、XTE J1550-564、GX 339-4和MAXI J1820+070四个黑洞双星的X射线与射电观测数据，考察$R_{\rm in}$、X射线分数变率幅度(rms)与X射线硬度的相关性及与喷流活动的时间关系。
AI.result: 四个源均在喷流活动前1-10天出现$R_{\rm in}$和rms下降，且喷流前无吸积率剧增。XTE J1859和MAXI J1820在亚爱丁顿吸积下即表现喷流活动。多个源共同呈现rms-$R_{\rm in}$关系的弯曲形状。
AI.conclusion: 要求吸积率增强或超爱丁顿吸积的喷流模型不太可能成立。监测$R_{\rm in}$可预测喷流发射时机：当$R_{\rm in}$与rms持续下降且$R_{\rm in}$接近ISCO时，可发出"喷流预报"警报以触发机遇目标观测。

title: Exceptional poles of archimedean Asai $L$-functions
summary: Let $π$ be an irreducible generic representation of $\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$. We classify the exceptional poles of the associated Asai $L$-function $L(s,π,\mathrm{As})$ and give a representation-theoretic characterization of them. When $π$ is in general position, we further express $L(s,π,\mathrm{As})$ in terms of the exceptional $L$-factors attached to the irreducible constituents occurring in the derivatives of $π$.

AI.tldr: 本文对 $\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ 上不可约通用表示的 Asai $L$-函数的例外极点进行了分类与表示论刻画，并在一般位置情形下用导子中不可约成分的例外 $L$-因子表达了该 $L$-函数。
AI.motivation: Asai $L$-函数在自守表示与 Langlands 纲领中具有重要地位，其解析性质（尤其是极点结构）与表示本身的算术、表示论信息密切相关。然而对 $\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ 上通用表示的 Asai $L$-函数的例外极点尚缺乏系统分类与表示论解释，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 设 $\pi$ 为 $\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ 的不可约通用表示，研究其 Asai $L$-函数 $L(s,\pi,\mathrm{As})$ 的例外极点，对其进行分类并给出表示论刻画；在 $\pi$ 处于一般位置时，借助 $\pi$ 的导子中出现的不可约成分所对应的例外 $L$-因子，给出 $L(s,\pi,\mathrm{As})$ 的表达式。
AI.result: 完成了对 Asai $L$-函数例外极点的分类，并给出了这些例外极点的表示论刻画；在一般位置情形下，将 $L(s,\pi,\mathrm{As})$ 表示为 $\pi$ 的导子中不可约成分的例外 $L$-因子的组合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了 Asai $L$-函数的例外极点与表示导子结构之间的内在联系，为通过表示论数据理解 $L$-函数解析行为提供了新的途径。

title: Plug-and-Play Methods Provably Converge Even with Improperly Trained Denoisers: Convergence by Architectural Design
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods replace proximal operators with learned denoisers, which produce state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, but sacrifice the variational interpretation and convergence guarantees of proximal methods. Learned Proximal Networks (LPNs) address this problem by designing the denoiser architecture so that it is exactly the proximal operator of a regularizer. In this work, we clarify the theoretical foundations of LPNs and extend the framework to a broader class of activation functions. We then study two practical mechanisms for controlling the learned prior: (i) averaging the LPN with the identity, a common heuristic in PnP methods, and (ii) directly scaling the implicit regularizer induced by the proximal operator. In particular, we characterize the regularizer induced by averaging and develop a convergent method for evaluating the scaled proximal operator.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了学习近端网络（LPN）的理论基础，将其扩展到更广泛的激活函数类别，并研究了两种控制学习先验的实用机制：LPN与恒等映射的平均，以及隐式正则器的直接缩放。
AI.motivation: PnP方法用学习到的去噪器替代近端算子，虽能获得最优重建质量，但牺牲了变分解释和收敛保证。LPN通过设计去噪器架构使其恰为正则器的近端算子来解决该问题，但理论基础和框架适用范围仍需澄清与扩展。
AI.method: 1）澄清LPN的理论基础，并将框架扩展到更广泛的激活函数类别；2）研究两种控制学习先验的机制：(i) 将LPN与恒等映射平均（PnP中的常见启发式），(ii) 直接缩放由近端算子诱导的隐式正则器；3）刻画平均所诱导的正则器，并开发评估缩放近端算子的收敛方法。
AI.result: 扩展了LPN框架以涵盖更广泛的激活函数；刻画了LPN与恒等映射平均后所诱导的正则器；提出了评估缩放近端算子的收敛方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LPN提供了更清晰的理论基础并拓宽了其适用范围，同时为控制学习先验提供了两种有理论保障的实用机制。

title: GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
summary: In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration. Code is available at https://github.com/EurekaZang/CalibAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出 GAUGE 框架，用于规划器条件下的四足速度接口主动标定：在规划器诱导的命令分布下，以期望认知不确定性缩减选择试验，实现任务导向的精度与不确定性联合达标，并在仿真导航地图上达到非劣性。
AI.motivation: 商用四足机器人通常只暴露平面速度命令接口，底层运动控制器不可访问，导致"指令速度—实际运动"存在系统性偏差；而导航规划器实际只使用命令空间的一个结构化子集，因此无需全域密集标定，需要针对任务相关区域高效标定并量化不确定性。
AI.method: 维护贝叶斯"命令—运动"模型，在规划器诱导的命令分布下按期望后验认知不确定性缩减量选取授权试验；基于所得后验实现验证式停止准则、有界逆补偿，以及接口漂移检测后的任务相关重标定。
AI.result: 在三类受控响应族中，GAUGE 以少于被动采集、D-最优和任务无关方法的试验次数，同时满足任务相关精度与不确定性的联合判据；在六张留出的 Isaac Sim 导航地图上，达到相对于密集标定的预设非劣性边界。
AI.conclusion: 任务与规划器感知的主动标定可显著降低四足速度接口标定成本，同时提供不确定性量化与漂移后重标定能力，具备替代密集标定的潜力。

title: The Beilinson--Bloch heights of generalized Ceresa cycles
summary: We compute the Beilinson--Bloch height of the generalized Ceresa cycle $\mathrm{Ce}(V)=\frac 1 2(V-[-1]V)$ for any cycle $V$ of pure dimension $d$ on an abelian variety $A$, in terms of an arithmetic intersection number of a certain adelic line bundle. As an application, we prove that this height is given by an adelic line bundle over algebraic families.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了阿贝尔簇上一类广义Ceresa cycle的Beilinson–Bloch高度，将其表示为某adelic线丛的算术相交数，并证明该高度可由代数族上的adelic线丛给出。
AI.motivation: Beilinson–Bloch高度是算术代数几何中研究代数闭链的重要不变量，而Ceresa cycle及其广义形式与阿贝尔簇上的富性质、Bloch–Beilinson猜想密切相关。此前对该高度的显式计算尚不充分，作者希望给出其明确的adelic相交数刻画，并理解其在代数族中的行为。
AI.method: 对阿贝尔簇 $A$ 上任意纯维数 $d$ 的闭链 $V$，定义广义 Ceresa cycle $\mathrm{Ce}(V)=\frac{1}{2}(V-[-1]V)$，通过构造与该闭链相关的特定 adelic 线丛，用其算术相交数（arithmetic intersection number）来表示 Beilinson–Bloch 高度。
AI.result: 给出了广义 Ceresa cycle 的 Beilinson–Bloch 高度的一个显式表达，即等于某 adelic 线丛的算术相交数；并进一步证明该高度可由代数族上的 adelic 线丛给出。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将广义 Ceresa cycle 的 Beilinson–Bloch 高度纳入 adelic 线丛与算术相交理论的框架，为研究阿贝尔簇闭链的算术高度以及其在代数族中的变化提供了新工具。

title: Finite Element Analysis of Maxwell's Equations with Time-Varying Coefficients and Nonlinear E-H Coupling: Convergence and Exponential Decay
summary: This paper analyzes finite element approximations for Maxwell's equations with time-dependent coefficients and nonlinear E-H coupling in both the total current density and the Silver-Müller-type boundary condition. The nonlinear coupling and the time-varying material parameters prevent the use of standard analytical tools, including the discrete compactness property and the Minty-Browder argument, making the numerical analysis particularly challenging. As the main novelty, we establish two primary contributions: Uniform convergence on every finite time interval $[0,T]$ and exponential stability on the infinite time horizon $[0,\infty)$. The uniform convergence is established via a Cauchy-type argument within a time-dependent Hilbert space framework that entirely bypasses Minty's trick and the discrete compactness argument. Furthermore, under a positive homogeneity assumption on the nonlinearities, the exponential stability is analyzed by means of a nonlinear sup-max problem arising from ratios of consecutive discrete energies. With this strategy, we ultimately prove a fully discrete unconditional exponential decay result under a specific sufficient condition. In the absence of this condition, a concrete counterexample shows that the energy decay fails to hold. Numerical experiments are provided to validate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 该文研究含时变系数与非线性E-H耦合的Maxwell方程的有限元逼近，在时变Hilbert空间框架下以Cauchy型论证证明任意有限时间区间上的一致收敛，并在正齐次性假设下借助非线性sup-max问题证明全离散无条件指数衰减，同时给出条件缺失时的反例与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 非线性耦合与时变材料参数使得离散紧性性质与Minty-Browder论证等标准分析工具失效，数值分析面临实质困难，需要发展绕开这些工具的新框架。
AI.method: 在时变Hilbert空间框架中采用Cauchy型论证建立一致收敛，完全避开Minty技巧与离散紧性论证；在非线性项正齐次性假设下，通过由相邻离散能量之比构造的非线性sup-max问题分析指数稳定性。
AI.result: 证明了任意有限时间区间[0,T]上的一致收敛，以及在特定充分条件下全离散的无条件指数衰减；并给出具体反例说明该条件缺失时能量衰减不成立；数值实验验证了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为时变、非线性耦合Maxwell方程的有限元分析提供了不依赖离散紧性与Minty技巧的新途径，并刻画了指数稳定性的充分条件及其必要性边界。

title: Investigating signatures of extinct PeVatron activity in supernova remnants IC 443 and W51 C
summary: Context. Supernova remnants (SNRs) are renewed sources of non-thermal particles and the main contributors of Galactic cosmic rays (CRs). Recent ultra-high energy (UHE) gamma-ray data from middle-aged SNRs, such as IC 443 and W51 C, highlight the key role of these systems for particle acceleration. Understanding SNR contribution to PeV CRs requires a detailed modelling about how accelerated particles escape their shocks and are released inside the Galaxy. Aims. We aim at critically assessing the SNR paradigm for the origin of Galactic CRs by investigating the expected secondary radiation produced by hadronic collisions of confined and escaping protons in SNRs, and compare these to recent UHE observations. Methods. Through a time-dependent analytical model describing particle acceleration at the SNR forward shock, we investigate particle escape from the shock expanding into uniform environment and diffusing inside and outside the SNR. Results. Our results support the interpretation that the gamma-ray emission from W51 C and IC 443 is due to hadronic emission from both confined and escaping protons, allowing us to derive robust constraints on the particle maximum energy, the magnetic field amplification process, and the CR acceleration efficiency in these systems. Conclusions. We find that the acceleration efficiency is in the range 1 - 10% (2 - 12%) when the spectrum of accelerated particles is proportional to p^-4 (p^-4.3) and the in-situ diffusion coefficient is suppressed by a factor of 3-10 compared to the average Galactic value. On the other hand, the particle maximum energy ever achieved falls, by a factor of a few, below the PeV energy required to explain the CR knee in the context of SNRs only.

AI.tldr: 本文通过含时解析模型研究超新星遗迹（SNR）中受限与逃逸质子的强子碰撞次级辐射，以约束粒子最大能量、磁场放大和宇宙线加速效率。
AI.motivation: IC 443 和 W51C 等中年 SNR 的甚高能伽马射线数据凸显其在粒子加速中的关键作用；理解 SNR 对 PeV 宇宙线的贡献需要细致刻画粒子如何逃逸激波并在银河系中扩散。
AI.method: 采用含时解析模型描述 SNR 前向激波的粒子加速，研究粒子在均匀介质激波上的逃逸及在 SNR 内外部的扩散，计算受限与逃逸质子强子碰撞产生的次级辐射。
AI.result: W51C 和 IC 443 的伽马射线发射可解释为受限与逃逸质子的强子辐射；加速效率在谱指数 p^-4 时为 1-10%，p^-4.3 时为 2-12%，原位扩散系数相比银河系平均值被抑制 3-10 倍。
AI.conclusion: 粒子达到的最大能量比解释宇宙线膝区所需的 PeV 能量低数倍，SNR 单独解释银河系 PeV 宇宙线面临挑战。

title: Structure of derived Hecke algebras with coefficients in torsion-free profinite rings
summary: In this article, we study derived Hecke algebras with coefficients in torsion-free profinite rings regarded as discrete rings. We compare each such algebra with the degreewise inverse limit of the derived Hecke algebras with coefficients in finite rings and with its subalgebra consisting of elements with uniformly finite double-coset support. Under cohomological comparison hypotheses, the natural map to this subalgebra has image given by its degree-zero part and its positive-degree torsion. We describe the kernel in terms of continuous cohomology and prove that it is a divisible square-zero ideal annihilated by every positive-degree element. These comparisons are compatible with Yoneda products, and the action on torsion Ext classes factors through the image. We compute the resulting algebras for the additive group $\mathbb{Q}_p$ and determine the underlying graded abelian groups for $(\operatorname{GL}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p),\operatorname{GL}_2(\mathbb{Z}_p))$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{Z}_p$, for $p>3$. The examples exhibit distinct effects of the coefficient topology and the support condition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究系数在无挠profinite环（视为离散环）中的derived Hecke代数，将其与有限系数derived Hecke代数的逐度逆极限及其“一致有限双陪集支撑”子代数进行比较，并在上同调比较假设下刻画自然映射的像与核，最后计算若干具体例子。
AI.motivation: derived Hecke代数在系数取profinite环时，系数拓扑与双陪集支撑条件会同时产生影响，但二者如何相互作用、自然映射的像与核如何描述尚不清晰，因此需要系统的比较理论。
AI.method: 定义系数在无挠profinite环（视为离散环）中的derived Hecke代数；与有限系数版本的逐度逆极限及一致有限双陪集支撑子代数作比较；在上同调比较假设下分析自然映射的像（次数零部分与正次数挠部分）与核（用连续上同调描述，证其为可除平方零理想且被所有正次数元素零化）；验证与Yoneda乘积的兼容性及对挠Ext类的作用分解；对加性群Q_p及(GL_2(Q_p),GL_2(Z_p))（p>3，系数Z_p）作具体计算。
AI.result: 在上同调比较假设下，到子代数的自然映射的像由次数零部分与正次数挠部分构成；核可由连续上同调刻画，为可除平方零理想且被每个正次数元素零化。这些比较与Yoneda乘积兼容，且对挠Ext类的作用经由该像分解。计算得到Q_p对应的代数，并确定p>3时(GL_2(Q_p),GL_2(Z_p))、Z_p系数下底层的分次阿贝尔群。
AI.conclusion: 系数拓扑与支撑条件在derived Hecke代数上产生彼此不同的效应，比较理论能统一刻画这些效应并给出可计算的结构结果。

title: Sharp Critical Minimax Laws and No-Learning Thresholds in Continuous-Time Adaptive Control
summary:
We study episodic continuous-time control with an unknown vector control gain, scalar state, quadratic action cost, and smooth convex terminal cost. In the scalar Gaussian experiment, let $Δ(H)$ denote the minimax improvement over zero control and set $δ=\sqrt2H^2-1$. We prove the critical law
  $$ Δ(H)\asymp δ^4\sqrt{\log(1/δ)} \qquad (δ\downarrow0), $$
  with a matching lower and upper bound. The lower bound follows from a uniform deficit--energy inequality valid for fully adaptive controls with unbounded amplitudes, while a moving soft-threshold feedback attains the rate.
  For local parameters $θ=N^{-1/4}h$, $|h|\le H$, we show that the normalized minimax regret over $N$ episodes is within $O(N^{-1/2})$ of a fixed-horizon Gaussian sequential control problem, without an additional dimension factor. The terminal task enters the limit only through $c_g=\operatorname{Var}(g(Z))$. The Gaussian problem exhibits an exact no-learning phase transition:
  $$ C_d^T(H)=TH^2/2 \iff H^4T\le d^2/2, $$
  yielding the asymptotic task boundary $c_gH^4=d^2/2$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究未知向量控制增益、标量状态、二次动作代价与光滑凸终端代价的回合式连续时间控制。核心结果给出标量高斯实验中相对零控制的极小极大改进临界律 Δ(H)≍δ⁴√log(1/δ)（δ↓0），并刻画了有无学习相变边界 c_g H⁴=d²/2。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间回合控制理论对未知控制增益下“学习能否带来收益”的临界条件缺乏精确刻画，尤其是极小极大改进速率与相变边界。作者旨在建立可匹配上下界的临界律，并将局部参数下的归一化遗憾归约到固定时域高斯序贯控制问题。
AI.method: 设 Δ(H) 为标量高斯实验中相对零控制的极小极大改进，δ=√2 H²−1。下界通过一个对所有完全自适应、幅度无界控制均成立的一致亏损—能量不等式得到；上界由移动软阈值反馈策略达到。对局部参数 θ=N^{−1/4}h（|h|≤H），将 N 回合归一化极小极大遗憾与固定时域高斯序贯控制问题比较，证明误差为 O(N^{−1/2})，且不含额外维度因子；终端任务仅通过 c_g=Var(g(Z)) 进入极限。相变通过 C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 ⟺ H⁴T≤d²/2 精确刻画。
AI.result: 证明临界律 Δ(H)≍δ⁴√log(1/δ)（δ↓0），上下界匹配。归一化极小极大遗憾与固定时域高斯序贯控制问题相差 O(N^{−1/2})，终端任务仅由 c_g=Var(g(Z)) 决定。高斯问题存在精确无学习相变：C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 ⟺ H⁴T≤d²/2，对应渐近任务边界 c_g H⁴=d²/2。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了连续时间回合控制中学习收益的精确临界律与相变边界：当 c_g H⁴≤d²/2 时无法通过控制获得超过零控制的收益；超过边界后学习才产生改进。方法上结合亏损—能量下界与移动软阈值上界，并通过遗憾归约去除了维度因子。

title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
summary: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

AI.tldr: RecastVLA 提出在流匹配 VLA 策略中以共享快速权重表示自适应策略状态，使动作生成过程本身形成持久状态，从而在无专家动作标签的测试时训练下提升序列操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 序列操作要求机器人跟踪已发生的交互，即便当前场景已无法反映历史；显式历史表示的策略可将过去交互作为当前决策的上下文，本文进一步探究动作生成过程本身能否构成后续控制所需的持久状态。
AI.method: 基于动作侧测试时训练，在流匹配视觉-语言-动作策略中维护自适应策略状态：状态由共享快速权重表示并在整个动作生成过程中保持固定；深度专用接口读取同一状态，不同深度与流评估的特征共同定义下一次策略调用的单次更新；后续动作损失通过可微穿越早期状态转移来训练初始化、接口与更新规则；部署时更新仅使用策略自身的动作生成特征，无需专家动作标签。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 及十二项真机任务上，RecastVLA 相比未使用测试时训练的匹配策略取得更高平均成功率，其中 RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean 提升 10.68 个百分点；受控 RoboTwin 对比显示保留状态可提升成功率，且共享设计比独立训练的逐层 TTT 高 2.58 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作生成过程可作为持久策略状态的载体，共享快速权重的测试时训练设计在多种仿真与真机任务上优于无 TTT 基线及逐层独立 TTT，验证了状态保留与跨层共享的有效性。

title: Prime-Detecting Identities from Dirichlet Inversion
summary: For each integer $k\geq1$, let $σ_k(n)=\sum_{d\mid n}d^k$, let $σ_k^{-1}$ denote its Dirichlet inverse, and let $J_k$ denote the $k$th Jordan totient function. For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, define $F_k(n)=σ_k^{-1}(n)+μ(n)+J_k(n)+3$. We determine the zero set of $F_k$ completely. We prove that $F_1(n)=0$ if and only if $n$ is prime or $n=18$, whereas for every $k\geq2$, $F_k(n)=0$ if and only if $n$ is prime. The proof uses the convolution identities $σ_k=\mathbf{1}*I_k$ and $J_k=μ*I_k$, where $I_k(n)=n^k$, together with an explicit prime-power formula for $σ_k^{-1}$ and a classification by prime-exponent patterns. We also prove the companion characterization $σ_k^{-1}(n)+n^k=-1$ if and only if $n$ is prime, for $k\geq1$ and $n>1$. Lambert-series coefficient identities recover the three constituent functions, while an exact intermediate-divisor relation explains the connection between the two characterizations and the exceptional value $18$.

AI.tldr: 本文完整确定数论函数 $F_k(n)=\sigma_k^{-1}(n)+\mu(n)+J_k(n)+3$ 的零点集：$k=1$ 时 $F_1(n)=0$ 当且仅当 $n$ 为素数或 $n=18$；$k\ge2$ 时 $F_k(n)=0$ 当且仅当 $n$ 为素数。
AI.motivation: 研究由除数幂和函数 $\sigma_k$ 的 Dirichlet 逆、Möbius 函数 $\mu$ 与 Jordan  totient 函数 $J_k$ 线性组合而成的函数 $F_k$ 的零点分布，刻画其零点集合与素数之间的对应关系，并揭示两族特征刻画之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 利用卷积恒等式 $\sigma_k=\mathbf{1}*I_k$ 与 $J_k=\mu*I_k$（其中 $I_k(n)=n^k$），给出 $\sigma_k^{-1}$ 的显式素数幂公式，并按素数指数模式进行分类讨论；同时借助 Lambert 级数系数恒等式还原各构成函数，并用精确的中间除数关系解释两种刻画与例外值 18 的关联。
AI.result: 完整确定了 $F_k$ 的零点集：$F_1(n)=0 \iff n$ 为素数或 $n=18$；对每个 $k\ge2$，$F_k(n)=0 \iff n$ 为素数。并证明了伴随刻画 $\sigma_k^{-1}(n)+n^k=-1 \iff n$ 为素数（$k\ge1,\ n>1$）。
AI.conclusion: $F_k$ 的零点几乎完全由素数构成，仅 $k=1$ 时出现唯一的合数例外 $n=18$；该例外及两族刻画之间的联系可由中间除数关系加以解释。

title: A Spectral Model-Informed Neural Network for Inverse Source Problems
summary: In this paper, we propose an unsupervised, two-step model-informed deep learning framework for solving the inverse source problem. In the first step, boundary measurement data are transformed into an imaging function that encodes information about the shape and location of the unknown source. Leveraging this information, we derive a Fourier-based model equation in the spectral domain that relates the imaging function to the Fourier coefficients of the source function. In the second step, this model equation is incorporated into the training of a model-informed neural network to recover the parameters of interest. The proposed approach enables fast and accurate reconstruction of the source function while maintaining robustness to noise. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through numerical experiments in both two- and three-dimensional settings. For the two-dimensional case, we further compare our approach with the traditional least-squares method to validate its computational efficiency and reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无监督、两步式模型驱动深度学习框架求解逆源问题：先将边界测量转为成像函数，再在谱域推导Fourier模型方程并嵌入模型驱动神经网络训练，实现快速、精确且抗噪的源函数重建。
AI.motivation: 逆源问题需由边界测量重构未知源，传统方法（如最小二乘）在效率与精度、以及噪声鲁棒性方面存在不足，因此需要结合物理模型与深度学习的优势。
AI.method: 两步框架：第一步将边界测量数据转换为编码源形状与位置信息的成像函数，并据此在谱域推导连接成像函数与源函数Fourier系数的Fourier模型方程；第二步将该模型方程嵌入模型驱动神经网络的训练中以恢复待求参数，全程无监督。
AI.result: 二维与三维数值实验验证了方法的有效性，可实现快速准确的源函数重建并保持噪声鲁棒性；二维情形下与传统最小二乘法对比，验证了其计算效率与重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型驱动深度学习框架能高效、精确且鲁棒地求解逆源问题，优于传统最小二乘方法。

title: JWST unveils a dust-obscured supernova associated with a gamma-ray burst
summary: Recent observations have challenged the duration-based classification of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), making the detection of an associated supernova (SN) or kilonova crucial for conclusively identifying their progenitors. We investigate the origin of GRB 240825A at $z=0.659$, whose prompt emission gave conflicting indications of a merger or collapsar origin and for which no SN was detected in deep ground-based observations. We analyze JWST/NIRSpec observations obtained 66.5 days (40.1 days in the rest frame) after the burst. We identify a SN signal using a pixel-by-pixel decomposition of the 2D spectrum and isolate it by jointly modeling the host and transient emission. We constrain the line of sight extinction from the afterglow spectral energy distribution and characterize the host through broadband photometry and nebular emission lines. Despite a dusty line of sight ($A_V=1.37\pm0.08$ mag), with tentative evidence of a 2175 Å bump, and a bright host galaxy ($M_B=-20.5$ AB mag), we identify a point-like source at the GRB position with broad spectral features similar to those of SN 1998bw. The SN contributes $\sim$10-15% of the NIRSpec flux and would contribute only $\sim$1% of the total flux in a ground-based optical image at the same epoch. Its extinction-corrected luminosity is comparable to SN 1998bw, although it remains sensitive to the host subtraction and template assumptions.
