By eliminating the primal transport plan from the updates, we derive an equivalent dual formulation that reveals BDRS as annealed Sinkhorn under an implicit inverse-linear temperature schedule, with an additional log-scaling momentum term and a cooler kernel. While this explains the role of the temperature parameter in BDRS as an initial temperature, it also reduces the solver's memory requirement from quadratic to linear. Utilizing this annealing perspective, we introduce overrelaxed BDRS, which combines annealing and overrelaxed scaling within a single recursion. We derive a primal-dual certificate for both methods that can be evaluated in linear memory without transport plan construction, thus providing a computable stopping rule. On the DOTmark benchmark, combining momentum with the cooler kernel produces substantially smaller optimality gaps than annealed Sinkhorn under the same schedule. For pixel-level color transfer between $1024\times1024$ images, BDRS attains a lower repaired transport cost than MDOT-TNT with a 9$\times$ speed up, reaching a relative duality gap of $1.59\%$ in 24 minutes. We further demonstrate a color transfer with $4238\times2365$ images, yielding 10 million pixels per image and approximately one hundred trillion implicit transport entries, reaching a best relative duality gap of $2.41\%$ and $2.80\%$ within 35 hours in each direction on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了用于无正则化离散最优传输的Bregman Douglas-Rachford分裂（BDRS），并在线性内存下构建了任意时刻原始-对偶证书。
AI.motivation: 无正则化离散最优传输求解通常需要存储二次规模的传输方案，内存开销大，且缺乏线性内存下可计算的停止准则。
AI.method: 证明BDRS等价于单次内层Sinkhorn迭代的热启动IPOT；消去原始传输方案得到等价对偶形式，揭示BDRS为隐式反线性温度退火下的退火Sinkhorn，并含对数缩放动量项与更冷核；据此提出过松弛BDRS，将退火与过松弛缩放结合于单一递推；推导无需构造传输方案、线性内存即可计算的原始-对偶证书作为停止规则。
AI.result: 在DOTmark基准上，动量与更冷核组合在相同调度下最优性间隙显著小于退火Sinkhorn；1024×1024图像像素级颜色迁移中，BDRS修复传输代价低于MDOT-TNT且加速9倍，24分钟内相对对偶间隙达1.59%；4238×2365图像（每图1000万像素、约百万亿隐式传输条目）单张NVIDIA L40S GPU上双向分别在35小时内达到最佳相对对偶间隙2.41%与2.80%。
AI.conclusion: BDRS的退火视角统一了温度调度与缩放机制，提供线性内存的可计算证书，并在大规模颜色迁移任务上兼顾效率与精度。

title: Proactive Motion Planning for Human-Robot Cooperation
summary: This abstract addresses the incorporation of human motion prediction into proactive and dynamic human-aware motion planning, with the goal of enabling safe collaboration between humans and robots. A deep learning, graph-based model is used to forecast human motion and is integrated into a planning framework. This framework employs a static roadmap along with a time-variant A* algorithm to modify the trajectory of a UR5e manipulator. This method greatly improves human-robot interaction and enables proactive collision avoidance by combining precise motion forecasts with adaptive trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 该论文将基于深度学习的图模型人体运动预测模块嵌入到主动式动态人机共融运动规划框架中，通过静态路网图结合时变A*算法实时调整UR5e机械臂轨迹，实现主动避碰并显著提升人机协作的安全性与交互性。
AI.motivation: 传统人机协作中的运动规划多为被动避碰，缺乏对人体未来运动的预判，导致交互效率低、安全性差。因此作者希望把人体运动预测引入主动式、动态的人体感知规划中，使机器人能够在人接近之前提前调整轨迹。
AI.method: 采用基于深度学习的图（graph-based）模型进行人体运动预测；预测结果被集成到规划框架中。规划器以静态路网图（roadmap）为搜索空间，配合时变A*（time-variant A*）算法，对UR5e机械臂的轨迹进行动态修正。
AI.result: 将精确的运动预测与自适应轨迹规划相结合，使方法在人机交互性能上获得大幅提升，并实现了主动式碰撞避免。
AI.conclusion: 融合深度学习人体运动预测与时变A*规划，可支撑主动、动态的人体感知运动规划，是提升人机协作安全性与流畅性的有效途径。

title: Rank stability of elliptic curves over $\mathbb{F}_q(t)$ in residue classes
comment: 26 Pages. An updated version containing additional results will be uploaded in the near future. Comments Welcome!
summary: Fix a prime $\ell$. Let $K = \mathbb{F}_q(t)$ be a global function field such that $\gcd(q,6) = 1$ and $q \equiv 1 \pmod \ell$. Let $E$ be a non-isotrivial elliptic curve over $K$. Given a fixed monic polynomial $Q$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$, and assuming some mild conditions on $E$, we show that the rank of $E$ does not change with respect to a positive proportion of $\mathbb{Z}/\ell \mathbb{Z}$ extensions $K(\sqrt[\ell]{f})/K$, as $f$ varies over the set of monic polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_q$ such that $f \equiv A \pmod Q$ for any given polynomial $A$. We obtain this result by combining analytic and probabilistic techniques to study the distribution of certain prime Selmer groups of auxiliary abelian varieties constructed from these polynomials $f$.

AI.tldr: 在全局函数域上，非等平凡的椭圆曲线在满足同余条件的一类Z/ℓZ扩张中，其秩在正比例情形下保持不变。
AI.motivation: 研究椭圆曲线秩在域扩张族中的变化行为，是算术几何与数论中的核心问题之一。作者希望在全局函数域设定下，考察限制在特定同余类多项式所定义的Z/ℓZ扩张中，椭圆曲线秩的稳定性，从而推广或补充已有的平均秩与秩不变量结果。
AI.method: 结合解析方法与概率方法，研究由这些多项式f构造的辅助阿贝尔簇的若干素数Selmer群的分布；通过对这些Selmer群分布的分析来推断原椭圆曲线E在相应Z/ℓZ扩张中的秩行为。
AI.result: 在gcd(q,6)=1且q≡1 mod ℓ的条件下，若E/K非等平凡并满足若干温和假设，则对给定单项多项式A，当f取遍满足f≡A mod Q的单项多项式时，E在K(f的ℓ次根)/K上的秩对正比例的Z/ℓZ扩张保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在全局函数域中，对满足指定同余条件的Z/ℓZ扩张族，椭圆曲线秩具有正比例的稳定性；其证明依赖于辅助阿贝尔簇素数Selmer群分布的解析与概率分析。

title: Spectral analysis of a class of IRK stage preconditioners for linear wave equations
summary: We lay out the analysis of the ``Kronecker preconditioners'' adopted in [24] for the linear wave equations. Importantly, we deliver the analysis justifying the claims in~[24, Section 4.2] about these preconditioners and we unpack all of the necessary numerical background for a full understanding of the observed phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文对文献[24]中用于线性波动方程的"Kronecker预条件子"进行了系统的理论分析，为其在[24, 第4.2节]中的相关论断提供了严格的数学依据，并补充了理解所观察现象所需的全部数值背景知识。
AI.motivation: 文献[24]提出了用于线性波动方程的Kronecker预条件子，并在第4.2节中给出了一系列论断，但缺乏严格的理论证明与充分的数值背景说明。本文旨在填补这一空白，对这些论断进行理论分析与论证。
AI.method: 采用理论分析的方法，对Kronecker预条件子进行系统分析，同时整合必要的数值背景知识，以解释所观察到的现象。
AI.result: 给出了支持[24, 第4.2节]中关于Kronecker预条件子论断的理论分析结果，并完整梳理了相关数值背景，从而全面解释了所观察到的现象。
AI.conclusion: 本文为文献[24]中Kronecker预条件子在线性波动方程中的应用提供了理论支撑，验证了其论断的正确性，并阐明了相应的数值背景。

title: Accelerated Consensus and Decentralized Optimization over Slowly Varying Networks
summary: We study average consensus over slowly time-varying networks and its application to decentralized optimization. We introduce WAVE, a windowed Chebyshev method that limits the accumulated effect of network variation by restarting the recurrence after finite windows. If $χ$ bounds the network condition number and successive communication operators satisfy $\|L_{k+1}-L_k\|\leqβ$, WAVE reaches $ε$-consensus in $O((\sqrtχ+\min\lbraceβχ^2,χ\rbrace)\ln(e/ε))$ communication rounds. This rate matches the fixed-network $\sqrtχ$ dependence when $β=O(χ^{-3/2})$ and smoothly interpolates across the full range of network variation. For piecewise-constant networks where each change is detected when it occurs and consecutive changes are at least $τ$ rounds apart, WAVE reaches $ε$-consensus in $O((\sqrtχ+χ/τ)\ln(e/ε))$ communication rounds. Finally, we use WAVE as the consensus step in an accelerated decentralized optimization method for $α$-smooth convex local objectives with a $μ$-strongly convex average. For sufficiently slow network variation, every agent obtains an $ε$-solution to the global optimization problem after $\widetilde O(\sqrt{α/μ}\,\sqrtχ)$ communication rounds, matching the fixed-network dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WAVE（窗口化Chebyshev方法），通过有限窗口后重启递推来限制网络变化累积效应，实现慢时变网络上的平均共识，并应用于去中心化优化。
AI.motivation: 研究慢时变网络上的平均共识问题及其在去中心化优化中的应用，旨在解决网络拓扑变化对共识收敛速率的影响。
AI.method: 引入WAVE——一种窗口化Chebyshev方法，在有限窗口后重启递推以限制网络变化的累积效应；并在加速去中心化优化方法中用作共识步骤，针对α-光滑凸局部目标与μ-强凸平均。
AI.result: 若χ界定网络条件数且连续通信算子满足‖L_{k+1}-L_k‖≤β，WAVE在O((√χ+min{βχ²,χ})ln(e/ε))通信轮内达到ε-共识；当β=O(χ^{-3/2})时速率匹配固定网络的√χ依赖并平滑插值。对于分段常数网络（变化被检测且相邻变化间隔≥τ轮），达ε-共识需O((√χ+χ/τ)ln(e/ε))轮。用于加速去中心化优化时，慢变网络下每个智能体在Õ(√(α/μ)√χ)轮内获ε-解，匹配固定网络依赖。
AI.conclusion: WAVE在慢时变网络上实现了与固定网络相当的共识与优化收敛速率，平滑适应网络变化程度，为时变去中心化优化提供了有效方法。

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Hongzhou Wang (wanghongzhou@jlu.edu.cn)
summary: Code-as-Policy agents accomplish long-horizon embodied tasks by generating and executing code, yet continually improving them with teachers that are stronger but not globally reliable remains a key challenge. Existing distillation methods typically treat the teacher's complete behavior as the supervision target and thus misassign training credit on states where the teacher fails. We propose RE-0, a recursively verified policy improvement framework: rather than assuming that the teacher globally outperforms the student, RE-0 requests local corrections from the teacher on the student's own failure histories and checks in the environment whether each correction is genuinely beneficial; verified corrections yield immediate improvement. Building on this, we propose RE-OPD, which turns verified interventions into supervision for on-policy distillation. Only counterfactually verified teacher interventions provide distribution-level supervision, weighted by their measured local benefit, and the improvement they induce is projected back into the standalone student, so both where supervision is applied and how much credit the teacher receives co-evolve with the student policy. We further prove that the student's per-round gain is lower-bounded by its verified intervention gain up to verification and projection error terms. Experiments across multiple Code-as-Policy embodied tasks show that RE-0 improves both teacher-assisted execution and the standalone student, and generalizes to novel robots and scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 RE-0 递归验证式策略改进框架与 RE-OPD 在策略蒸馏方法，通过只在学生失败历史处请求教师局部修正并在环境中反事实验证其有效性，实现教师不全局可靠条件下的 Code-as-Policy 智能体持续改进。
AI.motivation: Code-as-Policy 智能体需靠教师持续提升长程具身任务能力，但教师通常更强却并非全局可靠。现有蒸馏方法把教师完整行为当作监督目标，会在教师失败的状態上错误分配训练信用，导致监督信号失真。
AI.method: RE-0 不假设教师全局优于学生，而是在学生自身失败历史上请求教师的局部修正，并在环境中检验每条修正是否真正有益，验证通过的修正立即带来改进。RE-OPD 进一步将验证后的干预转为在策略蒸馏监督：仅经反事实验证的教师干预提供分布级监督，按其实测局部收益加权，并将诱导的改进投影回独立学生，使监督施加位置与教师信用分配随学生策略共同演化。
AI.result: 理论证明学生的每轮增益下界由已验证干预增益给出，误差项仅含验证与投影误差。多个 Code-as-Policy 具身任务实验显示，RE-0 同时提升教师辅助执行与独立学生性能，并可泛化到新机器人与新场景。
AI.conclusion: 以局部可验证修正替代全局教师模仿，为不可靠教师下的策略改进提供了兼顾信用分配与可证明增益的蒸馏范式。

title: Higher-order colossally abundant numbers
summary: Colossally abundant numbers have large sums of divisors relative to their size. They also admit a geometric description using supporting lines of a planar convex hull. Starting from this description, we change coordinates to obtain nested subsets of these numbers, which we call colossally abundant numbers of higher order. Their definition does not depend on the Riemann hypothesis. We give conditions under which Robin's inequality holds on any one of these subsets if and only if the Riemann hypothesis is true. Some of the resulting families have infinite sets at every level but an empty intersection. For two classes of coordinates, we determine how fast the least members grow. We also prove that every fixed positive integer divides all members of sufficiently high order. Under a concavity assumption, the least members form a divisibility chain; for power abscissas, successive quotients have unbounded numbers of prime factors, with an explicit limsup growth rate. In a second class of families, every global maximum of the normalized divisor sum is retained, and the least members tend to infinity if and only if the Riemann hypothesis is true. We give numerical examples and explain how the Ramanujan--Nicolas bounds produce terminating chains.

AI.tldr: 本文将超丰数（colossally abundant numbers）的凸包支撑线几何描述推广到"高阶超丰数"嵌套子集，给出其上Robin不等式等价于黎曼假设的条件，并研究最小元的增长、整除链及数值例子。
AI.motivation: 超丰数在数论中与Robin不等式及黎曼假设密切相关，且具有平面凸包支撑线的几何刻画。作者希望从这一几何描述出发，通过坐标变换构造更精细的嵌套子集，以在更一般（且不依赖黎曼假设）的框架下研究Robin不等式成立的条件与最小元的增长性质。
AI.method: 从超丰数的凸包支撑线描述出发，进行坐标变换得到高阶超丰数的嵌套子集，其定义不依赖黎曼假设；通过分析两类坐标下最小成员的增长速度、整除链性质及归一化除数和的最大值，并结合Ramanujan–Nicolas界给出终止链的构造。
AI.result: 给出在这些子集上Robin不等式成立当且仅当黎曼假设为真的条件；部分族在每一层均为无限集但交集为空；确定了两类坐标下最小成员的增长速度；证明任意固定正整数整除充分高阶的所有成员；在凹性假设下最小成员构成整除链，幂坐标下相邻商具有无界的素因子个数并给出显式limsup增长率；第二类族保留归一化除数和的所有全局最大值，且最小成员趋于无穷当且仅当黎曼假设成立。
AI.conclusion: 高阶超丰数提供了一种不依赖黎曼假设的嵌套结构，将Robin不等式、整除链与归一化除数和最大值等问题统一起来，并用Ramanujan–Nicolas界解释终止链现象。

title: A weighted polygonal discontinuous Galerkin method for hierarchically coupled reaction-diffusion systems with cubic interactions
summary: We develop and analyse a symmetric weighted interior penalty polytopal discontinuous Galerkin (SWIP-PolyDG) method for multi-species reaction--diffusion systems with nonlinear reaction terms of up to cubic order. Such terms arise naturally when higher-order interactions are incorporated into population models, allowing non-additive effects among multiple species to influence local growth and conversion mechanisms. The proposed framework accommodates heterogeneous and possibly anisotropic diffusion tensors on general polygonal meshes. To control the nonlinear coupling, we consider a hierarchical block structure in the reaction operator, whereby each population block depends only on its own variables and on those associated with preceding blocks. In addition, the cubic self-interactions within each block are assumed to have a dissipative diagonal structure. Under these hypotheses and proceeding recursively over the hierarchy of population blocks, we derive local-in-time stability estimates in two spatial dimensions for the semi-discrete formulation in both the $L^2(Ω)$-and dG-norms. We further establish an a priori error estimate in a combined $L^2(Ω)$-dG energy norm for sufficiently regular solutions for the semi-discrete formulation. Finally, numerical experiments confirm the predicted convergence behaviour and illustrate the robustness of the method under heterogeneous diffusion.

AI.tldr: 提出并分析SWIP-PolyDG方法求解多物种反应-扩散系统，建立稳定性与先验误差估计，数值验证收敛性与异质扩散鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多物种种群模型中引入高阶（最高三次）非线性相互作用会自然产生非线性反应项，用于刻画多物种间非加性效应对局部增长与转化机制的影响；同时需要处理一般多边形网格上异质且各向异性的扩散张量。
AI.method: 针对多物种反应-扩散系统，构建对称加权内部惩罚的多边形间断Galerkin（SWIP-PolyDG）方法，支持一般多边形网格及异质、各向异性扩散张量。为控制非线性耦合，在反应算子中引入层级块结构：每个种群块仅依赖自身变量及前序块变量；并假设每块内三次自相互作用具有耗散对角结构。基于这些假设，沿块层级递归推导半离散格式在二维空间下的局部时间稳定性估计。
AI.result: 在半离散格式下，分别于L²(Ω)范数与dG范数中导出了局部时间稳定性估计；对足够正则的解，在L²(Ω)-dG能量范数下建立了先验误差估计。
AI.conclusion: 数值实验验证了理论预测的收敛行为，并展示了方法在异质扩散条件下的鲁棒性。

title: Higher-Order Mean-Field Control Barrier Functions
summary: Mean-field control barrier functions (MF-CBFs) enforce swarm safety through constraints on the agents' distribution. Previous formulations, including applications to stochastic coverage and shepherding, use first-order differential inequalities. These cannot directly enforce constraints whose barrier functions yield control-free first derivatives. Thus, we develop the theory of higher-order MF-CBFs, which ensures the positivity of the barrier functionals through higher-order differential inequalities, as in their finite-dimensional analogs. More specifically, we introduce the notion of relative degree for mean-field safety functionals and develop an analytic framework for computing their higher-order derivatives. Moreover, for practical examples of cross-correlation and self-correlation functionals, we show that repeated differentiation along mean-field dynamics is structure-preserving and reduces to kernel recursions. As an illustration, we apply higher-order MF-CBFs to double-integrator swarm tracking and avoidance problems, where position-only constraints lead to MF-CBFs of relative degree two.

AI.tldr: 本文将控制障碍函数（CBF）推广到群体平均场场景，提出高阶平均场控制障碍函数（higher-order MF-CBFs），通过高阶微分不等式保证障碍泛函的正性，并以相对度与核递归为核心构建解析框架，应用于双积分器群体的跟踪与避障。
AI.motivation: 已有的平均场控制障碍函数（MF-CBFs），包括在随机覆盖与牧羊问题中的应用，均基于一阶微分不等式。当障碍函数的首阶导数中不显含控制输入时，这类一阶形式无法直接施加约束。因此需要发展高阶 MF-CBF 理论，以处理此类约束。
AI.method: 1) 引入平均场安全泛函的“相对度”（relative degree）概念；2) 建立计算其高阶导数的解析框架；3) 针对互相关（cross-correlation）与自相关（self-correlation）泛函这两类实际例子，证明沿平均场动力学反复求导具有结构保持性，并可归结为核递归（kernel recursions）；4) 用高阶微分不等式保证障碍泛函正性，类似有限维情形的高阶 CBF。
AI.result: 理论上给出了平均场安全泛函高阶导数的解析计算框架，并证明互相关/自相关泛函的反复求导保持结构、化为核递归。应用上，将高阶 MF-CBFs 用于双积分器群体的跟踪与避障问题，其中仅位置约束对应相对度为二的平均场控制障碍函数。
AI.conclusion: 高阶 MF-CBFs 弥补了一阶 MF-CBFs 在障碍函数首阶导数不含控制时无法施加约束的不足，为群体安全控制提供了可解析计算、结构保持的高阶约束工具，并在双积分器群体跟踪与避障中得到验证。

title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.

AI.tldr: 提出DRAM——一种即插即用的记忆模块，可在不改动架构、不重训练主干的前提下，为预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆能力，仅需对记忆模块与动作专家做任务级后训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作本质上依赖历史信息，但多数预训练策略仅以当前观测或短时窗为条件。现有长时记忆方案存在明显缺陷：多帧观测窗口显著增加推理开销；依赖预定义语义特征则限制任务通用性，且可能需重训练主干以适配记忆。
AI.method: DRAM采用门控delta-rule线性注意力维护固定规模的联想记忆，并修改更新规则以并行纳入每帧内全部token；配合架构无关的读出机制，将历史上下文注入不同策略架构的动作预测。训练时冻结主干，仅对记忆模块和动作专家进行任务特定后训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，DRAM在冻结的预训练策略上稳定优于短上下文基线以及多种替代性紧凑记忆设计。
AI.conclusion: DRAM验证了固定规模、事后加装、主干冻结训练的记忆模块的有效性，为预训练机器人策略提供了一种通用、低开销的长时程记忆增强方案。

title: Omega bound for the Piltz divisor problem
comment: 13 pages. Comments and suggestions are welcome
summary: We obtain improved omega bounds for the error term in the Piltz divisor problem over number fields. Our proof combines Lamzouri's resonance argument with a counting theorem for nonnegative multiplicative functions. The counting theorem gives the estimates needed for the divisor coefficients over a number field and allows us to remove the factor involving the third iterated logarithm from the earlier bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了数域上Piltz除数问题余项的Ω界，通过将Lamzouri共振论证与非负乘法函数计数定理相结合，去掉了此前界中涉及三阶迭代对数的因子。
AI.motivation: 数域上Piltz除数问题余项的Ω界已有结果中包含一个与三阶迭代对数相关的多余因子，该因子并非本质，需要改进以得到更精确的下界。
AI.method: 结合Lamzouri的共振论证（resonance argument）与关于非负乘法函数的一个计数定理；该计数定理为数域上的除数系数提供所需估计。
AI.result: 得到了数域上Piltz除数问题余项改进的Ω界，成功移除了先前界中涉及三阶迭代对数的因子。
AI.conclusion: 通过计数定理与共振方法的结合，可获得更优的余项下界估计，改进了数域上Piltz除数问题的已知Ω结果。

title: The Numerical Onsager-Machlup action functional for Euler discretized SDEs driven by fractional Brownian motion
summary: In this work, different from previous results, the explicit expression of numerical Onsager-Machlup action functional for Euler discretized SDEs driven by fractional Brownian motion is derived provided the drift coefficient and numerical reference path satisfy some suitable conditions. Then numerical fractional Euler-Lagrange equations for numerical Onsager-Machlup action functional are also obtained. Finally, numerical experiments to illustrate and support the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了分数布朗运动驱动的Euler离散随机微分方程的数值Onsager-Machlup作用泛函的显式表达式，并给出对应的数值分数Euler-Lagrange方程，最后通过数值实验验证理论结果。
AI.motivation: 已有关于Onsager-Machlup作用泛函的结果多针对连续型随机微分方程，而其数值离散（Euler离散）情形下的显式表达尚待建立，以便刻画数值路径的最可能转移路径。
AI.method: 在漂移系数与数值参考路径满足适当条件下，对分数布朗运动驱动的Euler离散随机微分方程，推导数值Onsager-Machlup作用泛函的显式表达式，进而导出相应的数值分数Euler-Lagrange方程，并进行数值实验。
AI.result: 得到了Euler离散SDE的数值Onsager-Machlup作用泛函的显式表达，以及对应的数值分数Euler-Lagrange方程，数值实验支持了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Onsager-Machlup理论推广到分数布朗运动驱动的离散数值格式，为数值最可能路径的刻画与分析提供了理论工具。

title: DCEmbed: Scalable Optimization over Neural Surrogates
summary: Neural surrogates can accelerate large-scale optimization by replacing expensive or intractable model components with efficient learned approximations, but solving the resulting embedded problems can remain prohibitively costly. For instance, standard exact encodings of neural networks with ReLU activations allow the problem to be solved by mixed-integer solvers, but add large numbers of binary variables to accommodate the nonlinearity of the activations, which can render the problem computationally prohibitive. To address this, we propose DCEmbed, a heuristic for optimization problems with embedded neural surrogates that leverages the difference-of-convex (DC) representation of the network and avoids adding activation binaries. Exploiting shared structure within the DC representation of a ReLU network, we derive a reduced-size, exact formulation for its convex components that can be embedded in optimization problems using just two linear inequalities and one continuous auxiliary variable per hidden neuron. Using this, the problem is solved via an iterative penalty convex-concave procedure, where only the concave portions of the neural terms are approximated at each stage. The original objective, constraints, and any discrete decisions are retained, allowing standard convex or mixed-integer optimization solvers to optimize the host and surrogate jointly at each iteration. In experiments on quadratic programs, mixed-integer resource allocation, and neural two-stage stochastic programming, our method demonstrates much faster progress toward high-quality feasible solutions than approaches using exact mixed-integer embeddings. In particular, DCEmbed achieves $4\times$ lower normalized primal integral than the best exact baseline on the resource allocation problem, while in two-stage stochastic programming it reaches the global surrogate optimum $\sim 5\times$ faster than Gurobi ML.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCEmbed，一种针对含嵌入神经网络代理的优化问题的启发式方法，利用ReLU网络之差凸（DC）表示避免引入激活二值变量，并通过迭代惩罚凹凸过程求解，在多个任务上显著优于精确混合整数嵌入。
AI.motivation: 将神经网络代理嵌入优化问题可加速大规模优化，但标准精确编码（如ReLU的混合整数编码）会引入大量二值变量，导致问题计算上难以求解。
AI.method: DCEmbed利用神经网络的差凸（DC）表示，避免添加激活二值变量；针对ReLU网络DC表示中的共享结构，推导出凸分量的缩减规模精确形式，每个隐藏神经元仅需两条线性不等式和一个连续辅助变量即可嵌入；随后采用迭代惩罚凹凸过程（penalty convex-concave procedure）求解，每阶段仅近似神经项中的凹部分，并保留原目标、约束及离散决策，使标准凸或混合整数求解器能联合优化宿主与代理。
AI.result: 在二次规划、混合整数资源分配和神经两阶段随机规划实验中，该方法比精确混合整数嵌入更快获得高质量可行解；在资源分配问题上，其归一化原始积分（normalized primal integral）比最佳精确基线低4倍；在两阶段随机规划中，达到全局代理最优解的速度比Gurobi ML快约5倍。
AI.conclusion: DCEmbed通过DC表示与迭代惩罚凹凸过程，在无需激活二值变量的情况下高效求解含神经网络代理的嵌入优化问题，在多个基准上展现出优于精确混合整数嵌入的收敛性能。

title: GlowTact: Simple and Compact Vision-Based Tactile Sensing with High Sensitivity and Spatial Resolution
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) provide rich contact information for robotic manipulation, but existing designs can be hard to simplify and adapt to the size and constraints of humanoid fingertips. We introduce \textbf{GlowTact}, a pressure-responsive vision-based tactile sensing mechanism that directly visualizes contact pressure. \textbf{GlowTact} requires only single-color, non-directional illumination, and the raw tactile image directly represents the pressure distribution without explicit geometry reconstruction. This simple sensing principle enables compact, customizable tactile sensors while preserving high sensitivity and rich spatial detail. We demonstrate gram-scale contact detection, accurate normal-force estimation, and reconstruction of fine contact geometry, including M1 screw threads. These results establish \textbf{GlowTact} as a practical new sensing technology for compact humanoid fingertips, combining a durable nitrile membrane and simple optical design with sensitive and information-rich tactile perception.

AI.tldr: GlowTact是一种压力响应型视触觉传感机制，通过单色非定向照明直接可视化接触压力分布，无需显式几何重建，可实现紧凑、可定制的高灵敏度触觉传感器。
AI.motivation: 现有视触觉传感器（VBTS）虽能提供丰富接触信息，但设计难以简化和适配人形机器人指尖的尺寸与约束，因此需要一种结构简单、紧凑且信息丰富的传感方案。
AI.method: 提出GlowTact压力响应型视触觉传感机制，仅需单色、非定向照明，原始触觉图像直接表示压力分布，无需显式几何重建；采用耐用丁腈膜与简单光学设计，实现紧凑、可定制的传感器结构。
AI.result: 实现了克级接触检测、精确法向力估计以及精细接触几何重建（包括M1螺纹），同时保持高灵敏度与丰富空间细节。
AI.conclusion: GlowTact是一种适用于紧凑人形指尖的实用新型传感技术，兼具耐用丁腈膜、简单光学设计与灵敏且信息丰富的触觉感知能力。

title: Square root cancellation in the hyperbolic lattice counting problem over cocompact groups
comment: This is a first draft. Comments are welcome
summary:
For cocompact Fuchsian groups $Γ\leq \hbox{PSL}(2, \mathbb{R})$ we improve Selberg's bound for the error term of the counting function in the hyperbolic lattice counting problem, achieving an essentially optimal upper bound for the error term \begin{equation*}
  E(X;z, w) = O(X^{1/2+\varepsilon}) \end{equation*} for almost every pair of points $z,w$. We extend this pointwise result for cocompact lattices acting on the $n$-dimensional real hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Moreover, in the $2$-dimensional case we study the second moment of the error term of the counting function. We improve the upper bounds of Chamizo and Cherubini for almost all pairs $z,w$, but we disprove a conjecture of Phillips and Rudnick for the case of cocompact Fuchsian groups.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了Selberg关于双曲格点计数问题误差项的界，对余紧Fuchsian群得到几乎最优的 O(X^{1/2+ε}) 上界（对几乎处处的点对），并推广到n维双曲空间；同时研究二维情形下误差项的二阶矩，改进Chamizo-Cherubini上界并否证了Phillips-Rudnick的一个猜想。
AI.motivation: 双曲格点计数问题中，Selberg给出的误差项界在几乎处处意义下并非最优，作者希望改进这一经典结果、逼近理论最优的 X^{1/2+ε}，并在更高维及二阶矩层面深化对误差项的理解。
AI.method: 对余紧Fuchsian群 Γ≤PSL(2,R)，在几乎处处点对的意义下分析计数函数误差项 E(X;z,w) 的上界；将逐点结果推广到n维实双曲空间 H^n 上的余紧格；在二维情形进一步研究误差项的二阶矩，并与Chamizo、Cherubini及Phillips-Rudnick的相关工作与猜想进行比较。
AI.result: 对几乎每对点 z,w 得到 E(X;z,w)=O(X^{1/2+ε}) 的本质最优上界；该逐点结果推广到 H^n 上的余紧格；在二维情形改进了Chamizo和Cherubini关于几乎处处点对的二阶矩上界，同时否证了Phillips和Rudnick针对余紧Fuchsian群的猜想。
AI.conclusion: 作者在几乎所有点对上实现了双曲格点计数误差项的本质最优估计，并将其框架推广到高维，还通过二阶矩研究纠正了已有猜想，推动了对双曲格点计数误差项渐近行为的理解。

title: Fully Discrete Active Flux Methods for the Euler Equations: Exploring Different Reconstructions and New Multi-Dimensional Evolution Operators
summary: We present new fully discrete Cartesian grid Active Flux methods for the two-dimensional Euler equations of gas dynamics. A key component of these methods is the evolution operator used to evolve point-value degrees of freedom. Therefore, we derive several new, third-order accurate, multidimensional evolution operators for point-value updates of the linearized Euler equations using the method of bicharacteristics. We also investigate how the reconstruction and choice of approximate evolution operator affect the accuracy and stability of the resulting methods.

AI.tldr: 提出二维气体动力学Euler方程的全离散笛卡尔网格Active Flux方法，基于双特征线法推导多个三阶精度的多维演化算子，并研究重构与近似演化算子对精度和稳定性的影响。
AI.motivation: Active Flux方法的核心组件是用于演化点值自由度的演化算子，而现有二维Euler方程求解中缺乏高阶、多维且适用于点值更新的演化算子，因此需要构造此类算子并厘清重构与算子选择对方法性能的影响。
AI.method: 面向二维Euler方程，构建全离散笛卡尔网格Active Flux格式；针对线性化Euler方程，利用双特征线法（method of bicharacteristics）推导若干新的三阶精度多维演化算子，用于点值自由度的更新；并系统考察重构方式与近似演化算子的选取对格式精度与稳定性的作用。
AI.result: 获得多个三阶精度的多维演化算子，并揭示重构策略和近似演化算子的选择会显著影响所得Active Flux方法的精度与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 双特征线法可用于系统构造高阶多维点值演化算子，为二维Euler方程的Active Flux方法提供了可行途径，且重构与演化算子的合理搭配是保证精度与稳定性的关键。

title: Mixed-Noise Plug-and-Play with Infimal Convolution Fidelities and Multiple Priors
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) algorithms are a class of iterative methods for inverse imaging. Within an optimization algorithm, they combine a flexible fidelity term, encoding the forward operator, and a pretrained image denoiser, in order to deal with more severe corruptions such as blurring or downsampling when reconstructing an image. This work studies provably convergent PnP methods for mixed-noise forward processes by using the infimal convolution as a fidelity term, providing a statistical interpretation as a joint maximum a-posteriori estimator over both noises, and preserving the Bayesian MAP interpretation of PnP methods. Independently, we extend the PnP formulation to multiple prior terms using the Davis--Yin three-operator splitting. This extension can be combined with either standard fidelities or the proposed mixed-noise infimal-convolution fidelities. We verify that these generalized PnP methods are convergent under standard Kurdyka--Lojasiewicz conditions. Numerical experiments on Laplace-Gaussian and Poisson--Gaussian noise demonstrate stable convergence of single-prior and multiple-prior PnP methods, and divergence under fidelity mismatch. Furthermore, PnP with infimal convolution fidelities are able to scale to noise up to 38% standard deviation, with multiple priors reaching different stationary points that qualitatively preserve more textural properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可证明收敛的即插即用（PnP）算法，利用下确界卷积作为保真项处理混合噪声，并将其扩展到多先验情形，在Kurdyka–Lojasiewicz条件下验证收敛性。
AI.motivation: 传统PnP算法多针对单一噪声或较简单的前向过程，面对模糊、下采样等严重退化时保真项设计受限；同时混合噪声（如Laplace-Gaussian、Poisson-Gaussian）下的统计解释与收敛性尚不完善，多先验融合的PnP框架也缺乏系统性扩展。
AI.method: 1) 使用下确界卷积（infimal convolution）作为保真项，处理混合噪声前向过程；2) 给出其作为两种噪声联合最大后验估计的统计解释，并保持PnP方法的贝叶斯MAP解释；3) 借助Davis–Yin三算子分裂将PnP扩展至多先验项，可兼容标准保真项或所提混合噪声下确界卷积保真项；4) 在标准Kurdyka–Lojasiewicz条件下证明收敛性。
AI.result: 在Laplace-Gaussian与Poisson-Gaussian噪声上的数值实验表明：单先验与多先验PnP方法均稳定收敛；保真项不匹配时出现发散；下确界卷积保真项的PnP可扩展至标准差高达38%的噪声；多先验方法收敛到不同稳定点，并在定性上保留更多纹理特性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为混合噪声下的PnP反演提供了具有收敛保证与统计解释的框架，并通过下确界卷积保真项和Davis–Yin多先验扩展提升了高噪声场景的重建稳定性与纹理保持能力。

title: Assisting for Open-Ended Tasks: Goal-Oriented Shared Autonomy as a Particle Filter
summary: A common approach for shared autonomy blends human inputs with autonomous assistance based on the human's likely goal. However, most existing approaches assume that a static set of possible goals is known a priori, which limits the use of such methods in unstructured assistive settings. We instead investigate how to enable shared autonomy with open-ended and dynamically changing goals. We formulate goal-oriented shared autonomy as a particle filter in which particles represent candidate human goals. Unlike conventional approaches with a fixed goal set, our transition model dynamically proposes new candidate goals as the interaction evolves, and human actions update the belief over these goals in real time. We instantiate this framework with foundation models (e.g., vision grounding and large language models) that propose context-relevant semantic goals, generate goal-conditioned assistance from low-level skill primitives, and refine those skills from human corrections. We assess our approach through a user study where 12 participants perform a variety of tabletop manipulation tasks with our method and state-of-the-art shared autonomy baselines. The results show that our particle filter-based approach reduces the amount of time users spend teleoperating the system and improves user satisfaction. User study videos: https://youtu.be/Ii26XuRqm9c

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于粒子滤波的开放式目标共享自主框架，利用基础模型动态提出并更新候选目标，实现动态目标下的辅助控制。
AI.motivation: 现有共享自主方法大多假设目标集合是先验固定的，这限制了其在非结构化辅助场景中的应用。
AI.method: 将目标导向的共享自主建模为粒子滤波，粒子表示候选人类目标；转移模型随交互动态提出新目标，人类动作实时更新目标信念；并使用基础模型（视觉定位、大语言模型）提出上下文相关语义目标、由低层技能原语生成目标条件下的辅助，并从人类纠正中改进技能。
AI.result: 通过12名参与者完成多种桌面操作任务的用户研究，与最先进的共享自主基线对比，该方法减少了用户遥操作时间并提升了用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: 粒子滤波框架结合基础模型可有效支持开放式、动态变化的共享自主目标，提升辅助效率与用户体验。

title: An improved high-low method for the parabola
summary: We demonstrate a modification of the high-low method of Guth-Maldague-Wang that yields a decoupling theorem which gives the sharp estimate for the discrete restriction constant for the parabola and also a diameter-free bound for the three-fold additive energy of rational points on the parabola and circle. These results were recently obtained by Deng-Fan-Guo-Guo-Luo and Cushman-Demeter-Wu, respectively. The novel features in this argument are an orthogonal expansion of $F^3$ and a new square function that also keeps the wavepackets discarded after pruning, resulting in new and more efficient high and low lemmas.

AI.tldr: 本文改进Guth-Maldague-Wang的高-低方法，得到解耦定理，给出抛物线的离散限制常数的精确估计，以及抛物线上和圆上有理点的三重重加性能量的无直径界。
AI.motivation: Guth-Maldague-Wang的高-低方法是调和分析中处理解耦与限制问题的有力工具，但现有版本在抛物线离散限制常数与有理点的加性能量等具体问题上未能给出最优或无量词性的界，本文希望对该方法进行修改以解决这两类问题。
AI.method: 修改Guth-Maldague-Wang的高-低方法：引入$F^3$的正交展开，并构造一个新的平方函数，该平方函数保留剪枝后丢弃的波包，从而得到新的、更高效的高引理和低引理。
AI.result: 得到解耦定理，给出抛物线离散限制常数的精确估计，以及抛物线和圆上有理点三重重加性能量的无直径界，分别对应Deng-Fan-Guo-Guo-Luo和Cushman-Demeter-Wu近期获得的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过对高-低方法的两项技术改进（$F^3$的正交展开与保留剪枝波包的新平方函数），成功复现并统一了近期关于抛物线离散限制与有理点加性能量的两个独立结果。

title: Addressing Data Engineering Challenges in the Cold-Chain Sector to Reduce its Environmental Impact Through Analytics
summary: Data analytics offer a great opportunity for organizations within the cold-chain industry to become more sustainable and reduce their environmental footprint. Yet, despite recent progress in data sciences, they still face challenges to ensure data quality and streamline data processes through adapted full-scale ecosystems, limiting their ability to perform sustainable analytics.  Most data techniques and tools stem from the data-science community and are not always suitably adapted to domain specificities. For instance, nearly all data-quality frameworks are designed to individually consider entities, i.e. representations of real-world elements. However, achieving environmental impact reduction in industrial settings, particularly within the cold-chain sector, often requires modelling and studying entire systems comprised of multiple interdependent entities. This publication challenges the application of conventional data science and engineering concepts in data ecosystems within the cold-chain sector and proposes an alternative approach to sustainably address prevalent challenges and thus optimize analytical processes.

AI.tldr: 本文指出冷链行业在利用数据分析推进可持续发展时面临数据质量与全流程生态系统的挑战，批评传统数据科学工具（如以单一实体为中心的数据质量框架）不适配领域需求，因其往往需要研究由多个相互依赖实体构成的整体系统。文章提出一种替代性方法，以可持续地应对这些挑战并优化分析流程。
AI.motivation: 冷链行业希望借助数据分析提升可持续性、降低环境足迹，但受限于数据质量难以保证、数据流程未能通过适配的全尺度生态系统实现贯通，难以开展可持续分析。现有数据技术与工具多源自数据科学界，未充分适配领域特性，尤其数据质量框架多以单一实体为单位，而工业场景（特别是冷链）的环境影响削减常需对由多个相互依赖实体构成的系统进行建模与研究，由此产生了方法层面的错配。
AI.method: 本文对冷链数据生态系统中传统数据科学与工程概念的应用提出质疑，并在此基础上提出一种替代性方法论路径，用于可持续地应对上述普遍性挑战并优化分析流程。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或量化数据，属于立场/方法类论述，主要成果是对现有数据科学范式在冷链领域适用性的批判性分析与替代方案的提出。
AI.conclusion: 面向冷链行业的可持续分析需要超越以单一实体为中心的传统数据科学框架，转向以系统级、多实体相互依赖为核心的数据生态与方法设计，以更可持续地解决数据质量与流程优化问题。

title: On the Relevance of Incorporating Decision Dependence in Distributional Ambiguity
summary: Most existing studies on distributionally robust optimization (DRO) with a decision-dependent ambiguity set focus on the computational and theoretical challenges posed by this class of problems. In this paper, we adopt a combined modeling and computational perspective to understand the trade-offs between modeling fidelity, solution quality, and computational effort, particularly in comparison with DRO models using decision-independent ambiguity sets. Motivated by representative applications in joint pricing-stocking newsvendor problems with price-dependent demand and facility location problems with location-dependent demand, we consider a two-stage stochastic mixed-integer program with (non)convex continuous recourse. Assuming a finite sample space, we model the decision-dependent distributional ambiguity with a polyhedral ambiguity set and reformulate the problem as a nonconvex mixed-integer nonlinear program. To efficiently solve the reformulations, we propose decomposition-based cutting-plane algorithms. Our experiments on benchmark instances indicate that a decision-dependent ambiguity set substantially reduces the postdecision disappointment for the newsvendor and out-of-sample cost for the facility location problems, up to 65% and 7% on average, respectively; thereby mitigating the optimizer's curse relative to a decision-independent DRO. However, this improvement is achieved at the expense of increased computational effort, with the absolute runtime ratio falling between 2 and 25 for medium- to large-sized newsvendor instances and between 2 and 12 for facility location instances.

AI.tldr: 本文从建模与计算双重视角研究决策依赖模糊集下的分布鲁棒优化，通过多面体模糊集建模与分解割平面算法求解两阶段随机混合整数规划，实验表明决策依赖模糊集显著降低决策后失望度（最高65%）与样本外成本（平均7%），但计算耗时增加2至25倍。
AI.motivation: 现有决策依赖模糊集的分布鲁棒优化研究多聚焦于计算与理论挑战，缺乏对建模精度、解质量与计算代价之间权衡的理解，尤其缺少与决策无关模糊集DRO模型的系统比较。研究动机来源于价格依赖需求的联合定价-库存报童问题与位置依赖需求的设施选址问题。
AI.method: 针对具有（非）凸连续补偿的两阶段随机混合整数规划，在有限样本空间假设下，采用多面体模糊集刻画决策依赖的分布模糊性，将问题重构为非凸混合整数非线性规划，并设计基于分解的割平面算法高效求解。
AI.result: 基准算例实验显示：相比决策无关DRO，决策依赖模糊集使报童问题的决策后失望度最高降低65%，设施选址问题的样本外成本平均降低7%，从而缓解了优化者诅咒；但计算代价上升，中等至大规模报童算例的运行时间比为2至25，设施选址算例为2至12。
AI.conclusion: 决策依赖模糊集能显著提升解的质量与鲁棒性，但需以额外计算开销为代价；该权衡关系为实际应用中模糊集建模选择提供了量化依据。

title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
summary: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC 框架，借鉴双过程认知理论，在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间自适应路由，仅在需要时进行高成本 deliberation，实现最多约 4 倍推理加速且性能与鲁棒性可比。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动 MPC 将学习到的世界模型与在线轨迹优化结合，在连续控制中性能优异，但每步需采样并评估数百条候选轨迹，计算开销大，导致控制频率远低于实时机器人需求。受人类认知双过程理论启发，作者质疑是否每个决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberation。
AI.method: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC，一个轻量级框架，在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间进行自适应路由，将高成本 deliberation 仅保留给最需要的状态；在外界扰动下可选择性地回退到规划。
AI.result: 在 103 个连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的任务性能，同时实现最多约 4 倍推理加速；在外部扰动下选择性回退到规划，保持与原始规划器相当的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 并非每个决策都需要同等计算 deliberation，通过自适应路由快慢两种决策机制，可在保持性能与鲁棒性的同时显著降低推理成本。

title: Sums of von Mangoldt convolutions via trace-sum averages over $U(N)$
summary: We study piecewise polynomial functions $δ_k(c)$ that appear in the conjectured asymptotics for the variance of short-interval sums of von Mangoldt convolutions $Λ^{*k}$. By a theorem of Kuperberg and Lalín, a unitary matrix integral involving a sum of trace products governs the large-$q$ limit of the function-field analogue of this variance. We identify $δ_k(c)$ as the leading-order coefficient of this integral when the total trace degree and matrix size grow with a fixed ratio $c$. Through an asymptotic analysis of two lattice-point representations for the matrix integral, we obtain explicit forms of $δ_k(c)$. A finite spline expansion and a contour-integral representation expressing $δ_k(c)$ as the inverse Laplace transform of a two-weight block Hankel determinant are also obtained.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 von Mangoldt 卷积 Λ^{*k} 短区间和的方差渐近中的分段多项式函数 δ_k(c)，通过矩阵积分渐近分析给出其显式形式与样条/围道积分表示。
AI.motivation: δ_k(c) 出现在 von Mangoldt 卷积短区间和方差的猜想渐近公式中，其显式刻画有助于理解该数论方差问题；同时 Kuperberg-Lalín 定理将函数域类比方差的大 q 极限归结为含迹积之和的酉矩阵积分，为计算 δ_k(c) 提供了途径。
AI.method: 在总迹度与矩阵尺寸按固定比例 c 增长的情形下，将 δ_k(c) 识别为该矩阵积分的首阶系数；对矩阵积分的两种格点表示进行渐近分析，从而得到 δ_k(c) 的显式形式，并进一步给出有限样条展开及将其表示为双权块 Hankel 行列式的逆 Laplace 变换的围道积分表示。
AI.result: 得到了 δ_k(c) 的显式形式，以及其有限样条展开和作为双权块 Hankel 行列式逆 Laplace 变换的围道积分表示。
AI.conclusion: δ_k(c) 可借助酉矩阵积分的首阶渐近系数来刻画，并具备样条展开与 Hankel 行列式围道积分两种等价表示。

title: A priori error analysis for one-parameter Lagrange and POD reduced order methods
summary: This work deals with the numerical solution of parametric linear elliptic partial differential equations using the finite element method for spatial discretization and a proper orthogonal decomposition or Lagrange subspace method based ROM for treating the parameter dependency. We study a simple one-parameter model problem and prove an error estimate for these ROMs as a function of the snapshot point set. Sub-exponential convergence with respect to the number of snapshot points is established under very mild assumptions on the point set. Exponential convergence is proven for structured point sets. In contrast to existing error analysis of Lagrange subspace methods, our estimates are not based on interpolation or perturbation arguments. Rather, we define a new approximation operator from the snapshot subspace and prove error and stability estimates for it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化线性椭圆偏微分方程，结合有限元离散与POD/Lagrange子空间ROM，提出新的逼近算子并建立了基于快照点集的误差估计，证明亚指数与指数收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有Lagrange子空间方法的误差分析依赖插值或扰动论证，分析框架受限，作者希望建立不依赖此类论证的误差与稳定性估计。
AI.method: 空间离散采用有限元法，参数依赖性处理采用本征正交分解（POD）或Lagrange子空间降阶模型；研究单参数模型问题，从快照子空间定义新的逼近算子，并为其证明误差与稳定性估计。
AI.result: 在非常温和的快照点集假设下证明了关于快照点数量的亚指数收敛；对结构化点集证明了指数收敛。误差估计不基于插值或扰动论证。
AI.conclusion: 所提逼近算子为Lagrange子空间类ROM提供了新的误差与稳定性分析途径，推广了收敛性结论的适用范围。

title: An Intersection Cutting Plane Algorithm for Chance-Constrained Programs with Finite Support
summary: Standard Big-M mixed-integer programming reformulations of chance-constrained programs (CCPs) with finite support often yield weak linear relaxations and scale poorly as the number of scenarios increases. To address this limitation, we derive two families of intersection cuts from problem-specific S-free sets and develop decomposition-based branch-and-cut frameworks. The first one exploits the submodular structure of the scenario requirement function, while the second one uses probability covers. We propose hybrid separation strategies that combine classical mixing inequalities and quantile cuts with the proposed intersection cuts. Computational experiments on integrated production-distribution planning instances show that the proposed hybrid methods reduce computational time compared to pure methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有限支撑下机会约束规划（CCP）的标准Big-M混合整数重构松弛弱、扩展性差的问题，从问题特定的S-free集合推导出两类割平面，并构建基于分解的分支切割框架，通过混合分离策略显著减少了计算时间。
AI.motivation: 机会约束规划（CCP）在有限支撑情形下，常采用标准Big-M混合整数规划进行重构，但这类重构的线性松弛往往较弱，且随着场景（scenario）数量的增加，求解规模与难度急剧上升，扩展性较差。因此需要更强的割平面来改进松弛质量并提升求解效率。
AI.method: 作者从问题特定的S-free集合出发，推导出两族交集割（intersection cuts），并构建了基于分解（decomposition-based）的分支切割（branch-and-cut）框架。第一族割利用场景需求函数的子模结构（submodular structure），第二族割基于概率覆盖（probability covers）。此外，提出混合分离策略，将经典混合不等式（mixing inequalities）和分位数割（quantile cuts）与所提出的交集割相结合。
AI.result: 在集成生产—配送规划（integrated production-distribution planning）实例上的计算实验表明，相较于单纯使用某一类割的方法，所提出的混合方法能够有效减少计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘问题特定的S-free集合结构（子模结构与概率覆盖）来生成交集割，并将其与经典割相结合，可有效增强CCP在有限支撑下的重构松弛，缓解Big-M方法扩展性差的问题，从而提升求解性能。

title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
summary: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/

AI.tldr: RECAST 将 VLM 的语义推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位结合，构建可执行代价地图，实现鲁棒机器人导航。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型导航模型在训练分布外易失效；VLM 方法虽具备高层理解，但缺乏场景空间定位与动作对齐。作者希望兼得 VLM 的推理能力与视觉基础模型的精确空间落地。
AI.method: 给定机器人前视图像与用户指令，先用 VLM 分解场景，输出四类判断（可通行表面、风险物体、偏好朝向、可穿越空隙）；再由视觉基础模型在图像中定位对应的表面与物体，并将四类判断空间化重铸为一张紧凑代价地图。该地图既作为轨迹解码器的条件，也用于对候选轨迹打分以选取执行动作。为应对 VLM 答案滞后于实时场景，方法同时利用两个时间点的代价地图：VLM 判定的枢轴帧（含全部四类判断）与当前帧（地形与碰撞代价由当前图像重建）。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，仿真中成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，真实四足机器人上提升 31.4 个百分点；碰撞率分别降低 9.6 与 14.3 个百分点，达到所有方法中最低碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: RECAST 通过显式空间化 VLM 判断并融合双帧代价地图，有效提升了跨环境导航的成功率与安全性，验证了“语义推理+空间定位”结合路线的有效性。

title: Coxeter Symmetry in Hypergeometric Functions and Elliptic Integral Moments
summary: We develop a hypergeometric framework for elliptic integral moments organized around Mishev's completed Saalschützian $L$-function and its $W(D_5)$ symmetry. The Bailey--Mishev very-well-poised ${}_7F_6(1)$ representation places complementary elliptic integral moments and harmonic hypergeometric sums in a common parameter space. We first give collision-based hypergeometric derivations of the three complementary-modulus moment families involving $K'^2$, $E'K'$, and $E'^2$. The $E'^2$ identity is also recovered independently from a Barnes-contiguous relation mirroring the differential system of the elliptic integrals. We then derive a hypergeometric evaluation of the harmonic-series representation of the four-Bessel moment $s_{4,0}$. At symmetric parameter points, Coxeter symmetry forces selected Taylor coefficients to vanish along symmetry-adapted paths, producing families of harmonic and special-value identities involving values of the Riemann zeta function and the same Bessel period. The resulting picture shows that these elliptic-moment, harmonic-sum, and special-value identities arise from a common $W(D_5)$ symmetry of generalized hypergeometric functions.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕 Mishev 完成的 Saalschützian $L$-函数及其 $W(D_5)$ 对称性建立椭圆积分矩的超几何框架，给出互补模矩族与四 Bessel 矩 $s_{4,0}$ 的新求值，并揭示椭圆矩、调和和与特殊值恒等式同源于广义超几何函数的 $W(D_5)$ 对称性。
AI.motivation: 椭圆积分矩、调和超几何和与特殊值恒等式通常分散研究，缺乏统一解释；作者希望借助 Mishev 完成的 Saalschützian $L$-函数及其 $W(D_5)$ 对称性，把它们纳入同一参数空间与统一框架。
AI.method: 以 Bailey--Mishev 非常良平衡 ${}_7F_6(1)$ 表示为共同参数空间；采用碰撞法（collision-based）超几何推导三个互补模矩族（含 $K'^2$、$E'K'$、$E'^2$），并独立用 Barnes-相邻关系（Barnes-contiguous relation）恢复 $E'^2$ 恒等式；再对四 Bessel 矩 $s_{4,0}$ 的调和级数表示作超几何求值；最后在对称参数点利用 Coxeter 对称性迫使沿对称适配路径的 Taylor 系数消失。
AI.result: 得到三个互补模矩族的碰撞法超几何推导，$E'^2$ 恒等式的 Barnes-相邻独立验证，四 Bessel 矩 $s_{4,0}$ 的调和级数超几何求值；在对称参数点导出涉及 Riemann zeta 函数值与同一 Bessel 周期的调和恒等式和特殊值恒等式族。
AI.conclusion: 椭圆矩、调和和与特殊值恒等式可由广义超几何函数共同的 $W(D_5)$ 对称性统一生成，Mishev 的 $L$-函数框架为这些看似无关的结果提供了共同来源。

title: Refined Gauss--Lobatto bounds for odd-order convexity
comment: 17 pp., accepted for publication in Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics
summary: For functions that are convex of higher order, classical extremalities identify Gaussian quadrature as a lower bound and Gauss--Lobatto quadrature as an upper bound for the integral. We sharpen this bracket in every odd order: if $f$ is $(2n-1)$-convex on $[-1,1]$, then the exact integral $I[f]:=\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,dx$ lies not merely between the $n$-point Gauss--Legendre rule $G_n[f]$ and the $(n+1)$-point Gauss--Lobatto rule $L_{n+1}[f]$, but already between $G_n[f]$ and their midpoint. This yields the certified estimator $Q_n[f]:=\frac{3}{4}G_n[f]+\frac{1}{4}L_{n+1}[f]$, with $|I[f]-Q_n[f]|\leqslant\frac{1}{4}|L_{n+1}[f]-G_n[f]|$, and the constant $\frac{1}{4}$ is sharp. We also record a complementary phenomenon in even order: for $2n$-convex functions the Gauss--Radau endpoint rules still bracket the integral, but the midpoint of the two Radau rules cannot yield a one-sided refinement. The obstruction is explained by an odd, sign-changing Radau quadrature kernel. Finally, we distinguish numerical certification from ordinary high-order approximation: we include concrete examples from spline, moment and statistical models and report experiments for truncated powers and near-pole Stieltjes kernels, where the shape certificate remains meaningful when classical smoothness-based error constants are unavailable or severely pessimistic.

AI.tldr: 该文针对高阶凸函数，收紧了高斯型求积对积分的上下界：奇数阶时积分位于n点Gauss–Legendre与Gauss–Lobatto中点之间，给出常数1/4尖锐的认证估计Q_n；偶数阶时Radau端点规则仍可夹逼但其中点无法单侧改良，原因在于Radau核为奇、变号；并通过样条、矩、统计模型及截断幂、近极点Stieltjes核实验区分了数值认证与高阶逼近。
AI.motivation: 经典极值性质仅给出Gauss求积为下界、Gauss–Lobatto求积为上界的区间，此类区间在高阶凸性下偏宽；且基于光滑性的误差常数在样条、矩与统计等模型下往往不可用或过于悲观，因此需要更紧的、无需光滑性假设的认证估计。
AI.method: 利用(2n-1)-凸函数性质，将n点Gauss–Legendre规则G_n与(n+1)点Gauss–Lobatto规则L_{n+1}的中点作为新上界，构造认证估计量Q_n=(3/4)G_n+(1/4)L_{n+1}，并证明误差界|I[f]-Q_n|≤(1/4)|L_{n+1}-G_n|且常数1/4尖锐；对偶数阶情形分析Gauss–Radau端点规则的夹逼性及其中点失效，归因于奇、变号的Radau求积核；并通过截断幂和近极点Stieltjes核进行数值实验。
AI.result: 对任意(2n-1)-凸函数，积分I[f]不仅位于G_n与L_{n+1}之间，而且已位于G_n与二者中点之间，从而Q_n给出可认证估计且1/4常数最优；2n-凸函数时两个Radau端点规则仍夹逼积分，但其中点无法实现单侧精化，障碍来自奇、变号的Radau核；实验表明在光滑性误差常数不可用或严重悲观时，形状认证仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在高阶凸性框架下收紧了经典求积夹逼区间，给出尖锐常数的认证估计量，并刻画了偶数阶Radau中点失效的机制；同时强调数值认证不同于普通高阶逼近，在样条、矩与统计模型等缺乏可靠光滑性常数的场景中具有实用价值。

title: Constrained Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with One Projection
summary: Constrained nonconvex optimization has seen increasing application in modern machine learning, such as safe LLM alignment/finetuning, transfer learning and rank-constrained continual learning. The commonly used approach is Projected SGD which requires projection at every iteration. However, projection onto a functional constraint can cost substantially more than a stochastic first-order update. We study whether this operation can be deferred until the end of nonconvex stochastic optimization, and only do it once. For weakly convex, possibly nonsmooth objectives with regular convex constraints, we give a penalized proximal method that uses $\widetilde O(ε^{-4})$ stochastic subgradients and one projection onto the constraint set. The returned point is exactly feasible and has a small Moreau-envelope stationarity measure; for smooth objectives, the same algorithm controls the projected-gradient mapping. For smooth nonconvex constraints, we assume a global lower bound on the infeasible constraint slope which permits arbitrary, possibly infeasible initialization. An exact-penalty variant attains the same stochastic-oracle order and returns an exactly feasible point within $O(ε)$ of an $ε$-KKT point. All intermediate updates use only projections onto a simple Euclidean ball. These are oracle-complexity guarantees: the cost of the single terminal projection is separate, and no efficient projection algorithm for a general nonconvex set is assumed to follow from regularity.

AI.tldr: 提出惩罚近端方法，仅在最后做一次投影，达到 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 随机次梯度复杂度并返回精确可行点。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习中的约束非凸优化（如安全对齐、迁移学习、秩约束持续学习）常用 Projected SGD，但每次迭代都投影到功能约束集的代价远高于随机一阶更新，因此希望探究投影能否推迟到优化结束只做一次。
AI.method: 对弱凸、可能非光滑目标配合正则凸约束，给出惩罚近端方法：中间迭代只用简单欧氏球投影；针对光滑非凸约束，假设不可行约束斜率存在全局下界以允许任意（可能不可行）初始化，并给出精确惩罚变体，仅需一次终端投影。
AI.result: 使用 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 个随机次梯度与一次约束投影，返回点精确可行且 Moreau 包络稳定性度量很小；光滑目标下控制投影梯度映射；精确惩罚变体保持相同随机预言机阶数并返回在 $\varepsilon$-KKT 点 $O(\varepsilon)$ 邻域内的精确可行点。
AI.conclusion: 给出预言机复杂度保证：单次终端投影代价单独计算，且不假设一般非凸集存在由正则性导出的高效投影算法，说明投影确实可在非凸随机优化中推迟至最后一次性完成。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
summary: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: WSM将SLAM范式直接引入下游导航任务，通过增量状态更新、持久记忆与后端误差优化来维护一致的世界状态，端到端联合训练使导航性能与SLAM精度同步提升。
AI.motivation: 传统方法仅将SLAM视为提供位姿、地图或token的上游模块，与下游导航解耦，难以在交互过程中维持连贯的世界状态，限制了长时程世界建模与具身交互能力。
AI.method: WSM采用SLAM核心机制（增量状态更新、持久记忆、后端累积误差优化）维护一致世界状态；在给定当前观测与导航目标时预测未来视觉状态，并联合估计相机运动与稠密几何；空间状态随新观测持续更新，为动作生成与闭环导航提供基础；模型以导航–SLAM联合目标端到端训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，WSM在提升导航性能的同时保持了较强的SLAM精度，验证了SLAM作为长时程世界建模内在机制的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 将SLAM从上游模块转变为导航的内生机制，可同时实现精确几何估计与闭环导航，凸显SLAM在长时程世界建模与具身交互中的价值。

title: Density of $μ$-ordinary Primes for K3 Surfaces
summary: By a result of Bogomolov and Zarhin, a K3 surface $X$ over a number field $L$ has ordinary reduction at a density 1 set of primes after passing to a finite extension of $L$. In this paper, we refine this result for non-CM K3 surfaces whose transcendental Hodge structure has endomorphism field $F$ abelian over $\mathbb{Q}$. We further assume a condition on the connected components of the $l$-adic monodromy group of $X$, and, when $F$ is totally real, a parity condition on the rank of the transcendental lattice over $F$. Under these assumptions, we prove that the set of primes of $L$ at which $X$ has $μ$-ordinary reduction has density $1$. As a corollary, the set of primes of $L$ at which $X$ has ordinary reduction has density $1/[FL:L]$. We include explicit examples of K3 surfaces satisfying these conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文强化了Bogomolov–Zarhin关于K3曲面在数域上普通约化密度的结果，对具有阿贝尔自同态域的非CM K3曲面，在特定单值群和奇偶条件下证明μ-普通约化素数集密度为1，并推出普通约化素数集密度为1/[FL:L]。
AI.motivation: Bogomolov–Zarhin已证K3曲面在有限扩张后密度1的素数处有普通约化，但结论较粗（需扩张、密度为1的集合界定不精确）。本文旨在对非CM且超越Hodge结构自同态域F在Q上阿贝尔的K3曲面精细化该结论，给出精确的普通/μ-普通约化素数密度。
AI.method: 限定非CM K3曲面，要求超越Hodge结构的自同态域F在Q上阿贝尔；附加关于X的l-adic单值群连通分支的条件；当F全实（totally real）时，对超越格在F上的秩施加奇偶条件。在此假设下分析约化在素数处的μ-普通性与普通性，并构造满足条件的显式例子。
AI.result: 在所给假设下，证明L中使X具有μ-普通约化的素数集密度为1；作为推论，使X具有普通约化的素数集密度为1/[FL:L]。同时给出满足这些条件的K3曲面的显式例子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作细化了Bogomolov–Zarhin的密度结果，明确了普通约化素数密度由域扩张次数[FL:L]决定，并通过显式例子验证了假设条件的可实现性。

title: GAC-PINN: Geometry-Adaptive and Constraint-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: For systems with steep gradients, sharp interfaces, or severe spatio-temporal coupling, Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) suffer from spectral bias, geometric inflexibility, and boundary constraint conflicts, which undermine accuracy and convergence. To overcome these issues, we propose a geometry-adaptive and constraint-enhanced PINN (GAC-PINN). The framework comprises four components: a gradient-driven adaptive grid mapping (AGM) for diffeomorphic point concentration with Jacobian regularization, an adaptive bandwidth hard-constraint ansatz with spatially-varying boundary transition widths, a Gaussian Fourier feature mapping as a spectral preconditioner to further enhance high-wavenumber representation, and an operator-aware router that automatically selects the appropriate hard-constraint construction based on whether the governing PDE contains temporal derivatives. An AGM callback mechanism and a three-stage training strategy ensure stable coordination. Benchmarks including the viscous Burgers equation, a sharp-peaked 2D Poisson problem, and the Allen-Cahn phase-transition equation show that GAC-PINN attains relative (L^2) errors of ((1.747\pm 0.450)\times 10^{-4}), ((2.868\pm 0.947)\times 10^{-5}), and ((1.756 \pm 0.712)\times 10^{-3}), respectively, consistently outperforming the baselines. Ablation studies further reveal that AGM alone yields a substantially lower error than residual-based adaptive refinement (RAR), while RAR becomes beneficial only when combined with FFM, demonstrating a context-dependent module interaction. Convergence analysis verifies rapid error reduction and saturation with increasing resolution, establishing a practical adaptive framework for high-fidelity simulation of problems with localized sharp features in applied mechanics and computational physics.

AI.tldr: 提出几何自适应与约束增强的PINN（GAC-PINN），通过四项模块协同解决陡峭梯度问题，在多个基准问题上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 针对具有陡峭梯度、尖锐界面或强时空耦合的系统，传统PINN存在谱偏置、几何不灵活和边界约束冲突等问题，损害了精度与收敛性。
AI.method: 框架包含四部分：(1) 梯度驱动的自适应网格映射（AGM），实现微分同胚的点集中并带Jacobian正则化；(2) 自适应带宽硬约束拟设，边界过渡宽度随空间变化；(3) 高斯傅里叶特征映射（FFM）作为谱预条件子以增强高波数表征；(4) 算子感知路由器，根据控制PDE是否含时间导数自动选择硬约束构造。配合AGM回调机制与三阶段训练策略保证稳定协同。
AI.result: 在粘性Burgers方程、尖峰2D Poisson问题、Allen-Cahn相变方程上，相对L^2误差分别为(1.747±0.450)×10^-4、(2.868±0.947)×10^-5、(1.756±0.712)×10^-3，持续优于基线。消融实验显示：单独AGM误差显著低于基于残差的自适应细化（RAR），而RAR仅在结合FFM时才有益，体现模块间的上下文依赖交互。收敛性分析验证了误差随分辨率增加快速下降并饱和。
AI.conclusion: GAC-PINN为应用力学与计算物理中含局部尖锐特征问题的高保真仿真建立了实用的自适应框架。

title: On the Optimal Linear Minimization Oracle Complexity of Active-Hull Methods for Minimizing Convex Hölder Smooth Functions
summary: We consider the convex problem $(P): {\min}_{y\in \mathbb{R}^n}\, f(Ay)+g(y)$, where $A:\mathbb{R}^n\to \mathbb{R}^m$ is a linear operator, $f$ is convex and $(M,ν)$-Hölder smooth on $\mathbb{R}^m$, and $g$ is proper, closed convex on $\mathbb{R}^n$, and admits a (generalized) linear minimization oracle (LMO). An active-hull (AH) method %refers to the one that %is the one that that calls the LMO in each iteration and outputs a point that lies in the convex hull of all the past LMO returns. We show that in the high-dimensional regime, the optimal LMO complexity for the class of AH methods to solve $(P)$ is $O\big(M^{{2}/({1+ν})}D^2\varepsilon^{-{2}/({1+ν})}\big)$, where $D$ denotes the diameter of the feasible region and $\varepsilon$ the objective sub-optimality gap. In particular, the optimal LMO complexity is achieved by a single-loop first-order primal-dual splitting method. Since this method requires knowledge of the problem parameters (e.g., $M$, $D$ and $ν$), we propose two meta parameter-search algorithms that aim to resolve this issue. These algorithms are parameter-free, but come with the price of an additional log-factor in their LMO complexities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究复合凸优化问题(P)的LMO复杂度，证明AH方法类的最优LMO复杂度为O(M^{2/(1+ν)}D²ε^{-2/(1+ν)})，并由单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法达到；另提出两种免参数检索算法。
AI.motivation: 在复合凸优化问题中，g仅通过（广义）线性最小化预言机（LMO）访问，如何在高维情形下刻画并达到最优的一阶/LMO复杂度是关键问题，同时已有最优方法依赖M、D、ν等未知问题参数，限制了实用性。
AI.method: 针对f为凸且(M,ν)-Hölder光滑、g为正常闭凸并可由（广义）LMO访问的复合问题(P)，研究主动包（AH）方法类（每次迭代调用LMO，输出落在历史LMO返回值凸包内）。通过复杂度下界与上界匹配分析，给出单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法达到最优复杂度，并设计两种元参数搜索算法以实现免参数化。
AI.result: 在高维情形下，AH方法类求解(P)的最优LMO复杂度为O(M^{2/(1+ν)}D²ε^{-2/(1+ν)})，其中D为可行域直径、ε为目标次优间隙；该最优复杂度可由单环一阶原始-对偶分裂方法实现。为解决该方法需要已知M、D、ν的问题，提出两种免参数元搜索算法，其代价是LMO复杂度上多出对数因子。
AI.conclusion: AH方法在高维复合凸优化中达到了关于LMO复杂度的最优阶，且可通过单环原始-对偶分裂算法实现；所提两种免参数算法在牺牲对数因子的情况下消除了对问题参数的依赖。

title: PF-RL: Progress Field Reinforcement Learning via Goal-Conditioned Value Geometry for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning~(RFT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) policies, yet sparse task-level outcomes provide limited credit for intermediate transitions, especially in long-horizon manipulation. A natural approach is to model intermediate task progress and use it as dense feedback for policy improvement. Despite their architectural differences, existing progress-aware methods commonly formulate task progress as an explicit scalar prediction, providing limited structure for modeling how intermediate observations relate to the task goal, which may hinder effective transition-level credit assignment. We introduce Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL), which learns a structured goal-conditioned progress representation over pretrained VLA features and converts it into dense credit for policy optimization. A lightweight shared Progress Field head maps current and goal representations into a compact progress space, where geometric distance induces goal-conditioned value, while complementary temporal and goal-structure objectives shape the learned geometry. Transition-level value changes naturally yield dense progress advantages, enabling fine-grained credit assignment for both offline policy improvement and online reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that PF-RL consistently improves policy performance over strong supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning, and progress-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL)，将任务进度建模为预训练 VLA 特征上的结构化目标条件进度表示，并转化为密集信用以优化策略，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 和真实双臂任务上超越 SFT、RFT 及进度感知基线。
AI.motivation: RFT 改善 VLA 策略时，稀疏的任务级结果难以为中间转移提供有效信用，尤其在长时程操作中。已有进度感知方法虽架构不同，但普遍将任务进度表述为显式标量预测，缺乏刻画中间观测与任务目标关系的结构，可能阻碍转移级信用的有效分配。
AI.method: PF-RL 在预训练 VLA 特征上学习结构化的目标条件进度表示，并转化为密集信用。通过一个轻量共享的 Progress Field 头，将当前表示与目标表示映射到紧凑进度空间，以几何距离诱导目标条件价值；同时引入互补的时间目标与目标结构目标来塑造所学几何。转移级价值变化自然产生密集进度优势，从而支持离线策略改进与在线强化微调的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 及真实双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，PF-RL 持续优于强监督微调、强化微调以及进度感知基线。
AI.conclusion: 将任务进度建模为结构化的目标条件进度场而非显式标量预测，可有效提供转移级密集信用，提升长时程操作的策略性能，并在仿真与真实任务中具一致增益。

title: Finite Element Approximation of a Hemivariational Inequality for Steady-State Heat Conduction: Double-Limit Convergence of Penalization and Discretization
summary: In this paper we study the numerical approximation and convergence analysis of a steady-state heat conduction problem with mixed boundary conditions. The physical model is governed by a hemivariational inequality depending on a heat transfer parameter $α> 0$. We consider the finite element approximation of this penalized problem, as well as its corresponding limit problem with a prescribed constant temperature on a part of the boundary. The main theoretical result establishes the strong convergence of the discrete solutions. Specifically, we prove the double-limit convergence of the finite element approximations to the limit solution as the mesh size $h$ tends to zero and the penalization parameter $α$ tends to infinity, independently and simultaneously. We further complement the convergence analysis with an error estimate of optimal order for the discrete limit problem, and we explain why an estimate uniform in the penalization parameter cannot be expected. The theoretical results are illustrated by numerical simulations on four examples verified by the method of manufactured solutions.

AI.tldr: 研究带混合边界条件的稳态热传导问题，该问题由含热传递参数α的半变分不等式描述，分析其有限元逼近的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 该物理模型由依赖热传递参数α>0的半变分不等式刻画，需要同时处理罚化问题及其极限问题（边界部分给定恒定温度），并研究有限元离散解在网格尺寸与罚参数双重极限下的收敛行为。
AI.method: 对罚化问题进行有限元逼近，同时考虑其对应的极限问题；通过收敛性分析证明离散解当网格尺寸h→0、罚参数α→∞（独立及同时）时的双重极限收敛性，并给出极限问题的最优阶误差估计。
AI.result: 证明了有限元近似解随h→0和α→∞独立及同时趋于极限解的强收敛性；获得了离散极限问题的最优阶误差估计，并说明无法期望得到关于罚参数一致的误差估计；通过四个算例的数值模拟（采用制造解方法验证）佐证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提有限元方法能有效逼近该半变分不等式系统，双重极限收敛性得到理论证明，极限问题具有最优阶误差估计，但关于罚参数的一致误差估计不可行，数值算例验证了理论分析。

title: Regular simplex tensors: optimization landscape, conjecture proof, and beyond
summary: The concept of tensor eigenpairs has attracted increasing research attention in the past decades. Recent works have focused on a special class termed regular simplex tensors, which are constructed from an equiangular tight frame of n vectors in (n-1) dimensional space for n >= 3 and order m >= 3. Existing works focus on analyzing the robustness of eigenpairs obtained by the tensor power method. At the end of that work, a conjecture was made that if they exist, the only robust eigenvectors of a regular simplex tensor, up to sign equivalence, are the vectors in the regular simplex frame. A subsequent study theoretically proved that this holds for the simplest triangle case where n = 3. However, for cases with higher n, the process becomes complicated in both checking all eigenpairs and determining the explicit formula for the robustness criterion. In this paper, to deal with this issue, a connection between robust and locally optimal eigenpairs is built, recognizing the latter as another pivotal concept in the field of optimization. Then, we turn to checking the local optimality of all eigenpairs, for which we have developed an efficient model with a favorable structure that facilitates the enumeration of all eigenpairs and delineates the optimization landscape for the model. Then, integrating the two advances enables us to narrow the scope of the robust eigenpairs to those locally maximized ones, which are exactly the vectors in the regular simplex frame. Finally, the proof of the conjecture reduces to only examining the vectors in the frame, whose robustness can be easily checked for any higher n and m. This work shows that, up to sign equivalence, excluding the exceptional cases (m, n) = (3, 3)/(3, 4)/(4, 3) where no robust eigenpairs exist, the only robust eigenvectors of a regular simplex tensor are the vectors in the regular simplex frame.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立"鲁棒特征对"与"局部最优特征对"之间的联系，将正则单纯形张量鲁棒特征向量的猜想证明归结为对局部极大特征对的检验，从而证明：除少数例外情形外，正则单纯形张量唯一的鲁棒特征向量正是正则单纯形框架中的向量。
AI.motivation: 已有工作对由n维空间中(n-1)维等角紧框架构造的正则单纯形张量提出猜想：若鲁棒特征向量存在，则（在符号等价意义下）仅为框架中的向量。该猜想仅在n=3的三角形情形被理论证明；对更高阶n，逐一检验所有特征对并确定鲁棒性判据的显式公式变得十分复杂。本文旨在突破这一计算与理论瓶颈。
AI.method: 1）建立鲁棒特征对与局部最优特征对之间的等价/联系，将鲁棒性问题转化为优化中的局部最优性问题；2）构建一个结构良好的高效模型，便于枚举全部特征对并刻画该模型的优化景观；3）结合两者，将鲁棒特征对的范围缩小到局部极大特征对，即正则单纯形框架中的向量；4）最终将猜想证明简化为仅检验框架向量，其对任意高阶n和m的鲁棒性易于验证。
AI.result: 证明了该猜想在一般情况下成立：在符号等价意义下，排除不存在鲁棒特征对的例外情形(m,n)=(3,3)、(3,4)、(4,3)后，正则单纯形张量唯一的鲁棒特征向量就是正则单纯形框架中的向量。框架向量的鲁棒性可对任意n和m便捷检验。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入局部最优性视角并设计高效枚举模型，本文成功将正则单纯形张量鲁棒特征向量猜想的证明化繁为简，完整刻画了其鲁棒特征结构，仅存三个例外情形。

title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies demonstrate promising generalization across diverse short-horizon tasks. However, they remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, partly because the large-scale training data is biased toward single-stage manipulation tasks that are cheaper to demonstrate. A single weak atomic skill can cause failures across multiple multi-stage tasks. To address such failures, existing methods often require experts to identify the bottleneck and provide additional demonstrations, making the improvement costly and potentially impractical after deployment. To this end, we present a Self-Evolving Embodied System (SEES) that learns from failures and improves the VLA policy without additional expert demonstrations. SEES decomposes long-horizon tasks into atomic tasks and routes them to corresponding family policies. Each family consists of related atomic skills that share one VLA adapter. During execution, the system automatically monitors atomic-task outcomes to identify the most frequently failing atomic skills as the current bottlenecks. To overcome these bottlenecks, SEES constructs tailored RL tasks in simulation by restoring previously encountered states and generating task-specific success criteria with an LLM. Online RL updates the shared family adapters to promote positive transfer among related atomic skills and cumulative improvement across evolution rounds. Extensive experiments show that SEES can be integrated with different VLA backbones to progressively improve their long-horizon performance. We also observe continued improvement on unseen tasks, providing evidence of transfer beyond the evolution settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自进化具身系统SEES，通过失败监测与仿真强化学习自动修复VLA策略的薄弱原子技能，无需额外专家示范即可持续提升长时程任务表现。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA策略在短时程任务上泛化性良好，但在长时程任务上表现不可靠。根本原因在于大规模训练数据偏向单阶段操作任务，导致某些原子技能薄弱，而单个弱技能会在多个多阶段任务中引发连锁失败。现有改进方法依赖专家定位瓶颈并补充示范，成本高且在部署后往往不可行。
AI.method: SEES将长时程任务分解为原子任务并路由至对应的家族策略，每个家族由共享同一VLA适配器的相关原子技能组成。执行时系统自动监测原子任务结果，识别失败频率最高的原子技能作为当前瓶颈；随后在仿真中通过恢复历史状态并由LLM生成任务特定的成功判据，构造针对性RL任务；再用在线RL更新共享的家族适配器，以促进相关原子技能间的正迁移和跨进化轮次的累积提升。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SEES可与不同VLA骨干网络集成，并逐步提升其长时程任务性能；同时在未见过任务上也观察到持续改进，说明其泛化能力超出进化设置本身。
AI.conclusion: SEES提供了一种无需额外专家示范、从失败中自进化的VLA改进框架，通过原子技能分解、瓶颈识别与仿真RL适配器更新，实现长时程任务的持续提升与跨任务迁移。

title: Plectic Lie Algebra Action on Hilbert modular varieties
summary: We construct some part of the plectic Galois action on the locally analytic $p$-adically completed cohomology of Hilbert modular varieties, predicted by the plectic conjecture of Nekovář-Scholl. As a byproduct, we prove a vanishing result for the completed cohomology of Hilbert modular varieties below middle degree. To do this, we make use of the partial Sen operators constructed earlier by a geometric method.

AI.tldr: 本文在Hilbert模簇局部解析p进完备上同调上构造了Nekovář-Scholl plectic猜想所预测的部分plectic Galois作用，并据此证明了中间度以下完备上同调的消没结果，方法基于已有的部分Sen算子。
AI.motivation: Nekovář-Scholl提出的plectic猜想预测Hilbert模簇的（完备）上同调上存在一个比通常Galois作用更大的plectic Galois作用。该作用的存在性与结构尚待验证；同时中间度以下完备上同调的消没性也是理解其结构的自然问题。本文旨在部分实现这一猜想并给出应用。
AI.method: 在Hilbert模簇的局部解析p进完备上同调上，构造plectic Galois作用的一部分。工具是先前用几何方法构造的部分Sen算子（partial Sen operators），利用它们在该上同调空间上定义相应的作用。
AI.result: 成功构造出plectic Galois作用的一部分，验证了plectic猜想在相应范围内的预测；作为副产品，得到Hilbert模簇完备上同调在中间度以下（below middle degree）的消没定理。
AI.conclusion: 本文部分实现了Nekovář-Scholl的plectic猜想，并借助部分Sen算子给出了中间度以下完备上同调的消没结果，为后续研究完整plectic作用与上同调消没性提供了基础和工具。

title: High-order energy diminishing ALE-SAV finite element methods for two-phase Navier--Stokes flow
summary: We develop a high-order fully discrete ALE-SAV finite element method for sharp-interface two-phase Navier--Stokes flow that satisfies a discrete energy dissipation law. We introduce an SAV reformulation to ensure the stable treatment of the surface and gravitational potential energies, together with an energy-stable ALE transfer operator that controls the density-weighted kinetic energy across moving meshes. The resulting scheme is linear and satisfies a modified energy-dissipation inequality. Numerical experiments, including rising-bubble benchmarks, demonstrate the robustness of the method and confirm second-order convergence in time and arbitrarily high-order convergence in space.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种高阶全离散ALE-SAV有限元方法,用于锐界面两相Navier-Stokes流动,满足离散能量耗散律。
AI.motivation: 锐界面两相Navier-Stokes流数值模拟中,移动网格(ALE)与界面、重力势能等能量项的处理易破坏离散能量稳定性,需构造保持能量耗散性质的高阶格式。
AI.method: 采用SAV(标量辅助变量)重构以稳定处理表面能与重力势能;引入能量稳定的ALE网格传递算子,控制动网格间的密度加权动能;构造线性格式,满足修正的能量耗散不等式;结合高阶有限元实现空间高阶离散。
AI.result: 格式为线性且满足修正能量耗散不等式;数值实验(含上升气泡基准)验证了方法鲁棒性,并确认时间上二阶收敛、空间上任意高阶收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了锐界面两相流动的线性、能量稳定、高阶全离散ALE-SAV有限元模拟,兼具稳定性与高精度。

title: A One-Factorization Predictor-Corrector Long-Step Arc-Search Method and a Curvature-Amplified Variant for Semidefinite Programming with a Homogeneous Self-Dual Embedding
summary: In a predictor-corrector arc-search method, a point on the predictor arc is first selected and a corrector is then computed at that point. Since the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) matrix changes with the selected point, this correction may require a second factorization in each iteration. We propose a one-factorization arc-search method (OFAS) for semidefinite programming (SDP) that avoids this second factorization, retains the corrector after the arc step, and uses only one KKT factorization per iteration. The key is a three-term decomposition of the complementarity mismatch at the selected point on the arc, which allows the correction to be assembled from linear-system solutions using the factorization at the current iterate. We also propose a curvature-amplified variant (CA-OFAS) that amplifies the second-order arc term. The proposed methods are formulated with a homogeneous self-dual embedding. For a wide long-step neighborhood, we prove that both methods reduce the homogeneous complementarity and residuals below $\varepsilon$ in $O(n \log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations for an $n$-by-$n$ SDP matrix variable. Numerical experiments show that the one-factorization structure and the correction after the arc step are associated with reductions in computation time. Compared with the Mehrotra-type method, CA-OFAS reduces the geometric-mean computation time by 17% on SDPLIB and 13% on neural network verification SDP problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出单次分解弧搜索方法（OFAS）及其曲率放大变体（CA-OFAS），用于半定规划，每迭代仅需一次KKT分解，并保持O(n log(1/ε))的迭代复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统预测-校正弧搜索方法中，预测弧上选定点处的KKT矩阵随点变化，导致每次迭代需要第二次矩阵分解，计算开销较大。作者希望消除这一额外分解，降低每次迭代的计算成本。
AI.method: 提出OFAS：在弧步之后保留校正项，仅使用当前迭代点的KKT分解完成校正；核心是弧上选定点处互补性失配的三项分解，使得校正可通过当前迭代分解的线性系统解组装得到。进一步提出曲率放大变体CA-OFAS，放大弧的二阶项。两种方法均基于齐次自对偶嵌入框架，并在宽长步邻域内进行复杂度分析。
AI.result: 理论证明两种方法在宽长步邻域内均能在O(n log(1/ε))次迭代内将齐次互补性与残差降至ε以下（针对n×n半定矩阵变量）。数值实验表明单次分解结构与弧步后校正可减少计算时间；与Mehrotra型方法相比，CA-OFAS在SDPLIB上几何平均计算时间减少17%，在神经网络验证SDP问题上减少13%。
AI.conclusion: 通过三项分解实现每次迭代仅一次KKT分解的弧搜索SDP算法，在保持理论迭代复杂度的同时显著降低实际计算时间，CA-OFAS效果尤为突出。

title: MORPH: Self-Organising Multi-Robot Task Allocation via Neuroplasticity-Inspired Adaptive Topology
comment: Full version of the paper published in The 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS), 2026.The implementation and experiment scripts are available at https://github.com/Cyber-physical-Systems-Lab/morph_v2
summary: Multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) in dynamic environments faces a fundamental tension: effective coordination requires learned structure, but that structure must adapt when conditions change. Existing methods resolve this by assuming prior task knowledge, a utility function, a cost matrix, or a trained policy making them brittle when deployed without such knowledge or when task distributions shift. We present MORPH(Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy), a training-free MRTA framework where global allocation quality emerges from 4 local plasticity rules (synaptic, homeostatic, structural, and metaplasticity) applied to a directed pairwise preference matrix updated from runtime co-occurrence and task-completion feedback. MORPH requires no task model, no bid computation, and no offline training; response decisions use learned AGV-to-Picker preferences rather than a fixed proximity rule. Within the Gerkey-Mataric MRTA taxonomy, MORPH is the first method in the single-task, single-robot, instantaneous-assignment class to learn directed pairwise allocation preferences online. Evaluated on the TA-RWARE warehouse benchmark (8-24 agents, 4 maps, 800 steps per episode, 5 seeds), MORPH achieves 110% of all-to-all throughput at N=24 while using only 21% of possible coordination links as an efficiency advantage that grows monotonically with fleet size. Under spatial task distribution shift, MORPH degrades 3x less than proximity-based methods while its learned preferences remain uncorrelated with Manhattan distance. Systematic ablation confirms all four plasticity rules contribute measurably. Two allocation properties emerge without programming: cross-type preference dominance and progressive preference sparsification, mirroring the developmental refinement of biological neural circuits. Learned preferences are driven by task co-occurrence history, not spatial proximity.

AI.tldr: MORPH：一种无需训练的多机器人任务分配框架，用4条局部可塑性规则在线学习有向成对偏好矩阵，在动态环境下兼顾协调结构与适应性。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下的MRTA存在根本矛盾：有效协调需要习得的结构，而该结构又必须随条件变化而调整。现有方法依赖先验任务知识、效用函数、代价矩阵或已训练策略，在缺乏这些知识或任务分布发生偏移时表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出MORPH（Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy），一种免训练框架：将突触、稳态、结构和元可塑性4条局部可塑性规则施加于一个由运行时共现与任务完成反馈更新的有向成对偏好矩阵，全局分配质量由此涌现。无需任务模型、投标计算与离线训练，响应决策基于习得的AGV-拣选员偏好而非固定邻近规则。
AI.result: 在TA-RWARE仓库基准（8-24智能体、4张地图、每回合800步、5个随机种子）上，N=24时达到全连接吞吐量的110%，仅使用21%的潜在协调链路，且效率优势随规模单调增长。空间任务分布偏移下退化程度比邻近型方法低3倍，习得偏好与曼哈顿距离不相关。消融实验证实四条可塑性规则均有可测贡献。无需编程即涌现两类分配特性：跨类型偏好主导与渐进式偏好稀疏化。
AI.conclusion: MORPH在Gerkey-Mataric分类体系中的单任务、单机器人、瞬时分配类中首次实现有向成对分配偏好的在线学习；偏好由任务共现历史而非空间邻近驱动，其发展性细化过程与生物神经回路相似。

title: Isogeometric multi-patch preconditioner for time-dependent electromagnetic problems
summary: We build upon recent developments in high-order spline-based geometric methods for the three-dimensional initial boundary value problem of Maxwell's equations. Previous schemes were limited to single-patch geometries. To address the computational challenges associated with inverting mass matrices in multi-patch settings, we extend existing techniques for 0-forms mass and stiffness matrices to 1-forms mass matrices. Our approach leverages the tensor-product structure of spline spaces to construct a spectrally equivalent preconditioner for the 1-forms mass matrices. Specifically, we design an efficient preconditioner for single-patch domains that is robust with respect to both mesh size and spline degree. In the multi-patch case, this methodology is extended by integrating the single-patch preconditioner with an additive Schwarz approach, ensuring robustness and scalability with respect to the number of patches. We analyze the computational complexity of the proposed preconditioner and validate its robustness and efficiency through comprehensive numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文为高阶样条几何方法下的三维Maxwell方程初边值问题设计了高效的1-形式质量矩阵预条件子。
AI.motivation: 以往高阶样条几何方法仅限于单块（single-patch）几何，多块情形下质量矩阵求逆面临较大计算挑战，需要扩展相应技术。
AI.method: 将已有的0-形式质量与刚度矩阵技术推广到1-形式质量矩阵；利用样条空间的张量积结构构造谱等价的预条件子；单块情形设计对网格尺寸与样条次数均鲁棒的预条件子，多块情形则将其与加性Schwarz方法结合，保证对块数的鲁棒性与可扩展性；并分析计算复杂度。
AI.result: 提出的预条件子在网格尺寸与样条次数上保持鲁棒性，多块情形下对块数具有鲁棒性与可扩展性，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将样条几何方法从单块推广至多块情形，为Maxwell方程的1-形式质量矩阵提供了鲁棒且高效的预条件策略。

title: Linesearch-Free Nonlinearly Preconditioned GD with Semiautomatic Geometry Design
summary: Nonlinear preconditioning makes it possible to adapt gradient updates to the growth of the objective's curvature, but combining its design with suitable stepsize selection is challenging. We propose adaptive dual preconditioned gradient descent (adaptive DPGD), which combines curvature-based preconditioner design with a linesearch-free stepsize rule based on local information. For convex objectives, we establish linear convergence under local strong convexity of the objective. By adapting the stepsize rule, we extend the method to weakly convex objectives and establish asymptotic stationarity without global Lipschitz smoothness. Moreover, our local assumptions give greater freedom in preconditioner design. We exploit this freedom to develop a semiautomatic recipe guided by the objective's curvature, yielding a family of preconditioners that includes those underlying normalized and hyperbolic gradient descent. Experiments on convex and weakly convex problems with real data demonstrate the effectiveness of the preconditioner design and adaptive stepsize selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应对偶预条件梯度下降（adaptive DPGD），将曲率型预条件设计与基于局部信息的无线搜索步长规则结合，在凸与弱凸目标上分别建立线性收敛与渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 非线性预条件可让梯度更新适应目标曲率的增长，但将其与合适的步长选择相结合具有挑战性，现有方法难以兼顾预条件器设计与步长规则的协调。
AI.method: 提出 adaptive DPGD，联合曲率型预条件器设计与无需线搜索、仅依赖局部信息的步长规则；通过在局部强凸下建立线性收敛，并调整步长规则推广至弱凸目标，在无全局 Lipschitz 光滑性假设下建立渐近稳定性；利用局部假设带来的设计自由度，提出由目标曲率引导的半自动配方，导出一族包含归一化梯度下降与双曲梯度下降预条件器的预条件器族。
AI.result: 理论上：凸目标在局部强凸下具线性收敛，弱凸目标下无需全局 Lipschitz 光滑即获渐近稳定性。实验上：在真实数据的凸与弱凸问题上验证了预条件器设计与自适应步长选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应 DPGD 成功将曲率型预条件设计与无线搜索自适应步长统一，既放松了对全局光滑性和预条件器形式的限制，又在理论与实验上验证了有效性。

title: An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning
summary: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验研究视觉模仿学习中哪些设计选择能让视觉运动策略跨视角泛化，发现保留密集视觉token并让动作头参与几何推理可显著提升视角泛化，且该策略能从仿真零样本迁移到真实世界随机相机配置。
AI.motivation: 视觉模仿学习虽能训练完成多样任务的机器人操作策略，但现有策略对视角扰动脆弱，难以在不同环境中部署。作者希望厘清哪些设计选择决定了视觉运动策略的视角泛化能力。
AI.method: 开展受控经验性研究（controlled empirical study），系统对比不同设计选择对视角泛化的影响。关键设计为：保留密集视觉token（dense visual tokens），并让动作头（action head）参与几何推理。在覆盖广泛相机位姿的仿真任务套件上评估策略表现。
