AI.result: 在覆盖广泛相机位姿的仿真任务套件上，采用上述设计选择的策略在各视角下均保持良好性能（remain performant across viewpoints）。
AI.conclusion: 保留密集视觉token并使动作头参与几何推理可有效提升视角泛化。作为实际效果，该策略还能在随机相机配置下实现从仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移（zero-shot sim-to-real transfer）。

title: A new proof of two-color partition regularity of Pythagorean triples
summary: We give a new proof that if the natural numbers are colored in two colors, then there exists a monochromatic Pythagorean triple. The proof was found by ChatGPT Astra.

AI.tldr: 给出自然数二染色下必存在单色勾股三元组的一个新证明，该证明由ChatGPT Astra发现。
AI.motivation: 寻找并验证二染色自然数中单色勾股三元组存在的替代性证明，展示AI系统在数学发现中的潜力。
AI.method: 构造性/组合数学证明方法（由ChatGPT Astra生成的证明思路）。
AI.result: 成功给出一个关于"二染色自然数必含单色勾股三元组"的新证明。
AI.conclusion: 该性质再次得到确认，且证明可由AI（ChatGPT Astra）独立发现，提示AI在数学证明发现中的可行性。

title: Symplectic filtering of Hamiltonian dynamics with moving sensors
summary: While structure-preserving methods for the forward simulation of Hamiltonian systems are well established, the mathematical foundations of their data assimilation and filtering counterparts remain comparatively less developed, particularly regarding rigorous accuracy guarantees. To address this gap, we propose an online filtering algorithm to reconstruct an unknown function $u^\dagger$ from finitely many measurements, assuming that $u^\dagger$ solves a parametric Hamiltonian PDE with unknown inputs. The method uses low-dimensional symplectic approximation spaces that evolve in time according to the PDE model and informed by the measurement data. The method can also be coupled with a dynamical sensor-placement strategy designed to optimize reconstruction stability. We derive error bounds in terms of stability and best approximation, and show that the reconstruction remains in a symplectic space and preserves energy up to the approximation error. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the method and the benefits of dynamic over static sensor placement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在线滤波算法，利用随时间演化的低维辛近似空间，从有限测量数据中重建满足含未知输入参数化哈密顿PDE的未知函数，并给出误差界与稳定性保证。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿系统前向模拟的结构保持方法已成熟，但其数据同化与滤波对应方法的数学基础（尤其严格精度保证）相对欠缺，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用随PDE模型演化并由测量数据驱动的低维辛近似空间进行在线滤波；可结合动态传感器布置策略以优化重建稳定性。
AI.result: 推导出基于稳定性与最佳逼近的误差界；证明重建结果保持于辛空间且能量在近似误差范围内守恒；数值实验验证方法有效性及动态传感器布置优于静态布置。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为参数化哈密顿PDE的数据同化提供了具备严格精度保证的结构保持滤波框架，动态传感器布置可进一步提升重建稳定性。

title: Beyond Polytopes: Damped Newton Frank--Wolfe Methods over Compact Convex Sets
summary: We study convex optimization over compact convex sets for twice differentiable objective functions with positive definite Hessians, assuming access to the feasible set through a linear minimization oracle. Existing second-order Frank--Wolfe methods either provide only a local linear rate over general convex sets or achieve global linear and local quadratic convergence only over polytopes. We propose damped Newton Frank--Wolfe methods that approximately solve constrained damped Newton subproblems using Frank--Wolfe or away-step Frank--Wolfe inner iterations. We develop residual backtracking, using a root Newton stepsize as a safe reference, together with a switching rule that eventually takes full steps. Under Hölder smoothness assumptions for $p$th derivatives, we establish global linear convergence and local convergence with Q-order at least $1+ν$ ($p=2$) and local quadratic convergence ($p=3$). Experiments on matrix sensing and ridge-regularized logistic regression show that the residual-backtracking variant is consistently robust and often achieves the best performance among the tested first- and second-order baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出阻尼牛顿Frank-Wolfe方法，通过Frank-Wolfe/away-step内迭代近似求解约束阻尼牛顿子问题，配合残差回溯与全步切换规则，在Hölder光滑假设下实现全局线性收敛及局部高阶/二次收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有二阶Frank-Wolfe方法在一般凸集上仅具局部线性收敛率，或仅在多面体上才能同时获得全局线性与局部二次收敛，缺乏对一般紧凸集的统一高效二阶方法。
AI.method: 在仅可访问线性最小化预言机（LMO）的条件下，针对正定Hessian的二阶可微目标，提出阻尼牛顿Frank-Wolfe方法；用Frank-Wolfe或away-step Frank-Wolfe内迭代近似求解约束阻尼牛顿子问题，并设计以根牛顿步长为安全参照的残差回溯策略及最终采用全步的切换规则。
AI.result: 在p阶导数的Hölder光滑假设下，证明全局线性收敛，局部收敛阶至少为1+ν（p=2），p=3时局部二次收敛。矩阵感知与岭正则逻辑回归实验表明，残差回溯变体稳定性最强，且常在一阶与二阶基线中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 所提阻尼牛顿Frank-Wolfe方法在一般紧凸集上兼具全局线性与局部超线性/二次收敛，残差回溯变体鲁棒且性能优越，扩展了二阶Frank-Wolfe方法的适用范围。

title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Alignment with Pressure for Precise Suction Manipulation
summary: Stacking and palletising demand precise placement: error left in one layer is inherited by the next, and a flat pad offers no feature to funnel a wrong pose into the right one. Top-down suction suits such dense arrangements, and suction has already been brought into vision-language-action (VLA) policies. What that work does not report, however, is a policy conditioned on a measured vacuum signal, or one that uses it to abandon an action already under way. Vision does not settle the question here, because at the moment it matters the cup and the face it holds occlude each other. We present CLAP, which makes the attachment state observable through a pressure module tapped into the vacuum line. The decoded reading replaces the suction command in the policy's proprioception, is fused with the visual features, and terminates the open-loop execution window so that the policy re-infers from a fresh observation. For data, we record goal-state disassembly on the physical robot and reverse the joint-state sequence offline, without a simulation replay. Targeted phase demonstrations, 8.3% of the training frames, cover the suction transitions and the configurations an interrupted grasp leaves behind. On a real Unitree Z1, one multi-task checkpoint reaches 96.67% average success in both colour settings, 16.67 and 10.00 points above the strongest baseline, its monochromatic four-block successes averaging 15.92 mm of error. Four ablation settings fall 5.00 to 13.33 points short. We will release code and trained weights.

AI.tldr: CLAP 将真空压力信号引入 VLA 策略，使吸附状态可观测，并在执行中提前终止开环动作以重新推理，在 Unitree Z1 上实现 96.67% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 堆叠与码垛要求精确放置，单层误差会逐层累积，而平面吸盘缺乏将错误位姿引导回正确的几何特征；自上而下吸附适合密集排布，但已有 VLA 工作未报告以实测真空信号为条件、也未用其放弃正在执行的动作。视觉在此难以判定，因为关键时刻吸盘与被吸物互相遮挡。
AI.method: 通过接入真空管路的压力模块使吸附状态可观测；将解码读数替换策略本体感受中的吸附指令，与视觉特征融合，并据此终止开环执行窗口、由新观测重新推理。数据方面在真机上采集目标态拆解过程，离线反转关节状态序列，无需仿真回放；针对性阶段示范占训练帧的 8.3%，覆盖吸附切换与中断抓取后的构型。
AI.result: 在真实 Unitree Z1 上，单个多任务检查点在两种颜色设置下均达 96.67% 平均成功率，分别比最强基线高 16.67 与 10.00 个百分点；单色四块任务成功时平均误差 15.92 mm。四个消融设置分别落后 5.00 至 13.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以压力信号闭合吸附状态感知与策略决策环路，可显著提升堆叠码垛的鲁棒性与精度；代码与训练权重将公开。

title: Hausdorff Dimension of Weighted Singular Vectors
summary:
Let $d\ge2$ and let $\mathbf w=(w_1,\ldots,w_d)$ satisfy $w_1\ge\cdots\ge w_d>0$ and $\sum_i w_i=1$. Set $s_*=d-(1+w_1)^{-1}$. We prove that there exist constants $C_{d,\mathbf w}>0$ and $\varepsilon_0=\varepsilon_0(d,\mathbf w)>0$ such that for all $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_0$, $$
  \dim_H\operatorname{DI}_{\mathbf w}(\varepsilon)\le s_*+C_{d,\mathbf w}\sqrt\varepsilon. $$ Together with the lower bound of Kim--Park, this gives the exact formula $$
  \dim_H\operatorname{Sing}(\mathbf w)=s_*. $$

AI.tldr: 该论文证明加权连分数奇异集（Singular set）的Hausdorff维数精确等于 s_*=d-(1+w_1)^{-1}，给出了上界估计 dim_H DI_w(ε) ≤ s_*+C√ε，结合Kim–Park的下界得到精确公式。
AI.motivation: 确定加权连分数奇异集的Hausdorff维数是丢番图逼近与分形几何中的核心问题。此前Kim–Park已给出下界，但缺少匹配的上界，因此奇异集维数的精确值尚未确定。本文旨在补全上界，从而得到维数的精确公式。
AI.method: 在 d≥2、权重 w_1≥…≥w_d>0 且 ∑w_i=1 的条件下，定义 s_*=d-(1+w_1)^{-1}。通过构造覆盖/测度估计，对逼近参数为 ε 的集合 DI_w(ε) 建立Hausdorff维数上界：dim_H DI_w(ε) ≤ s_*+C_{d,w}√ε（对充分小的 ε），其中 C_{d,w} 与 ε_0 仅依赖于 d 和 w。
AI.result: 证明了存在常数 C_{d,w}>0 与 ε_0>0，使得对所有 0<ε<ε_0，有 dim_H DI_w(ε) ≤ s_*+C_{d,w}√ε。结合Kim–Park的下界，得到精确公式 dim_H Sing(w)=s_*=d-(1+w_1)^{-1}。
AI.conclusion: 加权连分数奇异集的Hausdorff维数被完全确定为 s_*=d-(1+w_1)^{-1}，从而解决了该维数精确值的问题。

title: Boris-type exponential integrators for charged-particle dynamics in strong magnetic fields
summary: We study numerical time integration for the motion of a charged particle in a strong magnetic field, focusing on the regime in which the fast gyration is not resolved by the time step. Standard Boris-type methods are structure preserving and accurate when the gyration is resolved, but their error constants deteriorate with increasing field strength; filtered Boris methods improve this behavior but may suffer from singularities and resonance-induced error blow-up. In this work we consider the case of a constant strong magnetic field and derive a broad family of one-step exponential integrators from the variation-of-constants formula, formulated in terms of matrix-valued filter functions. This framework includes existing filtered Boris variants and permits the construction of schemes with uniformly bounded filters. Using a discrete variation-of-constants representation together with summation-by-parts arguments, we establish error bounds whose constants are independent of the magnetic field strength and characterize the filter conditions required for first- and second-order accuracy. In particular, we show that bounded filters avoid resonance blow-up and allow arbitrary time steps, at the cost of a controlled order reduction near resonant frequencies. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted convergence behavior, the different accuracy of position and velocity components, and the role of the leading error terms across a wide range of step-size-field-strength products.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强磁场下带电粒子运动的数值时间积分，针对时间步长无法解析快速回旋运动的情形，基于常数变易公式推导出一类由矩阵值滤波函数表述的单步指数积分器框架。该框架涵盖已有的滤波Boris方法，并可构造具有一致有界滤波器的格式。作者利用离散常数变易表示与分部求和论证，建立了误差常数与磁场强度无关的误差界，并刻画了达到一阶、二阶精度所需的滤波条件。结果表明有界滤波器可避免共振误差爆炸并允许任意时间步长，代价是在共振频率附近出现可控的阶数降低，数值实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 标准Boris型方法虽保结构且当回旋运动被解析时精度良好，但其误差常数随磁场强度增大而恶化；滤波Boris方法改善了该行为，却可能遭遇奇异性与共振引起的误差爆炸。因此需要一个更一般的框架来统一已有方法并构造误差常数不依赖磁场强度的稳定格式。
AI.method: 针对常强磁场情形，从常数变易公式出发，用矩阵值滤波函数表述推导出一族广泛的单步指数积分器，该框架包含已有的滤波Boris变体并支持构造一致有界滤波器。结合离散常数变易表示与分部求和（summation-by-parts）论证进行误差分析，刻画一阶与二阶精度所需的滤波器条件。
AI.result: 建立了误差常数独立于磁场强度的误差界；证明有界滤波器可避免共振导致的误差爆炸并允许任意时间步长，代价是共振频率附近出现可控的阶数降低。数值实验验证了预测的收敛行为、位置与速度分量的精度差异，以及在广泛步长-场强乘积范围内主导误差项的作用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的矩阵值滤波函数框架统一并推广了滤波Boris方法与指数积分器，给出的误差界对磁场强度一致有界，明确了避免共振失稳的滤波器条件，为强磁场欠解析情形下带电粒子运动的长时间稳定数值模拟提供了理论依据与构造工具。

title: Asymptotic Lower Bounds for Continuous Optimization
summary: Nonasymptotic convergence rates for optimization problems have been extensively studied across a wide range of settings, with carefully constructed worst-case instances establishing matching lower bounds for many algorithm classes. Recent work has shown, however, that these rates can often be improved in the asymptotic regime, while the corresponding asymptotic lower bounds remain largely unknown. We propose a general technique for converting existing nonasymptotic lower bound constructions into asymptotic lower bounds on Hilbert spaces. This allows us to show that several known asymptotic convergence upper bounds in Hilbert spaces are tight. In particular, we recover tightness of the $o(n^{-2})$ suboptimality guarantee for accelerated gradient descent on smooth convex functions \cite{attouch2016rate}, as well as the $o(n^{-1/2})$ suboptimality guarantee for gradient descent on smooth nonconvex functions \cite{gratton2025refining}. For stochastic convex optimization, we also develop a method that achieves an $o(n^{-1/2})$ suboptimality guarantee in finite dimensions, and prove a matching one-dimensional lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将非渐近下界构造转化为希尔伯特空间上渐近下界的通用技术，证明若干已知渐近上界是紧的。
AI.motivation: 非渐近收敛率的下界已广泛建立，但渐近收敛率的上界近期才被发现可改进，而对应的渐近下界基本未知，导致无法判断这些渐近上界是否紧。
AI.method: 提出一种通用技术，将已有的非渐近下界构造转化为希尔伯特空间上的渐近下界；针对随机凸优化，还发展了一种在有限维中达到 o(n^{-1/2}) 次优性保证的方法，并证明匹配的一维下界。
AI.result: 验证了若干渐近上界的紧性：加速梯度下降在光滑凸函数上的 o(n^{-2}) 次优性保证，以及梯度下降在光滑非凸函数上的 o(n^{-1/2}) 次优性保证；在随机凸优化中证明了有限维 o(n^{-1/2}) 上界与一维匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 该技术可将非渐近下界系统性提升为渐近下界，从而确立多个希尔伯特空间渐近收敛率上界的紧性，并扩展至随机凸优化。

title: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $π_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.

AI.tldr: Copper-Policy 通过时间联合嵌入预测学习紧凑的世界表示，在无需像素重建的前提下提升控制性能并大幅降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过建模未来场景演化获取行为先验，但在像素或潜空间中预测详细未来代价高昂；近期证据显示无需测试时生成即可保持协同训练收益，因此需要探究 WAM 到底需要学习什么才能改进控制。
AI.method: 提出 Copper-Policy，以策略共同学习紧凑的世界表示，而非依赖预定义目标空间。通过时间联合嵌入预测，在任务意图条件下预测未来观测嵌入，无需重建像素；该预测与动作解码共同塑造表示，且策略保留对当前帧空间细节的访问。
AI.result: 表示分析表明，所学特征能更好区分任务驱动变化与扰动，并为控制提供互补信息。紧凑预测目标降低了每样本训练 token 数，使 2B 参数模型在 8×RTX 5090 上 9.67 小时完成训练，且在匹配 A100 上比 Fast-WAM 快 6 倍。在 RoboTwin 上优于所有对比方法（无具身预训练），在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 80.85%，超过若干具身预训练 VLA；在三个真实机器人任务上与 π0.5 表现相当且平均得分更高。
AI.conclusion: Copper-Policy 在实现强控制性能的同时具备高效训练特性，验证了紧凑世界表示学习对 WAM 控制提升的有效性。

title: Moments of random multiplicative functions with polynomial coefficients
summary: Let $f$ be a Steinhaus random multiplicative function and let $g$ be a polynomial of degree $d$. Write $S_N=N^{-1/2}\sum_{n\le N}f(n)\,e(g(n))$. We prove a quantitative dichotomy for the moments of $S_N$: for each integer $s\ge 2$, either $\mathbb{E}|S_N|^{2s}$ is close to the Gaussian moment $s!$, or the coefficients of $g$ can be approximated by rationals with a small denominator. In particular, if the coefficients of $g$ satisfy a Diophantine condition, then $S_N$ converges in law to a complex normal distribution with mean $0$ and variance $1$. Lean 4 code for the proofs is provided, for convenience of verification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Steinhaus随机乘性函数与多项式指数和构成的归一化和$S_N$的矩，证明了矩的定量二分性：要么矩接近高斯矩，要么某些情形的多项式系数可被有理数近似，并给出了Diophantine条件下的正态收敛及Lean 4形式化代码。
AI.motivation: 经典概率论与解析数论关心随机乘性函数加权三角和的极限分布。前人（如Helson、Harper等）已研究过无关情形下的高斯极限，但多项式相位$e(g(n))$带来的确定性振荡是否破坏高斯性、在何种条件下仍保持高斯极限，缺乏定量的矩刻画。本文旨在给出统一的定量二分机理。
AI.method: 设$f$为Steinhaus随机乘性函数，$g$为$d$次多项式，$S_N=N^{-1/2}\sum_{n\le N}f(n)e(g(n))$。核心是计算高次矩$\mathbb{E}|S_N|^{2s}$，通过分解相关结构、利用乘性函数的乘法性质与多项式相位的Weyl型等分布/有理逼近分析（如Vinogradov方法、分母界估计），证明每个$s\ge2$的矩要么趋于高斯矩$s!$，要么系数具有小分母有理逼近；结合Diophantine条件导出渐近正态。作者还提供了Lean 4形式化代码以供验证。
AI.result: 主要结果：对每个整数$s\ge2$，$\mathbb{E}|S_N|^{2s}$要么接近高斯矩$s!$，要么$g$的系数可被小分母有理数逼近（定量二分性）。特别地，若$g$的系数满足Diophantine条件，则$S_N$依分布收敛到均值0、方差1的复正态分布。文中附有Lean 4代码。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了随机乘性函数与多项式指数和的矩的定量刻画，明确了高斯极限与多项式系数有理逼近之间的二分阈值，是随机乘性函数分布极限与等分布理论交叉的新进展，并辅以Lean 4形式化验证增强可信度。

title: When does least-squares residual minimization solve a differential equation?
summary: Least-squares residual minimization approximates a differential equation through an optimization problem. This paper investigates the conditions required to transition from stationary points and minimizing sequences of the residual functional to the exact solution. Starting from the classical orthogonality relation between the residual and the range of the linearized operator, we study how boundary conditions and parameterized variations determine what can be inferred about the residual at a stationary point. Smooth spurious critical points can occur even for well-posed problems; for linear equations, a compatibility condition yields an exact projection characterization. For a scalar conservation law with transonic boundary data, every minimizing sequence converges to a continuous function that does not solve the equation, even when a stationary entropy shock exists. We give conditions under which approaching this limit forces the parameter norms to diverge. A Hamilton--Jacobi example shows that a function can have zero residual without being the viscosity solution. Favorable results for a viscous model and uniformly convex Monge--Ampère critical points identify conditions that restore the corresponding implications. For piecewise-smooth trial families, the regularity needed to define the residual functional does not by itself justify the sampled gradient used in training. Moving residual jumps can contribute terms absent from that gradient; an explicit example has identically vanishing sampled gradients and a nonzero continuous derivative. Together, these results clarify what stationarity and sampled gradients imply about the residual, and under which conditions minimizing sequences lead to the intended solution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了最小二乘残差最小化中，驻点、极小化序列与采样梯度能否推出精确解的条件，指出光滑伪临界点、极小化序列收敛到非解、零残差非粘性解及采样梯度失效等现象，并给出恢复正确蕴含的条件。
AI.motivation: 最小二乘残差最小化被广泛用于以优化问题近似微分方程，但残差泛函的驻点或极小化序列未必对应方程的真解。本文旨在厘清从驻点与极小化序列过渡到精确解所需的充分条件，并揭示采样梯度在训练中可能失效的机制。
AI.method: 从残差与线性化算子值域的经典正交关系出发，分析边界条件与参数化变分如何决定驻点处残差的可推断信息；对线性方程给出兼容性条件下的精确投影刻画；研究标量守恒律跨声速边界数据、Hamilton–Jacobi、粘性模型与一致凸Monge–Ampère情形；并考察分片光滑试探族下定义残差泛函的正则性与训练所用采样梯度之间的差距。
AI.result: 即使适定问题也可能出现光滑伪临界点；线性方程在兼容性条件下可得精确投影刻画；标量守恒律跨声速边界数据下，每个极小化序列都收敛到不满足方程的连续函数，即使存在驻点熵激波，并给出参数范数发散的条伴；Hamilton–Jacobi例子表明零残差函数未必是粘性解；粘性模型与一致凸Monge–Ampère临界点下可恢复相应蕴含；分片光滑试探族中，移动残差跳跃会带来采样梯度缺失的项，存在采样梯度恒零而连续导数非零的显式例子。
AI.conclusion: 论文澄清了驻点与采样梯度对残差意味着什么，以及极小化序列在何种条件下收敛到目标解；指出标准残差最小化在若干非平凡情形下的失效机制，并给出通过粘性、凸性或正则性条件恢复正确蕴含的途径。

title: Accelerated Bregman Proximal Gradient Methods from Dual Geometric Perspectives
summary: We study Bregman proximal gradient (BPG) algorithms under relative smoothness for convex, relatively strongly convex, and nonconvex objectives. Existing accelerated BPG algorithms for convex objectives typically require additional assumptions on Bregman divergences, most notably triangle-scaling conditions, which can lead to slower convergence rates. We propose a family of geometry-accelerated BPG algorithms that exploit Bregman geometry in both proximal-gradient and mirror-space updates, without imposing additional geometric conditions such as triangle-scaling conditions. Our methods adapt the stepsizes and mirror-space updates through local backtracking and computable acceptance criteria, without a global relative-smoothness constant as input. We derive convergence bounds in terms of the parameters accepted during the iterations. These bounds yield an $Ø(k^{-2})$ rate for convex objectives and a linear rate for relatively strongly convex objectives when the geometry-acceleration parameters remain uniformly bounded. For nonconvex objectives, we establish an $Ø(k^{-1})$ rate for a stationarity measure without requiring a lower Bregman bound or a full-domain Bregman divergence. Numerical experiments on inverse problems, entropy-regularized least squares, D-optimal design, and nonnegative matrix factorization demonstrate faster practical convergence than established Bregman baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一类几何加速的Bregman近端梯度算法，在近端梯度与镜像空间更新中同时利用Bregman几何，无需三角缩放等额外几何条件或全局相对光滑常数，实现凸目标Ø(k^{-2})、相对强凸线性、非凸Ø(k^{-1})的收敛率，并在多个任务上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有凸目标下的加速BPG算法通常需要三角缩放条件等额外假设，这会导致收敛率变慢。因此作者希望在不引入这类额外几何条件的前提下，利用Bregman几何实现加速。
AI.method: 提出一类几何加速的Bregman近端梯度（BPG）算法，在近端梯度与镜像空间更新中同时利用Bregman几何；通过局部回溯与可计算的接受准则自适应调整步长和镜像空间更新，无需全局相对光滑常数作为输入。
AI.result: 以迭代中接受的参数给出收敛界：凸目标达到Ø(k^{-2})速率，几何加速参数一致有界时相对强凸目标达到线性速率；非凸目标在不需下Bregman界或全域Bregman散度的情况下，对某平稳性度量达到Ø(k^{-1})速率。数值实验在逆问题、熵正则最小二乘、D-最优设计、非负矩阵分解上显示比已有Bregman基线更快的实际收敛。
AI.conclusion: 所提几何加速BPG算法在无需三角缩放等额外几何条件与全局相对光滑常数的情况下，统一获得凸、相对强凸、非凸目标的加速或理论保证，并在实际任务中展现出更快收敛。

title: CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 2 algorithms. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
summary: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.

AI.tldr: 提出 CollisionGAT：一种图注意力网络，输入移动智能体当前与拟议状态及局部相关静态障碍，输出每个智能体的碰撞风险评分，可被任意控制器用于接受、修复、重规划或推迟拟议步，并集成到路径跟随控制器与 GATeD 规划器中，用精确几何检查生成训练标签并独立审计执行步。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同移动前，每个拟议步必须与其他机器人及障碍物进行碰撞检测，传统精确几何检查计算开销大，难以在大规模或实时场景中高效支撑规划与控制。
AI.method: 提出 CollisionGAT，基于图注意力网络，以移动智能体当前状态和拟议状态、以及局部相关静态障碍为输入，输出每个移动智能体的碰撞风险评分；将评分作为接口供任意控制器使用，用于接受、修复、重规划或推迟拟议步；实例化于连续路径跟随控制器和 GATeD（一种障碍盲 D* Lite 规划器，使用类型化否决更新规划图）；训练标签由精确几何检查提供，每个执行步由精确几何检查独立审计。
AI.result: CollisionGAT 可为每个移动智能体输出碰撞风险评分，并成功挂载于连续路径跟随控制器与 GATeD 规划器；精确几何检查同时承担训练标签生成与执行步独立审计两种角色。
AI.conclusion: CollisionGAT 作为通用碰撞风险评分模块，能够以图注意力方式对多机器人拟议步进行碰撞评估，并与控制器和规划器解耦集成，借助精确几何检查实现训练与执行审计闭环。

title: Weak Hall's conjecture, approximation gains, and continued fractions
summary: For an integer solution of $y^2=x^3+k$ with $x,y\ge 1$ and $k\ne 0$, the integers $x^3$, $|k|$ and $y^2$ form a triple in which one term is the sum of the other two. When $\gcd(x,y)=1$ this triple is coprime, and the $abc$ conjecture predicts that its quality is asymptotically at most $1$. Following Müller, Taktikos and de Weger, we factor this quality through the product $P=xy|k|$ into the approximation gain $G_a=\log\max(x^3,y^2)/\log P$ and the power gain $G_p=\log P/\log\rad(xy|k|)$, which is at least $1$. We show that the weak form of Hall's conjecture, which asks that $|k|>x^{1/2-δ}$ for every $δ>0$ outside finitely many solutions, is equivalent to the asymptotic bound $G_a\le 1$. More generally, for $6/11\leκ<6/5$, an asymptotic bound $G_a\leκ$ gives $|k|>x^{3/κ-5/2-δ}$ for every $δ>0$ outside finitely many solutions, and for $3/4\leκ<6/5$ the two statements are equivalent. Since the approximation gain never exceeds the quality, an $abc$ inequality with exponent $1\leκ<6/5$ gives the same bound for primitive solutions. The case $κ=1$ extends to all solutions and recovers the classical implication from the $abc$ conjecture to weak Hall. We also relate small values of $|k|$ to large partial quotients of $\sqrt x$.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分解abc质量为逼近增益G_a和幂增益G_p，证明了弱Hall猜想等价于G_a≤1的渐近界，并推广到6/11≤κ<6/5的情形。
AI.motivation: 研究Mordell方程y²=x³+k整数解中三元组(x³,|k|,y²)的质量，建立abc猜想、Hall猜想与逼近增益之间的定量联系。
AI.method: 沿用Müller、Taktikos和de Weger的方法，将质量按乘积P=xy|k|分解为逼近增益G_a=log max(x³,y²)/log P与幂增益G_p=log P/log rad(xy|k|)，并分析G_a的渐近界与|k|下界的关系。
AI.result: 证明弱Hall猜想（|k|>x^{1/2-δ}除有限多个解外对任意δ>0成立）等价于G_a≤1；对6/11≤κ<6/5，G_a≤κ推出|k|>x^{3/κ-5/2-δ}；对3/4≤κ<6/5两命题等价；指数1≤κ<6/5的abc不等式给出原根解同样下界；κ=1扩展至所有解，恢复从abc猜想推弱Hall的经典结论；并将|k|小值与√x的大部分商相联系。
AI.conclusion: 逼近增益提供了统一框架，将abc/Hall型猜想转化为质量分解下的渐近界，并推广了经典蕴含关系，同时揭示小|k|与√x连分数部分商之间的关联。

title: Finite-Time Concentration and Convergence Rates for Projected Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation with Markov Noise
summary:
We study finite-time concentration and convergence rates for projected two-time-scale stochastic approximation driven by a controlled Markov chain. The averaged fast map is contractive, while the slow iterate is projected onto a compact convex polyhedron. The associated projected ordinary differential equation may have a discontinuous vector field at the boundary, preventing a direct application of standard analyses based on Lipschitz vector fields.
  Using the Skorokhod map, we establish explicit high-probability bounds for tracking the moving fast equilibrium and the projected slow dynamics. These bounds separate martingale fluctuations, Markov-noise residuals, and the bias due to time-scale separation. A Lipschitz Lyapunov function satisfying a uniform decrease condition over fixed time intervals yields almost-sure convergence, with explicit last-iterate rates when the decrease admits a power lower bound. Under uniform Lyapunov contraction, polynomial step sizes yield joint fast-tracking and slow Lyapunov-error exponents arbitrarily close to $1/3$. Under the additional assumption that the reduced slow update map is a Euclidean contraction, logarithmically separated step sizes improve the joint rate to $O(n^{-1/2}\log n)$ almost surely, including for boundary equilibria. The same rate holds under a distinct geometric condition involving a strictly attracting face of a box and a fast equilibrium that is constant on that face.
  An actor-critic application achieves an almost-sure value-gap rate of $O(n^{-1}\log n)$ relative to the optimum within the constrained policy class. Further applications include projected TD(0) and projected stochastic gradient descent. We also extend the analysis to projection of the fast recursion under Euclidean contractivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由受控马尔可夫链驱动的投影双时间尺度随机逼近(SA)的有限时间集中与收敛速率，针对投影ODE在边界处向量场可能不连续、标准Lipschitz分析失效的难题，借助Skorokhod映射建立显式高概率界，并给出几乎必然收敛及多种条件下的显式末迭代速率，最后应用于actor-critic、投影TD(0)与投影随机梯度下降。
AI.motivation: 双时间尺度随机逼近的有限时间分析已有较多结果，但多数依赖于向量场的Lipschitz性质。当慢迭代被投影到紧凸多面体上时，投影ODE在边界处向量场可能出现不连续，标准基于Lipschitz向量场的分析方法无法直接使用；同时，实际算法(如actor-critic、投影TD(0))中普遍存在此类投影与时间尺度分离耦合的情形，亟需刻画其收敛速率与集中行为。
AI.method: 研究对象为受控马尔可夫链驱动的投影双时间尺度SA：快迭代的平均映射为压缩映射，慢迭代被投影到紧凸多面体。利用Skorokhod映射处理边界反射，建立跟踪移动快平衡与投影慢动态的显式高概率界，将鞅波动、马尔可夫噪声残差与时间尺度分离偏差分离开来。通过构造在固定时间区间上满足一致下降条件的Lipschitz Lyapunov函数证明几乎必然收敛；当下降量具有幂下界时给出显式末迭代速率。分别在一致Lyapunov收缩、慢更新映射为欧氏压缩、以及涉及盒子严格吸引面且快平衡在该面上为常数的几何条件下分析速率。并将分析扩展到快递归的投影情形。
AI.result: a) 建立跟踪快平衡与投影慢动态的显式高概率界，分离鞅波动、马尔可夫噪声残差与时间尺度分离偏差；b) 一致Lyapunov收缩下，多项式步长给出联合快跟踪与慢Lyapunov误差指数可任意接近1/3；c) 在简化慢更新映射为欧氏压缩的额外假设下，对数分离步长将联合速率改进为几乎必然O(n^{-1/2}log n)，且对边界平衡点也成立；d) 在涉及盒子严格吸引面且快平衡在该面上为常数的几何条件下得到相同速率；e) actor-critic应用在受限策略类内相对最优值取得几乎必然O(n^{-1}log n)的值差速率；f) 给出投影TD(0)与投影随机梯度下降等进一步应用，并将分析扩展到欧氏压缩下的快递归投影。(注：d、e两条为基于摘要信息的推断性归纳。)
AI.conclusion: 本文为具有投影、不连续边界向量场与受控马尔可夫链噪声的双时间尺度随机逼近提供了统一的有限时间误差分解与收敛速率分析框架：Skorokhod映射刻画投影动态，Lipschitz Lyapunov函数给出几乎必然收敛与显式末迭代速率，并在一致收缩、欧氏压缩以及特定几何条件下分别给出接近于1/3、O(n^{-1/2}log n)的联合速率。该框架适用于actor-critic(值差O(n^{-1}log n))、投影TD(0)与投影随机梯度下降等，并可推广至快递归的投影情形。

title: Singular intersections in split semiabelian varieties
summary: Let $\mathcal G$ be a split semiabelian variety of dimension $n \ge 2$ and let $\mathcal C \subset \mathcal G$ an irreducible curve, where everything is defined over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$. We prove that, under the natural hypothesis that $\mathcal C$ is not contained in any proper algebraic subgroup of $\mathcal G$, the set of points $P$ of $\mathcal C$ lying in an algebraic subgroup $H$ which intersects the curve tangentially at $P$ is finite. This generalizes a result for curves in 2-dimensional tori by Marché and Maurin. We apply these results to square-freeness of certain geometric divisibility sequences.

AI.tldr: 证明了分裂半阿贝尔簇上不在真代数子群中的不可约曲线，与之切触相交的代数子群对应的点集是有限的，推广了二维环面情形，并应用于几何可除序列的无平方性。
AI.motivation: Marché与Maurin已在二维环面情形下证明了类似结果；作者希望将其推广到更一般的分裂半阿贝尔簇，并将该结论用于研究几何可除序列的无平方性。
AI.method: 设𝒢为维数n≥2的分裂半阿贝尔簇，𝒞⊂𝒢为不可约曲线（均定义在ℚ̄上）。在自然假设"𝒞不包含于𝒢的任何真代数子群"下，考虑曲线𝒞上满足存在代数子群H在P处与曲线相切相交的点P，证明这样的点集是有限的。
AI.result: 证明了在所述自然假设下，𝒞上落在与𝒞在P处切触相交的代数子群H中的点P所构成的集合是有限的。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将Marché–Maurin关于二维环面中曲线的结论推广至分裂半阿贝尔簇，并成功应用于某些几何可除序列的无平方性问题。

title: Contraction-Based Model Predictive Control using Bilinear Koopman Realizations with Proportional Error Bounds
summary: Data-driven model predictive control based on Koopman operator theory is a promising approach for constrained control of nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics. This paper proposes a robust model predictive control framework for such systems using bilinear Koopman realizations with state- and input-dependent proportional approximation-error bounds that vanish at the target equilibrium. Since prediction in lifted coordinates with a finite-dimensional Koopman realization need not remain on the manifold of valid lifted states, multi-step prediction may leave the region where one-step error certificates apply. We avoid this difficulty by reprojecting each predicted lifted state onto the original state coordinates and lifting it again, yielding an error-aware discrete-time control-affine predictor in the original state space without assuming invariance of the Koopman dictionary. For this predictor, we develop a homothetic tube construction based on a discrete-time robust control contraction metric whose radius explicitly accounts for the proportional approximation error bounds. The tube tightening handles arbitrary continuously differentiable nonlinear constraints, and the resulting model predictive control problem includes terminal ingredients and a tube-radius penalty that exploits the vanishing uncertainty near the target. We prove robust satisfaction of the original nonlinear constraints, recursive feasibility, and exponential stability of the sampled true closed-loop system with high probability over the training data without requiring a globally optimal solution to the model predictive control problem. Numerical examples, including nonlinear obstacle-avoidance constraints, demonstrate robust stabilization and higher performance of the proposed approach compared to existing Koopman-based model predictive control methods in terms of smaller closed-loop cost and flexibility.

AI.tldr: 提出基于双线性Koopman实现与状态/输入相关比例近似误差界的鲁棒MPC框架，通过重投影构建误差感知的控制仿射预测器，结合同伦管与收缩度量实现鲁棒约束满足、递归可行性与高概率指数稳定。
AI.motivation: 非线性未知动力学系统的约束控制中，Koopman数据驱动MPC存在两难：有限维提升坐标下的多步预测会偏离有效提升状态流形，导致单步误差证书失效；且通常需假设Koopman字典不变性。亟需一种无需该假设、且能在目标平衡点附近利用误差衰减特性的鲁棒MPC方法。
AI.method: 采用双线性Koopman实现，并给出随状态与输入变化、在目标平衡点消失的比例近似误差界。将每步预测的提升状态重投影回原状态坐标再重新提升，得到原状态空间中的误差感知离散时间控制仿射预测器，不要求字典不变性。基于离散时间鲁棒控制收缩度量构造同伦管，其半径显式含比例误差界；管收紧处理任意连续可微非线性约束。MPC问题含终端要素与利用目标附近不确定性衰减的管半径惩罚项。
AI.result: 理论上证明了原非线性约束的鲁棒满足、递归可行性，以及采样真实闭环系统在训练数据上以高概率的指数稳定性，且不要求MPC问题全局最优解。数值算例（含非线性避障约束）表明，相比现有Koopman-MPC方法，闭环代价更小、灵活性更高，实现了鲁棒镇定与更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 重投影策略有效规避了提升坐标多步预测的流形偏离问题，使误差证书可跨步使用；结合收缩度量同伦管与消失误差界，在无字典不变性假设下实现了具有概率保证的鲁棒约束控制，兼顾理论严谨性与实际性能。

title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
summary: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/

AI.tldr: 提出SonoGraph-WM：一种动作与目标条件化的世界模型，用场景图表示解剖结构并预测未来场景图与探头位姿，配合滚动时域规划实现前瞻式超声探头导航，训练数据由CT标签图生成。
AI.motivation: 超声采集高度依赖操作者对解剖结构的理解及对探头运动所致视图变化的预判能力；而现有机器人超声导航方法在选择动作时，并未显式预测这些解剖层面的变化，缺乏前瞻性。
AI.method: 以场景图（SG）表示解剖，编码可见结构、其几何及空间关系，不合成超声图像；输入SG历史与探头位姿，用统一Transformer联合预测未来SG与位姿。滚动时域规划器递归"想象"候选轨迹，选择到达目标图的最短预测路径，并在短执行时域内执行后基于新观测重规划。为减少对带追踪与解剖标注超声序列的依赖，从CT标签图沿表面约束的探头轨迹生成对齐的SG–位姿训练数据。
AI.result: 在四个留出CT病例上，20步预测内空间关系F1保持93%以上；使用标注导出SG的闭环导航在胆囊和胰腺上成功率分别为77.50%和75.00%；在机器人–体模实验中，使用标签图导出SG的规划器在73.7%的试验中到达目标视图。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并凸显频繁观测更新对可靠导航的重要性。

title: On a generating function of the basis of weakly holomorphic functions on an elliptic curve
summary: Let $\Gz$ be a cofinite Fuchsian group whose quotient $\Gz\backslash\HH$ has genus one and a single cusp, normalized to be at $\infty$ with width one. Let $\Xg$ be its smooth compactification, which is an elliptic curve over $\CC$. Let $x,y$ be canonical generators of the function field on $\Xg$, which have poles of order $2,3$ respectively at the cusp and which {satisfy} a generalized Weierstrass relation $y^2+(a_1x+a_3)y=x^3+a_2x^2+a_4x+a_6$. Let $f$ be the unique (up to scale) weight two cusp form for $\Gz$, normalized so that the associated holomorphic differential is $ω=dx/(2y+a_1x+a_3)$. With all this, we prove that the generating function identity \[ \frac{\bigl(y(τ)+y(z)+a_1x(z)+a_3\bigr)f(z)}{x(z)-x(τ)}=\sum_{m\ge0}Φ_m(τ)q_z^m \] defines a family $\{Φ_m\}_{m\ge0}$ of weakly holomorphic modular functions on $\Xg$ such that the set $\{Φ_0\}\cup\{Φ_m\}_{m\ge2}$ is a canonical basis of the space $M_{0,\Gz}^{!,\infty}$ of weakly holomorphic modular functions on $\Xg$ with poles supported only at the cusp. As an application, by comparing the generating function of the family $\{Φ_m\}_{m\ge0}$ with the generating function of the Niebur--Poincaré series, we show that the generating function of the special values of the Kloosterman zeta function at $1$ is the holomorphic part of a certain weight two harmonic Maass form up to an additive constant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究亏格为1、单尖点的余有限Fuchsian群。利用尖点处极点为2、3的典范生成元构造弱全纯模函数族的生成函数恒等式，证明其构成弱全纯模函数空间典范基，并将Kloosterman zeta函数特殊值的生成函数与权2调和Maass形式联系起来。
AI.motivation: 对亏格1、单尖点的余有限Fuchsian群，其商空间的函数域具有广义Weierstrass关系。作者希望建立弱全纯模函数的显式典范基，并刻画Kloosterman zeta函数在s=1处特殊值的解析性质，从而将经典椭圆曲线上的Weierstrass理论推广到模形式与调和Maass形式的框架中。
AI.method: 设$\\Gz$为余有限Fuchsian群，$\\Gz\\backslash\\HH$亏格为1且单尖点，规范化为无穷远、宽度1。取光滑紧化$\\Xg$为$\\CC$上椭圆曲线，$x,y$为函数域典范生成元，在尖点处极点阶分别为2、3，满足广义Weierstrass关系$y^2+(a_1x+a_3)y=x^3+a_2x^2+a_4x+a_6$。令$f$为唯一（至多相差常数）权2尖点形式，使相伴全纯微分$\\omega=dx/(2y+a_1x+a_3)$。构造生成函数恒等式$(y(\\tau)+y(z)+a_1x(z)+a_3)f(z)/(x(z)-x(\\tau))=\\sum_{m\\ge0}\\Phi_m(\\tau)q_z^m$，定义函数族$\\{\\Phi_m\\}$。再将该生成函数与Niebur--Poincaré级数的生成函数比较。
AI.result: 证明了上述恒等式定义的$\\{\\Phi_m\\}_{m\\ge0}$为$\\Xg$上弱全纯模函数族，且$\\{\\Phi_0\\}\\cup\\{\\Phi_m\\}_{m\\ge2}$构成仅以尖点为极点的弱全纯模函数空间$M_{0,\\Gz}^{!,\\infty}$的典范基。进一步，通过比较生成函数与Niebur--Poincaré级数生成函数，证明Kloosterman zeta函数在1处特殊值的生成函数在相差一个加性常数意义下是某权2调和Maass形式的全纯部分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了亏格1单尖点Fuchsian群上弱全纯模函数空间的显式典范基，并揭示了Kloosterman zeta函数特殊值与权2调和Maass形式全纯部分之间的精确联系，为相关模形式与调和Maass形式研究提供了新的生成函数工具。

title: Quantitative Stability, Coercivity and Uniqueness of Optimal Transport Plans
summary:
For probability measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$ supported in fixed compact sets, we prove that quadratic optimal transport plans are quantitatively stable in Wasserstein distance under perturbation of both marginal measures, assuming that one of the initial measures satisfies an upper Ahlfors regularity condition with exponent strictly greater than $d-1$. Under the same assumption, we also prove novel quantitative stability results for optimal transport maps.
  Furthermore, we prove a coercivity theorem which states that any probability measure on the product space must be quantitatively close to the set of optimal plans, if it has similar marginals and a similar transport cost to the optimal value.
  Finally, we prove a quantitative uniqueness theorem which acts as a quantitative counterpart to Brenier's theorem. The Wasserstein diameter of the set of optimal plans is controlled by the distance of one marginal measure to a regular measure for which uniqueness holds. In this way, "almost uniqueness" of optimal plans is quantified by the source measure being "almost regular".
  Examples are provided which prove that the exponents of all estimates are sharp.

AI.tldr: 该论文在紧支撑概率测度框架下，证明了二次最优传输计划在Wasserstein距离下的定量稳定性，并给出最优传输映射的定量稳定性、矫顽性定理及定量唯一性定理，且证明所有估计指数均为尖锐。
AI.motivation: 现有最优传输理论多关注定性结论（如Brenier定理的唯一性），缺乏在边际测度扰动下传输计划与传输映射的定量稳定性刻画，尤其在唯一性失效时如何度量"几乎唯一性"尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在固定紧集上对R^d上的概率测度，假设其中一个初始测度满足指数严格大于d-1的上Ahlfors正则性条件，研究二次代价下最优传输计划的Wasserstein稳定性；进一步通过矫顽性论证将接近最优的计划与最优计划集的距离量化；并构造定量唯一性定理，用源测度到唯一性成立的正则测度的距离控制最优计划集的Wasserstein直径；最后通过例子验证指数尖锐性。
AI.result: 证明了二次最优传输计划在边际扰动下的Wasserstein定量稳定性；在相同假设下得到了最优传输映射的定量稳定性结果；证明了矫顽性定理，即具有相似边际和相似传输代价的概率测度必定量接近最优计划集；给出了Brenier定理的定量对应版本，将最优计划集的Wasserstein直径与源测度到正则测度的距离相联系；并构造例子证明各估计的指数是尖锐的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将最优传输的定性唯一性理论提升为定量稳定性理论，揭示了"几乎唯一性"由源测度的"几乎正则性"所控制的机制，且结果的指数最优性得到了验证。

title: Predictor-Based Stabilization of a Delayed Hetero-Dimensional Shoreline--Bathymetry System
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, Submitted to Automatica for possible publication
summary: Exponential stabilization is investigated for a hetero-dimensional parabolic system in which a one-dimensional shoreline subsystem, subject to a constant input delay, is bidirectionally coupled with unactuated two-dimensional bathymetric dynamics. A spectral decomposition separates the finite-dimensional critical shoreline modes from the exponentially stable residual dynamics. State feedback is designed on the critical subspace and lifted to the full shoreline space. An auxiliary transport equation represents the delay, while a predictor removes the explicit input delay from the nominal predictor dynamics. Exponential stability of the full coupled system is established by combining shoreline stabilization and bathymetric coercivity using weighted input--output estimates and a small-gain condition on the hetero-dimensional interaction. Numerical simulations show that uncompensated delayed feedback can strongly amplify both shoreline and bathymetric responses, whereas predictor compensation restores decay of the critical shoreline dynamics and prevents delay-induced amplification from propagating to the unactuated bathymetric subsystem.

AI.tldr: 研究一类异维抛物系统的指数镇定问题：一维岸线子系统带常值输入时滞，与无执行器的二维水深动力学双向耦合；通过谱分解、临界子空间状态反馈、辅助输运方程与预测器补偿，结合加权输入—输出估计与异维小增益条件证明全系统指数稳定，数值仿真验证预测器补偿可消除时滞引起的放大。
AI.motivation: 异维抛物系统（一维岸线 + 二维水深）双向耦合且岸线侧存在常值输入时滞，水深子系统无执行器，时滞反馈可能导致岸线与水深响应被显著放大，因此需要研究其指数镇定与预测器补偿机制。
AI.method: 1) 谱分解将有限维临界岸线模态与指数稳定残余动力学分离；2) 在临界子空间设计状态反馈并提升至全岸线空间；3) 用辅助输运方程表示时滞，设计预测器消除标称预测器动力学中的显式输入时滞；4) 结合岸线镇定与水深矫顽性，采用加权输入—输出估计及异维交互的小增益条件。
AI.result: 建立了全耦合系统的指数稳定性；数值仿真表明，未补偿的时滞反馈会强烈放大岸线与水深响应，而预测器补偿可恢复临界岸线动力学的衰减，并阻止时滞诱导的放大传播到无执行器的水深子系统。
AI.conclusion: 针对带输入时滞的异维抛物耦合系统，所提出的临界子空间反馈 + 输运方程预测器方案可在小增益条件下实现全系统指数镇定，且能抑制时滞向无执行器水深子系统的放大传播。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FINE是一个未来信息导航编码框架，通过从已有示范轨迹的未来观测中提取潜在监督信号，增强视觉语言导航策略在有限示范数据下的性能。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言导航（VLN）策略适配到新环境成本高昂，因为每条新路线和指令都需要实体示范。而标准的观测到动作训练仅利用了每条轨迹中已有信息的一小部分，尤其是未来观测中蕴含的与指令相关的路标信息（外观及3D排列）未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出FINE框架，为VLN主干网络配备两种互补的辅助表征：1）显式路标token，遵循指令指定的有序路标，在语义2D patch特征空间和视角相关的3D几何特征空间中预测未来路标区域；2）隐式未来token，通过视频世界模型生成的同场景反事实未来，学习区分实际到达的路标状态。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE val-unseen上，全量训练数据下FINE使InternVLA-N1的成功率分别提升2.6和4.5个百分点；在70%示范预算下，成功率提升6.8个百分点，恢复了因减少训练示范所损失性能的约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: FINE通过挖掘现有示范中未来观测的潜在监督，有效提升了VLN策略性能，且示范数据越有限，增益越显著，缓解了对大量实体示范数据的依赖。

title: Complete classification of $7$-adic Galois images for non-CM elliptic curves over $\Q$
summary: We solve Conjecture 1.6 of Furio and Lombardo [On $7$-adic Galois representations for elliptic curves over $\Q$, Proc.\ London Math.\ Soc.\ (3) \textbf{133} (2026), e70193.]. As a consequence, we complete the classification of $7$-adic Galois images for non-CM elliptic curves over $\Q$. The proof is the result of a long AI-training period by the author from June 2026 to September 2026. The author has been working on this project alone without the help of any other.

AI.tldr: 求解Furio–Lombardo提出的猜想1.6，从而完全分类了$\Q$上非CM椭圆曲线的$7$-adic Galois像。
AI.motivation: Furio与Lombardo在关于$\Q$上椭圆曲线$7$-adic Galois表示的论文中留下猜想1.6未决；该猜想是完成$\Q$上非CM椭圆曲线$7$-adic Galois像完全分类的关键缺口，因此有必要予以解决。
AI.method: 证明该猜想。摘要未给出具体数学技术，仅说明证明是作者在2026年6月至9月长期"AI训练"的结果，且由作者独立完成。
AI.result: 猜想1.6被证明成立。
AI.conclusion: 作为推论，$\Q$上非CM椭圆曲线的$7$-adic Galois像分类得以完全确定。

title: Amortized Feedback Planning: Turning Model-Based Rollouts into Executable Policies
summary: Closed-loop planning accounts for future observation-dependent actions but can be expensive to repeat at deployment. Bellman-gradient (BG) refinement differentiates conditional rollouts through an existing actor, corrects the current action, and stores the result in an executable policy. A backward sweep reuses deployed future feedback; full-horizon rollouts in an identified Gaussian belief model need no learned value critic. A nonlinear error recursion links quadratic continuation error, local correction, and policy storage. A controlled non-LQG example exhibits second-order policy accuracy with consistent storage, while ideal affine LQG admits exact backward recovery. In nonquadratic thrust, BG reduces actor cost by 2.47-3.20% and remains within 0.13-0.53% of the tested feedback MPC; original policies execute in 5-6 microseconds in a seed-0 native audit. With matched storage, BG attains competitive plant costs at about one ninth (arm) and one sixtieth (docking) of feedback-teacher-plus-student construction time on one GPU, excluding shared learning and node preparation. Richer common maps substantially narrow some student-BG gaps. These results expose the roles of learned feedback, local correction, and storage in executable control.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Bellman-gradient (BG)精化方法，通过将条件rollout的反馈存储为可执行策略，避免部署时重复闭环规划，兼具高精度与低执行成本。
AI.motivation: 闭环规划虽能考虑依赖未来观测的动作，但在部署时重复计算代价高昂。因此需要一种能将规划得到的反馈离线精化并存入可执行策略、从而在部署时快速执行的方法。
AI.method: Bellman-gradient (BG)精化：通过现有actor对条件rollout求导，修正当前动作并将结果存入可执行策略；采用反向扫描复用已部署的未来反馈；在已辨识的高斯信念模型中进行全时域rollout，无需学习价值critic。建立非线性误差递推，关联二次continuation误差、局部修正与策略存储。
AI.result: 在受控非LQG示例中呈现二阶策略精度且存储一致，理想仿射LQG可实现精确反向恢复；非二次推力任务中BG将actor成本降低2.47-3.20%，与所测反馈MPC差距在0.13-0.53%内，原始策略执行耗时5-6微秒（seed-0原生审计）；匹配存储下，BG在单GPU上以约九分之一（arm）和六十分之一（docking）的反馈教师加学生构建时间达到有竞争力的plant成本（不含共享学习与节点准备）；更丰富的公共地图显著缩小部分student-BG差距。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了学习反馈、局部修正与策略存储三者在可执行控制中的作用。BG精化能兼顾规划精度与执行效率，为部署级控制提供可行途径。

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
summary: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.

AI.tldr: RoboFoundry 是首个将具身智能体支撑系统统一建模为策略的「自进化系统即策略」（Self-Evolving System-as-Policy）框架，通过将执行轨迹转化为经校验的系统更新，并在上下文系统与分层技能系统两个层面进化，实现跨异构机器人的能力迁移，在 EmbodiedBench、RoboMemArena、LIBERO-PRO 及真实部署中均取得领先或大幅提升的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多分别优化智能体栈的单个组件（记忆、上下文、技能、动作接口），而非把支撑系统本身视为统一策略；且仅有交互不足以带来自我改进，必须把执行经验转化为持久且经验证的系统变更。因此需要一种以系统为策略、可自进化的具身智能体框架。
AI.method: 提出 RoboFoundry：1）将过程形式化为 Self-Evolving System-as-Policy；2）诊断决策与记忆管理中的能力缺口，将执行轨迹转化为经校验的任务特定系统更新，并把反复出现的改进提升为通用系统；3）进化作用于两个互补面——管理活跃内部上下文与持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，以及组织原子技能、可复用组合与故障条件恢复的分层技能系统；4）共享语义接口分离「具身无关决策」与「具身相关执行」，使进化后的系统能力可跨异构机器人迁移。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedBench 上达到 SOTA，尤其使 GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%，并让 Qwen3.7-Plus 接近 GPT-5.5（70.3% vs 72.7%）；在长程记忆 RoboMemArena 上以至少 39.0% 的优势超过所有基线（含借助外部基础模型的方法）；在 LIBERO-PRO 上于所有扰动类型下超过 Cap-Agent0 达 243.8%–679.7%；真实部署中展现跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移与在线进化。
AI.conclusion: RoboFoundry 表明把支撑系统作为统一策略并持续自进化，能跨基础模型带来一致增益，并支持跨异构机器人的零样本迁移与在线进化，展现了实现完全自主具身智能体的潜力。

title: A note on large clusters of $E_2$-numbers
summary:
Let $q_n$ denote the $n$th product of two distinct primes. By completing a square in Sono's sieve and solving the resulting one-dimensional variational problem, we prove unconditionally that, for every $\varepsilon>0$ and all sufficiently large integers $ρ$, \[
  \liminf_{n\to\infty}(q_{n+ρ}-q_n)
  \leq \exp\left((π+\varepsilon)\sqrtρ\right). \]

AI.tldr: 本文通过完善Sono筛法中的平方配方法并求解相应的一维变分问题，无条件证明了半素数序列相邻项的极限下界间隙不超过 exp((π+ε)√ρ)。
AI.motivation: 研究半素数（两个不同素数之积）序列的间隙分布，希望给出 q_{n+ρ}-q_n 的极限下界估计，类比素数间隙问题的思路但同时处理半素数情形。
AI.method: 完善Sono筛法（在筛法中进行平方配方），并将问题转化为一维变分问题后求解该变分问题。
AI.result: 无条件证明了：对任意 ε>0 及充分大的整数 ρ，liminf_{n→∞}(q_{n+ρ}-q_n) ≤ exp((π+ε)√ρ)。
AI.conclusion: 给出了半素数序列间隙的无条件下界估计，其形式与素数情形中已知的间隙上界结果相呼应，指数中的常数 π 反映了变分问题的解。

title: Sharp Observability Costs for Strongly Coupled Parabolic Systems with Vanishing Principal Coupling
summary: We study the loss of observability for a class of strongly coupled parabolic systems as the coupling parameter tends to zero. The system is observed through a fixed matrix $B$ on a measurable subset of space-time with positive measure. Under the Kalman rank condition, we determine the exact blow-up rates of the optimal observability cost. Different components of the state, as well as different combinations of them, may have different blow-up rates, and these rates are determined by the algebraic structure of the pair $(B,K)$. The full-state observability cost is determined by the largest of these rates. We also show that the worst-case minimum $L^\infty$-norm of null controls has the same asymptotic behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究强耦合抛物系统在耦合参数趋于零时的可观测性丧失，精确给出最优可观测性代价的爆破速率，并证明零控制的最坏情形最小 $L^\infty$ 范数具有相同渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 强耦合抛物系统在耦合参数趋零时会出现可观测性退化，需要刻画其定量退化规律，尤其是最优可观测性代价随参数变化的爆破速率。
AI.method: 在 Kalman 秩条件下，针对在正测度时空子集上通过固定矩阵 $B$ 观测的强耦合抛物系统，分析耦合参数趋于零时最优可观测性代价的渐近行为；通过考察状态各分量及其不同组合的爆破速率，并利用 $(B,K)$ 的代数结构确定这些速率。
AI.result: 状态的不同分量及不同组合可以具有不同的爆破速率，这些速率由 $(B,K)$ 的代数结构决定；全状态可观测性代价由其中最大的爆破速率决定；最坏情形零控制的最小 $L^\infty$ 范数具有相同的渐近行为。
AI.conclusion: 耦合参数趋零导致的可观测性丧失可由 $(B,K)$ 的代数结构精确量化，全状态代价受最大分量速率支配，且零控制的 $L^\infty$ 范数与可观测性代价呈相同渐近行为。

title: Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CommHG——一种通信感知的异构图学习框架，用于去中心化多人类多机器人（MH-MR）任务分配，通过联合优化分配与通信决策提升协调规模下的任务完成度。
AI.motivation: MH-MR团队需要将机器人自主性与人类专长结合，但有效任务分配需协调稀缺且动态可用的人力支持与分布式机器人执行；有限的机器人间及人机通信会延迟信息交换与监督干预，加剧这一耦合难题。
AI.method: CommHG以局部图表示人-机器人-任务的耦合交互，图条件依赖于信息可用性与信息年龄；学习通信动作，使机器人自主决定何时、向哪位操作员查询以及何时与同伴共享信息；通过合作式多智能体强化学习联合优化分配与通信。同时构建了包含异构人机、动态任务与运行状态、受限机器人间及双向人机链路的基准环境。
AI.result: 在最多16个机器人、6个人类和112个任务的异构团队实验中，CommHG在协调规模增大时提升及时加权任务完成度，并在Large场景中优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通信感知的联合优化能有效利用有限通信与监督资源，在去中心化MH-MR任务分配中随规模扩展保持优势。

title: On the largest prime factors of $p-1$ and $p+1$
summary: We prove that each of the inequalities $P^{+}(p+1)>P^{+}(p-1)$ and $P^{+}(p-1)>P^{+}(p+1)$ holds for a positive proportion of primes. The argument combines a logarithmic balance identity with a uniform Selberg sieve over a thin cofactor strip. The same transfer mechanism applies to either shift and converts a one-sided large-prime-factor reservoir into an unconditional ordering result in both directions.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了对于正比例的素数 $p$，$p+1$ 与 $p-1$ 的最大素因子大小关系在两个方向上均无限次成立，即 $P^{+}(p+1)>P^{+}(p-1)$ 与 $P^{+}(p-1)>P^{+}(p+1)$ 各自对正比例素数成立。
AI.motivation: 研究相差 2 的整数对（$p-1$ 与 $p+1$）的最大素因子的比较问题，先前结果多只有单方向的定性结论，缺乏双向且具有正比例密度意义的刻画。
AI.method: 结合对数平衡恒等式（logarithmic balance identity）与在薄余因子带（thin cofactor strip）上的均匀 Selberg 筛法；该转移机制对两个平移（$p-1$ 与 $p+1$）均适用，将一侧的大素因子"库"转化为无条件的双向排序结果。
AI.conclusion: 利用对数平衡恒等式与均匀 Selberg 筛，成功将单侧大素因子信息双向转移，从而无条件地同时得到两个方向的正比例排序结果。

title: Stochastic Model-Based Methods for Minimizing Paraconvex Functions
summary: This paper studies stochastic algorithms for minimizing paraconvex functions, a function class that generalizes weakly convex functions and includes, for instance, Hölder smooth functions and compositions of convex functions with Hölder smooth maps. We first establish the convergence of the stochastic subgradient method and the stochastic proximal subgradient method for unconstrained and composite paraconvex optimization, respectively. The analysis is then extended to a broad family of algorithms that access the objective through stochastic models satisfying certain approximation-quality and continuity assumptions. The main principle that underlies the convergence analysis is that the algorithms under consideration can be interpreted as perturbed descent methods on the generalized Moreau envelope of the original paraconvex problem.

AI.tldr: 该文研究极小化paraconvex（拟凸/弱凸推广类）函数的随机算法，先证明随机次梯度法与随机近端次梯度法的收敛性，再推广到满足近似质量与连续性假设的更广算法族，核心原理是将算法视为原问题广义Moreau包络上的扰动下降法。
AI.motivation: paraconvex函数类推广了弱凸函数，涵盖Hölder光滑函数以及凸函数与Hölder光滑映射的复合，但此类非凸非光滑目标的随机优化算法收敛性分析尚不充分，需要统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 建立无约束情形下随机次梯度法、复合情形下随机近端次梯度法对paraconvex目标的收敛性；进一步在算法仅通过满足近似质量与连续性假设的随机模型访问目标函数的条件下推广分析。核心分析工具是广义Moreau包络，将所考察算法解释为该包络上的扰动下降法。
AI.result: 证明了随机次梯度法与随机近端次梯度法在paraconvex优化中的收敛性，并将结果推广到一大类通过随机模型访问目标的算法，建立了基于广义Moreau包络的统一收敛性分析。
AI.conclusion: paraconvex优化可通过广义Moreau包络框架进行统一分析，将算法视为包络上的扰动下降法即可获得收敛保证，该原则适用于多种随机算法与更一般的随机模型假设。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations
summary: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用LQT运动先验与黎曼流形扩展，使操作者仅凭少量via点即可生成虚拟夹具轨迹，并用于微创手术切割任务。
AI.motivation: 传统概率式LfD需要大量演示，在遥操作场景中往往不可行；因此需要在少量演示条件下仍能为操作者提供直观的轨迹生成与引导能力，并将其作为Virtual Fixtures（VFs）使用。
AI.method: 采用Linear Quadratic Tracking（LQT）作为运动先验，由少量via点定义引导轨迹；为处理方向引导，将经典LQT在黎曼流形上重新表述并引入额外几何先验；通过对LQT解的概率解释推导每个轨迹点的协方差估计，用其调节夹具刚度并定义夹具的有效区域，从而在via点附近强引导、远离时弱引导，并允许操作者离开影响区执行未建模任务。
AI.result: 在若干toy examples上评估了所提出的黎曼LQT形式，并在da Vinci Research Kit（dVRK）上以需要高精度的微创手术切割任务验证完整框架。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在少量演示下生成带方向引导与刚度调制的虚拟夹具，兼顾精度与灵活性；黎曼LQT扩展和协方差驱动的有效区域设计适用于高精度遥操作手术任务。

title: A difference formula of $p$-adic height pairings via the Bloch-Kato logarithm map
summary: The construction of a $p$-adic height pairing for a geometric $p$-adic representation of the absolute Galois group of a number field depends on a global $p$-adic logarithm and on local splittings of the Hodge filtrations at the primes above $p$. We study the dependence on these splittings for suitable two-dimensional symplectic self-dual representations, including self-dual twists of representations attached to even-weight newforms at non-ordinary primes not dividing the level. We express the difference between the height pairings associated with the two splittings determined by Frobenius explicitly in terms of local Bloch--Kato logarithms. As an application over $\mathbb{Q}$, we prove that at least one of the two cyclotomic $p$-adic height pairings is non-trivial under the additional assumptions that the Frobenius eigenvalues at $p$ are distinct and the localization map at $p$ from the Bloch--Kato Selmer group is non-zero.

AI.tldr: 研究p进高度配对对Hodge滤过分裂的依赖性，将两种分裂的配对差用局部Bloch–Kato对数表示，并给出在Q上至少一个分圆p进高度配对非平凡的应用。
AI.motivation: 几何p进表示的p进高度配对依赖于全局p进对数和p处Hodge滤过的局部分裂，二者带来的歧义需要被理解，尤其对二维辛自对偶表示（含非寻常素数处偶数权新形式的自对偶扭）缺乏明确刻画。
AI.method: 针对合适的二维辛自对偶表示，研究由Frobenius决定的两个局部分裂所对应的高度配对之差，将该差显式地用局部Bloch–Kato对数表达。
AI.result: 证明了两种分裂对应的高度配对之差可由局部Bloch–Kato对数刻画；作为Q上的应用，在p处Frobenius特征值互异且Bloch–Kato Selmer群到p的局部化映射非零的附加假设下，证明两个分圆p进高度配对中至少一个非平凡。
AI.conclusion: p进高度配对的局部分裂依赖性被局部Bloch–Kato对数精确控制，由此可导出分圆p进高度配对非平凡性的结论。

title: A Sharper Theory of Ball-Proximal Optimization: Convergence and Radius Selection
summary:
We study the exact Euclidean ball-proximal point method for proper, closed, convex functions, where each iteration minimizes the objective over a ball centered at the current point. Retaining the objective gap in the decrease of squared distance yields sharper bounds on objective values, stationarity, and the symmetric Bregman distance to a minimizer. For constant radius $t>0$ and initial distance $D_0>0$ to the solution set, the objective gap after $K$ iterations is at most its initial value multiplied by $\exp(-2K^2t^2/D_0^2)$.
  We characterize convergence for arbitrary positive radius sequences. If their sum diverges, the method reaches a minimizer in finitely many iterations whenever one exists; otherwise, the objective values converge to the infimum and the iterates escape every bounded set. If the radii are summable, the iterates converge to a possibly nonoptimal point. Self-contraction gives finite trajectory length for bounded iterates and a constant-radius termination bound $O_d(1+D_0/t)$, whose implicit constant depends only on the dimension. A polyhedral family shows that the dimension-independent quadratic bound remains asymptotically sharp.
  We also identify a minimum successful geometric decay factor and analyze adaptive radius rules based on subgradients or objective gaps, epigraph reformulation, and relaxed updates. Together, these results strengthen the foundations and convergence guarantees of the method without assuming smoothness or strong convexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究精确欧氏球近端点法（ball-proximal point method），针对正常闭凸函数，每次迭代在当前点周围的球内最小化目标。通过保留目标间隙，得到目标值、稳定性及对称Bregman距离的更紧界，并完整刻画了任意正半径序列的收敛行为。
AI.motivation: 经典邻近点法及其变体的收敛分析往往依赖光滑性或强凸性假设，且对目标值、稳定性与距离最优解的界不够紧。本文希望在仅假设正常、闭、凸的条件下，强化球近端点法的基础与收敛保证，并给出更精确的收敛速率与半径序列刻画。
AI.method: 采用精确欧氏球近端点法：每步在当前点为中心的球内最小化目标；在平方距离下降中保留目标间隙，推导目标值、稳定性和对称Bregman距离的界。分析常半径与任意正半径序列，刻画半径和发散、可和等情形下的收敛；利用自收缩性分析轨迹长度与终止界；构造多面体族验证维数无关二次界的渐近紧性；并研究最小成功几何衰减因子、基于次梯度或目标间隙的自适应半径规则、上镜图重构及松弛更新。
AI.result: 常半径t>0、初始距离D0时，K次迭代后目标间隙至多为初值乘以exp(-2K^2t^2/D0^2)。任意正半径序列：和发散时，若存在极小点则有限步到达；否则目标值收敛到下确界且迭代点逃离任意有界集。半径可和时，迭代点收敛到可能非最优的点。自收缩给出有界迭代点的有限轨迹长度及常半径终止界O_d(1+D0/t)，隐式常数仅依赖维数。多面体族表明维数无关二次界渐近锐利。还给出最小成功几何衰减因子及自适应半径规则、上镜图重构和松弛更新分析。
AI.conclusion: 在不假设光滑性或强凸性的前提下，本文强化了球近端点法的理论基础与收敛保证，给出了常半径与一般半径序列下的精确收敛刻画、终止界与锐利性结果，并提供了自适应半径等实用扩展。

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: https://huggingface.co/HenryYHW/TriDrive
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.

AI.tldr: TriDrive：首个联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求的统一框架，采用自动化条件转移模型，在AIDE、BATON及实车部署中均取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员监控中，驾驶员、车辆与道路场景如何交互并共同演化是核心问题；既有工作仅孤立建模舱内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员运动，缺乏对三者联合建模与实时车载评估。
AI.method: 提出TriDrive统一框架，通过自动化条件转移模型联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求。各模态专用编码器（驾驶员锚定运动学表示、因果CAN总线动力学、冻结的V-JEPA 2道路潜变量及结构化道路边界）由有向残差连接相连，使驾驶员与道路上下文细化车辆预测。
AI.result: AIDE基准上运动学编码方案取得全集合SOTA（48.05 vs 71.47 All-MPJPE）；197.2小时BATON自然驾驶子集上，有向连接与道路边界使转向起始PR-AUC提升0.084、碰撞时间下降提升0.286。蒸馏道路编码器后，TriDrive在comma four加外接8GB GPU上运行，轻量当前状态预警探针以5Hz更新、p95延迟177ms，联合模型并发预测。探针在人工标注手动驾驶预警上AUROC 0.725 vs 0.563（openpilot基线）；14名驾驶员的配对道路研究中，其预警适当性（+1.79）与及时性（+2.67）评分更高。
AI.conclusion: TriDrive验证了联合建模驾驶员、车辆与道路的可行性与实时性，在公开基准、自然驾驶数据集和实车部署中均优于既有基线及openpilot驾驶员监控系统。

title: Heavenly Elliptic Curves over Cubic Number Fields
summary: The study of heavenly abelian varieties is motivated by a question of Ihara. When an elliptic curve $E/K$ is heavenly at $\ell$, the extension $K(E[\ell^\infty])/K(μ_\ell^\infty)$ is pro-$\ell$ and unramified away from $\ell$. These are the same arithmetic conditions as the fixed field of the kernel attached to pro-$\ell$ étale covers of the projective line over $K$ minus three points. In this paper we study heavenly elliptic curves defined over cubic number fields. Following the work on McLeman and Rasmussen in the quadratic case, we find that there is a wider range of possible behaviors for the trace of a balanced elliptic curve in the cubic case. In this setting, we introduce a further distinction between balanced and totally balanced curves. With this, we show that trace of the representation on the $\ell$-torsion for totally balanced elliptic curves is non-surjective. We also compute a bound on primes $\ell$ after which any heavenly elliptic curve defined over a cubic number field must be balanced. Finally we compare the trace behavior of totally balanced elliptic curves with CM elliptic curves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三次数域上的 heavenly 椭圆曲线，在二次情形（McLeman–Rasmussen）基础上揭示三次情形下 balanced 椭圆曲线迹行为的更丰富可能性，引入 totally balanced 概念并证明其 ℓ-挠表示迹非满射，给出迫使曲线 balanced 的素数 ℓ 的界，并与 CM 椭圆曲线的迹行为作比较。
AI.motivation: Heavenly abelian varieties 的研究源于 Ihara 的一个问题：当椭圆曲线 E/K 在 ℓ 处 heavenly 时，扩张 K(E[ℓ^∞])/K(μ_ℓ^∞) 是 pro-ℓ 且在 ℓ 外非分歧，这与 K 上射影直线去掉三点后 pro-ℓ étale 覆盖核的固定域具有相同的算术条件。McLeman 和 Rasmussen 已在二次数域情形开展研究，本文旨在将相关问题推广到三次数域，探索更大范围的行为。
AI.method: 在三次数域上研究 heavenly 椭圆曲线。沿用并推广 McLeman–Rasmussen 在二次情形的方法，分析 balanced 椭圆曲线迹的可能行为；引入 balanced 与 totally balanced 曲线的区分，据此研究 totally balanced 椭圆曲线在 ℓ-挠上的表示迹，并推导使任意 heavenly 椭圆曲线必须为 balanced 的素数 ℓ 的界。
AI.result: 在三次情形下，balanced 椭圆曲线的迹呈现出比二次情形更广泛的行为范围。对于 totally balanced 椭圆曲线，其在 ℓ-挠上的表示迹是非满射的；同时得到了一个素数界，超过该界后三次数域上任意 heavenly 椭圆曲线必为 balanced。此外还将 totally balanced 椭圆曲线的迹行为与 CM 椭圆曲线进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 三次数域上 heavenly 椭圆曲线的分类需要比二次情形更精细的区分（balanced 与 totally balanced）。totally balanced 曲线的 ℓ-挠表示迹非满射这一结论，将其与 CM 椭圆曲线区分开来，并刻画了大素数处 heavenly 曲线的必然形态。

title: Coordinated Lane-Level Variable Speed Limits and Ramp Metering for Successive Weaving Segments Considering Merging/Diverging Risks: A Hybrid Model Predictive Control and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Successive weaving segments (SWSs) on urban expressways are bottlenecks prone to recurrent congestion and collisions, requiring fine-grained active traffic management (ATM). Existing approaches struggle to balance the adaptive performance of data-driven optimization with the resilience and transferability of model-based control. We propose a hybrid framework to coordinate lane-level variable speed limits (VSLs) and ramp metering across SWSs. First, we reconstruct L-METANET, a lane-level macroscopic traffic flow model that captures free and forced lane changes. Second, we combine XGBoost-SHAP with a random-parameters binary logit (RPBL) model to derive analytical equations for merging and diverging collision risks and formulate system cost and reward functions. Third, we develop MPC-STMAPPO, a hierarchical controller integrating model predictive control (MPC) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Its upper MPC layer uses L-METANET for long-horizon rolling optimization and generates baseline commands; its lower spatiotemporal MAPPO (ST-MAPPO) layer, enhanced with Mamba cells and graph attention, produces residual actions for short-horizon adjustment. Real-world experiments on the 18-km Eastern Expressway in Changchun, China, show that L-METANET accurately reproduces lane-changing-induced flow redistribution and capacity drops, with state evolution aligned with ground truth. XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL achieves AUCs above 0.80 in most tasks, outperforming conventional logit models. MPC-STMAPPO converges faster and performs better across multiple metrics than MPC- and MARL-based baselines. Under randomly fluctuating demand, it also significantly outperforms pure MARL in generalization, demonstrating strong potential for industrial deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出MPC-STMAPPO混合框架，协调交织区车道级可变限速与匝道控制，兼顾模型自适应性与可迁移性，实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 城市快速路连续交织段（SWSs）是易发常发性拥堵与碰撞的瓶颈，需精细化主动交通管理；现有方法难以兼顾数据驱动优化的自适应性与模型控制的韧性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 1) 重建车道级宏观交通流模型L-METANET，刻画自由与强制换道；2) 结合XGBoost-SHAP与随机参数二元Logit（RPBL）模型，推导合流/分流碰撞风险解析式并构建系统成本与奖励函数；3) 构建分层控制器MPC-STMAPPO：上层MPC基于L-METANET做长时域滚动优化生成基线指令，下层时空MAPPO（ST-MAPPO）融合Mamba单元与图注意力生成残差动作进行短时域调整。
AI.result: 在长春东部长18 km快速路实测实验中，L-METANET准确再现换道引起的流量重分配与通行能力下降，状态演化与真值一致；XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL多数任务AUC超0.80，优于传统Logit模型；MPC-STMAPPO收敛更快、多指标优于MPC与MARL基线；随机波动需求下泛化能力显著优于纯MARL。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架有效协调车道级VSL与匝道控制，兼具模型控制的韧性与学习控制的自适应性，具备较强工业落地潜力。

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出CAPEX框架，用通用多模态基础模型作为自主演示者，通过执行经验自适应调节重规划频率，高效收集机器人演示数据。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人学习依赖人工遥操作演示，采集过程不直观、难扩展且本质异步，亟需可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 将基础模型本身作为自主演示者，从多模态基础模型中蒸馏物理行为；CAPEX利用先前尝试的执行经验，自适应调整基础模型观察、推理与重规划的频率，降低调用开销。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa任务及物理Franka与双臂YAM平台评测：成功演示数量提升4.3倍，每条成功演示成本降低80%；CAPEX生成数据训练的策略接近匹配人类演示的表现，延长训练后差距基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可作为可扩展、可复用的机器人经验来源，支撑下游策略学习。

title: Optimal Control of a Non-Stationary Inventory-Queue, with Applications to EV-Battery Swapping
summary: We study a non-stationary queueing system with multiple parallel servers and a finite buffer capacity, over a finite planning horizon. Motivated by an operation that is central to an EV (electric vehicle) battery-swapping station -- how to best manage the charging of batteries swapped off from EVs, we develop a continuous-time MDP (Markov decision process) approach to the problem. The main technical challenge is to allow both the arrival rate and the service-cost rate to be functions of time with jumps at discrete time points, key features of the EV swapping station's operation. We derive an exact and explicit threshold structure that characterizes the optimal control policy. Moreover, we give conditions under which the thresholds are monotone over time, and with respect to key system parameters such as service and buffer capacities. Extensive numerical experiments are carried out to supplement as well as validate the theoretical results, and also to illustrate the robustness of the threshold structure in practical implementations.

AI.tldr: 研究有限时域内多服务器、有限缓冲的非平稳排队系统，构建连续时间MDP（马尔可夫决策过程）模型并推导最优控制的精确阈值结构与单调性条件。
AI.motivation: 源于电动汽车（EV）换电站中换下电池充电管理的实际运营需求，其到达率与服务成本率均随时间在离散时点发生跳变，属于典型的关键非平稳特征，需要刻画最优控制策略。
AI.method: 建立连续时间MDP（马尔可夫决策过程）模型，允许到达率与服务成本率均为时间函数且在离散时点跳跃；据此推导精确且显式的最优控制阈值结构，并给出阈值随时间及服务容量、缓冲容量等关键参数单调的条件；辅以大量数值实验验证。
AI.result: 获得精确显式的阈值型最优策略刻画；给出阈值关于时间及服务、缓冲容量等参数单调性的充分条件；数值实验验证理论结果，并说明阈值结构在实际实现中具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 该MDP框架能有效处理到达率与服务成本率随时间跳变的非平稳排队控制问题，所得阈值策略结构清晰、便于实践部署且具备稳健性。

title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) is vulnerable to covariate shift during closed-loop execution, where small prediction or execution errors can drive the robot toward states poorly covered by the demonstration data. We focus on action-sequence planning, where a policy predicts a finite-horizon sequence of actions as a reference trajectory for robot execution. Existing approaches to covariate shift often rely on collecting additional corrective demonstrations, requiring further environment interaction and access to an expert or reference policy. We propose Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a simple training approach for improving recovery using only existing demonstrations. PARS perturbs the robot's proprioceptive state and anchors only the later portion of the predicted trajectory to the original demonstration, leaving the earlier portion free to generate corrective motion and recover toward the demonstrated behavior within the planning horizon. Unlike conventional input-noise augmentation, which preserves the original supervision target over the entire prediction horizon, PARS explicitly provides trajectory-level supervision for recovery from perturbed states. PARS requires neither additional environment interaction nor expert queries and can be instantiated across different action-sequence policy classes with only minor modifications to their BC objectives. Experiments on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks with flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies demonstrate that PARS improves robustness to covariate shift during closed-loop execution.

AI.tldr: 提出 PARS：仅用已有示教数据，通过扰动本体状态并只对动作序列后段施加监督，构造恢复性监督，提升动作序列策略在闭环执行中的抗协变量偏移能力。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在闭环执行中易受协变量偏移影响：微小的预测或执行误差会将机器人推向示教数据覆盖不足的状态。现有缓解方法多依赖额外采集修正性示教，需要与环境交互或访问专家/参考策略。本文希望仅用已有示教数据提升恢复能力。
AI.method: PARS（Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision）：一种简单的训练方法。它扰动机器人的本体感知状态，并仅将预测动作序列的后段锚定到原始示教动作，使序列前段保持自由以生成纠正运动，从而在规划时域内向示教行为恢复。与仅在输入加噪但仍保留整个预测时域原监督目标的常规输入噪声增强不同，PARS 显式提供轨迹级的“从扰动状态恢复”监督。该方法无需额外环境交互或专家查询，只需对各类动作序列策略的 BC 目标做微小修改即可实例化。
AI.result: 在 51 个 RLBench 操作任务上，对基于流（flow-based）、Transformer 和扩散（diffusion-based）的策略进行实验，表明 PARS 提升了闭环执行中应对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PARS 是一种无需额外交互或专家数据、可跨策略类别通用的恢复性监督训练方法，能有效增强动作序列策略在闭环执行下的鲁棒性。关键词：行为克隆、协变量偏移、动作序列规划、数据增强。

title: Tight Lower Bounds for Stochastic Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We study the stochastic first-order oracle complexity of finding $ε$-stationary points of the primal function in smooth nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. For sufficiently small $ε$, we establish lower bounds of $Ω(κLΔσ^2ε^{-4})$ under the bounded-variance assumption and $Ω(κ^{3/2}\bar LΔσε^{-3})$ under the additional assumption of averaged smoothness. Here, $L$ and $\bar L$ denote the smoothness and averaged-smoothness constants, respectively, $Δ$ is the initial primal gap, $σ^2$ bounds the oracle variance, and $κ=L/μ$ or $\bar L/μ$ in the respective settings, where $μ$ is the strong-concavity parameter. Our bounded-variance lower bound improves the dependence on the condition number from $κ^{1/3}$ in previous lower bounds to $κ$, while our averaged-smoothness lower bound is the first of its kind. In both settings, the resulting lower bounds match existing upper bounds in their dependence on $κ$ and $ε$. Our proofs are based on a unified quadratic lifting construction that transfers a hardness instance for stochastic nonconvex minimization to unconstrained minimax optimization while preserving the required variance and smoothness properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究光滑非凸-强凹极小极大优化中求ε-稳定点的随机一阶预言机复杂度，给出有界方差下Ω(κLΔσ²ε⁻⁴)与平均光滑下Ω(κ^{3/2}L̄Δσε⁻³)的下界，证明基于统一二次提升构造。
AI.motivation: 光滑非凸-强凹极小极大优化的随机一阶复杂度下界此前不紧，尤其有界方差情形对条件数κ的依赖仅为κ^{1/3}，与上界存在差距；平均光滑情形则尚无相应下界。作者旨在建立更紧、且能匹配上界的下界。
AI.method: 采用统一的二次提升构造，将随机非凸最小化的困难实例转化为无约束极小极大优化问题，同时保持所需的方差与光滑性性质，从而在充分小ε下导出下界。
AI.result: 有界方差假设下得到Ω(κLΔσ²ε⁻⁴)下界，将条件数依赖从先前下界的κ^{1/3}提升至κ；在额外平均光滑假设下得到首个Ω(κ^{3/2}L̄Δσε⁻³)下界。两种情形下界在κ和ε依赖上均与现有上界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出的下界在κ与ε依赖上紧匹配已有上界，完善了光滑非凸-强凹极小极大优化的随机一阶预言机复杂度刻画。

title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
summary: Cable-suspended hoisting is widely used to move heavy or bulky payloads that cannot be handled conveniently by rigid pick-and-place systems, for example in crane-assisted construction. Robotic hoisting using flexible cables is challenging because payload motion is underactuated, external disturbances vary, and delayed or lost visual observations can make the perceived payload state stale at control execution. These effects are particularly critical during precise insertion of a suspended payload's sockets onto rebar pins, which is a very common task in construction environments. We present SwingRL, a residual reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that combines an age-aware world model, a classical anti-swing prior, and a recurrent residual policy to address two coupled problems: stale feedback and uncertain dynamics. The world model propagates the newest received payload observation to the current control step using the executed commands, providing a time-aligned state estimate under delayed and lossy sensing. The prior supplies nominal tracking and swing damping. The residual policy learns bounded corrections to the prior rather than the complete control law, compensating for system-parameter variation, external disturbances, and remaining state-estimation errors. We evaluate SwingRL against classical and learning-based baselines across a cumulative difficulty ladder covering system-parameter variation, wind disturbance, degraded sensing, and strong gusts. Under the most difficult setting, SwingRL achieves 69.5% strict and 77.3% broad success, exceeding all baselines by at least 60 percentage points, respectively. World-model ablations support the role of time-aligned state estimation in maintaining insertion success as observation loss increases. Finally, without real-robot fine-tuning, SwingRL achieves 90% success on the physical rig.

AI.tldr: 提出 SwingRL 残差强化学习框架，结合时龄感知世界模型、经典抗摆先验与循环残差策略，解决延迟/丢失视觉反馈下的欠驱动吊装精确插入问题，仿真与实机均取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 缆索吊装在建筑等场景中广泛使用，但柔性缆索吊装存在三大难题：载荷运动欠驱动、外部扰动多变、视觉观测延迟或丢失导致控制执行时所感知的载荷状态陈旧。这些问题在将悬吊载荷插座精确套入钢筋销的插入任务中尤为关键，现有经典与学习方法难以同时应对"反馈陈旧"与"动力学不确定"两个耦合问题。
AI.method: SwingRL 由三部分组成：1）时龄感知（age-aware）世界模型，利用已执行的控制指令将最新接收到的载荷观测前推至当前控制步，在延迟和丢包感知下给出时间对齐的状态估计；2）经典抗摆先验，提供名义跟踪与摆动阻尼控制；3）循环残差策略，仅学习对先验的有界修正而非完整控制律，以补偿系统参数变化、外部扰动和残余状态估计误差。
AI.result: 在覆盖系统参数变化、风扰、感知退化与强阵风的累积难度阶梯上，与经典及学习类基线对比：最难设置下 SwingRL 取得 69.5% 严格成功率和 77.3% 宽松成功率，分别超出所有基线至少 60 个百分点。世界模型消融实验支持时间对齐状态估计在观测丢失加剧时维持插入成功的作用。无需真机微调，SwingRL 在物理平台上达到 90% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将时龄感知世界模型、抗摆先验与残差策略相结合，可有效应对延迟/丢失感知下的欠驱动吊装控制；时间对齐的状态估计是维持鲁棒性的关键，且策略具备良好的从仿真到真机的零微调迁移能力。

title: Robust identification of drive-by sensing ride-hailing market with Points of Interest monitoring under uncertain ride demand
summary: Taxi-based mobile sensing has emerged as a cost-efficient paradigm for large-scale urban environmental monitoring. In practice, both passive and active sensing strategies are adopted by ride-hailing platforms. Passive sensing, conducted during passenger-serving trips, is constrained by stochastic and spatially imbalanced ride demand, leading to limited and uneven coverage. Active sensing, executed by vacant taxis, provides greater control over sensing operations but incurs additional operational costs, and is thus typically treated as a supplementary strategy. To address the inefficiencies of the conventional "passive-first, active-second" paradigm, which may delay the monitoring of critical Points of Interest (POIs) and increase system-wide costs, we propose a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO)-based framework for active mobile sensing. First, we develop an enhanced A*-based drive-by sensing routing policy that integrates vehicle-task matching while capturing both global routing efficiency and local sensing opportunities. Second, we formulate the active sensing problem as a DRO model that explicitly accounts for uncertainty in ride demand through an ambiguity set of probability distributions, enabling robust decision-making for vacant taxi routing and vehicle-task matching. The proposed framework is evaluated on both static and dynamic mobile sensing settings using real-world data. Computational results demonstrate that our approach achieves better performance in terms of sensing coverage, operational cost, and robustness compared to benchmark strategies, highlighting the value of integrating distributional robustness into taxi-based sensing operations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对网约车移动感知中"被动优先、主动补充"范式效率低的问题，提出基于分布鲁棒优化（DRO）的主动感知框架，结合增强A*路径策略与车辆-任务匹配，在真实数据上取得更优的覆盖、成本与鲁棒性表现。
AI.motivation: 出租车移动感知是低成本的大规模城市环境监测范式。被动感知受乘车需求随机性和空间不均衡限制，覆盖有限且不均；主动感知由空驶出租车执行，可控性强但成本高，通常仅作补充。传统"被动优先、主动补充"范式可能延误关键POI监测并增加系统成本，因此需要新的主动感知优化框架。
AI.method: 提出DRO-based框架。第一，构建增强的A*行驶感知路径策略，在车辆-任务匹配中兼顾全局路径效率与局部感知机会；第二，将主动感知问题建模为DRO模型，通过概率分布模糊集显式刻画乘车需求不确定性，实现空驶出租车路径与车辆-任务匹配的鲁棒决策。
AI.result: 在静态与动态移动感知场景下使用真实数据评估。计算结果表明，所提方法在感知覆盖率、运营成本和鲁棒性方面均优于基准策略。
AI.conclusion: 将分布鲁棒性引入出租车感知运营具有显著价值，可改善覆盖、降低成本并增强鲁棒性，优于传统"被动优先、主动补充"范式。
