title: REALM: A Coarse-to-Fine Generative Framework for Embodied Reactive Listening
summary:
Generating responsive listener facial motion is an important task for embodied conversational AI. Two modeling challenges are central: accounting for the timing of speaker cues while maintaining continuity with the listener's ongoing motion, and capturing locally variable facial events alongside the overall motion trajectory. Listener responses may follow preceding cues with a temporal lag, while brief expressions and blinks introduce variation that is difficult to predict deterministically. These challenges motivate a framework that combines history-aware temporal alignment with stochastic expression refinement. We propose REALM (Reactive Embodied Audio-driven Listening Model), a coarse-to-fine framework for audio-driven reactive listening. A Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion module combines listener motion history with speaker audio through a delay-centered attention prior and adaptive gating. A coarse decoder predicts a base motion trajectory, which is augmented by audio-conditioned stochastic residuals in the expression subspace while retaining the coarse pose parameters. Evaluations on ViCo and L2L show improvements over the evaluated baselines across multiple motion-quality metrics. Additional analyses examine delay sensitivity, gate behavior, and blink dynamics. Finally, deployment on an Ameca humanoid robot and a perceptual user study demonstrate the applicability of the generated behavior to physical embodiment.
  Code: https://github.com/lipzh5/REALM Demo: https://youtu.be/Tf5mpd5S8VQ

AI.tldr: 提出 REALM，一个由粗到细的音频驱动反应式倾听面部动作生成框架，结合历史感知时序对齐与随机表情精修，在 ViCo 与 L2L 上提升动作质量，并在 Ameca 机器人上完成部署与感知用户研究。
AI.motivation: 生成具有反应性的倾听者面部动作对具身对话 AI 很重要，但存在两大建模挑战：一是需要兼顾说话人线索的时序（反应可能滞后于线索）并保持与倾听者既有动作的连续性；二是既要刻画整体动作轨迹，又要捕捉局部可变的短暂面部事件（如短促表情与眨眼），这些事件难以确定性预测。
AI.method: REALM 采用由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）框架。其 Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion 模块通过以延迟为中心的注意力先验与自适应门控，将倾听者动作历史与说话人音频融合；粗解码器预测基础动作轨迹，随后在表情子空间中用音频条件化的随机残差进行增强，同时保留粗层的姿态参数。
AI.result: 在 ViCo 与 L2L 数据集上，相比所评估的基线，在多项动作质量指标上取得提升；并额外分析了延迟敏感性、门控行为与眨眼动态。最终在 Ameca 人形机器人上部署，并通过感知用户研究验证了生成行为在物理具身场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: REALM 通过历史感知的时序对齐与随机表情精修相结合，有效解决了倾听者反应式面部动作生成中的时序与局部变化难题，且具备向实体机器人迁移的实际可行性。

title: Projection-Free Algorithms for Nonsmooth Stochastic Convex-Concave Saddle-Point Problems
summary: We study nonsmooth convex-concave saddle-point problems over compact convex sets, assuming access to stochastic subgradients of the payoff function. We develop single-loop projection-free algorithms that use linear minimization oracles over the primal and dual domains. Unlike prior projection-free approaches that rely on smoothing, our methods are purely subgradient-based and handle nonsmoothness directly. This design makes the framework modular: when a linear minimization oracle is not used over a specific domain, the corresponding update can be replaced by a standard projection oracle without changing the single-loop structure. Thus, our framework covers both fully projection-free and hybrid oracle configurations. We prove anytime strong saddle gap guarantees under standard unbiased stochastic oracle assumptions with bounded variance. Our algorithms achieve an $O(ε^{-2})$ iteration complexity, matching projected stochastic subgradient methods. We also provide matching lower bounds for the corresponding oracle models, establishing minimax optimality. Our results show that, for nonsmooth stochastic minimax problems, the computational advantages of linear minimization oracles need not come at the expense of statistical or oracle efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对紧凸集上非光滑凸-凹鞍点问题，在仅有随机次梯度oracle的条件下，提出单循环无投影算法，直接在原始与对偶域使用线性最小化oracle（LMO），无需平滑化。框架模块化，可混合使用LMO与投影oracle，获得$O(\varepsilon^{-2})$迭代复杂度并给出匹配下界，达到极小极大最优。
AI.motivation: 既有无投影方法通常依赖平滑化处理非光滑性，而现有随机次梯度方法又多需要投影。作者希望在不引入平滑的前提下，直接处理非光滑随机鞍点问题，同时获得与投影随机次梯度方法相同的统计与oracle效率。
AI.method: 针对紧凸集上的非光滑凸-凹鞍点问题，在可获得payoff函数随机次梯度的设定下，设计单循环（single-loop）无投影算法，使用原始域与对偶域上的线性最小化oracle。方法纯基于次梯度，不依赖平滑。框架具有模块化特性：若某域不使用LMO，可将对应更新替换为标准投影oracle而不改变单循环结构，从而统一覆盖完全无投影与混合oracle配置。
AI.result: 在标准无偏随机oracle假设与有界方差条件下，证明算法具有anytime强鞍点间隙（strong saddle gap）保证；迭代复杂度为$O(\varepsilon^{-2})$，与投影随机次梯度方法相当；并针对相应oracle模型给出匹配的下界，证明极小极大最优性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对于非光滑随机极小极大问题，线性最小化oracle的计算优势不必以牺牲统计效率或oracle效率为代价。所提框架在完全无投影与混合oracle设置下均能达到最优复杂度。

title: Humanoids for Robot-Assisted Surgery: Bimanual Base Placement and Tool-Mount Optimization via Capability Maps
summary: Rapid advances in humanoid robotics have motivated growing interest in the application of humanoids for healthcare and clinical tasks. However, it remains unclear how close contemporary humanoids are to meeting the kinematic demands of robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery. In this work, we address the question of optimal robot positioning through a quantitative analysis of workspace and robot setup configurations. We present a capability-map-based robot setup framework that optimizes humanoid base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual humanoid reachability while accounting for tool-tip kinematics and remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraints. We evaluate three humanoid platforms spanning different body dimensions and kinematic redundancy on workspace reachability for three representative general surgery procedures: cholecystectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. The proposed joint optimization of base placement and tool mounting consistently outperforms base-only optimization and heuristic baselines. For cholecystectomy and inguinal hernia repair, which are characterized by relatively small and minimally overlapping workspaces, humanoid reachability approached 90%. For the larger, overlapping multi-port arm workspace of sleeve gastrectomy, humanoids yield substantially lower coverage. These results quantify the near-term promise of humanoids for selected laparoscopic procedures and clarify key limitations that must be addressed for broader deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于能力地图的机器人配置框架，联合优化人形机器人基座位置与器械安装朝向，以最大化双臂可达性并满足工具尖端运动学与RCM约束，量化评估人形机器人用于腹腔镜手术的空间可行性。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在医疗与临床任务中的应用日益受关注，但尚不清楚现有人形机器人能否满足机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的运动学需求，尤其缺乏关于最优机器人定位与工作空间可行性的定量分析。
AI.method: 构建基于能力地图的机器人配置框架，联合优化人形机器人基座放置与器械安装朝向，在考虑工具尖端运动学与远心运动（RCM）约束下最大化双臂可达性；在三个具有不同体型与运动冗余度的人形平台上，针对胆囊切除、腹股沟疝修补与袖状胃切除三种代表性手术评估工作空间可达性，并与仅优化基座及启发式基线对比。
AI.result: 联合优化基座位置与器械安装的配置始终优于仅基座优化和启发式基线。对于工作空间较小且重叠度低的胆囊切除与腹股沟疝修补，人形机器人可达性接近90%；对于工作空间更大且多端口臂重叠的袖状胃切除，覆盖率显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了人形机器人在部分腹腔镜手术中的近期应用潜力，同时明确了实现更广泛部署所需解决的关键局限，即在大范围重叠工作空间任务中的可达性不足问题。

title: Convex Optimization Is Free When Accuracy Is Expensive
summary: This paper studies convex optimization when the gradient cannot be evaluated exactly, but only approximated by a hierarchy of algorithms whose compute grows like $δ^{-γ}$ in the accuracy $δ$. When $γ>2$, falling into the Harder-Than-Monte-Carlo (HTMC) regime, the price of accuracy outruns the variance reduction that Monte Carlo would buy and we show that minimizing a loss function costs no more, up to a factor depending only on $γ$, than a single evaluation of its gradient at the accuracy the problem demands. A randomized multilevel oracle replaces the deterministic approximation of accuracy $δ$ by an unbiased estimator of it, whose variance $σ^2$ becomes a second, independently priced dial: the cost of one call drops from $δ^{-γ}$ to $δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}$. Plain inexact gradient descent driven by that oracle reaches loss $\varepsilon$ at expected compute $Θ(\varepsilon^{-γ})$ in the convex case, against $Θ(\varepsilon^{-(γ+1)})$ for the same method run at a fixed accuracy: randomization buys a full power of $\varepsilon$. Under $μ$-strong convexity the exponent halves, to $\varepsilon^{-γ/2}$, because the iterates settle at a noise floor and the bias budget relaxes accordingly. Both bounds are independent of the step size, and hence of the smoothness constant, and we show that the cost is a functional of the underlying gradient flow rather than of any discretization of it.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究梯度只能通过计算成本随精度δ以δ^{-γ}增长的层级算法近似时的凸优化问题；在γ>2的HTMC区域，提出随机多层oracle将确定性近似替换为无偏估计，使单次调用成本由δ^{-γ}降至δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}，并证明普通非精确梯度下降在凸情形达到ε精度仅需Θ(ε^{-γ})，强凸情形进一步减半至ε^{-γ/2}，且界与步长、光滑常数无关。
AI.motivation: 当梯度无法精确求值、只能以计算成本随精度 δ 按 δ^{-γ} 增长的层级算法近似时，若 γ>2（HTMC 区域），精度的代价超过蒙特卡洛方差缩减带来的收益，传统方法可能因误差累积而效率低下。作者希望探究在这种高成本精度区域，最小化损失函数的代价能否被控制在单次梯度求值成本的数量级，并利用随机化进一步降低对 ε 的依赖。
AI.method: 采用随机多层 oracle（randomized multilevel oracle）替代精度为 δ 的确定性梯度近似，构造其无偏估计，并引入一个可独立定价的方差 σ²；在此基础上使用普通非精确梯度下降（plain inexact gradient descent）作为优化算法。
AI.result: 随机多层 oracle 使单次调用成本从 δ^{-γ} 降为 δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}。在凸情形，普通非精确梯度下降以该 oracle 达到损失 ε 的期望计算量为 Θ(ε^{-γ})，而同一方法在固定精度下需 Θ(ε^{-(γ+1)})，即随机化节省了整整一阶 ε 的幂次；在 μ-强凸情形，指数减半至 ε^{-γ/2}，因为迭代收敛到噪声下限、偏差预算相应放宽。两个界均与步长及光滑常数无关，且成本是底层梯度流的泛函，而非其任何离散化的泛函。
AI.conclusion: 在 HTMC 区域（γ>2），随机化多层 oracle 能显著降低非精确凸优化的计算复杂度：凸情形下节省一阶 ε 幂次，强凸情形下指数减半；成本上界与步长、光滑常数无关，且本质上由底层梯度流决定，而非离散化方式。

title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
summary: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种无需预设结构、关节或几何的自由形态机器人进化方法，通过对比学习构建可搜索的设计嵌入空间，结合自回归发育模型、进化策略与强化学习，进化出能抓取、握持、旋转和使用物体的机械手，并在真实世界中零样本制造与测试。
AI.motivation: 目前关于如何人工设计具备灵巧操作能力的智能体所知甚少。虽然可从动物操控物体的行为中提炼设计原则，但这些结构与行为难以被仿生复现，且未必适合人造机器。因此作者试图摆脱对既有生物形态的依赖，探索自由形态机器人设计的可能性。
AI.method: 不预设身体任何部位的存在、关节或几何结构，直接进化自由形态机器人以完成抓取、握持、旋转和使用多样物体的任务。方法上使用对比学习构建高度可搜索的遗传设计空间嵌入，用自回归发育模型解码设计，用进化策略搜索优设计，再用强化学习训练每个进化出的设计。获胜设计被自动转换为可制造蓝图，打印、组装并在真实世界中进行零样本测试。
AI.result: 进化出的设计能够完成抓取、握持、旋转和使用多样物体的任务。在某些条件下会自发涌现出尾巴、喙、爪、钳等熟悉的抓握形态；同时从头设计也能揭示被忽视或未知的新结构，可能更适合特定任务。获胜设计被自动转化为可制造蓝图并零样本在真实世界中测试成功。结果在性能、多样性和复杂性方面代表了进化机器人学的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 自由形态机器人进化方法无需预设生物式结构即可发现多样且高效的操作设计方案，既能复现部分生物启发的抓握形态，也能产生全新的结构解。该方法将计算设计与真实制造闭环衔接，在性能、多样性和复杂性上达到进化机器人学的先进水平，并为灵巧操作智能体的设计提供了新范式。

title: Entrywise nonnegativity of the inverse relative gain array in dimension six
summary: We prove that $(G\circ G^{-1})^{-1}$ is entrywise nonnegative for every real symmetric positive definite matrix $G$ of order at most six, resolving the inverse relative gain array conjecture of Jeffrey Uhlmann. The proof combines an explicit sum-of-squares identity on $Λ^2\mathbb R^4$ with two bordering arguments. More generally, we establish an equivalence between a biquadratic inequality, a quadratic positivity property, and inverse relative gain array nonnegativity in three consecutive dimensions. As consequences, we characterize the fixed space and averaging properties of the inverse interaction operator and prove a reverse Schur--Horn majorization inequality for matrices diagonalized by real symmetric positive definite matrices. A rational example of order seven shows that both dimension bounds are sharp.

AI.tldr: 证明了实对称正定矩阵 G（阶数≤6）满足 (G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹ 逐元素非负，解决了 Uhlmann 的逆相对增益阵列猜想，并给出若干等价刻画与尖锐性反例。
AI.motivation: 解决 Jeffrey Uhlmann 提出的逆相对增益阵列猜想：对实对称正定矩阵 G，其 (G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹ 是否逐元素非负，并厘清该不等式的成立维数与本质结构。
AI.method: 核心工具是 Λ²R⁴ 上一个显式的平方和（sum-of-squares）恒等式，配合两次 bordering（加边）论证将结论推广；进一步建立双二次不等式、二次正性性质与逆相对增益阵列非负性在三个相邻维数之间的等价关系。
AI.result: 证明了对所有阶数不超过六的实对称正定矩阵 G，(G∘G⁻¹)⁻¹ 逐元素非负；给出上述三类条件的等价性；刻画了逆交互算子的不动空间与平均性质，并证明了一个关于被实对称正定矩阵对角化的矩阵的反向 Schur–Horn 优超不等式；构造七阶有理反例表明两个维数上界均为最优。
AI.conclusion: Uhlmann 的逆相对增益阵列猜想在阶数≤6时成立，且六阶与七阶分别是正例与反例的临界维数，说明该问题在维数上具有本质的紧致分界。

title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
summary: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出VPTwin，一种Real-Sim-Real视频预测框架，用真实同步的仿真孪生锚定真实世界未来预测，减少物理幻觉并提升操作规划性能。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的动作条件视频预测器在长时域rollout中常出现误差累积和物理上不合理的幻觉，严重削弱下游动作规划能力，因此需要借助仿真动力学来约束预测的物理合理性，同时保留真实视频中未建模的接触交互。
AI.method: VPTwin为Real-Sim-Real框架：针对目标操作任务，由VLM从真实演示片段重建可执行数字孪生；为应对未观测物理属性的不适定估计，在Isaac Sim中对候选动作轨迹下随机化物理配置进行多次前向动力学rollout；以这些rollout作为上下文参考，协调仿真与真实两个域，用仿真动力学强制物理合理性，并从真实视频中捕获未建模的接触交互。此外建立预测性规划闭环，用VPTwin视觉验证VLM提出的动作并指导可靠的真实世界执行。
AI.result: 评估表明视频预测中的物理幻觉显著减少，操作规划性能明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合仿真动力学与真实视频，VPTwin有效缓解了长时域视频预测的误差累积与物理不合理问题，并借助预测性规划闭环提升了真实世界操作规划的可靠性。

title: Multi-Modal Non-Prehensile Estimation of Physical Parameters via Press-and-Pull Tipping
summary: Recovering physical properties of unknown objects through non-prehensile interaction is challenging because no single manipulation primitive reveals all relevant parameters. Planar pushing couples mass and friction, while conventional tipping cannot recover friction and may fail entirely when low-friction or curved-base objects slide or rotate instead of tipping. We introduce a multi-modal estimation framework that combines a sliding interaction with a press-and-pull tipping primitive to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction. The press-and-pull interaction increases the object-table sliding threshold and stabilizes the pivot, enabling controlled tipping without any prior geometric object model. Wrist force/torque sensing, RGB-D perception, and robot proprioception are fused to estimate the physical parameters from the two complementary interaction modes. Experiments on an ABB IRB120 across four objects with varied geometry, mass, center of mass, and friction achieve low relative error, while successfully operating on curved-base objects that fail under conventional forward tipping. The results demonstrate that complementary non-prehensile interactions can recover a compact set of physical parameters without grasping, a prior object model, or learned interaction dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合滑动与"按压-牵拉"翻转两种非抓取交互的多模态框架，无需抓取、先验几何模型或学习交互动力学，即可估计物体质量、质心高度与表面摩擦。
AI.motivation: 单一非抓取操作原语无法揭示全部物理参数：平面推动会使质量与摩擦耦合，传统翻转难以恢复摩擦，且对低摩擦或曲面底部物体可能因滑动/旋转而完全失效。
AI.method: 设计多模态估计框架，将滑动交互与"按压-牵拉"(press-and-pull)翻转原语结合；该原语提高物体-台面滑动阈值并稳定支点，从而在无任何先验几何模型下实现可控翻转。融合腕部力/力矩传感、RGB-D 感知与机器人本体感知，从两种互补交互模式中估计物理参数。
AI.result: 在 ABB IRB120 上针对四个几何、质量、质心与摩擦各异的物体进行实验，取得较低相对误差，并成功处理传统前向翻转会失败的曲面底部物体。
AI.conclusion: 互补的非抓取交互可在不抓取、无先验物体模型、无学习交互动力学的前提下，恢复一组紧凑的物理参数。

title: Treewidth and the complexity of box-constrained quadratic programs
summary: We consider the problem of minimizing a sparse quadratic function over the unit hypercube. In binary quadratic programming, treewidth of the interaction graph is a central parameter for tractability: bounded treewidth yields polynomial-time solvability. Motivated by this fact, we investigate whether treewidth plays a similar role when the binary domain is replaced by the unit hypercube. We show that the situation is strikingly different. If the interaction graph is a forest, we give a strongly polynomial-time algorithm based on dynamic programming and a structural analysis of the resulting univariate value functions, which are shown to be concave and piecewise quadratic with linearly many pieces. However, the problem becomes strongly NP-hard already when the interaction graph has treewidth two. We then identify substantially more general polynomial-time solvable classes whose interaction graphs may have unbounded treewidth. Our approach exploits the fact that there exists an optimal solution in which every variable with a nonpositive coefficient for its square term is binary-valued, thereby separating the problem into a combinatorial part and a genuinely continuous part. We show that tractability can be recovered by controlling the complexity of these two parts and their interaction, rather than the treewidth of the entire interaction graph.

AI.tldr: 本文将二元二次规划中树宽可处理性的结论推广到单位超立方体连续域，发现情形截然不同：森林交互图可用强多项式动态规划求解，但树宽为2即强NP难；作者进一步刻画了树宽无界却仍多项式可解的更广问题类。
AI.motivation: 在二元二次规划中，交互图树宽是决定可处理性的核心参数：有界树宽可多项式时间求解。作者试图探究当二元域被替换为单位超立方体（连续松弛）后，树宽是否仍起同等作用，以厘清离散与连续情形下结构参数作用的差异。
AI.method: 为森林交互图设计基于动态规划的强多项式算法，并对产生的单变量值函数做结构分析，证明其为凹的、分片二次且片数为线性。为处理更一般情形，利用"平方项系数非正的变量可取二值"的最优解性质，将问题分解为组合部分与真正连续部分，通过控制这两部分及其交互的复杂度来获得可处理性，而非依赖整体交互图的树宽。
AI.result: 森林交互图情形存在强多项式时间算法；但交互图树宽为2时问题即为强NP难。作者进一步识别出更广的多项式可解类，其交互图树宽可无界。
AI.conclusion: 在单位超立方体上，树宽不再是刻画可处理性的核心参数，其作用与二元二次规划显著不同。可处理性可由组合部分、连续部分及其交互的复杂度共同刻画，从而覆盖树宽无界但结构受限的问题类。

title: Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task.

AI.tldr: 本文研究交互受限场景下指令-状态偏差对模仿学习的作用，提出CSDW方法，通过对指令监督进行连续加权提升受限任务表现。
AI.motivation: 在模仿学习中，从实测机器人运动构建动作目标已成惯例，但在存在交互约束时，指令与状态之间的偏差可能反映运动本身无法捕获的控制需求。作者希望探究这种信息何时重要以及如何加以利用。
AI.method: 基于三个真实机器人任务的任务与阶段分析，发现受限交互下监督差距更大，且选择性保留指令能提供局部有用信息；据此提出Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW)，考虑机器人响应时间，将后续进展、持续未满足需求及需求变化组合为指令监督的连续权重，无需任务阶段标注，也无需改动策略架构或推理。
AI.result: CSDW在受限任务上优于统一的指令监督；而在约束较少的任务中，各方法表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 指令-状态偏差在交互受限时包含运动之外的有用控制信息，将其纳入监督权重可提升性能，且方法实现简单、无需额外标注或架构改动。

title: Accelerated Algorithms for Stochastic Monotone Inclusions with Fixed Queries
summary: We study acceleration of stochastic first-order methods for monotone Lipschitz inclusions with a fixed number of oracle queries per iteration, measured by the expected squared residual. Existing methods either have suboptimal oracle complexity, require an increasing number of oracle queries per iteration, or both. Under same-sample oracle access and mean-square Lipschitz stochastic noise, we develop variance-reduced anchored forward-backward (VRAF), an anytime composite method that makes two oracle queries per iteration. VRAF attains the first log-free $O(1/ε)$ complexity under these oracle assumptions and hence the optimal $O(σ^2/ε)$ variance dependence. This, however, leaves open whether the optimal $O(1/\sqrtε)$ deterministic term can also be attained. We establish an impossibility result by extending the lower bound of Foster et al. (2019) to stochastic oracles permitting repeated queries to sampled stochastic operators, showing that $O(LD/\sqrtε+σ^2/ε)$ oracle complexity is unattainable in general. We therefore develop recentered regularized stochastic extragradient (RRSEG), which attains the near-optimal oracle complexity previously achievable only with an increasing number of queries per iteration, while using a fixed number of queries.

AI.tldr: 针对单调Lipschitz包含问题，在固定每次迭代oracle查询数的设定下，提出VRAF实现首个无对数O(1/ε)复杂度，证明最优O(1/√ε)确定性项不可达，并提出RRSEG达到近最优复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有随机一阶方法用于单调Lipschitz包含问题时，要么oracle复杂度次优，要么需要每次迭代增加oracle查询数，或二者兼有。目标是在固定oracle查询数条件下同时改善复杂度与方差依赖。
AI.method: 在same-sample oracle访问与均方Lipschitz随机噪声下，提出方差缩减锚定前向后向法（VRAF），一种每次迭代两次oracle查询的anytime复合方法；并通过扩展Foster等（2019）的下界，建立不可能性结果；进而提出最近中心正则化随机外推梯度法（RRSEG）。
AI.result: VRAF达到首个无对数O(1/ε)复杂度，从而获得最优O(σ²/ε)方差依赖；不可能性结果表明O(LD/√ε+σ²/ε)的oracle复杂度一般不可达；RRSEG在固定查询数下达到此前仅能以每次迭代增加查询数实现的近最优复杂度。
AI.conclusion: VRAF在固定查询预算下实现最优方差依赖，但最优确定性项不可同时达到；RRSEG以固定查询数实现近最优oracle复杂度，解决了查询数增长与复杂度之间的权衡。

title: TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement
summary: DAgger improves robot policies by aggregating expert supervision from states visited during policy execution. Robot-gated DAgger automates expert queries, allowing the robot to decide when to request expert takeover. While existing gates emphasize detecting the need for assistance, takeover timing also shapes the content of these demonstrations and their value for policy learning. We propose TimelyDAgger, combining Bridge-PCA monitoring of internal vision-language-action (VLA) features with Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation based on expert behavior to improve takeover timing. We introduce an evaluation framework linking failure detection, takeover timing, and policy improvement, including Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR) for assessing supervision quality without retraining. Experiments show that takeover timing affects policy learning, with TimelyDAgger achieving competitive failure detection and higher post-training success in most evaluated settings under matched expert-action budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出TimelyDAgger，通过融合VLA内部特征的Bridge-PCA监控与基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应来优化接管时机，并构建连接故障检测、接管时机与策略改进的评估框架（含TASR指标）。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人门控DAgger主要关注"何时需要帮助"的检测，但接管时机本身会决定所采集专家演示的内容，进而影响其在策略学习中的价值。因此需要优化接管时机而非仅优化检测。
AI.method: 1) 使用Bridge-PCA对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部视觉特征进行监控以判断是否需要介入；2) 基于专家行为进行反馈引导的阈值自适应（Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation）调整接管触发阈值；3) 建立评估框架，将故障检测、接管时机与策略改进联系起来，并提出Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR)，无需重训练即可评估监督质量。
AI.result: 接管时机影响策略学习效果；在匹配专家动作预算条件下，TimelyDAgger在多数评测设置中实现具竞争力的故障检测性能，并获得更高的训练后成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将接管时机作为门控DAgger的核心优化对象可提升监督质量与策略学习收益；TimelyDAgger结合特征监控与阈值自适应是有效方案，TASR为监督质量提供了免重训练的评估手段。

title: Learned Preconditioning for a Primal-Dual Interior-Point Method
summary: Interior-point methods (IPMs) are among the most widely used algorithms for constrained optimization, yet their Newton-based search directions require costly second-order information and large linear-system solves. Learning to optimize offers cheaper updates learned from data, but the singular behavior of logarithmic barriers near constraint boundaries makes IPMs highly sensitive to perturbations, complicating both warm starting and learning reliable updates. We introduce pdLIP, an IPM for smooth nonlinear programs that integrates learned preconditioning with pdProj, an all-shifted primal-dual projected-search IPM. A shared coordinate-wise recurrent network predicts a positive diagonal preconditioner that scales the right-hand side of the reduced Newton system for the primal step, and the remaining slack and multiplier directions are recovered analytically. The learned iterations avoid Hessian evaluations and Newton-system solves, using only first-order and coordinate-wise operations amenable to GPU parallelization. Training is self-supervised, with a loss based on a penalty-barrier merit function and the residual of perturbed optimality conditions, requiring neither target directions nor precomputed solutions. Primal and dual shifts mitigate the barrier's sensitivity to perturbations near constraint boundaries, enabling effective warm starting. Across four classes of 200-dimensional convex and nonconvex constrained problems, pdLIP warm starts reduce pdProj refinement iterations by 63-67% compared with cold starts at the same KKT residual tolerance of $10^{-8}$, with negligible warm-start generation cost relative to the subsequent pdProj solve. Improvements persist on box-constrained QPs with 1000 variables and extend to applications including portfolio optimization, support vector machines, and a nonlinear control example.

AI.tldr: 提出pdLIP：将学习到的对角预条件子与全平移原始-对偶投影搜索内点法（pdProj）结合，无需Hessian与牛顿系统求解，实现高效热启动，将精化迭代减少63-67%。
AI.motivation: 内点法（IPM）是约束优化主流算法，但基于牛顿的搜索方向需要昂贵的二阶信息与大型线性系统求解。学习优化虽可提供更廉价的数据驱动更新，但对数障碍在约束边界附近的奇异行为使IPM对扰动高度敏感，导致热启动与可靠的学习更新都很困难。
AI.method: 提出pdLIP，将学习式预条件与pdProj（全平移原始-对偶投影搜索IPM）集成。使用共享的坐标级循环网络预测正对角预条件子，用于缩放原始步的约化牛顿系统右端项，其余松弛与乘子方向由解析方式恢复。学习迭代避免Hessian计算与牛顿系统求解，仅使用一阶与坐标级操作，便于GPU并行。训练为自监督，损失由惩罚-障碍价值函数与扰动最优性条件残差构成，无需目标方向或预计算解。原始与对偶平移缓解障碍在边界附近对扰动的敏感性，支持有效热启动。
AI.result: 在四类200维凸与非凸约束问题上，相同KKT残差容差1e-8下，pdLIP热启动较冷启动减少pdProj精化迭代63-67%，且热启动生成成本相对后续pdProj求解可忽略。在1000变量箱约束QP上改进持续，并扩展至投资组合优化、支持向量机及非线性控制等应用。
AI.conclusion: pdLIP通过自监督学习对角预条件子并结合平移投影搜索内点法，在避免二阶信息与线性系统求解的同时实现高效可靠的热启动，显著降低精化迭代次数，具备良好的可扩展性与跨应用适用性。

title: Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"行为学行为基底"（ethological behavioral substrate）这一概念视角，主张将动物持续协调多种行为以应对竞争性需求的能力作为机器人学习的核心研究目标，并提出以机器人动物伴侣作为研究长期交互与适应的实验场景。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习已能构建能力日益强大的具身智能体，但对一种更基础的胜任力关注不足：当物理、环境与社会需求随时间变化时，智能体仍能保持情境在场、响应性与行为连贯性。现有研究多将动物行为视为孤立技能集合，忽视了其在竞争性需求下的持续协调，这一目标尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 本文为观点/立场类论文（perspective），不涉及具体算法或实验方法。其方法为概念性论证：提出"行为学行为基底"作为分析人工智能体持续行为胜任力的概念透镜；论证动物行为在竞争性需求下的持续协调构成重要的研究目标；并提议将机器人动物伴侣作为研究人本环境中持续交互与适应的研究平台。
AI.result: 本文未报告实验或定量结果，其"结果"为论证性成果：一是明确了持续行为胜任力这一被忽视的研究目标；二是提出机器人动物伴侣可作为研究社会行为、记忆与持续学习在长期交互中如何发展的有效场景。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张进一步研究这种持久的行为胜任力如何与具身智能体的高层能力形成互补，从而为机器人学习开辟新的研究方向。

title: From detectability of abstract linear systems to exponential output-to-state stability and back
comment: To be submitted to SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization (SICON)
summary: We study exponential output-to-state stability (eOSS) of linear infinite-dimensional systems in Banach spaces with bounded output operators. It is shown that eOSS is equivalent to the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in implication form. Also exponential detectability guarantees the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form and therefore eOSS. Counterexamples demonstrate that the converse implications fail in general: exponential zero-detectability does not imply eOSS, eOSS does not imply the existence of an eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form, which, in turn, does not imply exponential detectability. If the unstable subspace is finite-dimensional, zero-detectability implies exponential detectability and yields equivalent characterizations of eOSS. The results are illustrated with a parabolic equation.

AI.tldr: 研究Banach空间中有界输出算子的线性无穷维系统的指数输出-状态稳定性(eOSS)，建立eOSS与Lyapunov函数存在性的等价刻画，并给出反例与有限维不稳定子空间下的加强结论。
AI.motivation: 为线性无穷维系统建立eOSS的Lyapunov型刻画，明确eOSS与其他稳定性概念（指数可检测性、零可检测性）之间的逻辑关系，并澄清一般情形下这些蕴含关系是否可逆。
AI.method: 在Banach空间框架下，针对有界输出算子的线性无穷维系统，分别考虑蕴含形式与耗散形式的强制eOSS Lyapunov函数，通过构造反例与在有限维不稳定子空间假设下进行理论推导。
AI.result: eOSS等价于蕴含形式强制eOSS Lyapunov函数的存在性；指数可检测性可保证耗散形式强制eOSS Lyapunov函数存在，从而推出eOSS。反例表明：指数零可检测性不蕴含eOSS，eOSS不蕴含耗散形式eOSS Lyapunov函数存在性，后者也不蕴含指数可检测性。当不稳定子空间有限维时，零可检测性蕴含指数可检测性，并给出eOSS的等价刻画。以抛物方程为例进行说明。
AI.conclusion: eOSS的Lyapunov刻画在一般无穷维情形下并非完全等价，多重稳定性概念之间存在单向蕴含关系；有限维不稳定子空间可恢复更强的等价性，结果通过抛物方程得到验证。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
summary:
World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation.
  To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
  DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data.
  Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态预测规划（DPP）框架，将动态操作形式化为反事实规划，通过解耦计划生成的上下文与执行的物理状态，使在静态演示上训练的World-Action模型无需额外动态数据训练即可实时操作移动目标。
AI.motivation: 在静态演示上训练的World-Action模型（WAM）即使具备所需操作技能，也难以操控移动目标。作者将此失败归因于"目标响应坍缩"（target-response collapse）：随着执行推进，策略越来越偏向于已学习到的当前行为延续，对目标位置变化的响应性下降。
AI.method: DPP将动态操作形式化为反事实规划，解耦"用于计划生成的上下文"与"用于执行的物理状态"。具体地，先利用WAM的预测式rollout估计交互预期发生的时间，结合观测到的目标运动预测目标的未来交互位置；随后构造反事实观测，将该预测目标位置置于熟悉的机器人上下文中，从而调用已有操作技能，而非在不熟悉的机器人-目标构型下生成恢复行为；最后在执行时将所得计划与机器人真实状态对接。
AI.result: DPP可在单张消费级GPU上实现实时动态操作，无需在动态数据上额外训练。仿真与真实机器人实验表明，在多种目标运动下性能一致提升，仿真性能超越所有评估基线，包括额外在动态数据上训练的方法。项目主页：https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实规划解耦上下文与执行状态，DPP有效缓解了目标响应坍缩问题，使静态演示训练的WAM具备实时动态操作能力，且无需动态数据微调即可优于动态数据训练基线。

title: Peppy: An AI-Assisted Workflow for Tight Convergence Analysis of Optimization Algorithms
summary: This paper presents Peppy, an AI-assisted workflow for discovering tight, analytic convergence proofs for first-order optimization algorithms. Generic approaches to using LLMs to conduct mathematical research target an unspecified, broad spectrum of problems and sometimes use the Lean 4 proof assistant for formalization. On the other hand, Peppy leverages domain-specific knowledge more heavily and is thereby capable of constructing the proofs in a more structured manner, which allow a minimal and accessible verification through SymPy. We experimentally demonstrate through examples that Peppy provides a rigorous, practical, and reproducible paradigm for AI-assisted theorem synthesis in optimization. We further highlight its capability of closing several open problems on tight convergence analysis of first-order optimization algorithms, including conjectures for Nesterov's FGM. Overall, Peppy is designed to turn the art of optimization algorithm analysis into a science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Peppy，一种AI辅助工作流，用于发现一阶优化算法的紧致解析收敛性证明，通过重度利用领域知识实现结构化证明构造，并以SymPy进行极简验证，多个案例中解决了若干公开问题。
AI.motivation: 现有使用LLM进行数学研究的通用方法面向宽泛的问题谱，且部分依赖Lean 4形式化，缺乏针对性；优化算法分析亟需一种更结构化、可验证且可复现的AI辅助定理构建范式。
AI.method: Peppy采用领域特定知识驱动的工作流，以结构化方式构造紧致、解析的收敛性证明，并通过SymPy进行最小化且易于访问的验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，Peppy提供了严格、实用、可复现的AI辅助定理综合范式，并成功解决了若干一阶优化算法紧致收敛性分析的公开问题，包括Nesterov FGM的相关猜想。
AI.conclusion: Peppy旨在将优化算法分析从"艺术"转变为"科学"，展示了领域知识增强型AI辅助证明发现的有效性与可验证性。

title: Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向双足机器人的多地形统一控制器，使单一控制器即可应对斜坡、湿滑草地、沙石、楼梯等多种地形，并在Cassie机器人上完成验证。
AI.motivation: 传统双足运动控制器通常只针对特定地表有效，难以适应真实世界中多变且不可预测的地形，而部署多个专用控制器又不实际。因此，亟需一个能覆盖多类地形的通用控制器以提升实用性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在前期基于站立踝关节电机实现斜坡与粗糙地面稳定的工作基础上，将能力扩展至陡峭湿滑不平草地、沙地、砾石、岩石等柔顺地形以及楼梯等受限地形。为此引入新的碰撞映射（impact map）以维持性能和对未知地形的鲁棒性，并详细设计可在机器人上实时部署的控制结构。
AI.result: 所提控制器在具有20自由度的Cassie双足机器人上进行了验证，表明其能够在上述多种地形上实现稳定运动。
AI.conclusion: 单一多地形控制器可有效替代多个专用控制器，提升双足机器人在复杂真实地形中的适应性与鲁棒性，具备实际部署可行性。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

AI.tldr: DeltaWAM 提出以"变化"为中心的世界-动作模型，用紧凑的 delta token 作为未来预测单元，在 LIBERO 上达到 92.8% 平均成功率，推理 142.1 ms/动作块、峰值显存 3.86 GB。
AI.motivation: 像素空间世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽能为机器人操作提供视觉前瞻，但需逐帧重建整个未来场景，计算开销高且存在显著的时空冗余。在物理操作中，连续帧的大部分视觉上下文是共享的，真正需要动作策略预测的是帧间变化，因此逐像素重建的方式效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 DeltaWAM：以 delta token 为未来预测单元，每个 token 是一个向量，编码相邻两帧稠密 DINO 特征图之间的变化。模型基于 DeltaWorld（在大规模视频上预训练的潜空间世界模型），自回归地逐帧预测一个 delta token；再由一个 flow-matching 动作专家以预测的转移和作为空间锚点的当前 DINO 特征为条件，生成动作块。训练规模为 2 张 H100、256 GPU 小时，参数量 0.725B。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上取得 92.8% 的平均成功率；在 LIBERO-Pro 的程序化扰动下表现出稳健的泛化能力；推理每个动作块耗时 142.1 ms，峰值显存 3.86 GB。
AI.conclusion: 将世界-动作模型的预测粒度从像素空间转移到特征空间的变化量（delta token），可在显著降低计算与内存开销的同时保持高任务成功率与泛化鲁棒性，为高效视觉前瞻式机器人操作策略提供了可行路径。

title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出对称双臂专家（DAE）架构，基于共享VLM主干与解耦的双臂专家塔，通过两阶段意图路由与任务进度预测模块，缓解双臂交叉干扰并提升协作任务执行效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型缺乏显式机制来解耦双臂各自的状态与意图，导致非预期的交叉臂干扰，降低任务执行成功率。
AI.method: 1）在共享VLM主干上构建对称的双臂专家架构，各臂使用独立的专家塔；2）设计两阶段双臂意图路由：第一阶段依据显式语言指令路由专家，第二阶段依据隐式视觉语义路由；3）引入轻量任务进度预测模块，通过交叉注意力建模预分块时序特征与本体感觉、视觉观测语义表示之间的关系，逐帧估计任务完成进度，用于多机器人协作的进度同步与协同调度。
AI.result: 实验验证了模型在双臂意图路由与交叉臂干扰解耦方面的有效性；并初步发现单臂与双臂任务之间出现了技能泛化（双向）以及跨臂运动域技能迁移现象。
AI.conclusion: 对称双臂专家架构结合显式意图路由与任务进度预测，可有效缓解双臂交叉干扰并支持协作调度，同时展现出跨任务与跨臂的技能泛化潜力。

title: Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation
summary: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出以物体为中心的情境感知操作框架，通过触觉探索学习任务无关的物体表征，并将表征作为语义上下文引导操作策略，显著提升视觉模糊物体的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 物体的材质、容器内容物、软硬度等隐式属性难以从视觉直接推断，需借助触觉感知与探索性交互获取。但触觉信号瞬态且稀疏，如何提取有效触觉事件并融入机器人操作仍是难题。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：1）token learner 从长时程探索中自主选取具代表性的触觉片段；2）通过与描述性文本嵌入的对比对齐，构建能捕捉多种物理属性的隐空间表征；3）将学习到的表征作为语义上下文，引导以物体为中心的操作策略，依据物体属性自适应调整策略。
AI.result: 属性估计在已见与未见物体上分别达 93% 和 84% 准确率。在多物体重排、倒液、开箱三个涉及视觉模糊物体的任务上，相较无物体上下文条件的基线策略，任务成功率在已见物体上从 41% 提升至 92%，在未见物体上从 19% 提升至 67%。
AI.conclusion: 通过触觉探索学习任务无关的物体表征并作为语义上下文，可有效提升目标选择与依赖属性的操作自适应能力，显著改善视觉模糊场景下机器人操作的整体成功率与泛化性。

title: SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation
summary: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.

AI.tldr: SurgFlow 从立体手术视频中学习与本体无关的3D物体中心接触流，无需动作标签即可驱动手术机器人完成抓取、释放与操作，在 dVRK 上37/39阶段评估成功，并实现零样本跨本体迁移。
AI.motivation: 配对视频-动作数据稀缺（机器人仅承担约1%手术），而纯视频数据丰富；已有3D物体流虽可利用视频且与本体无关，但只规定物体应如何运动，未指明工具应在何处、何时接触，而这一区分在手术中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 SurgFlow 框架，从立体手术视频中无动作标签地学习3D物体中心接触流：对每个物体点预测未来3D轨迹与接触分数；通过3D跟踪和工具-物体邻近度提取目标；训练 flow matching 生成器进行预测；以预测接触触发抓取与释放，并由流优化末端执行器运动。
AI.result: 在 da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) 上，SurgFlow 在组织牵拉、双臂显露、拾针与交接四类任务共39个阶段评估中成功37次，优于使用同等数据（含或不含动作标签）训练的基线；零样本迁移至人形腹腔镜机器人，在相似与新颖相机视角下平均成功率分别为85%和70%。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模3D物体流与接触预测，可在无动作标签条件下从手术视频中学习可执行的手术操作策略，并具备跨机器人本体的零样本泛化能力。

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate.
  We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

AI.tldr: ActionGround 是一个免训练、神经符号的运行时包裹层，在不访问 VLA 权重的前提下为冻结的 VLA 策略引入相位感知的规则修正与惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日动力学项，在 LIBERO-Spatial 任务上提升成功率、稳定性与轨迹效率，并增强抗噪鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接将视觉观测与语言指令映射为机器人动作，但既未显式建模操作任务的相位结构，也未显式表征执行过程中的刚体动力学，导致动作缺乏阶段一致性与物理一致性。作者希望在无需重训练、微调或访问权重的情况下弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 提出 ActionGround：一个神经符号、免训练的运行时层，包裹冻结的 VLA 策略，每控制步开销低于 1 ms。其包含两个并行组件：(1) 符号化相位感知有限状态机，识别 approach、grasp、transport、place 四个操作相位并施加相位特定的规则修正；(2) 常开的惯性加权 Euler-Lagrange 项，将机器人运动方程引入每个控制步，其动力学残差仅作为一致性诊断记录，而非用作门控。参数在所有任务与骨干网络间固定。
AI.result: 在 7-DoF Franka Panda 上，针对 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA、Generalist-VLA 四个骨干，在十个 LIBERO-Spatial 抓放任务中：成功率最高提升 6 个百分点，稳定性最高提升 19.3 个百分点，轨迹效率最高提升 15%。在 Robosuite 噪声扫描中，注入动作噪声下轨迹抖动鲁棒性约提升 10 倍。在与真实 Agilex Piper 试验匹配种子的 Robosuite 仿真中，基线成功率由 35% 提升至 95%。
AI.conclusion: ActionGround 以极低开销、免训练的方式有效增强多种 VLA 策略的相位结构与动力学一致性，显著提升抓放任务的成功率、稳定性、轨迹效率与抗噪鲁棒性。局限在于仅评估刚性物体抓放操作；真机实验仅为定性部署演示，逐试次定量成功率留待未来工作。

title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
summary: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PORTER，将 3DSG 的“持久性”与“驻留性”解耦：轻量锚点常驻边缘机器人内存，重型对象负载在边缘与云之间迁移；通过 Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE) 度量卸载带来的需求覆盖损失，并按“单位字节边际 ISE 最小”策略构建预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.motivation: 现有任务驱动、即时（just-in-time）3DSG 方法仅构建或激活与当前任务相关的信息，从而压缩单任务表示，但稀疏的按任务工作集无法约束机器人全生命周期的板载内存占用。任务切换与场景扩展过程中，早期任务累积的负载对当前任务可能无关，却可能在未来任务中复用；全部保留会导致本地内存持续增长，全部丢弃又会造成后续重复构建的高昂代价。
AI.method: PORTER 将持久性与驻留性解耦：轻量 anchors 保留在边缘机器人的有限内存中，重型 object payloads 在边缘与云之间迁移。由于“相关性”不足以决定驻留（多个相关负载可能提供冗余信息），方法将每个任务分解为功能需求，并提出 ISE 指标：衡量卸载造成的需求覆盖损失，对可替换支撑进行折价，并在某需求剩余覆盖较弱时对损失施加更强惩罚。基于此，PORTER 反复卸载“单位字节边际 ISE 最小”的负载，构造预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.result: 在 JITOMA-Bench 上对四种 3DSG 构建器进行评估。在渐进压缩设置下，当负载字节卸载比例达到 91% 时，池化相对 mR@3 仍保持 100%。
AI.conclusion: 相关性驱动的驻留决策不足以保证长期内存有界；以需求覆盖损失（ISE）为准则的负载迁移可在显著降低本地负载字节占用的同时维持任务性能，实现边缘内存约束下 3DSG 负载的可持续管理。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-WAM，一种面向 World Action Models 的 4-bit 权重-激活训练后量化方法，通过 Action Observability Gramian 与 Action-Subspace Protection 在保持动作生成精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过迭代扩散联合生成视频与机器人动作，在机器人操作任务中表现优异，但其计算与内存开销过高，难以部署。现有 PTQ 方法（如 smoothing、rotation）无法维持动作生成的精度，因此需要针对 WAM 特点设计新的量化方案。
AI.method: 提出 Q-WAM 的 4-bit 权重-激活量化框架。核心包括：1) Action Observability Gramian (AOG)，用于度量某层输入通道加权组合的舍入误差经过全部去噪步骤后对最终动作的影响；2) Action-Subspace Protection (ASP)，将少数最动作敏感通道组合保留在 16-bit 低秩分支，其余权重与激活量化为 4-bit，二者均以稠密矩阵乘法实现以适配 GPU；3) 通过聚合各专家层中 AOG 导出的动作质量，识别对生成动作最关键的专家，仅对这些专家应用 ASP。
AI.result: 在三个 WAM 上进行了仿真与真实部署评估。在 RoboTwin 2.0 基准上达到 89.6–93.0% 平均成功率，与 16-bit 模型差距仅 1.1 个百分点，量化模块内存减少 3.1–3.4 倍；优于最强基线 SVDQuant 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人与双臂 UR3 机器人上，相比 SVDQuant 成功率提升 12.8–17.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q-WAM 通过动作敏感度驱动的量化保护机制，在保持动作生成质量的前提下实现了高效的 4-bit 权重-激活量化，验证了其在仿真与真实机器人部署中的有效性。

title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AquaWAM——首个面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型，通过建模紧凑导航状态与被动动力学（而非高维视觉观测）来预测动作后果，在USIM基准20项任务上取得72.6%成功率，决策速度比U0快2.7倍，且在部分传感器缺失时仍保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）对具身智能日益重要，可让机器人在与物理环境交互前预判候选动作的后果。但水下机器人常受被动动力学影响，如惯性、浮力、水动力阻力与持续漂移，这些效应在动作结束后仍持续作用。现有WAMs主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，未显式建模此类被动运动动力学，因此难以适用于水下场景。
AI.method: 提出AquaWAM，首个为水下具身智能体设计的世界动作模型。它不预测未来图像，而是同时建模动作条件动力学与被动物理动力学，包括推进器死区、持续超出指令时长的惯性滑行以及环境水流。感知方面依赖DVL、IMU、压力传感器与关节编码器，相机仅提供理解目标与目标位姿所需的语义信息。通过建模紧凑的导航状态而非高维视觉观测，显著降低模型规模与计算开销。
AI.result: 在USIM基准的20项水下任务中，AquaWAM取得72.6%的任务成功率，优于现有方法；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上动作决策速度比U0快2.7倍。模型在部分机载传感器测量缺失时依然有效：在缺少DVL速度测量时，成功率仍达61.6%，而U0仅为39.4%。
AI.conclusion: AquaWAM表明，面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型应显式建模被动物理动力学并采用紧凑导航状态表示，这样可在提升任务成功率与决策效率的同时降低计算成本，并对传感器缺失具备鲁棒性，为水下机器人前瞻性动作决策提供了新范式。

title: CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets
summary: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/

AI.tldr: 提出CompliantWBC，一套面向重型人形机器人的全身柔顺控制框架，使机器人能在任意部位受扰时保持柔顺并调动下肢参与，仿真与真机均验证有效。
AI.motivation: 重型人形机器人在有人类环境中的高负载作业需要全身柔顺控制。既有基于学习的力感知方法多局限于末端阻力、上半身各连杆弹簧或末端刚度调节，未解决重型平台上任意部位受扰、且需要下肢参与的问题。
AI.method: CompliantWBC含三部分：(1) 以多部位全身阻抗参考控制器（将经典笛卡尔阻抗推广到任意受控连杆）为引导，用强化学习训练基础策略以最大化柔顺保真度奖励；(2) 在冻结基础策略之上施加有界残差策略，修正由梯度屏障后协同训练的力编码器给出的粗略但结构化的力旋量估计，从而调整各连杆阻抗平衡点；(3) 采用Phong加权力作用点采样器与轴解耦骨盆锚点，通过两个可解释参数实现包含下肢的柔顺课程训练。
AI.result: 仿真中与柔顺及刚性基线对比，柔顺保真度最佳，偏离解析解仅2.58cm；在真实重型人形机器人上完成静态/动态力响应、擦板、负重深蹲与协同搬运载荷等任务。
AI.conclusion: CompliantWBC填补了重型人形机器人任意部位受扰、下肢参与的全身柔顺控制空白，柔顺精度高且可迁移到真机多类任务。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialHumanoid，一种面向人形机器人的单步协同语音动作生成系统，可实现情感可控、实时连续的全身体态生成与物理执行，并发布 AffectMoCap 数据集。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人需具备与语音同步、富有情感且可实时执行的身体行为；但现有协同语音方法主要面向数字人，缺乏对情感控制与低延迟连续生成的联合支持，且难以在物理实体上落地。
AI.method: 给定响应语音与指定情感条件，系统在单次前向传播中生成每个全身动作窗口，并通过动作历史条件连接相邻窗口；生成的类人动作在线转换为与机器人本体兼容的参考轨迹，由全身控制器跟踪实现物理执行。同时构建 AffectMoCap 数据集（两名专业演员、4 小时，含同步语音、身体动作、精细手部动作与情感标注），为情感性身体表达提供显式监督。
AI.result: 在 BEAT2 上取得对比方法中最优 FGD，语音-动作同步性具竞争力，推理速度约为 GestureLSM 的 6 倍（同一协议下）；感知评估表明 AffectMoCap 训练提升了生成动作的情感识别效果；真机实验验证了连续情感条件化行为与稳定的长时程执行。
AI.conclusion: SocialHumanoid 通过单步协同语音动作生成与 AffectMoCap 数据监督，弥补了数字人方法在情感控制与低延迟物理执行上的不足，实现了人形机器人情感化、实时、长时程的身体行为生成。

title: Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
summary: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HumanoidCSL-20K——一个包含20,648条句级中国手语序列的数据集与基准，每条序列含源视频、修复后人体运动、直接机器人参考与几何修复后机器人参考四个对齐版本，用于追踪从视频到人形机器人轨迹的完整转换链路。
AI.motivation: 手语数据采集成本高、遥操作扩展性差，因此需要复用大规模视频语料。但将视频中的人体运动转换为人形机器人轨迹时，拟合、人体运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复和控制等环节产生的误差难以仅凭最终轨迹区分，亟需可追溯的中间表示与配套评测。
AI.method: 构建 HumanoidCSL-20K 数据集与基准，每条句级手语序列提供四个对齐版本（源、修复后人体运动、直接机器人参考、几何修复后机器人参考）；采用观测支持的局部人体运动修复、全机器人几何修复以及跨表示来源追踪，使每次变换可溯源；设计配对评测，分别衡量人体运动的连续性与内容保真、机器人参考的可行性以及物理执行效果；提出手语专用运动学参考协议，在完整规划运动上对手型、位置、掌向和双手关系进行评分。
AI.result: 全语料结果显示，修复后手臂/手部异常步态减少，双手之间及手与身体的穿模现象减少。控制实验将参考可学习性与课程学习效应分离，而各分量得分揭示出仍存在的执行误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过四版本对齐与跨表示溯源，该工作将视频到人形机器人手语轨迹生成中的多环节误差解耦并可单独评测，为手语机器人化提供了可复用的数据与基准，同时表明执行环节仍有待改进。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出递归式执行框架蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation），将强智能体的干预经验蒸馏为可复用的"操作手册（playbook）"，并通过轻量智能体的执行反馈递归精炼，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下提升VLA模型的真实与仿真操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需适应多变任务与环境。VLA模型虽具备广泛操作能力，但在需要诊断失败并调整行为时表现不佳。强智能体可通过与这些策略交互发现有效干预手段，但此类干预经验缺乏跨任务、跨智能体的积累与复用机制。
AI.method: 递归式执行框架蒸馏方法：强智能体先将其干预经验蒸馏为面向轻量智能体的playbook，再利用轻量智能体的执行反馈对该playbook进行递归式精炼，最终使智能体在新任务实例中复用积累的干预知识，且无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 真实世界操作中，该框架将成功率从37.3%提升至64.0%；在SimplerEnv Bridge上，配备playbook的轻量智能体成功率达66.7%，优于仅用GR00T的基线41.7%，并超过无playbook的强智能体；同一playbook亦使强智能体提升至79.2%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了机器人领域执行框架蒸馏的可行性：干预经验可被积累、经执行过程精炼，并在智能体间复用，从而提升操作性能。

title: Large Language Models for Model-Based Robot Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can contribute useful engineering knowledge to robot design, but directly generated designs may rely on implicit assumptions and provide no guarantees of feasibility or optimality. These assumptions are critical because different reasonable modeling choices can materially change which designs are predicted to be feasible or optimal. We therefore present a framework that uses LLMs to construct explicit engineering models containing physical relationships, compatibility constraints, and objectives, allowing these modeling choices to be inspected and revised before formal optimization. The model can then be updated with additional engineering, manufacturer, or system-specific information before formal multi-objective optimization provides feasibility and Pareto-optimality guarantees with respect to the finalized model and specified design space. We evaluate the framework on quadcopter and line-following robot component-selection problems. Across 30 direct LLM design trials, none could be verified as feasible under the corresponding finalized model. Comparisons with an independently developed expert model and successive stages of model refinement further showed that changes in modeling assumptions substantially altered the predicted feasible and Pareto-optimal design sets. Together, these results show that using LLMs to construct explicit engineering models makes the underlying design choices available for inspection and revision before those assumptions determine the optimized designs. Explicit modeling therefore provides an interface for combining LLM-generated engineering knowledge, system-specific information, and formal design optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用LLM构建显式工程模型的框架，将物理关系、兼容性约束和目标显式化以便审查与修订，再进行多目标优化以获得可行性与Pareto最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 直接由LLM生成的机器人设计方案依赖隐含假设，无法保证可行性或最优性；而不同合理的建模选择会实质改变被预测为可行或最优的设计，因此需要让建模假设可被检查与修正。
AI.method: 用LLM构建包含物理关系、兼容性约束与目标的显式工程模型；在正式优化前允许检查与修订建模选择，并可补充工程、制造商或系统特定信息；随后进行正式多目标优化，给出相对于最终模型与指定设计空间的可行性与Pareto最优性保证。在四旋翼与循线机器人部件选择问题上评估。应用。
AI.result: 30次直接LLM设计试验中，没有一次能在对应最终模型下被验证为可行；与独立开发的专家模型及模型逐步细化阶段的对比显示，建模假设的变化会显著改变预测的可行设计与Pareto最优设计集合。
AI.conclusion: 用LLM构建显式工程模型，可使底层设计选择在决定优化设计之前被检查和修订；显式建模为整合LLM工程知识、系统特定信息与正式设计优化提供了接口。

title: VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation
summary: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIDEAS数据蒸馏框架，将视频中的连续物理动态转化为显式动作语义，并据此训练出基于语言的世界模型VIDEAS-WM，在具身动作语义推理上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能学习环境动态的内部表征以预测未来状态，但难以真正内化底层因果物理规律，无法显式推理动作前置条件与后续状态转移。
AI.method: VIDEAS将视觉演示解构为离散动作轨迹，利用先进视觉语言模型（VLM）提取包含动作前置条件与效果的结构化知识；引入基于文本环境的先验引导轨迹模拟机制验证知识以确保物理一致性；引入负向轨迹增强知识完整性与数据多样性以缓解认知偏差。基于AgiBot-World数据集蒸馏出34K高质量样本，训练了8B/9B参数的语言基世界模型套件VIDEAS-WM。
AI.result: VIDEAS-WM在高层具身动作语义推理上达到SOTA，展现出深刻的物理理解能力与对未见过场景的强泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将连续物理动态蒸馏为显式动作语义，可有效赋予基础模型因果物理推理能力，为构建具备动作前置条件与状态转移推理能力的语言基世界模型提供了可行路径。

title: AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid
summary: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.

AI.tldr: 提出AMBIT：用CVAE生成多样化全身招募策略，非学习选择器筛选排序验证，滚动时域带滞回提交，作为全身差分IK-QP参考，在MuJoCo与Unitree R1/G1上显著优于反应式跟踪器。
AI.motivation: 5自由度人形手臂无法单独跟踪通用双手末端轨迹，必须引入骨盆与腰部运动；但"动哪里、何时动"并不唯一，动力学有效策略构成连续流形。确定性回归器会模式平均，成功率仅35%；CVAE采样为52%，最优样本达82%，说明多样性是关键但需有效选择。
AI.method: AMBIT框架：CVAE基于指令轨迹的预览生成候选策略；非学习的选取器（selector）对候选进行过滤、排序与验证；滚动时域（receding-horizon）循环配合滞回（hysteresis）提交单一策略。提交策略作为与反应式跟踪器相同的全身差分IK-QP的参考，跟踪器保留残余误差的修正权。核心思路是保留策略多样性，使训练时未知的约束仅通过选择即可满足。
AI.result: 160个存在有效策略的留出回合、完整MuJoCo动力学与力矩控制器下，3cm/15°容差成功率85%对比跟踪器74%（置信区间不重叠）；48%回合中先招募躯干再让手臂饱和，对比35%。五项零样本偏移下均优于热启动跟踪器，并与代价高17倍的测试时重优化基线相当。Unitree G1上超参不变复现有效集结构，优势扩大至0.85对0.53。物理R1上五个选中策略执行成功，骨盆位移各异，编码器正向运动学末端跟踪中位误差11mm，验证运动学可实现性（非平衡能力）。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成+选择而非确定性回归保留策略多样性，是解决人形欠约束全身招募问题的有效途径；AMBIT在多平台、多偏移下稳健优于反应式跟踪器，并逼近昂贵重优化基线。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

AI.tldr: 在Silverline厨房电器工厂部署AI辅助协作检测单元（UR 10e机器视觉检测+Comau Racer-5功能测试，ROS 2 Humble集成），报告实际部署挑战与工程解决方案，采用四级人机交互分析框架。部署后单件质检时间由82 s降至61 s（约25%），终检资源效率由0.75升至0.88，操作员目检时间减少82%，NASA-TLX心理负荷显著下降（p = 0.005）。
AI.motivation: 装配线人工目检是持续存在的制造瓶颈：操作员在长班次中疲劳累积，导致缺陷检出率下降。论文旨在通过AI辅助协作检测单元缓解该瓶颈。
AI.method: 在AI-PRISM项目框架下，于Silverline厨房电器工厂设计、集成并现场部署协作检测单元：由搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线的Universal Robots UR 10e协作机器人执行视觉检测，Comau Racer-5协作机器人执行功能测试；通过Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器上的ROS 2 Humble进行协调；采集多模态数据（Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学、SPS电气安全测量），本地记录并用Grafana实时可视化；采用四级人机交互（HRI）分析组织集成方案。
AI.result: 报告了实际部署挑战（近距离安全、眩光与反射下AI鲁棒性、双协作机器人ROS 2命名空间冲突、操作系统与依赖问题）及相应工程解决方案。部署效果：单件质检时间从82 s降至61 s（约25%）；终检资源效率从0.75提升至0.88；操作员目检观察时间减少82%；操作员心理负荷显著降低（p = 0.005，NASA-TLX）。
AI.conclusion: 该AI辅助协作检测单元可有效缩短质检周期、提升终检资源效率、大幅减少人工目检时间并降低操作员心理负荷，验证了多模态协作机器人在装配线质检场景中的工程可行性与人因收益。

title: A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization
summary: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于机器人关节的小型盘状磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向厚度约1 cm，采用四磁力计结构抑制寄生交叉力，并通过定制磁屏蔽提升灵敏度、降低外部杂散场，扭矩测量精度达1.34 %FS（满量程50 Nm）。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域对直接扭矩感知的需求日益增长，而基于电机电流的扭矩估计在精密控制与交互场景中不够充分，因此需要一种可直接集成于机器人关节的紧凑型扭矩传感器。
AI.method: 设计盘状磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向封装尺寸约1 cm；采用四磁力计架构测量窄磁化区受应力调制后的磁场，同时抑制寄生交叉力影响；配合定制磁屏蔽结构增强扭矩灵敏度并降低外部杂散场（降低约7倍）；并完成机械设计、磁化流程与实验验证。
AI.result: 定制磁屏蔽使外部杂散场降低约7倍并提升扭矩灵敏度；在50 Nm满量程下，扭矩测量精度达到1.34 %FS。
AI.conclusion: 该传感器具备紧凑结构与高测量精度，展示了其在机器人关节直接扭矩感知应用中的潜力。

title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
summary: Current grasp diffusion models provide rich priors for generation, yet their object-centric approach can violate the kinematic and collision constraints imposed by the embodiment and the environment. Existing embodiment-aware methods primarily perform local corrections around generated grasps through gradient guidance or optimization, making it difficult to recover from fundamentally infeasible modes. We present Steer2Grasp, a training-free, embodiment-agnostic framework for inference-time grasp steering that adapts a frozen Cartesian grasp diffusion model using deployment-specific rewards. Through Feynman-Kac (FK) inspired particle reweighting and resampling, the method reallocates population mass from infeasible to high-reward grasp modes, enabling population-level mode transitions without modifying the pretrained diffusion model or requiring differentiable constraints. The framework enables a unified treatment for single and dual arm grasping through reachability and collision aware rewards, followed by gradient free gripper level local refinement. Across diverse objects, robot embodiments, and constrained environments, our method substantially improves feasible grasp generation while maintaining proximity to the underlying grasp prior.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、embodiment无关的推理时抓取引导框架Steer2Grasp，用Feynman-Kac粒子重加权/重采样将冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型导向可行且高奖励的抓取模式，并结合无梯度夹爪级精修，在多种物体、机器人与受限环境下显著提升可行抓取生成。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取扩散模型以物体为中心生成丰富先验，但会违反机器人本体与环境施加的运动学与碰撞约束；已有embodiment-aware方法仅在生成抓取附近做梯度引导或局部优化，难以从本质上不可行的模式中恢复，且依赖可微约束。
AI.method: Steer2Grasp为免训练、embodiment-agnostic的推理时抓取引导框架，基于部署特定奖励自适应冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型。核心为Feynman-Kac启发的粒子重加权与重采样，将种群质量从不可行模式重新分配到高奖励抓取模式，实现群体级模式转移，无需修改预训练扩散模型或可微约束；通过可达性与碰撞感知奖励统一处理单臂与双臂抓取，随后进行无梯度夹爪级局部精修。
AI.result: 在多样物体、机器人本体与受限环境中，方法大幅提升可行抓取生成，同时保持与底层抓取先验接近。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时种群级引导而非局部修正，可在不重训、不依赖可微约束的前提下有效缓解扩散抓取的embodiment与环境约束违背问题，实现embodiment-agnostic且统一支持单/双臂的可行抓取生成。

title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/.

AI.tldr: FoLD: 通过显式力引导学习灵巧手操作关节物体，用补偿力场作为先验指导残差策略，实现人类演示到机器人的技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类演示迁移到灵巧机器人困难：手部形态与接触动力学差异导致重定向运动无法产生预期的物体行为。
AI.method: 从人类演示与机器人当前交互状态计算补偿力场，生成促进演示物体运动的力先验；该先验指导残差策略，将重定向手部运动适配到任务的接触需求。
AI.result: 在公开的关节物体操作基准上，跨任务与跨本体持续优于现有最优基线；并在真实灵巧机器人平台验证成功迁移。
AI.conclusion: 显式力引导可有效弥合形态与接触动力学差异，实现人类操作技能向灵巧机器人的迁移。

title: SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Project page and demonstration videos: https://haoxuanxu1024.github.io/SLIP_VLA/
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are increasingly effective for robotic manipulation, yet most predict actions directly from current observations without explicitly modeling future scene evolution. Recent methods introduce future prediction to improve action generation, but dense future modeling often requires expensive iterative denoising, while one-step alternatives can underperform their multi-step counterparts. To reconcile efficient future modeling with strong action performance, we present SLIP-VLA, a policy learning framework that equips VLA models with a Single-Step Latent Imagination for future-aware action prediction. SLIP-VLA obtains temporally dense future latent representations with a single denoising update, and we improve the perceptual sufficiency of these representations by aligning intermediate latents with future geometric and semantic features. We further improve their control sufficiency through action-conditioned latent world modeling and inverse dynamics modeling, explicitly coupling latent transitions with robot actions. SLIP-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while its single-step latent imagination takes only 12 ms.

AI.tldr: SLIP-VLA是一个为VLA模型引入单步潜在想象的策略学习框架，通过一次去噪更新获得时间稠密的未来潜在表征，并借助几何语义对齐与动作条件世界建模提升其感知与控制充分性，在仿真与真实任务上取得SOTA，单步想象仅需12 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA多直接从当前观测预测动作，缺乏对未来场景演化的显式建模。近期引入未来预测的方法中，稠密未来建模依赖昂贵的迭代去噪，而单步替代方案性能又常弱于多步方法。因此需要同时兼顾高效未来建模与强动作性能。
AI.method: 提出SLIP-VLA策略学习框架，为VLA配备单步潜在想象（Single-Step Latent Imagination）以实现未来感知的动作预测。仅用一次去噪更新获得时间稠密的未来潜在表征；通过将中间潜在与未来几何、语义特征对齐提升感知充分性；通过动作条件潜在世界建模与逆向动力学建模，显式耦合潜在转移与机器人动作，提升控制充分性。
AI.result: 在多种仿真基准与真实世界操作任务上达到SOTA性能，且单步潜在想象的耗时仅为12 ms。
AI.conclusion: SLIP-VLA表明，单步潜在想象即可实现高效且时间稠密的未来建模，并通过感知与控制两方面的充分性增强，在保持低延迟的同时取得领先的动作性能，为未来感知的VLA策略学习提供了高效方案。

title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
summary: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions.
