We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SALT（State-Affine Latent Transition），一种动作条件的状态仿射潜空间动力学模型，并通过递归多步 rollout 监督训练，使训练方式与规划时使用方式一致，从而在视觉规划任务中显著提升闭环成功率。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入世界模型通常在编码状态上做单步预测训练，但规划时会递归地把学到的转移应用到自身预测上。单步精度无法刻画预测误差在递归 rollout 中如何传播。作者希望从误差传播角度重新设计动力学模型与训练目标。
AI.method: 首先将多步 rollout 误差分解为各步引入的误差及其在后续转移中的传播。理论上证明状态仿射动力学恰是雅可比与状态无关的可微转移，从而消除非线性传播残差，使误差传播算子仅依赖动作序列。据此提出 SALT：动作同时调制状态变换与加性更新。训练时采用递归多步 rollout 监督，将每个预测潜状态反馈回转移模块。
AI.result: 在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT 的单步预测误差比匹配的 LeWM 基线高 1.48–2.19 倍，但闭环成功率平均提升 10.0 个百分点。在 OGBench-Cube 上，执行后模型预测代价急剧上升而失败的回合比例从 23.3% 降至 2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 单步预测精度并非递归规划性能的可靠指标；通过状态仿射结构消除非线性误差传播并采用与规划一致的递归多步监督，可显著改善闭环规划鲁棒性与成功率。

title: InfraVLA: Extending Vision-Language-Action Navigation with Infrastructure Cameras
summary: Many indoor environments in which robots operate, such as warehouses, offices, and hospitals, already have cameras installed. They observe parts of the building that the robot cannot see from where it stands, yet navigation policies, including recent vision-language-action (VLA) models, do not use them. We propose InfraVLA, an end-to-end method that adapts a pretrained navigation VLA to such static infrastructure views: a closed-circuit television (CCTV) encoder turns each external view into tokens of the input sequence. Because the views matter only at rare decision points, fine-tuning alone did not make the policy use them in our experiments; we therefore train in two stages, on demonstrations with upsampled counterfactual data and then on recovery data. We evaluate on two simulated warehouse tasks, finding an object named in the instruction and rerouting around blocked aisles, where the deciding information is often visible only to the infrastructure cameras. Tested in distribution, InfraVLA reached a success rate of 100% on both, against 34.0% and 73.6% for a baseline without CCTV input. On out-of-distribution test sets it reached 88.2% and 88.9%. On a real quadruped fine-tuned with under 10 minutes of demonstrations, the policy reached 83.3% against 29.2% for the on-board-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出InfraVLA，将预训练导航VLA适配到环境中已有的静态CCTV视角，通过两阶段训练使策略在关键决策点利用外部摄像头信息，显著提升仓储导航任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 仓库、办公室、医院等室内环境已安装摄像头，能观测机器人自身视野之外的区域，但现有导航策略（含近期VLA模型）均未加以利用。
AI.method: 端到端方法InfraVLA：用CCTV编码器将每个外部视角转为输入序列的token，将预训练导航VLA适配到静态基础设施视角。因外部视角仅在极少数决策点起关键作用，单纯微调无法使策略真正利用它们，故采用两阶段训练——先在带过采样反事实数据的示范上训练，再在恢复数据上训练。
AI.result: 在两个仿真仓储任务（按指令寻找指定物体、绕行被阻塞通道）中，分布内成功率均达100%，无CCTV基线分别为34.0%和73.6%；分布外测试集上为88.2%和88.9%。真实四足机器人仅用不到10分钟示范微调后达83.3%，仅机载视角基线为29.2%。
AI.conclusion: 利用环境中已有的CCTV静态视角可有效扩展机器人导航的感知范围，两阶段训练（反事实过采样+恢复数据）对促使策略在稀疏决策点使用外部视角至关重要。

title: Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0.

AI.tldr: 提出无需专家示范的奖励学习范式，从稀疏任务结果与策略经验中直接学习稠密奖励，并通过RLER闭环框架随策略演化自适应更新奖励，在LIBERO和真实操作任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能让通用机器人策略通过试错改进，但受限于稀疏任务奖励。现有通用奖励模型依赖专家示范学习任务进度，会与策略优化中遇到的混合质量（次优与失败）轨迹产生分布不匹配，导致其估计在策略需要学习的次优和失败行为上不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明任务终止结果隐式定义了中间时间步的稠密成功概率反馈，可经自举递归学习。2) 提出eVTA0：通过时序差分式自举，从混合质量策略轨迹中学习成功概率，无需专家示范或中间标注。3) 提出RLER（基于演化奖励的强化学习）闭环框架，利用策略演化过程中新采集的轨迹自适应更新eVTA0。
AI.result: eVTA0相比最先进奖励模型提供更具信息量的奖励，在相同RL训练预算下于所有LIBERO任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率较初始策略提升5.4%–13.8%。真实世界操作中，RLER将总体成功率进一步提升20%–26%，分布外条件下增益达35%–36%。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了无需示范的奖励学习以及随策略演化自适应调整奖励的有效性，为稀疏奖励下的机器人强化学习提供了新范式。

title: Observability-Informed Optimal Sensor Placement for Soft Robots
comment: Published in IEEE Robosoft 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
summary: This paper presents the application and experimental evaluation of a systematic method for optimal sensor placement in soft robots. Existing methods either lack generalizability across different soft robot morphologies or do not account for system dynamics. The applied method uses convex optimization to find the optimal sensor configuration that maximizes an observability Gramian-based metric. The framework is experimentally evaluated using position and strain measurements on a soft continuum arm. Kalman filter state estimates using optimal sensor placements yield lower reconstruction error than a baseline across all sinusoidal input trials, with improvements on the order of millimeters. This case study shows that linear control theory tools can guide optimal sensor placement in soft robots, suggesting an interpretable approach to sensor placement that may extend to other morphologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实验验证了一种基于凸优化的软体机器人最优传感器布置方法，以可观测性格拉姆矩阵指标为目标函数，在软体连续臂上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有软体机器人传感器布置方法要么缺乏跨不同形态的通用性，要么未考虑系统动力学特性，因此需要一种兼顾通用性与动态特性的系统化布置方法。
AI.method: 采用凸优化求解最优传感器配置，最大化基于可观测性格拉姆矩阵（Observability Gramian）的指标；在软体连续臂上使用位置与应变测量进行实验评估，并通过卡尔曼滤波器进行状态估计以对比重构误差。
AI.result: 在所有正弦输入试验中，采用最优传感器布置的卡尔曼滤波状态估计重构误差均低于基线方法，改进量在毫米量级。
AI.conclusion: 该案例研究表明线性控制理论工具可指导软体机器人的最优传感器布置，提供了一种具有可解释性的传感器布置思路，并有望推广至其他形态。

title: MomWorld: Momentum-Aware Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution and potential risks, supporting safe and stable decisions in complex interactions. However, existing methods struggle to propagate motion trends from observed history into the future. Long rollouts based on a single latent state may further attenuate useful dynamics, retain stale motion patterns, and disrupt reliable near-term plans. We introduce MomWorld, a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon planning. MomWorld extracts scene motion trends from historical-to-current observations and propagates latent momentum into future horizons, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states. A learnable momentum persistence mechanism preserves stable trends, scene-conditioned momentum updates adapt future dynamics, and a scene-adaptive reset gate suppresses stale momentum under abrupt changes. We further propose MoFlow, a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module that refines a base trajectory to align with the predicted future scene evolution in only a few integration steps, with a horizon-aware residual fusion that preserves near-term planning stability while permitting stronger long-range corrections. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM, nuScenes and Bench2Drive demonstrate that MomWorld improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 12.2% relative to MomAD over a 6-second planning horizon.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MomWorld，一种动量感知的隐式世界模型，用于自动驾驶长时程规划，通过传播潜在动量并联合预测未来构型与动量状态，配合动量条件流匹配模块MoFlow，在NAVSIM、nuScenes和Bench2Drive上提升长时程规划一致性并将碰撞率相对MomAD降低12.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶规划方法难以将观测历史中的运动趋势外推到未来；基于单一隐状态的长滚动会导致有用动态衰减、保留过时运动模式并破坏可靠的近期规划。
AI.method: MomWorld从历史到当前观测中提取场景运动趋势，并将潜在动量传播到未来时域，联合预测未来构型与动量状态。核心机制包括：可学习的动量持续性机制以保持稳定趋势、场景条件动量更新以适配未来动态、场景自适应重置门以在突变下抑制过时动量。此外提出MoFlow——动量条件流匹配模块，仅需少量积分步即可将基础轨迹细化为与预测未来场景演化对齐，并通过时域感知残差融合在保留近期规划稳定性的同时允许更强的长程修正。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM、nuScenes和Bench2Drive上的大量实验表明，MomWorld提升了长时程规划一致性，并在6秒规划时域内将平均碰撞率相对MomAD降低12.2%。
AI.conclusion: 动量感知的隐式世界模型与动量条件流匹配相结合，可有效缓解长时程规划中动态衰减与过时模式问题，在保持近期规划稳定性的同时增强长程规划能力。

title: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple predictive visual modeling with action generation, typically relying on iterative denoising with a fixed denoising steps. However, manipulation tasks contain actions chunks with varying sensitivity to generation errors: critical actions require precision, while less sensitive actions allow faster generation with fewer denoising steps. Here we introduce AnyStep World Action Model, a general framework for tunable-budget prediction and scene-dependent computation allocation. Our budget-aligned teacher-trajectory distillation trains interval-conditioned flow maps using explicit frozen-teacher transitions and shared low-rank adapters, supporting action generation from one-step prediction to multi-step refinement. Building on this capability, a lightweight risk-benefit scheduler predicts teacher-curvature-based difficulty and budget-specific student-teacher fidelity from a single one-step preview, selecting the smallest budget predicted to satisfy risk-adaptive fidelity requirements. We evaluate our framework on three widely used WAMs Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA using RoboTwin 2.0. Our method reduces average denoising steps by 60.2%, 49.8%, and 85.28%, respectively, while maintaining baseline task success rates. In particular, our AnyStep training substantially improves model performance under a one-step denoising budget, increasing task success rates by 7.07%, 12.08%, and 8.94% on Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA, respectively. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks further validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyStep World Action Model框架，通过区间条件流映射蒸馏与轻量调度器实现可变预算动作生成，在降低去噪步数的同时保持成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有world-action模型依赖固定去噪步数的迭代去噪，但操作任务中动作块对生成误差的敏感度不同：关键动作需精细生成，非敏感动作可用更少步数快速生成，固定步数导致计算浪费。
AI.method: 1）预算对齐的教师轨迹蒸馏：利用显式冻结教师转移与共享低秩适配器，训练区间条件流映射，支持从单步预测到多步细化的动作生成；2）轻量风险-收益调度器：从单次一步预览中预测基于教师曲率的难度和预算相关的学生-教师保真度，选择满足风险自适应保真度要求的最小预算。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上评估Motus、FastWAM、LingBotVA三个WAM，平均去噪步数分别减少60.2%、49.8%、85.28%，且保持基线任务成功率；单步去噪预算下任务成功率分别提升7.07%、12.08%、8.94%；六个真实操作任务进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了可调预算预测与场景依赖的计算分配，在保证任务成功率的同时显著降低推理去噪开销，并提升极端低预算下的性能。

title: Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative robot policies provide expressive behavior priors, but updating a large diffusion or flow-matching model through online interaction is costly. Latent-space reinforcement learning avoids updating the pretrained generator by controlling its initial sampling noise, yet high-dimensional noise can have strongly anisotropic effects on decoded actions. We introduce Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a forward-query interface that constructs a fixed low-dimensional control basis from finite-difference decoder responses. Soft Actor-Critic controls the leading response directions, while the orthogonal complement is independently resampled from the Gaussian prior at each query. On three RoboMimic tasks with diffusion and flow-matching policies, response spectra reveal substantial concentration. Across five matched task-generator pairs, the training curves indicate that PSS generally converges faster and exhibits more stable late-training behavior than full-latent control, while achieving stronger final performance overall. Controlled Diffusion-Square ablations further show that leading-response directions outperform random and least-responsive subspaces of equal dimension. We further integrate PSS with a frozen, closed-source 3B-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policy in a humanoid learning system with synchronous transition collection, reset-time optimization, and latency-aware asynchronous deployment. In an exploratory screwdriver-placement evaluation, success is observed in 2/10 trials for the frozen VLA policy and 6/10 after SAC+PSS adaptation. These results support decoder-response geometry as a practical basis for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出主导向子空间（PSS）：以有限差分解码器响应构建低维控制基，用SAC控制主导响应方向，正交补每步从高斯先验重采样，实现冻结生成式机器人策略的在线适配，收敛更快、更稳、最终性能更强。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略（扩散/流匹配）提供强行为先验，但在线交互更新大模型代价高昂；潜空间强化学习通过控制初始采样噪声避免更新生成器，然而高维噪声对解码动作的影响呈强各向异性，直接全潜空间控制效率低、不稳定。
AI.method: PSS是一种前向查询接口：由有限差分解码器响应构造固定的低维控制基。SAC仅控制响应最强的若干主导方向；其余正交补方向在每个查询时刻独立地从高斯先验重采样。在三个RoboMimic任务、扩散与流匹配策略上验证响应谱集中性；用Controlled Diffusion-Square消融对比同等维度的随机子空间与最低响应子空间；并与冻结的3B参数闭源VLA策略集成于人形学习系统（同步过渡采集、重置时优化、时延感知异步部署）。
AI.result: 响应谱显示显著集中。五组匹配的任务-生成器配对中，PSS相较全潜空间控制通常收敛更快、后期训练更稳定，整体最终性能更强。消融表明主导响应方向优于同维度的随机与最低响应子空间。在探索性螺丝刀放置评估中，冻结VLA成功率2/10，经SAC+PSS适配后提升至6/10。
AI.conclusion: 解码器响应几何可作为冻结生成式机器人策略在线适配的实用控制基，为大规模预训练策略的低成本在线改进提供可行路径。

title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 28 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Project website: https://codeactionbench.org
summary: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CodeActionBench，一个包含 25 项操作任务的基准，通过智能体式 Code-as-Policy 评估通用多模态模型将视觉理解与推理转化为具身操作的能力，成功率为 2.7%–73.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态模型具备视觉理解与推理能力，但其能否将该能力转化为可执行的具身操作尚缺乏受控、可比较的评估手段，因此需要构建一个无任务特定微调、无特权状态、无预定义策略的基准来测量这种转化能力及其典型失败模式。
AI.method: CodeActionBench 包含 25 项操作任务，采用智能体式 Code-as-Policy 范式：在不使用任务特定微调、演示、外部专用感知或抓取模块、特权场景状态及预定义任务策略的前提下，智能体需自主选择视觉证据、构建任务相关的三维估计、生成操作目标，并迭代执行与修正策略。系统提供共享机器人 API（RGB 观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈与有界运动），配合固定任务实例、资源预算与隐藏的物理结果验证器，实现跨模型与不同框架配置的受控对比。
AI.result: 在九种配置、675 次尝试的广泛评估中，成功率从 2.7% 到 73.3% 不等。最优配置 GPT-6 Astra 搭配 Codex CLI 在三次尝试内至少成功完成 25 项任务中的 22 项，表现最佳但仍留有显著提升空间。轨迹分析揭示了空间对齐、目标保持与完成判定方面的困难，包括运动已成功执行却判定任务失败的情况。
AI.conclusion: CodeActionBench 提供了一个受控测试平台，用于衡量通用模型将其能力转化为操作行为的程度，并考察该过程中的典型失败场景。

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
summary: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出将世界-动作模型(WAM)的视觉预测作为目标条件视觉提案，通过跨模型预测一致性反馈并利用流策略优化(FPO)优化动作头，在四个真实UR5操作任务上将平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%。
AI.motivation: WAM虽能联合预测未来视觉观测与机器人动作，但其视觉预测与生成动作所蕴含的后果之间存在不一致：模型常能先给出视觉上合理的任务完成结果，却无法产生可靠达成该结果的动作序列。因此需要利用这种跨模型预测差异作为改进策略的反馈信号，同时避免在线机器人交互和额外训练任务特定奖励模型。
AI.method: 将WAM生成的视觉预测视为目标条件视觉提案而非可直接执行的计划；使用一个冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作条件后果，并基于两次未来预测之间的一致性以及与终端目标的对齐程度构建反馈信号；据此采用流策略优化(FPO)优化WAM的动作头。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界UR5操作任务上，该方法将平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%，而π_{0.5}为61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的操作任务下，跨模型预测差异能够为改进机器人策略提供有效反馈。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DeltaSeek——面向动态建筑环境的主动感知初步框架，聚焦"机器人感知形态如何约束其可获取的观测"这一前提问题，并在 IFC 基准上对比底盘与腕部 RGB-D 配置。
AI.motivation: 建筑环境持续演变，产生大范围几何变化，导致静态建图与配准性能下降，因此需要主动感知——由机器人主动选择传感配置以解析环境当前状态。本文针对其中一项关键前提：机器人的感知形态（embodiment）如何限制其可获得的观测集合。
AI.method: 形式化定义感知形态的"许可观测集"（permissible observation set）；在由 IFC 派生的基准上，使用配备 UR5e 的 Husky A300 机器人，比较底盘安装与腕部安装两种 RGB-D 配置，以几何可见性对观测打分、以可行驶距离度量代价；在含八处受控变化（覆盖四种可观测性条件）的房间尺度场景中进行穷举评估，共 240 个可行基座位姿与 5 种手臂姿态。
AI.result: 两处变化在任何底盘视角下均不可观测，而腕部相机可同时解析这两处；对两者均可观测的变化，腕部相机的中位基座行程为 6.0 m，底盘相机为 15.2 m。
AI.conclusion: 结果将"感知能力限制"与"观测获取代价"区分开来，从而明确一个观测究竟是本质上不可行，还是仅需更多移动即可完成。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 Robot-GST，一个几何感知的时空行为表示与评估框架，通过 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 构建 Gaussian-SAM 机器人环境，实现"先仿真评估、后执行"的实到虚策略验证，从而提升长时程操作的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的端到端操作策略缺乏对任务结果与动作能否达成目标状态的显式预测与评估机制，导致长时程操作中误差不断累积、部署可靠性不足。
AI.method: 从 RGB-D 观测出发，利用 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 构建高保真机器人环境；结合视觉观测与语言指令，借助大视觉语言模型进行时空推理与长时程任务规划；引入几何采样与基于状态的轨迹规划实现高斯感知的终态估计；执行前在 Gaussian-SAM 环境中对候选动作序列进行仿真与评估，过滤不可行行为。
AI.result: 在刚性、柔性及可变形物体的代表性任务（方块放置、玩具打包、鸭子重排）上验证，表明几何感知的时空推理与状态感知执行可提升不同物体类别下的操作可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将几何感知重建与高质量渲染仿真相结合，为评估机器人操作行为提供了一种可扩展的途径，有助于提升真实世界部署的可靠性。

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.

AI.tldr: 提出DexTaG——一种触觉引导的强化学习框架，将手套采集的人类操作数据重定向到机器人灵巧手，实现自然的接触丰富工具操作。
AI.motivation: 基于手套的动作捕捉是采集灵巧手演示数据的可扩展途径，但由于人手与机器人手之间的运动学差异，采集的人体运动无法直接在机器人上执行，尤其对于涉及手内重定向的接触丰富工具使用任务。现有工作虽通过强化学习或轨迹优化在仿真中弥合该差距，但难以保留人类接触模式，常导致非自然操作与不稳定的功能性抓取；且每条参考轨迹都需单独训练策略或求解优化，效率低下。
AI.method: DexTaG在训练过程中利用手套采集的触觉信号引导策略搜索，使其趋向测量到的人类接触模式，从而减少对精确参考几何进行接触监督的依赖。为提升效率，针对同一对象的所有训练轨迹联合训练一个可泛化的重定向器，并将其蒸馏为以目标物体轨迹为条件的无触觉学生控制器，用于真实世界部署。
AI.result: 在马克笔和锤子操作任务上，DexTaG学到了自然的、接触丰富的行为，而基于距离接触启发式的基线方法无法学到；方法可泛化到同一对象与任务的留出轨迹，并在OakInk2上优于单轨迹基线。
AI.conclusion: 触觉引导的强化学习结合联合训练的通用重定向器与无触觉学生控制器，可有效将手套采集的人类灵巧操作技能迁移至机器人，兼顾接触模式保真度、训练效率与真实部署可行性。

title: Residual Learning-Based Control of Vehicle Platoons with $\ell_2$ Stability Guarantees via Recurrent Equilibrium Networks
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: This paper proposes a residual learning-based control framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons subject to parametric uncertainty and external disturbances. A nominal controller designed via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), along with disturbance-observer compensation, is enhanced by a Recurrent Equilibrium Network (REN) trained offline using stored trajectories and nominal-model prediction errors. The REN is constrained to satisfy a prescribed $\ell_2$-gain bound, enabling sufficient small-gain conditions for local closed-loop stability and disturbance string stability. Experiments demonstrate reduced spacing and velocity errors relative to the nominal controller.

AI.tldr: 提出基于残差学习的异构车队控制框架：LMI标称控制器+扰动观测器补偿，叠加离线训练且带L2增益约束的REN，实现局部闭环稳定与扰动弦稳定，实验降低间距与速度误差。
AI.motivation: 异构车队面临参数不确定性与外部扰动，单一标称控制难以兼顾鲁棒性与性能；需在保证稳定性理论可证的前提下提升控制精度。
AI.method: 以LMI设计的标称控制器结合扰动观测器补偿为基线；用存储轨迹与标称模型预测误差离线训练循环均衡网络（REN）作残差项，并约束其满足给定ℓ2增益界，从而构造小增益条件证明局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定。
AI.result: 实验显示相比标称控制器，间距误差与速度误差均下降。
AI.conclusion: 残差学习与模型基控制结合，可在保留稳定性保证的同时改善异构车队的抗扰与跟踪性能。

title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
summary: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArticulateArena，一种用于关节化物体的表示不变性度量，通过比较单自由度关节所诱导的运动而非其参数编码来评估预测的关节结构，并证明其提出方法的度量性质，同时发布ArticulateArena-20K数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法可重建或生成仿真就绪的关节化物体，但评估预测的关节结构存在困难：关节描述的是运动而非形状，且运动之间没有公认的距离定义。现有评估协议分别对关节类型、轴方向、原点及运动范围打分，而这些参数共同描述同一物理运动，同一运动可有不同参数表示。因此，关节可能因与自身等价编码比较而得零分甚至最大错误分，且部分分量误差在预测准确时反而病态或未定义。
AI.method: 提出ArticulateArena，作为关节Chamfer距离的表示不变性对应物：比较单自由度关节所诱导的运动而非编码参数。将每个关节表示为其李代数端点旋量的无序对，并证明所得商距离为度量。统一处理固定、旋转、棱柱和螺旋关节，通过紧化将连续关节纳入同一评分；以质量分布加权时，其读数为运动部件以米为单位的RMS运动。进一步提出运动感知的树编辑距离，将度量提升到完整运动学树，以相同运动单位衡量虚假或缺失关节等结构错误；对于固定内积，其在树的重标号下仍为度量。
AI.result: 发布ArticulateArena-20K，包含19,977个具有已验证运动学的关节化物体，并在该新度量下重新评估已发表的重建方法。
AI.conclusion: ArticulateArena提供了表示不变、可解释且具备度量性质的关节评估框架，统一了多种关节类型并扩展到完整运动学树，配合大规模验证数据集，为关节化物体重建的公平评估提供了新标准。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
summary: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的几何深度估计方法，利用双目极线转移与相机位姿，将时间对应转为虚拟立体三角化，在室内外场景优于学习基线。
AI.motivation: 可靠的三维空间理解对自主导航、避障与场景重建至关重要。现有学习式深度估计在分布内精度高，但对新视角与新高度泛化能力差。
AI.method: 一种几何推导、无需训练的深度估计方法：仅用两幅单目图像与相机位姿估计，借助极线转移（epipolar transfer），利用相机运动合成基线可自由选择的虚拟立体像对，从而把时间对应问题转化为立体三角化任务，并缓解直接双视图三角化的几何退化。
AI.result: 在室外无人机飞行（最大约90 m）与室内OptiTrack环境以LiDAR为真值验证：室内AbsRel为0.092、δ<1.25为0.940，与直接三角化（AbsRel 0.073）相当，但在更多困难场景中保持有效深度；显著优于未针对该域训练或微调的ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570），且无需训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以几何方式实现训练无关的深度估计，在泛化性、困难场景有效深度覆盖与精度间取得良好平衡，可作为学习式方法在域外场景下的有力替代。

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
summary: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双时钟异步推理视角与"commitment-evidence gap"指标，据此设计的ReSync在冻结的RoboCasa测试上成功率提升4.48个百分点。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型通常在两条独立调度上分别去噪：动作流少步解码以保持控制快速，视频流多步去噪以保持预测清晰。这使两流处于不同"时钟"，可能在动作已可执行时其据以成立的未来仍大部分未解析。作者希望量化并利用这一异步性问题。
AI.method: 将上述现象形式化为"双时钟"异步推理，并引入"commitment-evidence gap"——直接从模型自身采样调度读出，而非通过搜索测量。方法ReSync根据该指标：在支持窗口内保持动作状态不变、仅推进世界（视频）流，然后恢复原生去噪。不改变参数，也不比较候选样本。
AI.result: gap具有预测性：gap扩大时，候选效用更难辨识，额外采样候选收益递减，而推进世界流收益增加，两者存在交叉点。因此在冻结的配对RoboCasa面板上，ReSync使成功率提升4.48个百分点；等算力但仅等待、不推进世界的对照无变化；同一规则无需重新调参即可迁移到第二个基准与第二个骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 额外世界计算并非越多越好，有效区间两端封闭且可在rollout前由调度读出；ReSync在此区间内分配计算，能以零参数改动、无候选比较的方式稳定提升性能并具备跨基准、跨骨干的迁移性。

title: Integrity Detection and Characterization of Malicious Injections in RAVEN II
summary:
The increasing adoption of robotic systems in surgery, together with the expanding range of procedures they can support and the growing level of autonomy they provide, has substantially increased the complexity of surgical robots. As these systems integrate more sensors, controllers, communication interfaces, and model-driven control components, their attack surface continues to expand. A compromise of the integrity of a surgical robot can therefore cause unintended robot behavior and potentially threaten patient safety.
  In this paper, we characterize the detection boundary of malicious injections on RAVEN II using a public dataset that pairs the platform's telemetry with external high-resolution encoder ground truth. We identify three injection points spanning the command and observation paths and evaluate three injection patterns with increasing temporal dispersion. To capture different detection behaviors, we perform detection at two timescales: the window scale and the session scale. Rather than reporting detection rates at an arbitrarily chosen threshold, we quantify, for each injection point and injection pattern, the smallest end-effector deviation that can be resolved while maintaining an alarm rate acceptable for surgical operation. Our results show that detectability is strongly influenced by how the injected deviation is distributed over time. An abrupt step can be detected at deviations well below the 1 mm clinical tolerance, whereas the same overall deviation spread across a window or a session can remain hidden from single-window statistics. The open source code can be found at http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity.

AI.tldr: 利用RAVEN II公开数据集刻画恶意注入的检测边界：在命令与观测路径设置三个注入点、三种时间弥散递增的注入模式，并在窗口与会话两个时间尺度上检测，量化在各条件下可分辨的最小末端执行器偏差。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人集成更多传感器、控制器、通信接口与模型驱动控制组件，攻击面持续扩大；一旦完整性被破坏可导致非预期行为并威胁患者安全，因此需要明确恶意注入的可检测边界。
AI.method: 基于RAVEN II公开数据集（平台遥测与外部高分辨率编码器真值配对）；在命令路径与观测路径上共选三个注入点；构造三种时间弥散程度递增的注入模式；分别在窗口尺度与会话尺度进行检测；不采用任意选定阈值报告检出率，而是对每个注入点与注入模式量化在满足手术可接受告警率前提下可分辨的最小末端执行器偏差。
AI.result: 可检测性强烈依赖注入偏差在时间上的分布方式：突变式阶跃在远低于1 mm临床容差的偏差下即可被检出；而将同等总偏差分散到整个窗口或会话时，可能无法被单窗口统计量发现。开源代码：http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity。
AI.conclusion: 恶意注入的可检测性由偏差的时间弥散特性主导，单窗口统计对弥散型注入存在盲区；应以临床可接受告警率约束下的最小可分辨偏差作为检测能力的量化指标。

title: FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving
summary: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FINGR策略，通过手指相对几何表示与未来交互预测监督，学习单只灵巧手连续旋转魔方，在真实手上达到99.0%单步成功率并完成整套2×2×2魔方复原。
AI.motivation: 用单只灵巧手操作魔方是持续的接触丰富控制难题：每次转层需部分手指支撑、部分手指推动并复位，协调复杂且易失手，如何学习这种手指间精细协同是核心挑战。
AI.method: FINGR（Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations）结合手指相对几何与未来交互预测。共享点编码器以每个指尖为参考表达魔方的点云并聚合，不依赖小块索引；学习到的未来token共享观测编码器，并在多个时间尺度上接受接触力变化、转层进度和手指关节位移的监督；所得表征条件化一个flow策略，直接生成手指动作。
AI.result: 真实灵巧手上300次转层尝试成功率99.0%，基线flow策略为79.7%；结合抓取与桌面辅助重抓，系统在平均约137秒内复原全部十个打乱的2×2×2魔方。
AI.conclusion: 以指尖相对几何编码与多尺度未来交互监督可有效学习灵巧手的持续接触丰富操作，显著优于纯flow基线，并能集成抓取与重抓完成完整魔方复原任务。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: Simify：免训练、测试时框架，通过大规模并行物理仿真实现显式空间推理，从单张RGB-D图像重建可仿真资产，用进化搜索优化物体摆放，真机验证复杂物体重排任务。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，支撑多物体交互的长程任务。现有基础模型在空间推理上能力有限，且缺乏准确几何信息，导致从仿真到真机迁移困难。
AI.method: 免训练、测试时框架。输入单张RGB-D场景图像，借助3D生成模型与视觉语言模型重建可仿真的资产；给定以奖励函数指定的任务（如搭建最高塔），在仿真中启动数千个并行rollout，并通过进化搜索优化物体排列，通常在数秒内收敛。
AI.result: 在真实机器人硬件上进行定量实验，端到端执行对未见物体的复杂重排任务；结果优于先前的空间推理基础模型方法，并表明完整、准确的几何对成功实现sim-to-real迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 在推理阶段有效利用大规模并行仿真可显著提升空间推理表现，且完整准确的几何重建是仿真到现实迁移成功的关键。

title: TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Wenjie Li and Binyu Yang contributed equally
summary: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.

AI.tldr: 提出被动穹顶薄膜TacGB，将切向载荷机械编码为压力图模式变化，无需电子器件或力重建，即可让端到端模仿学习策略分辨切向接触状态，在四个任务中提升成功率与接触质量。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富型策略常因不同物理状态外观相似却需不同动作而失败：相机无法判断连接器是否对准或完全就位；仅测法向力的触觉传感器又会漏掉垂直于抓取方向的切向交互，而这些交互正是区分上述状态的关键。作者由此提出核心问题：学习策略究竟需要标定过的剪切测量，还是只需一种可重复的、能区分剪切相关接触状态的观测。
AI.method: 设计TacGooseBumps（TacGB）：一种被动穹顶薄膜，贴附于现有触觉传感器之上。切向载荷使每个穹顶倾斜，从而在其足印范围内重新分配压力，把切向加载机械地编码为压力图的模式变化。端到端策略直接消费这些压力图，无需增加电子器件、无需力重建、也无需逐触觉单元（taxel）级的穹顶对齐。方法在四个模仿学习任务与两种数据采集流程中进行验证。
AI.result: 在四个模仿学习任务、两种数据采集流程下，TacGB改善了目标达成率、效率与接触质量：插入任务成功率最多提升36个百分点，且成功插入更快完成；易碎物体放置更轻柔，绘画更连续、更笔直。信号分析、分阶段分析、失效模式分析与轨迹分析表明，增益来自那些视觉与纯法向压力难以分辨任务相关切向交互的接触区间。
AI.conclusion: 剪切不必被度量式测量也能惠及机器人学习：它可以通过机械方式被编码，而无需改变底层触觉传感器，也无需改变策略的压力图输入格式。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ZeroBot是一个real2sim框架，在零人类演示、零策略预训练、零已知物体模型的条件下，仅凭单视角图像与目标位姿，数分钟内即可学会机器人操作任务，真实任务成功率达87%，平均训练仅119秒。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人操作学习依赖人类演示、策略预训练或已知物体CAD模型，成本高且难以规模化。作者希望探索在极端受限条件下（无演示、无预训练、无物体模型）能否实现快速、自主的任务学习。
AI.method: 输入仅为物体的单视角图像和目标位姿，利用image-to-3D生成模型重建完整物体网格；在仿真中用该网格进行大规模并行强化学习。为加速训练，提出一种动作空间，结合生成几何与学习到的价值函数来采样涉及机器人-物体接触的状态。
AI.result: 在抓取、推动、关节物体交互以及多阶段操作等真实任务上，ZeroBot取得87%的成功率，平均训练时间仅119秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将image-to-3D模型融入real2sim框架，可有效实现快速、自主的机器人学习。

title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
summary: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.

AI.tldr: 提出用动作一致性损失训练视觉状态估计器，仅学习感知接口复用冻结的专家策略，在五项操作任务和真实机器人上优于直接像素到动作模仿。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的操policy依赖特权状态信息，部署时需从部分观测（如噪声图像）行动。常用教师-学生蒸馏要求学生同时推断任务相关状态并重新学习专家已有的动作映射，效率低；另一路线是复用状态专家、仅学习重建缺失状态的感知接口，但最小化状态估计误差并不等价于最小化其导致的下游控制误差。
AI.method: 训练视觉状态估计器，联合使用直接状态监督与动作一致性损失；该损失通过冻结且可微的专家策略反向传播。采用调度式目标：先建立物理有意义的状态估计，再逐步强调影响专家动作的误差。
AI.result: 在五项目标条件操作任务中，保留专家（仅学感知接口）一致优于从同一专家示范语料进行直接像素到动作模仿。在物理Panda机器人上实现sim-to-real迁移，无需重新训练底层专家即达到76%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 复用并冻结特权专家、仅学习带动作一致性的感知接口，比端到端像素到动作模仿更有效，且能实现真实机器人零专家重训迁移。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Quantile Head，将回归与流匹配统一并扩展为分位数目标，单次前向即可预测有序的边际动作分位数，支持多种采样策略并联合监督训练中位数策略，在多个基准与真实机器人任务上取得最高平均成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将预训练VLM与动作头结合用于机器人控制，但常见动作头存在局限：点回归只给出动作分布的点估计，标准流匹配采样器则需要昂贵的迭代采样。作者希望同时克服这两点不足。
AI.method: 作者将回归与流匹配统一到同一目标下，并扩展推导出分位数目标。基于该目标设计Quantile Head：一次前向预测中位数及若干正间隔，构成有序的边际动作分位数。这些分位数无需重训练即可支持多种采样策略，并被联合监督以训练默认的中位数策略。作者还对联合监督做了局部分析。
AI.result: 局部分析表明，在邻近分位数已校准、间隔固定且修正速度匹配的条件下，直接中位数更新比仅中位数监督具有更低的方差。实验显示，该联合监督的中位数策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro及两个真实机器人任务上取得所比较方法中最高的平均成功率，并在匹配的LIBERO基线中拥有最短的平均回合时间。
AI.conclusion: 统一回归与流匹配的分位数目标及其Quantile Head实现，能在单次前向中提供有序分位数、支持灵活采样且无需重训练，并带来更低方差与更高的成功率与效率，代码已开源。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了现有JEPA世界模型在端到端自动驾驶中的表现，提出AD-E2E-JEPA，通过学习型投影器实现100倍推理加速，在零样本规划下保持规划性能并提升下游模仿学习效果。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要能理解物理世界、推理规划并安全运行的世界模型。现有基于JEPA的世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）存在两难：要么对驾驶准确但计算昂贵，要么计算高效但不足以支撑规划。作者希望解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: 采用目标条件下零样本规划设置，以真实未来观测作为目标、不训练任何驾驶策略，从而将世界模型质量与策略学习隔离。提出AD-E2E-JEPA，引入SIGReg正则化的可学习投影器作用于投影后的patch嵌入，将规划patch数量减少16倍、嵌入维度减少4倍。
AI.result: 实现100倍推理加速，8帧rollout在256条候选轨迹下运行0.8秒。不训练任何驾驶策略时，世界模型自身在平均20米外的目标上分别达到4.0/2.8米位移（候选轨迹词表256/8192）。NAVSIMv2上分别取得67.3/72.9 EPDMS（含乘法安全指标）和84.1/86.5 EPDMS†（不含）。自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习从80.2提升到85.4 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: AD-E2E-JEPA通过SIGReg正则化可学习投影器有效解决了JEPA世界模型准确性与效率的权衡，在零样本规划中保持性能的同时大幅加速，并能提升下游模仿学习表现。

title: Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在VLM决策前引入驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG）与SWRL推理阶段，将从检索知识中推导出的场景适用风险证据作为条件，提升视觉-语言驾驶系统的安全规划性能。
AI.motivation: RAG为视觉-语言驾驶系统提供外部安全知识，但检索到的风险规则可能"相关"却不"适用于"当前场景。VLM需自行完成物体定位、跨时间实体绑定与关系验证，风险结论的支撑过程是隐式的，由此产生"相关性—适用性"鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG），并在VLM决策前加入SWRL语义网规则推理阶段。结构化感知实例化场景事实，当规则前件被联合满足时，SWRL规则推导出事件与有向风险关系。已识别事件、绑定后的风险关系及被激活规则的语义描述构成紧凑证据，用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器。
AI.result: 在nuReasoning数据集上的配对对比中，该方法相较基于相关性检索的基线，将nuReasoning规划分数（NPS）提升1.30分，非过错碰撞分数（NC）提升2.76分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，相较于语义检索得到的风险知识，场景适用的风险证据能够改善安全加权规划性能，验证了以知识图谱与规则推理显式化风险适用性判断的有效性。

title: Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续往返式视觉语言导航（VLN），诊断出方向可观测性、偏差恢复与终止稳定性三类失败，并提出可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆系统，将去程轨迹记录为有序几何锚点并以反向查询方式复用，在50个反向配对回合中将返回成功率从22.0%提升至55.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN通常被当作单向任务评估，但实际部署的机器人到达目标后往往需要返回起点。连续往返场景下，反向导航面临方向可观测性差、偏差后难以恢复、终止判定不稳定等问题，现有方法未对此进行系统诊断与建模。
AI.method: 提出可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆（reliability-aware sparse route memory）：将去程（Outbound）已执行轨迹记录为有序几何锚点（ordered geometric anchors），在返回阶段进行反向查询，并通过三项机制实现复用——结构化提示（structured hint）、动作级仲裁（action-level arbitration）与终止验证（terminal verification）。评测基于NaVILA模型与仿真的Unitree Go2，采用50个反向配对回合。
AI.result: 仅依赖语言的Return成功率为22.0%；本文在线系统达到55.1%；在提供精确路径信息（exact route information）的条件下，相同接口可达86.0%。说明有效返回同时依赖准确的信息与对该信息一致的动作执行；在线条件下剩余的差距主要来自几何证据可靠性不足，无法授权干预。
AI.conclusion: 研究将信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性区分为长时程导航中的三个独立限制因素，表明往返VLN的性能瓶颈不仅在于信息获取，还在于可靠地据信息采取一致行动。

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

AI.tldr: RAVEL是一个异步VLA推理框架，通过滚动缓冲与解耦VLM编码，大幅降低动作生成延迟，同时保持任务能力。
AI.motivation: 基于流的VLA模型依赖昂贵的VLM编码与多步迭代动作生成，导致推理延迟高，难以在动态环境中快速响应。
AI.method: 提出RAVEL异步推理框架：让近期动作经单步去噪即执行，将部分去噪的未来动作放入滚动缓冲前推；将VLM编码与滚动动作生成解耦，动作专家持续使用最新VLM上下文，并用轻量Fast Observation Pathway（FOP）直接以当前观测条件化动作专家。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务中，RAVEL一致地显著降低响应延迟，同时保持底层VLA的任务能力，实现高频、响应式的闭环控制。
AI.conclusion: RAVEL通过同时缓解VLM主干与动作专家的计算瓶颈，实现了低延迟的机器人操作控制。

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.

AI.tldr: FailPatch：一种失败驱动的残差修补框架，通过解耦动作监督与执行可靠性监督，在冻结VLA策略的动作隐空间中引入Null门控残差专家库，仅训练0.52%参数即显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略通常用成功演示进行适配，能提供直接的动作监督，但几乎不覆盖易失效状态。部署中的失败虽暴露了这些状态，却缺乏监督学习所需的纠正动作。
AI.method: 提出FailPatch框架，将动作监督与执行可靠性监督解耦：成功演示提供"应如何行动"的监督，部署轨迹指示"行为何时不可靠"。基于动作隐表示在可靠与失效状态间具线性可分性且直接决定动作生成的观察，在冻结VLA策略的动作隐空间中引入Null门控残差专家库，并采用Preserve–Redirect–Trust统一目标：在可靠状态保留原策略，在失效状态选择残差专家，并在有界干预下将表示从失败区域重定向至成功区域。
AI.result: 仅0.52%可训练参数下，在四个长程RoboTwin任务上清洁评估成功率提升11.0个百分点；clean-to-random泛化提升9.5个百分点；三个真实世界任务较基线提升16.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦动作与可靠性监督并在动作隐空间做有界残差修补，可在极小参数开销下有效修正VLA策略的失效状态，提升成功率与泛化能力。

title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback.However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过采集人类触觉演示数据来提升机器人灵巧操作策略，提出同步触觉动作捕捉系统与UVTA数据集，并设计统一视-触-动作模型，将人类与机器人映射到对齐的触觉与动作表征，在五项真实任务上平均成功率达70%。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作需要触觉反馈，但机器人触觉演示难以规模化：灵巧手遥操作向操作者提供的触觉反馈有限。相比之下，人类演示是更具可扩展性的多样化触觉交互来源。核心假设是"手可以不同，但交互背后的物理规律不变"，因此可用人类触觉数据改进机器人操作策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建触觉动作捕捉系统，同步记录图像、触觉信号与手部运动；2) 基于该系统构建UVTA数据集，覆盖5类富接触任务，含1000个人类演示（交互模式多样）与每任务150个机器人演示；3) 提出统一视-触-动作模型（Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model），将两种具身映射到对齐的触觉与动作表征，并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹，从而用人类演示监督接触感知表征学习，部署时仅执行机器人动作。
AI.result: 在五项真实机器人任务评测中，方法平均成功率为70%，显著优于最强的视觉-触觉基线（29%）和架构消融版本（42%）；性能随人类演示数量增加持续提升，在每任务1000个演示时仍未饱和。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的人类触觉数据能有效用于灵巧操作，通过将人类与机器人具身对齐到共享的触觉-动作表征空间，可显著提升机器人接触丰富的操作性能，且对人类数据规模具有良好的可扩展性。

title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: WB-WAM：将显式全身动作监督融入生成式视频预训练的世界动作模型，实现数据高效的人形移动操作。
AI.motivation: 人形移动操作需要身体与手部协调动作，而传统机器人预训练数据对全身运动覆盖不足。
AI.method: 构建共享物理动作空间，统一异构来源的身体、根节点和灵巧手标注，从1880.2小时部分标注的视频与运动数据中进行视频-动作联合学习；经PICO中期训练精炼，并用辅助正向运动学监督适配机器人任务；构建WB-Datasets支持各阶段，包含重定向的第一人称人类演示与机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真中HumanoidArena达81.9%；真实世界五个任务平均成功率84.0%；任务对齐的PICO中期训练提升下游性能并减少真机演示需求。
AI.conclusion: 异构全身预训练与人体运动迁移是通往数据高效人形移动操作的可行路径。

title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
summary: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLE-Bench，一个面向机器人学习的编码智能体基准，覆盖交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计四类开发工作流，通过任务特定指标聚合为 RLE Index，并给出能力画像与案例分析。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基准多聚焦单一产物（策略或控制器）的性能，覆盖面有限，难以评估编码智能体在真实机器人工程中的综合能力。真实机器人开发要求智能体在资源约束下完成构建、集成、诊断与改进异构产物，并从多模态反馈中推理，因此需要新的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 RLE-Bench，包含覆盖四类代表性机器人开发工作流的机器人学习任务：交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计。采用多样的任务特定指标评估智能体提交的产物，包括智能体达成的成功率、训练出的策略智能体、构建的测试框架（harness）以及设计的机械结构；将指标聚合为总体 RLE Index，并输出各工作流的能力画像，同时进行代表性任务的深入案例分析。
AI.result: 通过任务特定指标与 RLE Index 实现了跨多个能力维度的系统性比较，并给出工作流级别能力画像；案例分析揭示了编码智能体在代表性任务上的当前能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: RLE-Bench 将评测范围从单一产物性能扩展到机器人工程全流程能力，为系统比较编码智能体提供统一框架，并指出机器人任务为未来智能体训练带来的机会。

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mmHRI，首个利用毫米波雷达实现隐私保护人机交互的多模态机器人操作框架，通过双流架构与记忆状态空间模型处理雷达稀疏性与时序不一致，将估计的人体状态转为文本指令驱动 VLA 策略，在遮挡场景下实现动作识别与闭环物品递送/取回。
AI.motivation: 现有 HRI 系统多依赖 RGB 相机持续观察人类以响应手势等非语言指令，在病房、餐厅等隐私敏感环境中直接摄像受限，存在隐私风险。因此需要一种无需可识别图像、能穿透隐私屏障感知人体运动的隐私保护型 HRI 方案。
AI.method: 采用毫米波雷达感知人体运动，提出 mmHRI 框架。针对杂乱机器人操作环境中雷达数据的稀疏性与时序不一致，设计：(1) 双流架构，同时从原始未滤波雷达张量和雷达点云联合学习，估计人体动作与 3D 姿态；(2) 基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM），保留历史雷达特征以减少姿态/动作的突变。估计出的人体状态被转换为结构化文本机器人指令，用于控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环操作与人体感知反应。
AI.result: 在隐私保护帘幕场景下，mmHRI 达到 85.09% 的动作识别准确率，优于现有基于雷达的替代方案。机器人试验进一步证明在视觉遮挡下可成功完成物品递送与取回，并在未见受试者、不同杂乱配置和环境间保持稳定任务性能。
AI.conclusion: mmHRI 验证了以毫米波雷达为核心、结合双流学习与记忆状态空间建模实现隐私保护 HRI 的可行性，可在视觉遮挡下稳定完成闭环机器人操作任务，为隐私敏感环境的 HRI 提供了有效方案。

title: Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种共享三维力估计框架，通过本体感受历史推断牛顿力，同时支持载荷承载与牵引引导两类任务。
AI.motivation: 运动过程中需承受载荷力，而牵引力可指定期望运动。作者探究是否能用一个共享的三维力估计（以牛顿为单位、由本体感受历史推断）同时支撑这两种任务。
AI.method: 联合训练估计器与运动策略，带监督式力/速度输出及学习到的潜在上下文；估计力用于条件化运动，并通过解析映射生成平面速度与偏航率指令以实现牵引引导。
AI.result: 持续载荷仿真中，各分量力RMSE时间均值1.44–2.83 N；相比域随机化基线，速度跟踪与基座姿态误差分别降低21.6%与46.5%，平均存活率由68.29%升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验验证了静止垂直/水平力估计、承载8.5 kg（超70 N训练上限）运动及同一力估计接口的牵引引导。
AI.conclusion: 单个共享三维力估计接口可同时服务于载荷适应与牵引引导，并在仿真与实物中表现优于基线。

title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

AI.tldr: GAE是一个面向通用、低延迟人形全身遥操作的统一学习框架，通过大规模异构人体运动数据、两阶段训练范式和延迟条件化预测机制，实现人形机器人流畅复现多样化人体行为。
AI.motivation: 人形化身可突破身体限制，使人类通过远程操作机器人参与社交、服务与劳动活动，这要求遥操作系统能实现多样、动态的全身行为并保持响应式人机同步。然而现有方法在行为多样性、人机样本不匹配与端到端延迟方面存在挑战，需要通用且低延迟的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模异构人体运动数据集，来源包括视频、动画与动作捕捉，并进行标准化与增强；2) 采用两阶段训练范式应对人体运动噪声与形态不匹配：先训练特权生成器策略在仿真中跟踪人体运动参考并生成可行的人形轨迹，再训练可部署执行器策略在课程域随机化下跟踪这些轨迹；3) 引入延迟条件化的预测机制，自适应补偿实时遥操作中的端到端延迟。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1与Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真实世界实验表明，GAE使人形机器人能够流畅地镜像多样化、敏捷且富有表现力的人体行为。
AI.conclusion: GAE作为一个统一学习框架，实现了通用、低延迟的人形全身遥操作，为超越身体限制的人形化身应用提供了可行技术路径。

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WAM-OPD，将on-policy蒸馏(OPD)引入世界动作模型(WAM)，并用前缀加权轨迹回放(PWTR)避免蒸馏过程中重复的环境交互，在仿真和真实实验中实现目标任务适配且不显著损失预训练技能。
AI.motivation: 预训练世界动作模型具备跨多样机器人操作任务的通用能力，但如何在不损害预训练技能的前提下将目标任务性能提升到专家水平仍具挑战。直接将学生策略拟合到狭窄的任务特定数据分布容易丢失预训练技能；而OPD虽能在学生自身诱导分布下迁移任务特定教师知识，却在闭环操作中因观测历史随学生策略演化而需要反复环境回放，成本高昂甚至不现实。
AI.method: 方法为WAM-OPD，基于on-policy蒸馏，使任务特定教师在学生自身诱导分布下进行知识迁移。为避免蒸馏期间反复环境回放，引入前缀加权轨迹回放(PWTR)：使用固定轨迹池（主要为初始学生策略回放，补充任务特定教师回放以扩大覆盖）；对每条回放轨迹，将当前策略条件于连续存储的历史以生成新的去噪路径，由任务特定教师在这些路径上监督。尽管去噪路径随策略演化而刷新，环境轨迹保持固定。为缓解由此产生的历史分布偏移，PWTR利用每条决策前轨迹前缀上累积的路径分数推导代理重要性权重，对逐决策蒸馏损失进行重加权。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，WAM-OPD在蒸馏过程中无需额外环境交互即可实现任务适配。在两种设置下，WAM-OPD均提升了目标任务性能，同时在未纳入适配的任务上保持接近初始模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将on-policy蒸馏应用于世界动作模型是可行的，PWTR通过固定轨迹池回放与代理重要性重加权，在避免昂贵环境回放的同时缓解历史分布偏移，实现目标任务适配与预训练技能的兼顾。

title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出统一动作表示 UMR 及策略 WEPVLA，实现人类演示到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有策略依赖本体特定动作空间，跨本体演示难以大规模利用，向新本体和空间变体的迁移受限。
AI.method: UMR 将操作分解为世界坐标系中与本体无关的 World Flow 和相对当前位姿的 Ego Trajectory，用 SE(3) 共轭耦合；实例化为 0.5B 的 WEPVLA，含双流 Point Action Adapter 与统一 Point Action Expert；并配数据高效策略 DES，通过阶段感知点云编辑多样化物体构型。
AI.result: 仿真中 LIBERO 平均成功率 97.5%，RLBench 10 任务 85.7%；真实实验中单策略零样本迁移至多种部署条件，每任务约 10 分钟人类演示、无机器人演示，六种设置平均成功率 91.7%，对比 HumanEgo 的 60.8%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的几何动作表示可有效支撑跨本体、跨空间条件的零样本技能迁移，并显著提升数据效率。

title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
summary: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboICL框架，通过上下文学习（演示上下文+交互记忆）提升通用视觉语言模型的零样本机器人控制能力，在高精度和长程任务上显著缩小差距，无需机器人特定参数更新。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型（如GPT-based模型）在零样本机器人控制中擅长开放式、语言/图像条件操控，但在高精度和长程任务上表现较弱。本文旨在不进行机器人特定参数更新、也不学习VLA的前提下弥补这一差距。
AI.method: RoboICL采用上下文机器人控制框架，将"演示上下文"（提供已有录制示例）与"交互记忆"（累积模型自身动作及观察结果）分离，二者共享observation-action-receipt-observation语法。为跨任务阶段保留经验，结合采样演示块与有界锚定记忆：固定锚点保留早期rollout交互供上下文学习，最新交互支持即时纠错。另可选Jev门控动作复用以减少调用。
AI.result: 在30个RoboDojo任务上（Open零样本，其余一次演示），各类别较官方零样本GPT模型提升20-27个进度分。在Memory和Open上领先排行榜基线，精确任务与最强基线相当，长程任务保持竞争力；30任务Overall得分50.64对最强基线33.68。独立十任务子集得分60.60，距π0.5+GPT混合方案2.00分以内。三个真机任务平均进度从零样本14.45升至一次演示63.33、三次演示78.89。两个开发任务中Jev门控动作复用减少33-48%的模型调用。
AI.conclusion: RoboICL通过上下文学习有效提升通用视觉语言模型在机器人控制中的表现，无需参数更新即可在精度、长程及真机任务上取得显著增益，Jev门控复用还能降低调用成本，代码已开源。

title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/mtbui2010/sage_release
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another.
