We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SAGE——一种单LLM规划器，由零token的符号门控（运行时安全监控，$O(|\pi|)$）与局部子目标后缀重编辑机制组成，并配合混合记忆库。在无泄漏协议下于75任务AI2-THOR基准测试中，SAGE在饱和基准上与强层级基线持平，在更难的多目标组合任务上领先+0.06至+0.23，注入中期故障时以2.4-3.3倍更少LLM调用达到同等恢复能力，符号门控还在每次执行前拦截不安全动作并提升所有规划器的仿真步成功率（最高+0.11），且可近乎零成本部署于边缘设备。
AI.motivation: LLM已成为具身家用智能体的默认认知核心，但其生成的规划在执行前很少用接地环境模型进行校验；同时任务成功率多在已饱和的基准上测量，导致各方法难以区分。因此需要一种可验证、可分解、安全且在边缘设备上可廉价运行的规划方案。
AI.method: SAGE由两个轻量机制构成：(1) 领域无关的符号门控（约250行Python，零token，$O(|\pi|)$复杂度），作为运行时安全监控，以带类型的原因阻止违反前置条件的动作；(2) 局部编辑，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保留已完成与未触及的工作；另设混合seed+live记忆库支持冷启动。评估采用无泄漏协议（留一检索），覆盖五个开放权重模型与75任务AI2-THOR基准。
AI.result: 标准基准目标完整度饱和（52%实例可平凡求解），SAGE与强层级基线持平；在更难、方法无关的多目标组合任务上，SAGE完整度优势重现且显著（跨四个模型+0.06至+0.23）。注入中期执行故障时，SAGE恢复可靠性与整规划重规划器相当，但LLM调用减少2.4-3.3倍。作为执行前验证门，符号监控在动作执行前拦截不安全动作，并提升每个被测规划器的仿真器报告步成功率（最高+0.11），而该信号验证器从未见过（非循环）。由于门控不调用模型（0.008 ms/plan），可作为边缘端近乎零成本的安全层；在Jetson AGX Orin上复现其规划质量。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过零token符号门控与局部后缀重编辑，在无泄漏评估协议下于饱和基准上持平、在困难组合任务上领先，并以更少LLM调用实现同等故障恢复，同时作为执行前安全门提升仿真步成功率，且以0.008 ms/plan的代价在边缘设备上近乎免费运行。作者发布了基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控测试框架，以及验证器可移植性研究（在ALFWorld上自动诱导，留出集0.89）。

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026, also presented at IROS 2026 Human-Robot Dialogue workshop
summary: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯框架，将自然语言澄清建模为基于STL任务规范的主动学习问题，利用LLM初始化候选规范并生成澄清问题，贝叶斯优化选择最大化信息增益的查询，最终将推断的STL规范交给形式化规划器生成可验证轨迹。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令常存在歧义、不完整或欠指定，机器人需推断并执行人类意图。LLM虽可作澄清交互接口，但依赖生成模型驱动多轮对话会引入系统性失败。
AI.method: 将澄清问题形式化为基于grounded Signal Temporal Logic任务规范的主动学习问题：LLM初始化候选形式化规范并将有信息量的对比转为自然语言澄清问题；贝叶斯优化维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，选择最大化信息增益的查询；收敛后将推断的STL规范传给形式化规划器合成可验证的机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个仿真与真实世界任务域中，该方法总体获得更高的任务满足度，澄清轮数少于LLM基线，并帮助较小模型缩小与大型推理模型的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 以贝叶斯主动学习结合LLM与形式化方法，可提升人机交互中意图推断的可靠性与效率，并增强可验证性。

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的具身导航框架 NavHarness，将记忆处理嵌入导航循环，通过多轮智能体会话维护地图、任务记录与房屋知识并跨会话传承经验，在 GOAT-Bench 与 IR2R-CE 上显著提升终身导航性能。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在单次具身导航任务上表现良好，但在连续任务中，智能体必须依赖不断演化的地图与历史搜索记录，而这些信息往往不完整，且可能与新观测相冲突。已有方法缺少对跨任务记忆的持续管理与校验机制，因此终身导航能力受限。
AI.method: NavHarness 为免训练（training-free）的具身导航"挽具"：将记忆处理作为导航循环的一部分。导航时，多轮智能体会话调用地图、任务记录与房屋知识，与当前观测进行核对，并记录修正以指导动作；在新任务或恢复尝试的新对话中保留既有经验，同时通过结果验证与运行结束摘要（run-end summary）支持后续复用；此外进行跨房屋的长期部署与记忆整合（consolidation）。
AI.result: 在 GOAT-Bench 上，NavHarness 相比仅依赖上下文的独立会话，s-SR 分别提升 18.6 分（Astra）与 22.6 分（Opus 5）；使用 SLAM 估计位姿时，GPT-6 Astra 版本达到 83.7 s-SR / 36.9 e-SR 的 SOTA，并在 IR2R-CE 上取得 85.9 s-SR。消融显示结构化恢复交接（structured recovery handover）优于等长摘要；跨房屋扩展部署中，记忆整合优于仅保留地图与任务记录。
AI.conclusion: 迈向终身导航的进展不仅取决于单任务能力的提升，更取决于连续推理会话如何在前序经验之上构建；将记忆处理纳入导航循环、并显式设计跨会话经验传承与整合机制，是提升长期具身导航表现的关键方向。

title: TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.

AI.tldr: TLC-DiT是一种即插即用的多任务扩散策略扩展，通过显式引入任务引导的局部视觉特征图，在不改变扩散目标和动作生成过程的前提下，提升策略的可检查性与视觉鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 语言条件机器人策略在多任务操作上取得了进展，但任务相关的局部视觉证据通常隐式地留在视觉主干或注意力层内部，导致策略难以检查，并在视觉变化下表现脆弱。这两个问题都指向一个缺失的显式、任务对齐的局部视觉通道。
AI.method: 提出TLC-DiT，对每个相机视图采用冻结的DINOv2 patch特征，经FiLM由CLIP任务嵌入调制，再由轻量级CoordConv CNN适配器细化为平滑空间图，并与原始全局图像、语言、关节状态和时间步条件拼接输入。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率达93.5%，高于Multitask DiT的86.5%和SmolVLA的79.25%；在LIBERO-plus上总成功率从54.07%提升至57.24%，在相机、背景和传感器噪声变化下增益更大。真实双臂任务中，Teabag Putting完成率从44%提升至89%，Match Box Opening性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 特征图可视化确认模型能跨视图和扰动关注任务相关区域，提供了直接检查视觉证据的方式，证明显式任务对齐局部视觉通道的有效性。

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
summary: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应潜在安全滤波器，利用直接观测到的世界模型误差，通过自适应保形推断构建在线不确定性集，并对学习到的安全价值函数进行悲观评估，从而在模型准确时保持最小保守性，在模型失配时更谨慎。
AI.motivation: 世界模型为高维机器人系统的安全推理提供了强大基础，但其预测可能有偏、校准不当或"自信地错误"。潜在空间安全滤波器通常在世界模型动力学上学习Hamilton-Jacobi安全价值函数，若世界模型不准确，价值函数会继承其误差并产生过度自信的安全估计。现有潜在安全滤波器依赖集成分歧或价值目标一致性残差等辅助信号进行自适应，但这些信号即使在世界模型预测偏离观测时仍可能很小，无法可靠反映模型误差。
AI.method: 提出自适应潜在安全滤波器，使用直接观测到的世界模型误差来校准安全推理。具体而言，采用自适应保形推断（Adaptive Conformal Inference），基于预测潜在状态与观测推断潜在状态之间的差异构建在线不确定性集；随后在这些不确定性集上最小化学习到的价值函数，实现对安全性的悲观评估。该方法在模型准确时保持最小保守性，在观测揭示模型失配时变得更加谨慎。
AI.result: 理论方面，为自适应不确定性半径提供了有限时间覆盖保证。实验方面，通过仿真和硬件实验表明，该方法相比最先进的潜在安全滤波器显著减少了失败，同时保持了任务完成度。
AI.conclusion: 利用直接观测到的世界模型误差驱动自适应不确定性集，能够有效校准潜在空间安全滤波器，克服现有辅助信号对模型偏差不敏感的缺陷，在保证任务完成的同时显著提升安全性，并具备有限时间覆盖的理论保障。

title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: https://www.taekyung.me/pss
summary: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出PSS框架，将VLM物理推理与备份式安全过滤结合，用共形预测校准未来物体占据区域，生成输入仿射约束以保证备份可行性，在Unitree Go1上实现99.3%安全成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人的几何感知只能反映当前环境，物理交互（如物体坠落、支撑失效、接触传播）会制造当前几何下不可见的未来危险，因而需要把视觉物理推理与安全过滤相衔接，提前预见并规避这类隐患。
AI.method: PSS首先用视觉语言模型预测物理事件及其发生时刻，或直接预测物体位移；再用显式运动模型将事件假设转化为物体轨迹；随后用分裂共形预测对指定物体、观测时刻与未来时刻上的位置误差进行联合校准，并通过几何形状边界把位置区域转为预测占据区域；最后针对给定备份机动评估其与该占据区域的关系，推导输入仿射约束，在保持机器人动力学与输入限制下备份可行性的同时，最小化对名义输入的修改。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中基于Unitree Go1开展实验，涵盖灯具坠落、冲击导致支撑失效与接触传播等场景。PSS安全回合率达99.3%，而仅依赖当前障碍几何的Backup Control Barrier Function基线仅为43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉物理推理与共形校准的预测占据区域能够为备份式安全过滤提供有效的未来危险信息，显著优于仅使用当前几何的安全基线，说明预测语义安全在动态物理危险场景中具有实用价值。

title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

AI.tldr: FutureDuet 让主视角与腕部视角采用不同的未来预测目标：主视角用 RGB 建模任务演进，腕部视角用潜空间预测短时交互变化，再由 ActionDiT 联合读取，训练期辅助模块不增加推理开销，在 RoboTwin50 与 LIBERO 上取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 将主视角与腕部视角融合为单一视觉流，并用同一未来视频目标训练，忽视了两者视觉动态的差异：主相机稳定，反映场景级任务演进；腕部相机随末端执行器运动，局部交互变化与视角漂移、自遮挡混杂。这种预测需求的差异提示两路视角应使用不同的未来目标。
AI.method: FutureDuet 在保留两路视角用于控制的同时，为每个视觉流分配不同的未来目标。主视角：未来 RGB 建模任务演进，辅以交互掩码与机器人骨架，将监督聚焦于任务物体与机器人运动；腕部流：未来潜空间预测建模短时交互变化，无需像素级重建。ActionDiT 联合读取由此得到的 Task State 与 Interaction State，融合场景级进度与近距交互证据。所有辅助预测模块仅用于训练，不增加推理开销。
AI.result: FutureDuet 在 RoboTwin50 上取得 94.2% 干净场景与 94.1% 随机化场景成功率，在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 99.2%。在六个需要精细交互的 RoboTwin50 任务上提升最显著，相较 Fast-WAM 在干净与随机化设置下平均增益分别为 9.2% 和 12.8%。
AI.conclusion: 对照实验进一步表明，分离腕部通路以及为两路视角分别设计未来监督均带来互补收益，验证了差异化未来目标设计的有效性。

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐式指称定位（IRG）这一新能力，并构建RoboIRG-Bench基准（40个变体、11个任务、4类挑战）系统评测VLA模型，揭示了从显式指令到隐式指称的"指称鲁棒性差距"，并在真机上验证该差距。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基准通常假设任务相关信息在指令中被显式给出，但现实中人类常以隐式方式指称物体、数量和关系，要求机器人从语言与感知上下文中恢复真实目标。该能力尚未被系统研究与评测。
AI.method: 定义Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG)能力；基于RoboMME构建RoboIRG-Bench，含40个任务变体、11个任务，覆盖直接、推理中介、空间、上下文四类指称定位挑战；评测具有不同记忆机制的代表性VLA模型，并在Franka Research 3机械臂上进行真实场景验证。
AI.result: 评测发现明显的指称鲁棒性差距：显式指令下表现良好的模型在需从上下文恢复信息时性能大幅下降；推理中介与空间指称尤为困难；使用外部VLM的模型鲁棒性更强但仍存在显著失败，且更换更强的外部VLM也无法消除该差距。真机实验中差距持续存在，表现为错误指称定位与下游执行失败。
AI.conclusion: IRG是可靠机器人指令跟随中一项独立且探索不足的关键能力，凸显了构建能稳健融合语言、感知、推理与动作的VLA模型的必要性。

title: Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA2027)
summary: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于B模式超声图像的接触感知方法与接触感知阻抗控制器，用于机器人超声成像，实现无力的接触检测、接触位置估计与交互坐标系更新，在保证跟踪精度的同时降低压缩力。
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助超声成像需可靠控制器以检测并定位探头-组织交互。现有方法依赖力测量，存在残余力偏置问题，且需在成像过程中保证接触安全与精度。
AI.method: 提出基于B模式超声图像的接触感知方法：独立于力测量检测声学接触，实现接触条件下的力/力矩归零以减少残余力偏置；接触过程中连续估计弯曲探头表面上的有效接触位置，并据此更新控制器的交互坐标系，从而对物理探头-组织接触点进行视觉伺服控制，并设计接触感知阻抗控制器。
AI.result: 在琼脂仿体实验中，探头滚转角-15°至15°范围内接触定位RMSE为1.46±0.14 mm；静态滚动时，所提控制器保持与常规固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的任务空间跟踪精度，同时将最大压缩交互力从31.56 N降至20.09 N，降低36.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明超声图像可作为直接接触反馈，用于安全且准确的机器人辅助超声成像，验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom
summary: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出类型化语义-几何接口，将语言操作为实体、关系与阶段，关系索引注册规范，经共形几何代数编译为关系专属任务映射与微分，并经 RMPflow 组合，实现保留关系自由度的连续控制。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令给出的是定性关系，而连续控制器需要可状态求值的任务量、微分与完成条件；定性关系通常未指定完整相对位姿，直接扩展为完整位姿会引入非预期约束，因此需明确语言模型与编译器之间的责任划分。
AI.method: 设计类型化语义到几何接口：语言指定实体、关系与阶段，每个关系索引一份已注册规范，描述其任务相关区分与保留自由度；机器人侧编译器基于共形几何代数对规范进行落地，构建关系专属任务映射与一致微分，并通过 RMPflow 组合所得策略。同时对比仅语义拓扑接口与额外要求关系几何规范接口，在 60 条指令上评估。
AI.result: 两种接口均在 41/60 条指令上产生正确的共享语义内容，但各自接口要求下的关键错误分别为 19/60 与 58/60。在涵盖八种几何关系形式的 64 次落地评估中，任务映射保留了已注册零方向并对关系相关扰动响应；解析方向导数与有限差分一致，雅可比秩与注册维度匹配。基于 MuJoCo 中仿真 Franka Emika Panda 的三次闭环消融中，固定关系保留坐标使终端进度误差中位数增加 20.24--71.00 mm，而保留关系误差仍在其评估界内。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将关系可见几何与保留自由度一同编译为可组合的连续目标，能够在保持关系约束的同时实现有效控制；更严格的关系几何接口会增加语言模型侧的关键错误负担。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
summary: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.

AI.tldr: CF-WAM 提出动态下一状态预测框架，将同一未来的视觉、语义、几何与交互投影统一为标准视频形式并对统一的世界-动作模型进行监督，从而突破固定表示带来的归纳偏置限制，提升训练效率、控制性能与跨本体泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）中，现有方法在训练前就把下一状态固定为 RGB、单一隐特征或预定义目标的静态组合，使动作学习受限于某种特定表示所保留的归纳偏置，难以捕捉支撑多种投影的共同状态转移结构，也限制了人类与机器人经验的跨本体复用。
AI.method: 提出 CF-WAM 动态下一状态预测框架：对同一未来采样视觉、语义、几何与交互四种投影，将其标准化为统一的视频形式，并在此多投影上监督一个统一的 WAM。跨训练步累积不同投影所暴露的动作相关约束，迫使模型学习同一动作条件下未来的底层状态转移结构；该动态机制同时为人类与机器人学习提供自然的跨本体动力学参考系，使异构经验绕过外观差异直接贡献于共享状态转移学习。
AI.result: CF-WAM 同时提升了训练效率与最终控制性能，并能将人类经验有效转化为策略增益。在 RoboCasa-GR1 上取得平均成功率 82.50% 的最优表现，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 82.65%，真实世界评测最高达 84.00%。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨不同下一状态参数化的联合学习，CF-WAM 证明了动态、多投影的下一状态监督可缓解固定表示偏置，改善跨本体泛化，并在仿真与真实任务中取得领先性能。

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
summary: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

AI.tldr: ARS 是一个无需训练奖励模型的推理框架，用通用 VLM 通过自适应视觉检查、事件提议与验证来做进度奖励建模，在语义错配基准、仿真策略学习及真实机器人长时程任务上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 进度奖励建模需要区分有意义的状态变化与失败尝试、任务无关动作，可靠估计困难；现有奖励基线在简单场景中也会对错误物体操作给出虚假进度。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Reward System (ARS)：给定离线轨迹与任务指令，使用子代理提出任务相关事件时间线，由主代理验证并修正，再用通用 VLM（27B）进行自适应视觉检查以估计逐帧进度；可引入终端结果标签与视觉参考，并可审计外部奖励模型的进度估计；无需额外奖励模型训练。
AI.result: 在受控语义错配基准上，多个奖励基线即使简单拾放场景也分配虚假进度，ARS 更好抑制此类错误；在仿真策略学习中优于基线；并在全尺寸工业洗衣机组装线复刻环境中，支持真实机器人多螺丝紧固的混合质量离线经验长时程策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理与验证可提升通用 VLM 在机器人奖励建模中的实用性。

title: Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments
summary: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带时间窗和可变利润的定向越野问题（OPTWVP），提出两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法DeCoST，在共享空间中生成无碰撞且高质量的轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在共享工作空间中同时保证轨迹的安全性和可行性，并实现高质量的定向越野任务执行。
AI.method: 提出DeCoST（两阶段解耦离散-连续优化，以服务时间引导轨迹），并引入节点的安全感知时间窗和工作空间离散化，以确保末端执行器与人之间的无碰撞轨迹。
AI.result: 初步结果验证了DeCoST在生成无碰撞轨迹规划的同时保持定向越野任务质量的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DeCoST能有效求解共享空间中的OPTWVP，兼顾安全无碰撞与任务质量。

title: Model-Informed Safe Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion via Step-to-Step Prediction
summary: Humanoid robots promise versatile mobility in cluttered, human-centric environments, but real deployment demands principled safety. Classical model-based gait generators yield interpretable motions but often lack the robustness and adaptability of modern reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches. We propose a model-informed reinforcement learning framework anchored to the analytical Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP) template. We provide a step-to-step safety certificate for ALIP stepping via a discrete exponential control barrier function (DECBF) and use it as (i) a training-time shaping signal and (ii) a runtime action filter that minimally adjusts swing-foot placement to satisfy template-level constraints. Full-order safety is evaluated empirically on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo with a whole-body controller stack. Compared to an unconstrained baseline, our approach reduces safety-violation events in the reported external-disturbance trial, while larger lateral-velocity transients reveal a safety-tracking tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种模型信息驱动的强化学习框架，将解析ALIP模板与离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）结合，为双足人形机器人步态提供步到步安全证书，并同时用作训练塑形信号与运行时动作过滤器，在Digit人形机器人上减少了外部扰动下的安全违规事件，但存在安全-跟踪权衡。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在杂乱、以人为中心的环境中需要通用移动能力，但实际部署要求具备原理性安全保障。传统基于模型的步态生成器可解释性强，却缺乏现代强化学习方法的鲁棒性与适应性；而纯RL方法虽灵活，却缺少明确的安全保证。因此需要融合两者优势。
AI.method: 提出模型信息强化学习框架，以解析的角动量线性倒立摆（ALIP）模板为锚点。通过离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）为ALIP迈步提供步到步安全证书，并将其双重使用：(i) 作为训练期的塑形信号；(ii) 作为运行时动作过滤器，以最小程度调整摆动脚落点以满足模板级约束。在MuJoCo中对Digit人形机器人配合全身控制器栈进行全阶安全性的实证评估。
AI.result: 与无约束基线相比，所提方法在报告的外部扰动试验中减少了安全违规事件；然而在较大的横向速度瞬变下，暴露出安全性与跟踪性能之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将解析模板级安全证书嵌入强化学习可有效降低人形机器人步态的安全违规，但安全约束会与任务跟踪性能产生冲突，尤其在大横向速度瞬变时，未来需进一步平衡二者。

title: Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration
comment: Author's version of a manuscript accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026). (c) IEEE
summary: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向月球长期居住需求，提出由充气式模块与模块化可重构机器人组成的联合系统，并用真实硬件（MoonBot机器人与HIDAS充气模块）演示了部署与维护任务，以提升系统可靠性。
AI.motivation: 月球长期驻留与原位开发推动未来人类前哨站建设，机器人是支撑其建造的关键技术；为提升月面居住舱部署与维护的可靠性，需要验证机器人辅助任务的可行性。
AI.method: 提出充气式模块与模块化、可重构机器人相结合的联合系统；使用真实硬件——模块化可重构机器人MoonBot与充气模块HIDAS，开展机器人辅助任务演示。
AI.result: 演示任务包括：充气过程中的机器人巡检、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定，以及部署后维护所需的三维建图；所有演示均在实验室环境或月球模拟试验场完成。
AI.conclusion: 总结实践经验与教训，为该机器人应用服务于未来月球居住提供关键见解。

title: MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors
summary: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.

AI.tldr: MonoEgo 用一台全局快门相机与被动腕部标志、稀疏锚点，借助 MonoTag SLAM 在离线单目重建中获得米制腕部跟踪，无需主动腕部硬件，但覆盖不完整且残余几何不确定性。
AI.motivation: 图像对齐的米制演示通常依赖专用跟踪硬件与跨设备同步。作者希望用离线单目重建替代主动式腕部传感器，降低采集端硬件与同步要求。
AI.method: 一台 90-FPS 全局快门相机在同一图像时钟下观测标定好的被动腕部标志群、稀疏工作台锚点与场景。MonoTag SLAM 融合标志角点与 ORB 几何，并利用视觉证据剔除歧义的平面标志位姿。其 metric Atlas 支持区间尺度重锚定、经验证的地图合并，以及基于最终地图对早期帧的追溯定位。
AI.result: 实验实现超出连续锚点可见性的米制跟踪、支持地图分量的重连，以及部分缺失相机位姿的恢复。与多传感器相机参考及独立静止标志群测试对比，刻画了轨迹一致性与精度，同时暴露出覆盖不完整与残余几何不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 被动固定装置加离线重建可降低采集端要求；动态精度、实际部署与下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

AI.tldr: 提出眼动追踪监督的注视提示方法：训练时用VR遥操作采集的注视点渲染为十字准星叠加在机器人头部图像上，部署时用轻量预测器估计注视位置，无需眼动仪或改动策略架构，在六个真实双臂操作任务上将平均成功率从26.3%提升至56.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA微调在每个时间步配对图像与动作，但仅提供任务级语言指令，导致逐时刻的视觉相关性是隐式的，缺乏帧级视觉引导。
AI.method: 利用VR遥操作过程中记录的眼动数据，将注视位置渲染为十字准星叠加到机器人头部相机图像上作为帧级视觉提示进行监督微调；部署阶段训练轻量预测器，根据近期图像与指令估计注视位置，提供同类型视觉提示。基于π0实例化，无需眼动仪或修改策略架构。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界双臂操作任务上，平均成功率从26.3%提升至56.0%；单一策略在全部六个任务上联合训练时同样观察到提升；并发布GazeMani数据集，含1200条带同步眼动数据的遥操作轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 注视提示可为VLA微调提供有效的帧级视觉引导，部署时可通过预测器替代真实眼动仪，且兼容现有策略架构，配合发布的数据集可推动相关研究。

title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.

AI.tldr: Ledger 提出将机器人操作记忆按类型分置：短期感知记忆留在策略内，长期物体记忆外置为可读台账，在 RoboMME 上以单组权重取得四套件平均 64.3% 的最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 长时程、部分可观测的机器人操作需要记忆能力（如记住物体放入哪个抽屉、移动了谁的杯子、经过了多少动作周期）。现有 VLA 模型把记忆直接嵌入策略内部，但基准测试表明没有任何单一策略内机制能覆盖所有时空维度，且大幅落后于 oracle 方法。
AI.method: 作者的论点是记忆类型决定记忆应存放的位置：短期感知记忆（重复、时序、回溯）适合放在策略内部，长期物体记忆（持久空间状态、容器关系、事件历史）应外置为显式可读的记录。基于此提出 Ledger，在单个微调的 π_0.5 策略上实现该分离：策略内使用帧采样记忆，策略外使用由 SAM3 跟踪器和 VLM 描述器从演示中构建的时空物体记忆（ledger），并由 LLM 规划器在步骤边界处读取并决策。运行时依据指令与记录选择记忆来源，从而无需任务级路由器。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 上，Ledger 在被评估方法中取得最高的四套件平均值 64.3%（最强先前方法在相同评测下为 45.9%），在物体指代上达 60.7%（对比 40.3%），在物体永久性上达 86.7%（对比 56.2%），且仅使用单组权重。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将短期感知记忆与长期物体记忆按类型分层放置（策略内 + 外置可读台账）是一种有效且统一的机器人操作记忆方案；运行时基于指令和记录动态选择记忆来源，可替代任务级路由器，并在多个时空维度上同时领先。

title: Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner
summary: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出GRIPPER框架：将空中抓取非合作目标建模为不完全信息一般和追逃博弈，在线推断目标代价参数并在滚动时域内迭代求解开环纳什均衡，结合梯度型逆博弈求解器（>50 Hz）与抗扰动控制器，实现精准抓取与递送。
AI.motivation: 非合作目标的精准捕获是难题。目标具有自主规避行为且代价参数未知，属于不完全信息下的对抗性动态交互；同时空中平台存在负载不确定与夹爪驱动扰动，要求高频实时求解与精确轨迹跟踪，现有方法难以兼顾博弈推理的实时性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 将交互建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈，采用滚动时域（receding-horizon）闭环框架；2) 在线推断目标的底层代价参数，并迭代精化开环纳什均衡（OLNE）策略；3) 提出计算友好的梯度型逆博弈求解器，基于隐式微分与快速Hessian-向量乘积，避免显式求解Hessian逆，实现>50 Hz的实时更新；4) 设计抗扰动控制器，抑制不确定负载与夹爪驱动扰动，实现规划轨迹的精确跟踪与目标抓取。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，GRIPPER在计算效率和任务性能上均优于对比方法；成功完成非合作目标的捕获与递送任务，验证了框架在强对抗场景下的鲁棒性、适应性与实时性。
AI.conclusion: 将逆博弈推理与实时数值优化、抗扰动控制相结合，可有效解决非合作目标空中抓取问题，兼顾实时性与鲁棒性，适用于高度对抗性场景，为空中操作中的动态博弈式规划提供了可行方案。

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 WAMACHINE 框架，通过保留并自适应推断状态来加速世界动作模型（WAM）推理，实现闭环重规划与去噪过程的高效续算。
AI.motivation: WAM 通过联合建模动作与环境动态实现未来感知控制，但迭代扩散/流推断带来显著去噪延迟。先前的推断状态为加速提供了自然机会，然而规划上下文、观测和中间表示的不断变化会使保留状态迅速失效，因此需要"自适应"而非简单复用推断状态。
AI.method: WAMACHINE 为免训练框架，包含三种跨尺度机制：（1）Trajectory Remapping：在闭环重规划间将前一重规划状态重映射以初始化下一次重规划，减少冗余轨迹生成；（2）Observation Rebinding：在动作执行期间进行前瞻推断，当一致性检查通过时将保留的去噪状态与真实观测重新绑定以续算，降低控制回路暴露的延迟；（3）Residual Rescaling：在 Transformer 层间选择性重缩放保留层状态，并在探针检查失败时通过中间层全量计算进行刷新，减少重复 Transformer 计算。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上对三种代表性 WAM 架构评估：观测到动作延迟提速 1.47-3.05 倍，每次重规划的 GPU 推断时间提速 2.23-3.27 倍，同时保留原生 WAM 任务成功率的 96.69-99.54%。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应（而非直接复用）推断状态，WAMACHINE 在无需训练的前提下显著加速 WAM 推理，并在多架构、多基准上以极小成功率损失换取大幅延迟降低。

title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the IROS 2026 workshop: Deformable Objects Manipulation: Research Foundations, Reproducibility and Real-World Challenges
summary: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可微物理仿真在机器人材料操控中的梯度数值可靠性，基于两个MPM系统辨识基准（弹塑性与颗粒操控）揭示三类影响优化结果的效应：GPU非确定性归约导致长时程梯度改变甚至符号翻转；有限差分校验在长时程下因重复运行损失波动增长快于扰动引起的损失变化而失效；观测与损失定义会改变优化行为和最终解。
AI.motivation: 可微物理被日益广泛用于机器人材料操控，包括系统辨识、轨迹与技能优化、演示生成以及机器人/末端执行器设计。这些应用都依赖通过长时程、接触密集的仿真轨迹反向传播的梯度。然而，这类梯度的数值可靠性尚缺乏系统研究，作者希望用受控基准评估其可信度，并为更广泛的可微物理优化提供警示。
AI.method: 作者构建了两个基于Material Point Method（MPM）的系统辨识基准，分别来源于弹塑性和颗粒材料操控问题。基准设计为受控实验，用以隔离并检验三种效应：(1) 依赖线程调度顺序的GPU多对一求和（many-to-one sum）对长时程梯度的影响，并与确定性参考值比较；(2) 有限差分校验在长时程 rollout 下的可靠性，比较扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行的损失波动；(3) 不同观测与损失定义对优化行为和最终解的影响，并用独立指标评估所偏好的解。
AI.result: 实验发现三类问题：(1) GPU many-to-one求和的顺序随线程调度变化，会改变长时程梯度，并使某个参数的梯度相对于确定性参考发生符号翻转；(2) 随着rollout变长，重复运行的损失波动增长速度远快于被测参数扰动带来的损失变化，导致有限差分检查可靠性下降；(3) 观测和损失的定义不同会改变优化行为以及独立指标所偏好的解。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议在将可微仿真用于机器人优化时采用三项实践：使用可复现的累加方式；有限差分验证应比较扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行的波动；以及显式报告目标函数的构造方式。这些措施有助于提高可微物理优化的结果可信度与可比性。

title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ICRA. Website: http://shinben0327.github.io/hoi-retarget
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，将人-物交互（HOI）迁移到人形机器人上，用于大规模运动数据生成，并公开代码与数据集。
AI.motivation: 从示范学习（LfD）已使人形机器人获得多样化全身技能，但将该范式扩展到人-物交互（HOI）受限于缺乏与机器人兼容的交互参考数据。因此需要一种能将已有HOI数据迁移到机器人上的方法。
AI.method: HOI-Retarget采用以接触为中心的重定向方法。其窗口化轨迹优化将每个标注接触作为物体坐标系中的目标，在机器人运动学约束下平衡身体跟踪、足部支撑与平滑性。该方法支持跨物体尺寸对单次示范进行增广、吸收从单目视频重建的接触，并扩展到多机器人操作同一物体。
AI.result: 方法可实现：跨物体尺寸增广单次示范；融合单目视频重建的接触信息；支持多机器人协同操作同一物体；并公开代码与重定向运动数据集。
AI.conclusion: HOI-Retarget有效缓解了HOI数据与机器人兼容性不足的问题，为大规模生成人形机器人HOI运动数据提供了可行途径，并已公开代码和数据集以促进后续研究。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个评估框架，将VLA模型的预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性三者分离，并证明自然轨迹高准确率可能伴随受控目标状态响应性薄弱。
AI.motivation: 从VLA模型内部表征准确解码物体状态，并不能证明预测对目标物理状态变化具有忠实响应。自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡与任务进度共同变化，上下文线索可能混入预测，因此需区分准确率与真实响应性。
AI.method: 构建评估框架，使用经物理验证的观测，将目标坐标与机器人上下文交叉组合，从而分离预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性；对表征、读出器和训练数据进行对比与干预实验；并将响应性与上下文敏感性加入基于初始状态误差和物理变量的失败预测器。
AI.result: 在固定表征-读出器组合下，高自然轨迹准确率可与薄弱的受控目标状态响应性并存；三项属性提供不同诊断信息；加入响应性与上下文敏感性能在新初始化上降低策略失败预测误差，优于指定基线，同时同观测受控MAE也具有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 应结合自然预测准确率，同时评估目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性，并考察其与实际策略行为和任务结果的关系。

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
summary: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人强化学习中的奖励塑形，区分"控制目标内在项"与"数值正则项"，证明稳定控制任务中奖励无需一阶(速度)项，但必须在目标相关坐标上具备零阶完备性。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人深度强化学习的奖励塑形高度依赖源自经典最优控制与轨迹优化的启发式原则，且现有方法很少区分控制目标内在的奖励项与数值正则项，导致超参数调优脆弱、奖励设计缺乏原则性依据。作者希望明确"奖励函数究竟必须包含哪些量"。
AI.method: 以稳定控制问题为研究对象，聚焦零阶(构型)与一阶(速度)信息，结合理论分析与实验验证，考察策略梯度方法在有无一阶奖励项条件下的表现，并分析一阶项尺度增大时的影响。
AI.result: 理论与实验均表明：策略梯度方法无需一阶奖励项即可成功求解稳定任务；加入一阶奖励项反而会随其尺度增大引入严重的敏感性。反过来，奖励函数必须在目标相关坐标上满足零阶完备性；在低耗散假设下，一阶状态仍须保留在策略观测中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为机器人强化学习的奖励设计提供了可操作且有原则的指导：奖励塑形应保证目标相关坐标的零阶完备性，谨慎引入一阶奖励项，同时将一阶状态纳入策略观测。

title: MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MarsLab，一个开源、ROS2 原生的火星车仿真器，用于自主导航算法开发，并结合 HiRISE 与程序化地形、可配置岩石/陨石坑/光照/沙尘参数，在 Isaac Sim 中运行 Perseverance 级火星车，通过 ROS2 标准话题发布多模态传感数据，并用 SLAM 与 VPR 基准验证其可控场景变化与共享 GT 轨迹的比较能力。
AI.motivation: 未来火星任务要求火星车在非结构化地形、光照变化、大气沙尘和有限通信条件下实现自主运行。仿真是在部署前研究这些条件的实用手段，但现有火星相关资源在覆盖范围上彼此割裂，包括面向任务的仿真器、固定的类比数据集、特定任务环境和开放机器人接口，缺乏统一、可定制的开发与评测平台。
AI.method: 提出 MarsLab：开源、ROS2 原生的火星车仿真器。地形融合 HiRISE 派生数据与程序化生成，支持可定制的岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照与大气沙尘设置；在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中运行 Perseverance 级火星车模型；运行时通过标准 ROS2 话题发布 RGB、深度、RGB-D 点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计与真值（GT）位姿数据。基于该平台开展跨传感模态、沙尘水平、场景几何与路径长度的 SLAM 基准，以及在光照与沙尘变化下重复火星基地遍历的 VPR 基准。
AI.result: 结果表明，受控的场景变化与共享 GT 轨迹可用于在同一仿真器内进行轨迹级估计（SLAM）与图像级位置识别（VPR）的对比评测，验证了 MarsLab 作为统一基准平台的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MarsLab 为火星自主导航与定位算法研究提供了开源、ROS2 原生且可定制的统一仿真与基准平台，通过共享 GT 轨迹支持轨迹级与图像级任务的同环境对比，有助于在部署前系统研究火星复杂条件对算法的影响。

title: SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: SOR-Nav是一个分层物体导航系统，通过显式地在"继续探索当前上下文"与"转向更有希望的可达区域"之间进行仲裁，在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和MP3D上取得最优SR与SPL，MP3D上SPL翻倍。
AI.motivation: 现有物体导航方法主要通过排序候选目标点来优化下一步去向，缺乏对是否应放弃当前搜索上下文、进行跨区域迁移的显式决策机制，导致在部分可观测与有限移动预算下搜索效率受限。
AI.method: SOR-Nav构建自主语义探索系统，累积持久化的3D物体簇并将可达前沿组织为簇决策图，提供高效搜索抽象；随后采用上下文门控的LLM驱动物体搜索监督器，评估当前搜索上下文的适宜性，决定继续探索还是进行跨区域重定位到其他可达前沿簇。
AI.result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和MP3D完整未过滤验证集上，SOR-Nav均取得报告中最强的SR和SPL。MP3D上SPL由先前最佳的18.1%提升至38.5%（翻倍以上），SR由50.7%提升至61.8%。嵌套HM3D-v2消融实验验证了决策结构的有效性，连续三目标真机部署展示了真实场景中的持续ObjectNav运行能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式的上下文仲裁与跨区域重定位决策能显著提升物体导航的搜索效率与成功率，且方法具备良好的泛化性与真实世界部署可行性。

title: ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation
summary: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.

AI.tldr: ExcavaTwin：纯视觉、几何引导的语义高程建图框架，无需挖掘专用训练，可实现可靠的几何与语义感知。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘需要同时刻画地形几何与任务相关语义的空间表示，但现有挖掘建图以高程为中心，通用语义模型在非结构化室外场景中不稳定。
AI.method: 基于多视角RGB图像，四步流程：1) 用冻结视觉模型重建场景几何与语义观测；2) 推导地形与非地形几何支撑；3) 几何约束的多视角语义融合，抑制不合理预测并补全缺失观测；4) 投影为任务导向的语义高程图。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与真实挖掘场景中验证了可靠的几何与语义感知；真实挖掘中平均更新间隔约1.4 s，动态修改区域平均高程误差12.74 cm；较大误差主要出现在快速地形变化与机器运动引起的瞬态视觉干扰时。
AI.conclusion: 纯视觉几何引导的语义高程建图可在无挖掘专用训练条件下实现自主挖掘所需的空间感知，但仍需应对快速地形变化与运动视觉干扰带来的误差。

title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world. See our project page (https://dexweave.github.io) for videos.

AI.tldr: DexWeave：交互一致的运动重定向 + 解剖感知全身策略学习，实现人形机器人灵巧全身移动操作。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示学习灵巧人形移动操作，不仅需迁移人体运动，还需迁移行为背后的协调交互结构。挑战在于：形态差异会扭曲身体运动、腕部位置、手指关节与物体交互之间的耦合；而运动学上准确的参考在机器人动力学下仍可能难以实现。
AI.method: DexWeave 统一框架：①两阶段重定向——先用专用求解器初始化躯干与手部运动，再在上肢交互链上做耦合精修，同时保持下肢支撑；②解剖感知 Transformer 策略——将解剖区域表示为结构化 token，用有向掩码注意力建模依赖关系，物体信息选择性调制上肢通路；策略联合输出身体与灵巧手动作，直接用强化学习训练（无需预训练跟踪策略、教师-学生蒸馏或后续残差精修）。
AI.result: 相比 MLP 基线，DexWeave 提升了重定向保真度与交互一致性，获得更高的操作性能与更快的策略收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 进一步在配备 Inspire 灵巧手的 Unitree G1 实机上部署所学策略，验证了真实世界中的灵巧全身移动操作能力。

title: Action Sequence Transfer via LLMs for Heterogeneous Environments
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: We present an action sequence transfer system that adaptively transfers user action sequences across different target spaces. Given an input action sequence from a source space and scene graph representations of both the source and target environments, our system predicts a corresponding action sequence in the target space by adapting to the spatial and object constraints of the new environment. To achieve this, we leverage multi-level representations of user activity to generalize actions at varying levels of abstraction. To demonstrate our system, we collect a new scene graph-based dataset derived from the Ego4D GoalStep dataset for evaluation. Results indicate that our system can generate valid action sequences even between spaces with drastically different object configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种动作序列迁移系统，可将源空间的动作序列自适应迁移到目标空间，并通过场景图建模环境约束，在新构建的Ego4D GoalStep场景图数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 用户动作序列通常与特定环境的空间布局和物体配置紧密绑定，难以直接复用到配置差异较大的新环境。需要一种能适应目标空间约束的迁移机制。
AI.method: 输入源空间动作序列及源、目标环境的场景图表示，预测目标空间中的对应动作序列。核心是采用多层级用户活动表示，在不同抽象层次上对动作进行泛化，以适配目标环境的空间与物体约束。并基于Ego4D GoalStep构建新的场景图数据集用于评估。
AI.result: 系统能够生成有效的目标动作序列，即使在源与目标空间物体配置差异很大的情况下仍可工作。
AI.conclusion: 动作序列迁移可通过多层级抽象表示与场景图约束适配实现，具备跨异构空间泛化的能力。

title: Simulation for Planetary Robotic Perception and Autonomy: A Concise Survey of Recent Capabilities and Gaps
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Planetary robotics is an important enabler of scientific exploration in environments where direct human-in-the-loop operation is costly, hazardous, or infeasible. However, developing and validating planetary robotic systems remains difficult because representative field testing is expensive, limited, and often unrepeatable under mission-relevant conditions. In this setting, simulation serves as a central tool for perception and autonomy research, synthetic data generation, system integration, and pre-deployment evaluation. Despite its importance, the literature on planetary robotics simulation remains dispersed across different simulation engines, implementations, and application settings. This paper surveys simulation works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy across four practical axes: Openness and Availability, Scenario and Platform Coverage, Sensor and Perception Support, and Environmental and Operational Realism. The surveyed simulation works report visual or physical fidelity and support perception-oriented workflows. They also indicate uneven public availability, rover-centered coverage, partial support for specialized sensing modalities, and uneven reporting of operational constraints such as onboard computation, energy, and communication restrictions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了行星机器人感知与自主性仿真工作，围绕开放性、场景与平台覆盖、传感器与感知支持、环境与操作真实感四个维度展开分析。
AI.motivation: 行星机器人是科学探索的关键使能技术，但直接人工介入操作成本高、风险大或不可行。代表性实地测试昂贵、受限且难以在任务相关条件下重复，因此仿真成为感知与自主性研究、合成数据生成、系统集成和部署前评估的核心工具。然而，相关文献分散于不同仿真引擎、实现和应用场景中，缺乏系统性梳理。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，沿着四个实践维度对行星机器人感知与自主性仿真工作进行分类与分析：开放性与可获得性、场景与平台覆盖、传感器与感知支持、环境与操作真实感。
AI.result: 所综述的仿真工作报告了视觉或物理保真度，并支持面向感知的工作流。同时揭示出若干问题：公开可获得性不均衡、以巡视器为中心的覆盖偏向、对专用传感模态的支持不完整，以及对机载计算、能量和通信等操作约束的报告不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 行星机器人仿真文献虽已支撑感知与自主性研究，但在开放共享、平台多样化、专用传感器支持和操作约束建模等方面仍存在明显不足，需进一步改进以提升任务相关条件下的适用性。

title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoHuB，一个面向自我中心视觉观测下多类人协作的仿真基准，含10个任务与同步VR遥操作示范数据，并揭示现有视觉运动策略在多类人协作上的显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 人类环境中的物理任务常需协作，但现有人形机器人基准多聚焦单机技能，缺乏在自我中心视觉观测下的多类人协作评估。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准CoHuB，包含10个任务（8个双类人、2个三类人），覆盖多种协作模式；通过多操作员VR遥操作管线采集同步示范数据，每位操作员从自身自我中心视角控制一个类人；并在该基准上评测代表性视觉运动策略。
AI.result: 代表性视觉运动策略在多种协调感知与控制形式上均表现出显著困难。
AI.conclusion: CoHuB为多类人协作策略的开发与评估提供了基础平台。

title: AGRO-SUVIDE: Agentic Robotics for Surgical Viscoelastic Debridement
summary: Augmented dexterity has the potential to reduce the fatigue experienced by surgeons during repetitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we propose the first AGentic RObotics framework for SUrgical VIscoelastic DEbridement (AGRO-SUVIDE), the repeated removal of small fragments attached to a viscoelastic substrate. Leveraging the self-improving and coding capability of agents, AGRO-SUVIDE adopts a modular framework. Specifically, the demonstration analysis module automatically identifies recurring skills from a single expert demonstration, using both visual and kinematic information. The construction module then builds each skill, either as a procedural model-based skill the agent codes against a scaffolded library or as a model-free policy-based skill. At runtime, the monitoring module composes the skills into a loop-style graph sized to the number of fragments it observes, then verifies pre- and post-conditions of each skill to decide whether to advance or retry. We evaluate AGRO-SUVIDE through 340 physical trials on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). AGRO-SUVIDE achieves an average single-fragment removal success rate of 85%, completing consecutive three-fragment removal at 60% and at 95% with one human intervention. It further generalizes to unseen five-fragment scenarios with an average success rate of 80% for single-fragment removal. Project page: https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/

AI.tldr: 提出首个智能体机器人框架AGRO-SUVIDE，用于外科黏弹性清创中的重复小碎片移除，在dVRK上实现85%单碎片移除成功率。
AI.motivation: 外科医生在重复性手术任务中易疲劳，增强灵巧性有望减轻疲劳；而反复移除黏弹性基底上附着的小碎片（黏弹性清创）正是典型的高重复性任务，亟需自动化方案。
AI.method: AGRO-SUVIDE采用模块化智能体框架，利用智能体的自我改进与代码生成能力：演示分析模块从单次专家演示中结合视觉与运动学信息自动识别可复用技能；构建模块将每项技能实现为基于模型的程序化技能（智能体针对脚手架库编写代码）或无模型的策略型技能；运行时监控模块将技能组合为与观测碎片数量匹配的循环式图，并通过校验各技能的前置/后置条件决定推进或重试。
AI.result: 在da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK)上进行340次物理试验：单碎片移除平均成功率85%；连续三碎片移除成功率60%，加入一次人工干预后达95%；并可泛化至未见过的五碎片场景，单碎片移除平均成功率80%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将智能体机器人框架引入外科黏弹性清创，验证了基于单次演示的技能学习与循环式技能编排在重复性碎片移除任务中的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
summary: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose *Action Upcycling*, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2--1.7$\times$ with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出 Action Upcycling，一种免训练算法，通过复用策略本要丢弃的动作，在不访问模型内部或额外采样的情况下自适应扩展执行时域，减少策略调用 1.2–1.7 倍且不损失成功率。
AI.motivation: 现代机器人策略从单次观测预测未来动作块，仅执行前缀后丢弃其余部分再重规划。执行时域长度存在反应性与效率的权衡：短时域反应性好但调用频繁。现有测试时自适应方法要么依赖模型内部信号（需针对不同架构选取），要么需要额外采样，增加成本。
AI.method: 提出 Action Upcycling，一种免训练算法，复利用策略原本会丢弃的动作，无需访问模型内部或额外采样。核心观察：只要动作速度保持平滑，被丢弃的动作与其重规划版本保持接近。算法据此将执行时域延长至速度开始出现波动的临界点。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务上进行大量实验，覆盖多种 VLA 模型乃至一个 World Action Model（WAM），结果显示策略调用减少 1.2–1.7 倍，成功率无损失。
AI.conclusion: Action Upcycling 可应用于任意分块策略，代价可忽略，且与少步采样、流式动作解码等其他策略加速方法正交，为策略加速开辟了新维度。

title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboFL 联邦世界-动作学习框架，通过 MoSAIC 将本地训练的 LoRA 适配器作为服务器 MoE 专家分支，并引入 FARD 与 PCEA，在降低通信量的同时提升性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作与世界-动作模型受限于稀缺、机构孤岛化且任务异质的物理交互数据。自然解法是联邦学习下用参数高效微调适配共享基础模型以避免交换全模型更新，但朴素聚合会纠缠不兼容更新，而将 MoE 路由引入联邦聚合可能稀释专精并导致专家选择不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 RoboFL，实例化 MoSAIC（Mixture of Slotted Adapters）用于联邦世界-动作学习。MoSAIC 将本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接作为服务器 MoE 的专家分支，服务器路由器在这些先验知情分支上学习 token 分配并联合精炼路由与专家参数。FARD（Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation）对齐模型三条路径的路由；PCEA（Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation）将完整专家更新转化为紧凑全局适配器用于个性化再分发。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 及真实 Franka 机械臂上实验表明 RoboFL 的优越性：在 Franka 机械臂上较集中式 PEFT 方法 InternVLA-A1 提升 12.23%，相对基于 MoE 的联邦 VLA 基线每轮客户端通信降低最多 86.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化专家装配的 RoboFL 能有效解决联邦适配器聚合中的更新不兼容与专精稀释问题，在保持个性化再分发能力的同时兼具性能优势与通信效率。

title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
summary: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/.

AI.tldr: NavJev将零样本VLN的在线导航从重复的多模态生成重构为视觉压缩加轻量类型化动作选择，在R2R-CE上以0.65 s/步实现27.0% SR与22.4% SPL，显著降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本VLN方法依赖MLLM在每一步进行自回归多模态推理，虽有效但推理延迟高，限制了具身智能体的响应能力。因此需要一种高效框架，在保持导航性能的同时降低在线推理开销。
AI.method: NavJev由两部分组成：Action-Centric Visual Compression（ACVC）将路点几何、BLIP描述和RAM语义标签整合为候选动作的紧凑表示；Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory（DASM）过滤共享语义并在导航步间保留具有区分度的动作特定证据。基于上述表示，Jev直接对可用动作集执行结构化概率决策，将在线导航转化为紧凑视觉压缩加轻量类型化动作选择。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE上，NavJev取得27.0% SR和22.4% SPL，每导航步仅需0.65 s，相比基于MLLM的VLN方法大幅降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.conclusion: NavJev表明，通过动作中心的视觉压缩、判别性动作语义记忆与结构化概率决策，可在零样本VLN中兼顾导航性能与推理效率，为具身智能体的实时响应提供可行方案。项目主页：https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/。

title: Graph-Based Simultaneous Path and Foothold Planning for Multi-Limbed Intra-Vehicular Robots in Space Stations
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Robot-aided operations in space stations are essential for reducing the workload of astronauts and improving the efficiency of on-orbit activities. Multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots (MLIVRs) equipped with grappling end-effectors have emerged as a promising solution, as they can securely grasp pre-existing interfaces, such as handrails and seat tracks, thereby enabling stable locomotion and forceful manipulation in microgravity environments. Since graspable locations on these interfaces are spatially limited and discretely distributed, motion planning for MLIVRs must be addressed jointly with foothold planning. This paper presents a simultaneous path and foothold planning framework based on graph theory for MLIVRs. The proposed method efficiently searches for feasible stance sequences for a multi-limbed robot while satisfying manipulability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through simulations in a 3D model of the International Space Station (ISS) cabin, demonstrating its capability to generate feasible and efficient locomotion plans in realistic intra-vehicular environments.

AI.tldr: 针对多肢舱内机器人(MLIVR)在微重力环境下可抓握点离散有限的问题,提出基于图论的路径-落足点同步规划框架,并在ISS舱室3D模型中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 空间站机器人化作业对减轻航天员负担、提升在轨活动效率至关重要。带抓握末端执行器的多肢舱内机器人(MLIVR)可抓取扶手、座椅轨道等既有接口,从而在微重力下实现稳定移动与有力操作。但此类接口上可抓握位置空间受限且离散分布,因此运动规划必须与落足点(抓握点)规划联合处理。
AI.method: 提出一种基于图论的多肢机器人同步路径与落足点规划框架,在满足可操作度(manipulability)约束的前提下高效搜索可行的支撑序列(stance sequence)。
AI.result: 在国际空间站(ISS)舱室3D模型中的仿真验证了该框架的有效性,能够生成现实舱内环境下可行且高效的移动规划。
AI.conclusion: 所提图论框架可同时完成路径与落足点规划,满足可操作度约束,适用于真实舱内环境中的多肢机器人移动规划。仿真结果验证了其可行性与效率。

title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/

AI.tldr: 提出MAIL-Bench基准评测VLA模型在相机中断下的表现，并提出MINT方法在视觉缺失下维持操作能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型均在任务全程所有相机可用的假设下开发与评测，但当相机在任务执行中停止供帧时，策略需在缺失视角下继续动作；该中断如何影响闭环操作尚缺乏系统研究，且具有重要现实意义。
AI.method: MAIL-Bench通过在每条策略成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同相机，衡量视觉输入不可用时策略的能力保持度。MINT在此基础上先训练VLA策略在视觉输入缺失下仍可运行；推理时选择性补充缺失观测，采用光流外推或动作条件世界模型，并在预测视图不可靠时将其撤回。
AI.result: 在π₀.₅和GR00T N1.5上，MINT在相机丢失条件下的任务成功率较原始模型显著提升；在AgiBot G2上进一步验证了相机丢失下的真机部署。基准已开源。
AI.conclusion: 视觉中断是VLA操作中实际且被忽视的问题；MAIL-Bench提供了系统评测手段，MINT通过训练鲁棒性与推理期选择性观测补充有效缓解相机丢失影响，并具真机可行性。

title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出VLA策略的失败模式由输出接口而非骨干规模决定，提出可拒绝且校准的决策头RCDH，在冻结骨干上实现风险感知弃权，在遮挡采摘场景中恢复分布外可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA（行为克隆或流匹配训练）被优化为必须输出动作轨迹，无法表达"我不知道"或"我不应行动"。在机器人采摘中，遮挡使单帧决策本质歧义：相同像素可能对应可切割茎干，也可能根本没有茎干。现有VLA被迫做出承诺，导致高置信度且后果不可逆的错误。作者据此主张VLA的失败模式由输出接口而非骨干规模决定。
AI.method: 提出RCDH（Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads），一种类型化、可拒绝、可校准的输出接口，可附加到冻结的VLA骨干上，无需重训练或新特征。包含两部分：(i) 带显式拒绝与有序条件分解的决策模式；(ii) 面向风险感知弃权的校准流程。在具有可控叶片遮挡的机器人采摘平台上，对比生成式、枚举式、校准式和可拒绝式接口，并进一步检验拒绝空间顺序是否关键。
AI.result: 仅替换输出头即可在遮挡下恢复分布外可用性，同时保持分布内性能；并验证了拒绝空间排序重要性的问题（结果显示顺序具有关键作用）。
AI.conclusion: 在不确定性下的可靠操作中，缺失的不是更大的模型，而是"拒绝的权利"这一接口；输出接口设计而非骨干规模是决定VLA失败模式的关键。

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
comment: The last two authors contributed equally as co-advisors. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail.
