Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric

AI.tldr: 提出EMPIRIC智能体，在物理引擎基础上学习"残差世界模型"：用程序代码补全引擎缺失的机制，并通过贝叶斯推断估计参数与隐藏状态，进而预测、设计与修订实验。
AI.motivation: 机器人在与陌生物体交互时需通过实验学习其行为并据此规划。物理引擎虽提供运动与接触的先验知识，但常遗漏整体机制（如胶水固化、水加热、风力等），因此不能完全依赖引擎，也不宜从零学习。
AI.method: EMPIRIC将物理引擎扩展为可学习的残差世界模型：学习得到的程序可引入新的力、约束和隐藏状态；用贝叶斯推断从含噪观测中估计程序参数与隐藏状态；模型驱动动作结果预测、信息性实验选择，并在预测失败时修正假设。
AI.result: 在五个仿真域中，EMPIRIC学到可解释、可复用的模型，相较三个基线用更少的环境交互解决更多任务；在真实机器人上学会风力与多米诺质量以完成操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 以程序形式补全物理引擎的残差建模，结合贝叶斯参数/状态推断与主动实验，是一种高效、可解释、可迁移的机器人世界模型学习范式。

title: QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning
summary: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂 QuadHand 与机器人中心符号距离场 MRC-SDF，结合时空全身轨迹优化，实现复杂环境下的安全 aerial manipulation。
AI.motivation: UAM 将机械臂与飞行平台结合以进行三维物理交互，但增大工作空间会加剧臂致扰动；同时现有几何表示在近距交互中难以兼顾几何保真度与计算效率。
AI.method: 设计 QuadHand：紧凑四旋翼 + 3-DoF 机械臂、夹爪及电池辅助被动质心补偿模块，用于抑制主要臂致扰动；提出 MRC-SDF（多关节机器人中心符号距离场），在可承受计算量下保留精细几何细节；并构建时空全身轨迹优化框架，联合优化四旋翼与机械臂。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，该方法能够在复杂环境中实现安全且可执行的空中操作。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件层面的扰动抑制与算法层面的几何表示及全身轨迹优化协同设计，QuadHand 与 MRC-SDF 有效提升了复杂环境下空中操作的安全性与可执行性。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

AI.tldr: ReCAT 是一种带结构化循环记忆的语言条件策略，通过 Mamba-2 循环记忆与因果注意力、流匹配 Transformer 解码器实现记忆依赖的机器人操作，在 LIBERO、RMBench 及三项真机任务上取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖型操作要求机器人利用当前传感器已无法获取的信息（如图像线索回忆、任务进度跟踪、事件计数、时间估计）进行决策，现有短历史基线难以胜任。
AI.method: ReCAT 由三部分组成：指令条件编码器从当前观测提取特征；循环记忆通过 Mamba-2 层与一层因果注意力整合观测流；流匹配 Transformer 解码器在每个模块中通过独立的交叉注意力分别读取当前与历史表征。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 95.3%，RMBench 62.4%，在九项任务中六项取得最佳或并列最佳。三项真机任务（空间回忆、事件计数、间隔计时）中最佳变体达 66.7% 平均成功率，而最强短历史基线仅 8.3%。消融显示观测编码器与逐块记忆条件化不可或缺；加法更新在计数与计时上成功率最高，delta-rule 更新在空间回忆上更优。
AI.conclusion: 结构化循环记忆结合语言条件策略可有效支撑记忆依赖操作；面向高效序列建模设计的更新规则在作为机器人记忆时表现各异，需按任务类型选择。

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练避障方法 NUDGE，将符号距离场的梯度注入扩散/流匹配策略的推理过程，实时引导机器人避开障碍。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略与视觉-语言-动作模型虽具备强任务能力，但缺乏显式的障碍规避机制，需要一种无需额外训练、可即插即用的避障方案。
AI.method: NUDGE 在推理时将符号距离场（返回各点到最近障碍距离的函数）的梯度注入策略，通过可微关节轨迹解码器支持多种动作参数化（绝对/相对关节位姿、末端执行器位姿），从去噪过程中引导动作远离障碍。
AI.result: 实验表明 NUDGE 在保持策略原有任务分布的同时，能够以反应式方式实时运行。
AI.conclusion: NUDGE 是一种免训练的通用避障框架，可无缝集成到现有扩散与流匹配策略中，兼顾任务性能与实时反应式避障。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Grafting，一种轻量空间模块，将冻结的三维重建特征绑定到机器人相对度量几何，并通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家，在不改动预训练策略感知通路的前提下提升多种 VLA/WAM 的操作性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略（VLA、WAM）将交互相关的度量几何隐含化；现有空间重建特征虽可靠，但只描述局部形状、不表达其相对机器人的位姿，且如何把这些特征送入预训练策略尚无定论。
AI.method: Spatial Grafting 构建度量锚定的空间 token，并将其通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家；保持宿主模型冻结、感知通路不变，且一套嫁接架构无需针对不同宿主重新设计。
AI.result: 在两个 VLA 与两个 WAM、四个仿真基准（短程操作、视觉鲁棒性、杂乱与长程移动操作）及三个真机平台（单臂/双臂）上验证。RoboTwin 2.0 上所有宿主均有提升：嫁接 π0.5 在干净与随机场景分别提升 11.3% 与 15.6%，达 94.0% 与 92.4%，超过最强已发表 3D 条件策略 WAM4D（93.8% 与 89.9%）。BEHAVIOR-1K 上六项任务中五项超过 2025 挑战赛冠军，Q-score 提升最高达 0.47，三项共同报告任务上平均优于地图条件空间策略。
AI.conclusion: 以最小侵入方式为预训练操作策略注入机器人相对度量几何，可稳定带来跨宿主、跨基准、跨平台的性能增益，且随任务时程延长优势扩大。

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.

AI.tldr: 提出 Boundary Feature Repair (BFR) 冻结宿主适配框架，在模态接口处学习任务监督的残差修正，无需重训检测器即可提升摄像头-LiDAR 检测器在传感器退化下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 相机-LiDAR 检测器即便两个传感器都存在、同步且已标定，仍会持续消费不可靠特征。现有方案通常需重训部署检测器，或依赖干净参考、损坏元数据、时序历史与在线更新，部署成本高、适用性受限。
AI.method: BFR 在检测器已消费的模态接口处学习任务监督的残差修正。BFR-C 修正融合所读取的每一级相机特征；BFR-L 将宿主条件化的 LiDAR 候选对齐到选定边界，并相对冻结锚点路由逐站点创新；两者联合训练得到 BFR-CL。零初始化的逐通道缩放使各变体在优化前为精确的检测器级恒等映射；仅修复模块参与训练，编码器、融合消费者、路由器、检测头与宿主归一化统计量保持固定。推理时无需干净参考、损坏元数据、时序历史或在线更新。
AI.result: 在完整 20 种损坏、5 个严重等级的 KITTI-C 网格上，相对复现的冻结基线，BFR-C 将 MVX-Net 的 RCE 从 14.07 降至 11.92，将 Focals Conv-F 的从 14.29 降至 11.00。在后一宿主上，BFR-L 将 AP_cor 从 73.65 提升至 74.48，BFR-CL 达到 77.01 AP_cor、10.46 RCE 与 86.02 干净 AP。在 nuScenes-R 上，BFR-CL 将复现的 MoME 基线 mAP 鲁棒性比从 80.1 提升至 81.4。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了边界修复作为一种有针对性的改造手段，可在不重训已部署检测器的前提下，应对"传感器存在但已损坏"的感知场景。

title: GuardPIBT: Counterfactually Gated Neural Guidance for Ultra-Large-Scale 3D Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: Large-scale 3D multi-agent path finding becomes increasingly difficult under dense traffic. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) scales well, but its one-step goal-directed ordering may become insufficient under dense interactions and large-scale congestion. We present GuardPIBT, which augments rather than replaces the PIBT executor: neural predictions only propose residual reorderings of PIBT's native candidates, while final actions remain determined by PIBT. First, local graph attention models nearby interactions, while global source--goal transport features provide population-level coordination context for candidate reordering. Second, a counterfactual group gate filters reorderings whose closed-loop effects may degrade coordination. Third, for ultra-large populations, population-adaptive grouping preserves decision granularity, asynchronous cached inference amortizes neural computation, and selective repair resolves long-tail agents. PIBT retains validity checking, priority inheritance, and backtracking throughout. Experiments with up to 100,000 agents demonstrate reliable completion across 2D and 3D environments, including all three 100,000-agent warehouse runs with zero audited graph violations. The project website is available at {\color{magenta}\texttt{https://guardpibt.github.io/GuardPIBT/}}.

AI.tldr: 提出GuardPIBT，在保留PIBT执行器有效性的前提下，用神经预测仅对PIBT原生候选进行残差重排序，实现100,000智能体规模密集交通下的可靠3D多智能体路径规划。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D多智能体路径规划在密集交通下难度剧增。PIBT可扩展性好，但其单步目标导向的排序策略在密集交互与大范围拥塞场景下不够充分。
AI.method: 采用"增强而非替换"PIBT执行器的思路：神经预测仅对PIBT原生候选提出残差重排序，最终动作仍由PIBT决定。具体包括：(1)局部图注意力建模近邻交互，全局源-目标运输特征提供种群级协调上下文；(2)反事实组门控过滤可能降低闭环协调效果的重排序；(3)针对超大规模种群，采用种群自适应分组保持决策粒度、异步缓存推理摊薄神经计算、选择性修复处理长尾智能体。全程保留PIBT的有效性检查、优先级继承与回溯机制。
AI.result: 在多达100,000个智能体的实验中，于2D和3D环境均实现可靠完成任务，包括全部三次100,000智能体仓库运行，且审计到的图违规为零。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差重排序与安全门控增强PIBT，可在超大规模密集交通下兼顾协调质量与执行有效性，证明了神经增强与经典有效性保障机制结合的可行性与可扩展性。

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/
summary: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DexAgent是一个智能体式Human2Sim2Robot框架，可将单段第一人称人类视频和任务提示转换为物理合理的机器人轨迹，用于策略训练，在11项真实任务上成功率比基线高3.5倍。
AI.motivation: 人类视频为灵巧机器人操作提供了可扩展的演示来源。但现有Human2Sim2Robot流程依赖预定义过程，难以适应多样化的物体属性和交互，尤其是涉及铰接物体和可变形物体的情形。
AI.method: DexAgent包含四个阶段：人类视频语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化和机器人数据生成。每个阶段通过从工具库中选择合适技能或在需要时开发新技能来适应任务与物体属性；属性专用验证器评估各阶段结果的物理有效性和任务特定要求，并反馈用于细化，防止错误在工作流中传播。最终阶段在仿真中改变物体和机器人状态以从单段视频生成多样轨迹，并对渲染观测重新贴图以促进sim-to-real迁移。
AI.result: 在11项真实世界任务中，使用DexAgent生成数据训练的策略成功率比竞争基线高3.5倍。新开发的技能和验证器被保留在工具库中，使其可自我进化以积累可复用能力，随着处理更多人类视频，处理时间减少。
AI.conclusion: 该自适应、验证引导的过程使DexAgent能够处理多样物体和长时程任务，并通过持续积累技能库实现自我进化。

title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
summary: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.

AI.tldr: P2P-T是一个数据高效、以物体为中心的框架，可直接从人类演示中学习工具使用，通过两阶段方法弥合认知与物理执行差距，在真实世界复杂工具操作任务上较此前最优方法提升73%。
AI.motivation: 扩大机器人操作规模的主要瓶颈是真实机器人数据的稀缺。现有利用人类视频演示的方法计算开销大，且仍需配对的人-机器人数据进行域对齐；同时当前最优方法虽擅长长程任务，但在复杂工具操作所需的精细、精确控制上表现不佳。
AI.method: P2P-T（from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation）采用两阶段方法：首先预训练一个以物体为中心的世界模型，以提取稳定的姿态先验；随后将这些先验集成到高效、姿态感知的底层策略中。借助现代基础模型驱动的自动化数据处理流水线，完全绕过对人-机器人对齐数据的需求，大幅降低整体训练开销。
AI.result: 在复杂真实世界工具操作任务上，仅需极少的逐任务微调，P2P-T的执行性能较此前最优方法提升73%，而这些任务目前对标准大规模预训练模型仍难以企及。
AI.conclusion: P2P-T证明了以物体为中心、从像素到姿态的范式可在无需人-机器人对齐数据的前提下，实现高效且精确的工具操作，为数据高效的机器人操作学习提供了新路径。

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出残差感知保形动作过滤（RACF），通过对固定标称预测器残差的保形校准生成运行裕度，用于有限模型动作投影，实现无需重训练的策略在线安全更新。
AI.motivation: 冻结的自适应巡航控制（ACC）策略在部署动力学与训练条件不一致时会违反约束，需要在固定策略下在线保障安全性同时控制计算开销。
AI.method: RACF校准固定标称预测器的残差，将其分位数转化为运行裕度用于有限模型动作投影；完成的转移用于更新裕度和候选选择，策略无需重训练。
AI.result: 在2400个控制器-试验单元的注册对比中，Adaptive RACF达94.3%回合安全率，较CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，投影频率由8.11%降至6.63%；对照实验显示残差-裕度注入带来4.54个百分点提升。匹配硬件评估中，相对Robust CBF-QP平均摊销展开时间减少21.2%（161/180对170/180安全回合）。
AI.conclusion: 刻画了一步残差覆盖与约束满足之间的关联条件，并量化了安全性-计算开销的权衡。

title: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
summary: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出低空问答（LAQA）任务与记忆质量度量方法GAE，构建以记忆为中心（MemCen）的无人机选择与功率分配框架，在仿真与真实实验中均取得高问答精度。
AI.motivation: 传统资源分配基于感知、通信、控制或计算指标，而LAQA需要显式度量"记忆价值"。现有黑盒式描述、检索与推理流程内部机制不可见，难以直接评估候选记忆对下游问答的价值，因此需要一种无需访问内部机制的记忆质量度量方法。
AI.method: 提出生成对抗考试（GAE）：用前向仿真评估记忆检索，并以"考试成绩"量化记忆质量，从而在不解剖黑盒流水线的前提下度量并优化候选记忆的下游问答价值。基于该度量构建MemCen框架，联合选择无人机并分配发射功率，在通信约束下最大化记忆质量。在噪声受限区域推导出QoM感知的封顶注水定律，将任务效用与物理层功率分配显式关联；并开发惩罚逐次优化（PSO）与"学习记忆"（L2M）求解器。
AI.result: MemCen在CARLA Town04与Town05中，静态与动态通信条件下分别达到92.4%与84.0%的问答精度；在真实世界实验中，于全景多智能体系统（PMAS）基准上取得88.5%的问答精度。无人机到机器狗的演示进一步验证了所获取记忆在环境理解与导航中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆为中心的度量与资源分配框架可有效提升分布式无人机记忆聚合后的问答质量，并在仿真与真实场景中验证了其实用性与泛化能力。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verify results, and revise from feedback as executable code. The same working pattern of explicit state, manageable execution, and revisable procedures underlies generalization and long-horizon execution in the physical world, letting physical experience return as reusable programs, memory, or evidence. We propose Physical Coding, representing task state and execution as code. Code as World records objects, relations, constraints, and progress; Code as Policy organizes planning, verification, recovery, and execution. We build HexaAnything, which calls perception, planning, and control tools, including VLA/WAM policies, and makes in-the-loop decisions from external feedback. Verified traces become data and memory, enabling evolution from tools and Harness to model weights, architectures, and ultimately hardware and task design. On RoboCasa365, HexaAnything improves Composite-Unseen and overall success over XR-1 VLA, and its Harness-trained HexaModel beats the base on every split, indicating code traces internalize physical execution. On PhyBench and a dual-arm AgileX robot, the agent autonomously completes physics experiments and most tabletop tasks, often faster than published results. We observe data, model, and tool self-evolution; future work targets weight internalization, autonomous redesign of architectures, languages, representations, and tasks, and deployment in manufacturing and science.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Physical Coding"范式，将物理任务的状 态与执行过程表示为代码（Code as World / Code as Policy），并构建了HexaAnything编码智能体，通过调用感知、规划、控制等工具实现可检查、可修正的长时程物理执行，在RoboCasa365、PhyBench及双臂机器人上验证了其泛化性与自演化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA与WAM模型将观测和指令直接映射为动作，导致策略与训练强绑定：布局或视角微小变化即失败，指令泛化差。其根因在于表征方式——任务需求、条件、进度与失败恢复被隐式编码在动作序列中，难以检验和修改。作者受数字编码智能体（LLM调用工具、验证结果、基于反馈修正可执行代码）的启发，认为物理世界中的泛化与长时程执行同样依赖于显式状态、可控执行与可修正流程。
AI.method: 提出Physical Coding，用代码表征任务状态与执行：Code as World记录物体、关系、约束与进度；Code as Policy组织规划、验证、恢复与执行。据此构建HexaAnything智能体，调用感知、规划、控制工具（含VLA/WAM策略），并基于外部反馈进行循环内决策；经校验的执行轨迹转化为数据与记忆，实现从工具与Harness到模型权重、架构乃至硬件与任务设计的演化。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365上，HexaAnything的Composite-Unseen与整体成功率均优于XR-1 VLA；其经Harness训练的HexaModel在所有划分上均超越基座模型，表明代码轨迹能够内化物理执行能力。在PhyBench与双臂AgileX机器人上，该智能体自主完成物理实验及多数桌面任务，速度常优于已发表结果。同时观察到数据、模型与工具的自演化现象。
AI.conclusion: 代码作为物理任务表征为泛化与长时程执行提供了可检查、可修正的路径，并支持从工具层向权重层的自演化。未来工作聚焦于权重内化、架构/语言/表征/任务的自主重设计，以及在制造业与科学场景中的部署。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

AI.tldr: 提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测的视觉未来作为持续的动作条件，并通过学习到的修订桥在反馈后恢复中间生成状态、调整其后续，从而在闭环控制中复用任务的时序结构。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型以预测的视觉未来为机器人动作提供条件，但执行反馈会部分否定预测内容；然而被否定的往往是局部细节，其任务结构仍然可用。直接丢弃整个预测或完全重新规划，都会浪费这种仍有效的时序结构。
AI.method: RTP 将视觉未来作为持续存在的动作条件并在反馈后进行修订。核心机制是学习到的修订桥：从视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态（checkpoint）恢复，并依据当前观测调整其续写。视觉与动作监督把该修订与后续控制相连接；时间感知历史提供观测证据；自适应策略在新噪声基础上选择保留、桥接修订或全新重规划，然后解码下一动作。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 与 RMBench 上，任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 与 84.8%。匹配对照实验支持学习式续写的有效性；对 checkpoint 来源与动作前缀效应的估计为正，但精度较低、分辨率不足。
AI.conclusion: 结果把反馈驱动的视觉规划修订与闭环任务性能联系起来，表明在反馈失效局部预测时，保留并修订时序结构比彻底重规划更有效；同时效应分解仍是待进一步精确刻画的开放问题。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.

AI.tldr: Uni-VLaT将全身分布式触觉信息集成到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，通过预测未来触觉、本体感觉与视觉表征来学习触觉锚定的多模态上下文，在五项真实机器人任务上取得75%平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在loco-manipulation中如何响应往往取决于物理接触，但仅靠视觉与本体感觉难以刻画物理交互，尤其在接触区域被遮挡时。与在预定义区域的稀疏力/力矩测量不同，分布式触觉传感能保留机器人全身空间分辨的接触模式，因此需要研究如何将全身触觉信息整合进VLA策略以支持富接触控制。
AI.method: 提出Uni-VLaT，引入一条触觉通路，其隐状态不仅用于动作生成，还被训练以预测未来的触觉、本体感觉与视觉表征。该预测目标构建触觉锚定的多模态上下文，形成对物理世界更结构化的理解。
AI.result: 在五项真实机器人任务（触觉触发运动、持续物理交互、人机接触、loco-manipulation）上评估。Uni-VLaT取得75%平均成功率，比无触觉输入基线高43个百分点，比无预测监督的触觉输入基线高7个百分点。在两种预训练VLA骨干上，Table Sweeping均提升30个百分点，Back-Tap Walking提升85-90个百分点。消融表明上下文化触觉预测与绝对未来目标是性能关键。
AI.conclusion: 预测式触觉学习为将预训练VLA策略扩展到全身物理交互提供了一条有效路径。

title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATok，一种因果动作分词器，将动作分词重构为因果结构化的生成过程，通过条件退火机制与基于MMDiT的流匹配解码器，实现与自回归骨干语义对齐的离散动作token空间，在多个基准与真实机器人任务中提升了重建-压缩权衡、推理效率与VLA成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归VLA模型虽有良好的可扩展性，但其动作分词器将分词视为压缩问题，所生成的表示与自回归骨干在语义上不对齐，从而限制了模型的生成一致性与性能。
AI.method: 提出CATok因果动作分词器：1）条件退火机制，通过逐步退火流匹配过程提取动作token，每个token以所有前序token为条件，并编码特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号，构建由粗到细的因果token空间；2）基于MMDiT的token条件流匹配解码器，从离散token重建连续动作块，达到混合扩散头架构的精度；3）该离散瓶颈在设计上强制知识隔离，无需显式注意力掩码即可分离高层语义推理与低层运动执行。
AI.result: 在三个仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务上的评测表明，CATok在重建保真度-压缩权衡和推理效率上持续优于现有分词方法，同时提升VLA任务成功率与训练效率。
AI.conclusion: CATok为纯自回归VLA系统建立了高性能、可扩展的基础，验证了将动作分词建模为因果结构化生成过程的有效性。

title: CoBrush: A Hierarchical Planning Framework for Human-Robot Co-Painting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Embodied co-painting requires a robot to repeatedly update a shared physical canvas while human intent evolves over interaction. Existing reference-driven painters or reactive assistants are typically optimized for single-shot rendering or sketch completion, limiting their ability to sustain coherent multi-round collaboration or to construct complex, content-rich scenes over time. We present CoBrush, a hierarchical framework that formulates multi-round co-painting as a coordinated semantic, spatial, and execution process. By separating high-level intent inference from spatial grounding and stroke-level control, the system supports progressive scene development on real acrylic canvases. We evaluate the framework through real human-robot painting sessions, stress tests, and user studies. Compared to single-turn baselines, our approach achieves stronger semantic alignment, more stable spatial progression, and higher perceived plausibility of robot actions. These results demonstrate that structured multi-stage reasoning improves the coherence and robustness of interactive painting and supports the progressive development of content-rich physical artworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoBrush，将多轮人机共创绘画建模为语义、空间与执行三层协调的分层框架，实现真丙烯画布上的渐进式场景构建，在多轮协作连贯性与鲁棒性上优于单轮基线。
AI.motivation: 具身共创绘画要求机器人在人类意图随交互不断演变的过程中，反复更新同一块物理画布。现有参考驱动绘画系统或反应式助手通常面向单次渲染或草图补全，难以支撑连贯的多轮协作，也无法随时间构建复杂、内容丰富的场景。
AI.method: 提出CoBrush分层框架，将多轮共创绘画形式化为语义、空间、执行相协调的过程：把高层意图推断与空间落地、笔画级控制解耦，从而在真实丙烯画布上支持场景的渐进式发展。
AI.result: 通过真实人机绘画会话、压力测试与用户研究进行评估。相比单轮基线，方法取得更强的语义对齐、更稳定的空间推进，以及更高的机器人动作感知合理性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多阶段推理可提升交互式绘画的连贯性与鲁棒性，并支持内容丰富的实体艺术作品的渐进式创作。

title: Robot Tool Design from Scratch via Behavior-Aware Hierarchical Optimization
summary: The ability to design a tool for a task marks a level of intelligence beyond merely understanding, selecting, or using one. Existing methods for robotic tool design typically optimize a tool's continuous shape and action within a structure that is prescribed or generated beforehand, so the structure itself stays outside the physical optimization loop. We study task-driven tool design from scratch, where tool structure, shape, and action are all derived from the desired physical outcome. Here we show that the three elements can be designed jointly by HOT, a hierarchical optimization whose upper level searches over discrete tool structures with BASS, while lower-level physical optimization evaluates their task behavior and returns milestone progress as behavioral evidence for the search, ultimately providing jointly optimized shape and action. On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.

AI.tldr: HOT 提出一种双层优化框架，将工具结构、形状与动作从零开始联合设计，以物理结果为驱动，在四个工具使用任务上高效搜索并生成可 3D 打印、可在真实机器人上执行的功能性工具。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人工具设计方法通常预先给定或生成工具结构，仅在固定结构内优化连续形状与动作，导致结构本身不参与物理优化循环。作者希望实现"从任务物理效果出发、从零设计工具"的目标，即让结构、形状和动作全部由期望的物理结果推导，迈向类人与动物的开放式工具制造。
AI.method: 提出 HOT（Hierarchical Optimization for Tools）层级优化框架：上层使用 BASS 在离散工具结构空间中搜索；下层进行物理优化，评估候选结构的任务行为，并将"里程碑进展"作为行为证据反馈给上层搜索；最终联合输出优化后的形状与动作。
AI.result: 在四个具有不同物理功能的工具使用任务上，HOT 仅评估了包含多达 5600 万个结构的搜索空间中的一小部分，即发现功能性结构；随后几何细化在所有任务上降低任务损失，同时保持成功率，且形变具有功能可解释性。将工具 3D 打印后，真实机器人在仿真得到的动作下完成了全部任务。
AI.conclusion: 从所需物理效果而非已知工具目录出发设计工具，是迈向开放式工具制造的一步，为机器人自主工具设计提供了可行路径。

title: ForVis: An In-Field Dataset and Benchmark for VIO Using Under-Canopy UAV Flights in Forests
summary: Visual-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for UAVs remains difficult to evaluate in real forest environments, where motion, illumination changes, repetitive vegetation, and vibration can all affect estimation. We present ForVis, an in-field dataset and benchmark for evaluating VI-SLAM during UAV flight in forest environments. The dataset contains twelve flights across open meadow, above-canopy, and under-canopy conditions in each environment. In total, it provides 563.8s of flight over 1096.8m of trajectory, recorded simultaneously with an Intel RealSense D435i and an OAK-D Pro Wide together with inertial and flight-controller data. We benchmark seven open-source VI-SLAM systems over 504 runs. The results show that sensor choice has a larger effect on trajectory error than the spread between algorithms: all seven methods achieve lower median error on the OAK-D Pro than on the D435i. ForVis is intended to support evaluation of speed, accuracy and robustness for VI-SLAM in challenging forest flight.

AI.tldr: 提出ForVis——面向森林环境中无人机VI-SLAM评估的实地数据集与基准，涵盖12次飞行、563.8s、1096.8m轨迹，双相机同步采集，并对7个开源VI-SLAM系统完成504次运行评测。
AI.motivation: 森林环境下无人机VI-SLAM难以评估，运动、光照变化、重复植被纹理与振动均会影响估计精度；现有工作缺乏真实林区飞行条件下的标准化数据集与基准。
AI.method: 构建ForVis数据集，覆盖开阔草地、林冠上方与林冠下方三类场景，各环境共12次飞行；同步使用Intel RealSense D435i与OAK-D Pro Wide采集视觉数据，并记录惯性与飞控数据；基于该数据对7个开源VI-SLAM系统开展504次运行基准测试，比较速度、精度与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 总计563.8s飞行、1096.8m轨迹，完成504次系统运行评测。传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法间差异：7种方法在OAK-D Pro上的中位误差均低于在D435i上的结果。
AI.conclusion: 传感器配置可能是森林飞行VI-SLAM精度的主导因素，其影响超过算法间差异；ForVis可作为挑战性林区飞行条件下VI-SLAM速度、精度与鲁棒性评估的基准平台。

title: Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向类月面环境的四足机器人地形感知探索框架，融合外部与本体感知建图，实现自主探索与低能耗导航。
AI.motivation: 自主行星探索要求机器人在未知、崎岖地形中导航，同时评估风险、可通行性与能量代价；四足机器人适合此类任务，因其能穿越不规则地表并在行走中采集移动性相关信息。
AI.method: 机载RGB-D相机建立以机器人为中心的高程图，估计几何可通行性并推导导航代价用于自主规划；本体感知测量提供交互感知的地形线索，补充基于几何的评估。局部地图增量配准为全局多层表示，探索模块据此在未探索兴趣区域选择目标，自主导航系统利用地图与代价层引导避障运动。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真中实现自主探索、地图扩展，并揭示地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间的空间关联；使用该信息进行后续导航时，平均运输代价（CoT）低于初始探索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 外部与本体感知融合的多层地图表示可有效支撑四足机器人在类月面环境的自主探索，并降低后续导航的能量代价。

title: Inspection-SPARS: Task-Oriented Sparse Roadmaps for Inspection Planning
summary: Inspection planning seeks a minimum-length collision-free robot tour that observes a given set of points of interest (POIs). Sampling-based methods reduce this continuous problem to a graph inspection planning (GIP) problem over a discrete roadmap, which is then solved using combinatorial solvers. Dense roadmaps capture diverse inspection viewpoints and motion shortcuts, and thus admit higher-quality solutions, but they induce large combinatorial search spaces on which state-of-the-art GIP solvers struggle to find good solutions within practical time budgets. Roadmap sparsification---restructuring a dense roadmap into a compact representation that preserves connectivity and path lengths---can alleviate this burden. However, existing sparsification approaches are either agnostic to the underlying inspection task, or strive to ensure coverage of the POIs without accounting for the quality of the resulting inspection plan. We present Inspection-SPARS, which is, to our knowledge, the first inspection-roadmap sparsifier with POI coverage and path-quality guarantees relative to the dense roadmap. To this end, we generalize the SPARS framework, a popular task-agnostic sparsifier, from purely geometric criteria to task-oriented ones, introducing an inspection-aware vertex admission mechanism that treats POI coverage as a first-class sparsification criterion alongside connectivity and path quality. Experiments in realistic 3D environments show that Inspection-SPARS reduces vertex and edge counts by 4-8x while preserving coverage, allowing the GIP solver to compute tours up to 25% shorter than with the dense roadmap or state-of-the-art inspection roadmap. More broadly, Inspection-SPARS shows that sparsification can be made task-aware without sacrificing guarantees on solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inspection-SPARS，首个具有 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证的巡检路网稀疏化方法，将任务无关的 SPARS 框架推广为巡检感知版本，在保持覆盖的同时将顶点和边数减少 4-8 倍，并使 GIP 求解器得到最多短 25% 的巡检路径。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的巡检规划将连续问题转化为离散路网上的图巡检规划（GIP）问题。密集路网能提供多样视角与运动捷径从而获得更优解，但导致组合搜索空间过大，现有 GIP 求解器难以在实用时间内找到好解。稀疏化可缓解该负担，但现有方法要么与巡检任务无关，要么只保证 POI 覆盖而不考虑最终巡检计划质量。
AI.method: 提出 Inspection-SPARS，将流行的任务无关稀疏化框架 SPARS 从纯几何准则推广到任务导向准则，引入巡检感知的顶点准入机制，把 POI 覆盖作为与连通性、路径质量并列的一等稀疏化准则，从而在相对密集路网的意义上同时保证 POI 覆盖与路径质量。
AI.result: 在真实 3D 环境实验中，Inspection-SPARS 在保持覆盖的前提下将顶点与边数减少 4-8 倍，使 GIP 求解器计算出的巡检路径比使用密集路网或最先进的巡检路网最多短 25%。
AI.conclusion: Inspection-SPARS 表明，稀疏化可以在不牺牲解质量保证的前提下实现任务感知，为巡检规划提供了兼顾效率与质量的路网压缩方案。

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 EdgeVLN，一种运行时感知、可直接部署的量化 VLN 模型，结合 4-bit StreamVLN 与轻量停止预测模块 LATTE，在 Jetson Orin NX 上实现可落地的边缘端导航。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 模型性能虽好，但依赖算力丰富的平台，难以部署到内存与功耗受限的机器人边缘设备。仅靠压缩无法判断模型是否真正满足边缘平台的内存、时延和能耗预算，同时保持导航行为。
AI.method: EdgeVLN 将量化后的 StreamVLN 与 Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor（LATTE）结合。LATTE 是轻量因果 Transformer，通过预测 Stop Action 验证器排名来改进实时停止判断，并复用骨干网络隐状态，无需额外视觉编码器或第二次骨干前向。两者通过自研 llama.cpp VLN 驱动执行，实现流式上下文重建与片上 memory token 剪枝。对预训练骨干从 8 到 2 bit 权重量化及多种推理运行时进行刻画。
AI.result: 在全部 1,839 个 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episode 上评估六种骨干精度与七种候选停止头。LATTE 在部署的 4-bit 模型上取得最高成功率 58.02%，超过 BF16 基线，每步仅增加 0.013 s 时延。四种 4-bit 格式成功率几乎相同，但每步能耗因执行路径相差 36.8 倍。仅 IQ4 NL 配合该驱动可适配开发板，常驻内存 11.35 GB，比存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍；INT2 崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 运行时选择、memory token 剪枝与量化对高效边缘部署至关重要，EdgeVLN 验证了量化 VLN 在机器人边缘设备上兼顾性能与资源预算的可行性。

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
summary: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出失败驱动的实-虚-实闭环学习框架F4R，将真实失败转化为策略改进，无需额外采集真实纠正示范。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型受限于专家示范覆盖不足及物理交互理解欠缺；补充真实失败示范成本高、低效、可能不安全且难以扩展。
AI.method: F4R先用智能体自动识别与诊断rollout中的失败；将每个失败重建为保任务相关空间与物理条件的交互式物体中心桌面环境；通过失败条件化的仿真-真实协同训练与重建环境中的定向强化学习精炼策略；改进后的策略重新部署，新失败持续反馈进入下一轮重建与学习循环。
AI.result: 在四项操作任务的真实世界评估中，F4R达到93.75%分布内成功率与90.0%分布外（OOD）成功率；在未采集额外真实纠正示范的情况下，OOD条件下比预算匹配的目标BC基线高18.75个百分点。
AI.conclusion: F4R证明以失败驱动、实-虚-实的闭环学习可有效提升VLA模型的泛化与鲁棒性，避免昂贵且难扩展的真实示范采集。

title: CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
summary: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.

AI.tldr: 提出CollisionSplatting：一种基于3DGS场景的GPU加速、概率启发的可调保守距离度量，可统一几何与视觉规划。
AI.motivation: 几何规划器依赖抽象场景表示而丢失视觉丰富性；学习式视觉模型缺乏几何可解释性与计算效率，难以将稠密视觉信息融入运动规划。
AI.method: 直接在标准3D Gaussian Splatting场景上定义简单、模块化、GPU加速且保守度可调的概率启发距离度量；结合学习式图像条件奖励函数，将碰撞感知代价与图像空间目标统一，并集成到GPU加速的MPPI与RRT规划器中。
AI.result: 碰撞分类性能与代表性基线相当或更优，同时碰撞检测吞吐显著提升、VRAM占用明显降低；在真实世界的视觉引导导航与操作任务中验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS可作为丰富感知与实时运动规划之间的实用桥梁，实现几何与视觉联合规划。

title: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

AI.tldr: 本文基于扩散去噪框架D4orm，提出面向多机器人轨迹规划的一系列规划器架构（解耦式、在线滚动时域反馈式、分布式），实现快速、可靠、可扩展的无冲突轨迹生成，并完成真实四旋翼与地面机器人的验证。
AI.motivation: 多机器人轨迹规划具有非凸、多模态、高维特性，传统数值优化方法计算困难；现有采样类方法（如MPPI）与学习型扩散模型方法在求解质量、速度与可靠性上仍有不足，且缺乏对大规模、在线与资源受限场景的统一支持。
AI.method: 以D4orm为基本模块：一种动力学感知的扩散-去噪框架，采用基于采样的优化，通过GPU等现代计算架构进行大规模并行采样，迭代优化候选控制轨迹的“形变”，生成满足运动动力学可行且无冲突的轨迹。在此基础上构建三类规划器：解耦式规划器（提升可扩展性）、带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器、面向资源受限环境的分布式规划器。
AI.result: 在2D与3D环境中的差速驱动与全向机器人上评估，D4orm类方法相较MPPI等采样优化方法及一种基于扩散模型的学习方法，能更快、更可靠地找到高质量解。进一步实现：十台真实四旋翼在障碍环境中的零样本部署、100台仿真机器人的大规模解冲突，以及六台地面机器人完全机载的分布式“终身”运行。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明扩散去噪可作为多机器人协调中可扩展且可靠的规划框架，兼具通用性、实时性与分布式部署能力。

title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
summary: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: MM-ABC 是一个面向移动操作的基础模型，围绕“感知—协调—想象”实现机械臂与底盘的协作，在多个仿真基准与真实任务上取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 移动操作使可达工作空间本身可被控制，但带来两大挑战：连续自运动下的空间感知，以及异质臂/底盘动作的协调控制。现有方法或用显式3D表征/预测式世界模型增强几何，或将移动与操作解耦为独立动作流；作者认为不仅需要解耦，还需支持跨流高效协作的表征。
AI.method: 提出 MM-ABC 基础模型，包含三部分：(1) 融合稀疏多层级 VLM 特征进行空间感知；(2) 仅训练期使用的未来分支，以世界想象与几何意图作为额外监督，强化感知与操作意图预测；(3) MM-APT，通过掩码联合注意力与 clean-action x-prediction 协调分离的操作流与移动流。
AI.result: 消融显示：将 clean-action 预测替换为速度预测使 RoboCasa365 composite-seen 成功率由 32.8% 降至 29.2%；移除未来监督或多层级条件带来更大降幅。在 5000+ 小时、40万+ episode、12 数据集、17 种本体上预训练。EBench 44.71%，RoboCasa365 61.2%，LIBERO 99.1%，LIBERO-Plus 82.8%（无扰动训练），五个真实任务平均成功率 83%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，跨流协作表征与未来监督对移动操作至关重要，MM-ABC 在仿真与真实场景中均验证了其有效性。

title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning
summary: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用策略的"结构先验"作为组合与技能之间的接口，并实例化为 APPL 框架：构建智能体将演示切分为可复用技能、为每个技能提出多个结构先验并训练/验证对应策略；运行时智能体依据接口选择并组合这些策略。在 MetaWorld 与 ManiSkill 上提升了分布外技能泛化并实现新技能组合，消融接口信息会显著降低性能。
AI.motivation: 少样本示范的机器人学习需要两种相互依赖的泛化：组合泛化（重组技能解决新任务）与技能泛化（学到的策略适应新情境）。但二者之间存在信息损失：技能"在哪有效"由其策略训练时的结构决定，而组合只能通过名称、指令或符号算子等描述看到技能，这些描述丢弃了该结构。作者希望弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 核心思想是把每个策略的结构先验作为"组合"与"技能"之间的接口的一部分。结构先验陈述行为依赖什么（例如抓取只依赖夹爪相对物体的位姿）：在训练中引入可塑造策略泛化范围，用语言表述则可告知组合该策略的适用范围。具体实例为 APPL（Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning）：构建智能体将完整演示切分为可复用技能，为每个技能提出若干结构先验，并针对每个先验训练和验证一个策略；运行时智能体在这些先验特定策略间选择，并利用其接口组合以达成新任务目标。
AI.result: 在 MetaWorld 与长时程 ManiSkill 任务上，APPL 提升了分布外技能泛化，并支持此前未见的技能组合；消融接口信息会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将训练阶段的结构假设作为连接技能学习与技能组合的桥梁。

title: LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Navigation and Systems (CINS), Dubai, UAE
summary: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 提出分层控制框架，用离板视觉全局导航与板载低延迟扰动抑制双环协同，解决两轮倒立摆机器人非对称抓取时的失稳与导航漂移。
AI.motivation: 两轮倒立摆（TWIP）机器人机动性强，但持续的平衡调节使板载里程计高度不可靠，难以精确导航；侧挂机械臂举升负载时会引入未驱动的侧向滚转力矩，在不平地形上问题被进一步放大，导致严重动态失稳与导航漂移。
AI.method: 采用分层/双环架构分担任务：离板视觉系统通过俯视ArUco标记提供高延迟全局路点导航，绕过里程计漂移；同时板载低延迟控制环利用惯性（IMU）与编码器数据抑制主动物理扰动，两者协同构成整体控制框架。
AI.result: 物理实验中，双环方法使自研机器人实现精确导航、抑制减速带带来的瞬态冲击、适应动态跷跷板坡道，并在窄轮距下安全携带负载而不翻倒。
AI.conclusion: 将全局视觉导航与板载快速扰动抑制解耦的分层控制策略，可有效应对TWIP机器人非对称操作中的耦合失稳与漂移问题，在多种不平与动态地形下验证了可行性与鲁棒性。

title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.

AI.tldr: Holo-M 是首个面向人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 的离散 VLA 模型，通过将动作 token 扩展进语言模型词表并采用分组离散扩散解码，在 SIMPLE 基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散动作 token VLA 模型主要面向机械臂控制，其人形机器人全身动作空间（腿、躯干、臂、手）维度更高且异构，带来了 tokenization、训练和实时推理方面的挑战，而先前 VLA 模型未能解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出 Holo-M，将动作 token 直接扩展进语言模型词表以内在利用语言模型。设计统一动作 tokenizer，将人形动作空间分解为四个身体部位专属 tokenizer——末端执行器、身体、手和运动学——以支持跨不同具身形态和数据源（人形遥操作、第一人称人类视频、仿真）的训练。为避免知识隔离问题，不采用独立连续动作专家。为满足实时控制需求，对各身体部位的动作 token 采用分组离散扩散解码，而非自回归。
AI.result: 在 SIMPLE 人形 loco-manipulation 基准上进行了大量实验，Holo-M 在通用（generalist）和专用（specialist）评测中均取得最高成功率，并以显著优势领先第二名。
AI.conclusion: Holo-M 证明了将离散动作 token 扩展进语言模型词表并配合分组离散扩散解码，是解决人形全身 loco-manipulation 中高维异构动作空间、多源数据训练与实时推理的有效方案，并将开源全部代码和模型权重。

title: RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation
summary: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a Komatsu excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboCompiler：一种图原生框架，将规范机构图编译为共享机械接口，利用闭链路径、解析残差雅可比、切线提升与作动端口映射，统一配置、运动、力与动力学建模，并可高效复用与局部更新。
AI.motivation: 具有运动学闭环、耦合作动器和变化接触的机器人，其配置、运动、力与动力学需要一致模型；但控制与仿真常分别重建这些接口，导致闭链与作动一致性难以维持。
AI.method: 以体、关节、坐标系、惯量和作动端口构建规范机构图；构造闭链路径与解析残差雅可比；通过秩检查延拓与校正求解可行配置；用切线提升将独立速度映射到整机与任务运动；用成对作动端口映射保持虚功；用约束曲率校正扩展到加速度与投影刚体动力学，涵盖浮动基座与支撑模式；支持周期局部评估、生成式雅可比和依赖感知复用以实现局部更新。
AI.result: 在Komatsu挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo和六UPS Stewart平台上评估物理闭环与任务诱导约束；高精度约束动力学和独立Pinocchio检查验证机械一致性；MuJoCo与Isaac Sim/PhysX执行展示原生接触下任务性能与模型复用；Kangaroo上编译使残差与雅可比评估时间降低96.7%，闭环rollout墙钟时间降低66.8%，且动力学与控制保持不变。
AI.conclusion: RoboCompiler通过共享机械接口和编译化建模，实现闭环、作动与动力学一致性，并在多平台验证其精度、复用性与显著计算加速。

title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
summary: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.

AI.tldr: DexRoam 提出一套从人类演示中学习移动双臂灵巧操作的系统，通过无追踪器全身动作捕捉与三阶段对齐，将连续耦合的全身运动映射到机器人动作空间，使人类与机器人演示能被标准 VLA 策略联合训练，实验表明人类演示显著提升策略成功率并减少所需机器人数据。
AI.motivation: 移动双臂灵巧操作需要在单条轨迹内持续协调移动、全身运动与手指级灵巧性，导致机器人演示数据采集瓶颈严重。以自我为中心的人类演示是可扩展的替代方案，但既有方法通过简化人体运动来降低迁移难度，恰好丢弃了这类任务所依赖的细粒度、耦合的运动结构。
AI.method: 1) 开发无需运动追踪器的捕获系统，仅用消费级 VR 头显与头戴式双目相机，无需外部相机或追踪设备，实现可扩展的全身人体操作演示采集；2) 在人体到机器人的迁移全过程中保持全身运动的连续性与耦合性；3) 执行三个显式对齐阶段——具身对齐、动作语义对齐与时间对齐——将捕获动作映射到机器人动作空间，保留细粒度全身运动，使人类与机器人演示可由标准 VLA 策略联合学习。
AI.result: 在不同 VLA 主干上的真实世界实验显示，人类演示在各类训练范式下均稳定提升策略学习：GR00T N1.7 平均成功率从 29% 提升至 56%，pi0.5 从 32% 提升至 57%；仅用一半机器人演示量即可达到纯机器人训练的水平。消融实验证实三个对齐阶段均为必要。
AI.conclusion: 人类演示在保留细粒度运动结构的前提下，对可扩展的全身移动操作具有显著潜力。
